article.articleHeadline: Ebola ar fi suferit mutații: peste 4.000 de cazuri în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola may have mutated: over 4,000 cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo strain, focused in Ituri Province (mining region) and spreading to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. By Aug 4, 2026, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths were reported; by Aug 7, cases surpassed 4,000. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with eightfold higher cases and sixfold more deaths than the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak at a similar point. Authorities fear possible mutations and plan studies with WHO to verify, given unprecedented severity. Two-thirds of deaths occur in the community; in Bunia MSF, 90% of hospitalized patients aren’t on contact lists, and contact tracing averages about 10 per case vs. an expected 40. Response shifts to door-to-door active case finding, stronger community engagement, and broader use of digital tools; remdesivir is considered, and Ervebo vaccination for Bundibugyo is being evaluated. Uganda reports 20 cases; UNICEF notes disruption to essential health services and routine immunizations in Mongbwalu.

article.articleHeadline: മഴക്കാലം= മഞ്ഞപ്പിത്തക്കാലം | Monsoon Health Risk: Understanding Hepatitis A and E Prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon Season = Jaundice Season | Monsoon Health Risk: Understanding Hepatitis A and E Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon elevates hepatitis risk, highlighting Hepatitis A and E outbreaks during the rains. Hepatitis A virus spreads mainly via contact with contaminated drinking water, food, milk, and undercooked shellfish; incubation is 2–6 weeks with two phases: an initial non-specific phase and a jaundice phase. Early symptoms include fever, loss of appetite, nausea, fatigue, abdominal discomfort, followed by liver enlargement and dark urine with yellowing of eyes and skin. Diagnosis uses blood tests showing elevated liver enzymes (ALT/AST); a preventive vaccine for Hepatitis A is available. Hepatitis E spreads through contaminated floodwater, environmental exposure from mosquitoes and pig excreta, and persists after floods. A three-dose Hepatitis E vaccine is available in India. Preventive measures include safe drinking water, well-cooked food, and routine handwashing with soap.

article.articleHeadline: عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بالإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 4,053 confirmed Ebola cases, including 1,850 deaths, according to a health authorities update. Of the affected individuals, 694 remain in isolation or receiving treatment in hospitals, and 793 have recovered. The outbreak is centered in eastern DRC, with ongoing transmission prompting urgent public health responses. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warned on August 5 that the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has become "more dangerous than at any time," spreading at an alarming, unprecedented pace with no sign of abating. The figures underscore a persistent, severe Ebola crisis in the region, highlighting ongoing challenges for containment and patient care as authorities monitor the evolving situation.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak intensified during the monsoon: TB operations will be handed over to the Microbiology Department, the team conducted an investigation.
article.articleSummary: Monsoon-driven surge at Junagadh GMERS General Hospital saw 201 patients admitted to the Medicine department, with more than 25 new cases during the season. Infections include viral fever, dengue, malaria, and gastroenteritis. A high-level review by the medical superintendent, senior physician, and nursing in-charge examined ward operations, drug and fluid stocks, and treatment protocols, while proposing patient-care aids such as a suggestion box, QR codes, and diet-care passes to improve responsiveness. Emphasis was placed on infection control and sanitation. The hospital announced that TB department operations will be transferred to the Microbiology department, with the local team conducting an investigation into this transition as part of the intensified outbreak response during the monsoon.

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد يودي بحياة 13 شخصا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad kills 13 people.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad: As of Aug 3, 2026, about 240 cases and 13 deaths (case fatality rate 5.4%) have been reported since the outbreak began in July, concentrated in Hadjer-Lamis in the north and in N'Djamena. About 50,800 people have received cholera vaccine since July 24. The first deaths were recorded on June 13. As of Aug 3, 2026, 11 deaths occurred in N'Djamena in August. Transmission is via contaminated food or water; treatment includes rehydration and antibiotics, but delay can be fatal. Ongoing challenges include limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation in Chad. The outbreak is occurring amid similar cholera activity in Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria.

article.articleHeadline: Lo ngại virus Ebola đột biến, CDC châu Phi tung chiến dịch 'gõ cửa từng nhà'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over mutated Ebola virus prompts Africa CDC to launch a door-to-door campaign.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be mutating, with the number of cases rising. As of August 4, the DRC reported 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths; Africa CDC later said total cases have surpassed 4,000. The Guardian notes this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, with current counts eightfold higher in cases and sixfold higher in deaths than the same period of the 2014–2018 West Africa epidemic. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya said WHO is helping investigate possible mutation, highlighting unprecedented severity. Over two-thirds of deaths occur in the community rather than in health facilities, and contact tracing is weak, signaling substantial community transmission centered in Ituri Province and reaching neighboring areas affected by armed conflict. To respond, health workers will shift to active case finding—door-to-door screening—while treatment expands to remdesivir and Ervebo vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: 'Amid blame for the spread of Ebola' the United States expands aid···Partners limited to 'Christian organizations'
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). On the 6th (local time) in Kinshasa, health authorities tested passengers aboard a vessel after a passenger suspected of Ebola infection died. The United States is launching a $2 billion partnership with Christian-based aid groups—World Vision, Compassion International, Samaritan's Purse and others—to deliver health and humanitarian support. The department called it the largest share of global health foreign assistance to faith-based groups in roughly 20 years. Eligibility is limited to Christian faith-based organizations, a decision that observers expect to be contentious. Observers say the move signals distrust of U.N.-affiliated bodies such as the World Health Organization (WHO). The step follows a broader U.S. trend of aid reductions that critics say weakened disease prevention and response capacity in the developing world.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad Battles Cholera as New Deaths Rise Despite Vaccination Campaign.
article.articleSummary: Chad reported 239 cholera cases and 13 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared in late July, with a case fatality rate of 5.4%. The outbreak is concentrated mainly in the Hadjer-Lamis region in northern Chad and the capital, N’Djamena, which recorded 11 deaths in August. Some 50,800 people have received the cholera vaccine since the declaration on July 24, as authorities pursue a containment campaign. Notably, the first cholera deaths occurred on June 13, more than a month before the official declaration. The broader African region is experiencing waves of cholera, including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Transmission occurs via contaminated food or water; most cases are treatable with rehydration and, when needed, antibiotics. Chad’s persistent water and sanitation access challenges hinder eradication.

article.articleHeadline: Exclusif - Kinshasa / Contrôle sanitaire à Maluku : les premiers résultats écartent la piste d'Ebola Bundibugyo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive - Kinshasa / Health screening in Maluku: early results dispel the Bundibugyo Ebola lead.
article.articleSummary: Seven suspected Ebola Bundibugyo cases in Kinshasa's Maluku district tested negative by INRB using the RP038 kit; samples from a boat carrying 955 passengers from Kisangani were analyzed on Aug 7, with results dispelling the Bundibugyo lead. Two malaria cases were confirmed by rapid diagnostic tests and will receive standard treatment. Seven samples will undergo multiplex platform analyses to search for other pathogens explaining the symptoms. Despite Ebola risk being ruled out, authorities maintain epidemiological surveillance. The alert relates to the Ituri outbreak in eastern DRC that began May 15, 2026, with 3,850 confirmed cases and 1,750 deaths. Passengers on the confined vessel faced potential 21-day isolation if positive; with negative results, they are expected to be free to move from today (Aug 7, 2026). The United States announced an additional $242 million for Ebola response and preparedness in DRC and Uganda, bringing total U.S. support to over $512 million.

article.articleHeadline: Điều đáng sợ nhất ở cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Scariest Thing About Influenza
article.articleSummary: Influenza can cause severe illness in Vietnamese children, not only those with underlying conditions. Dr. Pham Cong Khac of Bach Mai Hospital notes most children recover within a week with proper care, but flu can lead to pneumonia, dehydration, and in severe cases respiratory failure, myocarditis, encephalitis, seizures, rhabdomyolysis, shock, or multiorgan failure requiring ICU. High-risk groups include children under 5, especially under 2, with congenital heart disease, asthma, chronic lung disease, neurological or metabolic disorders, immune suppression, cancer, or on immunosuppressants; but healthy children can also worsen. Seek care for warning signs: difficulty or rapid breathing, blue lips, lethargy, seizures, poor feeding, dehydration, or prolonged fever. Vaccination remains the best preventive measure. In Vietnam, flu circulates year-round and peaks with weather changes; vaccines are updated annually, immunity takes about two weeks, and some children need two doses. Complementary measures: hand hygiene, masking, avoiding sick contacts, good ventilation, rest, fluids, nutrition; avoid unnecessary antibiotics.

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief 'deeply concerned' by speed of Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at unprecedented speed, with 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths across five provinces since it was declared in May, while the epicentre remains Ituri. Kinshasa has so far avoided the outbreak, but a suspected Ebola death was reported on a boat bound for the capital, underscoring ongoing transmission risks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the response must accelerate and move beyond community engagement to 'community ownership' as many deaths occur before patients are identified by surveillance teams. Unpaid health workers remain a major concern, with calls to standardise payments to frontline responders. The agency cautioned the true scale could be two to four times higher than official figures. Containment remains possible only if authorities move faster, boosting community surveillance and measures to interrupt transmission.

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ согласовала стратегию по сдерживанию вспышки Эболы в Конго - MigNews - Новости Израиля и Мира на русском языке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO agreed on a strategy to contain the Ebola outbreak in Congo - MigNews - News of Israel and the World in Russian
article.articleSummary: WHO and international partners agreed on a unified strategy to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, aiming to intensify coordination under national authorities to stop further spread. Since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported. The epidemic spans 51 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri province accounting for more than 87% of cases, making it the largest hotspot. At a Kinshasa meeting, WHO, Africa CDC, and others pledged to bolster support for health workers, provide PPE, and fund the response. The plan requires about $1.4 billion, with over $420 million already mobilized. Meanwhile, authorities intercepted a boat carrying ~200 passengers to Kinshasa from the affected Tshopo Province after a report of a suspicious death potentially linked to Ebola; a mobile laboratory was deployed for screening.

triage.notes: キンシャサへの疑い死者を乗せた船の拿捕・移動制限措置が報告されており、国内での渡航制限の動きも見られる。致死率は約45%と高い。

The first cholera deaths occurred on June 13, more than a month before the formal declaration. Across Chad, 239 infections and 13 deaths have been recorded to date. Several African countries are experiencing cholera outbreaks recently, including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria.

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला का बढ़ता खतरा, 330 बच्चों की मौत: यूनिसेफ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Growing threat of Ebola in Congo, 330 children dead: UNICEF.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has killed 330 children among 743 confirmed cases under 18 as of August 2, with Ituri Province being the hardest hit and disrupting essential health services. UNICEF reports children make up about one-quarter of confirmed cases but account for roughly one-third of deaths; under-fives have the highest mortality, more than double that of adults. Vaccination campaigns, maternal health services, and other care have plummeted due to fear and health-center disruptions, hindering access to treatment. Doctors Without Borders warns the eastern DRC situation is more severe than before, with rapid spread and no slowdown in sight. Since May 15, the outbreak has yielded 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths in the DRC. Separately, authorities halted a passenger boat near Kinshasa after a suspected Ebola-related death; the vessel, from Tshopo Province, underwent mobile-lab testing and intensified surveillance around Mongala Province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの脅威拡大、330人の子どもが死亡：ユニセフ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が拡大し死亡者数・症例数が大規模で、国際的拡大リスクや保健システムへの深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はイトゥリ州が最も深刻で、キンシャサ近郊での疑い例船舶検疫や他州（チョポ州、モンガラ州）での監視強化も報告されている。5月15日以降の累計症例3,973件、死亡1,801人と大規模。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد يودي بحياة 13 شخصاً - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad kills 13 people - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Chad is fighting a cholera outbreak with 239–240 reported infections and 13 deaths nationwide as of August 7, 2026, yielding a case-fatality rate of about 5.4%. The most affected areas are the Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and the capital, N'Djamena, which recorded 11 deaths this August. Since the outbreak was officially declared on July 24, roughly 50,800 people have received cholera vaccination. The initial fatalities occurred on June 13, more than a month before the declaration. The ministry notes ongoing transmission and a continued count of cases across the country, with the Hadjer-Lamis region bearing a substantial burden. In the broader African region, outbreaks have been reported in Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria in recent months.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラが流行、13人死亡 - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: チャドでコレラ流行が拡大しており、死亡13人・症例約240件・CFR約5.4%と重症度が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染による継続的拡大が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）にチャドは含まれない。記事末尾でCAR・DRC・Nigeriaでの流行にも言及があるが、これは背景情報であり本記事の主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en RD del Congo exige mayor respuesta y solidaridad internacional, señalan CDC de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo calls for a stronger response and international solidarity, according to Africa CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) worsens; since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, the DRC has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case fatality >45%), with about 776 recoveries. The 17th outbreak has expanded from 9 to 51 health zones affected. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya called for stronger international support to close critical response gaps and for studies on possible viral mutation. Major obstacles include limited contact-tracing capacity, rising community transmission, insufficient hospital beds, funding shortages, insecurity, and unsafe burials. Uganda is praised for interrupting local transmission, while 11 other African countries are deemed high-risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi and Somalia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、より強力な対応と国際的連帯が必要とアフリカCDCが指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模流行が進行中で致死率45%超、51保健地域に拡大し国際支援が要請されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。ザンビアは高リスク国として言及されているが発生国ではないため参考として含めた（実際の症例発生国はDRCのみ）。対象国リストにない周辺国（南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ、ブルンジ、ソマリア、コンゴ共和国）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: 雨天积水勿蹚水，国家疾控局提醒：积水暗藏病菌，可引发多种疾病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't wade through standing water after rain; standing water harbors pathogens and can cause various diseases, warns the National CDC.
article.articleSummary: Following persistent rainfall, urban waterlogging has become severe in some Chinese cities. People are wading through floodwater for convenience. The National CDC warns that floodwater in cities can damage sewer and wastewater systems and mix with bacteria, viruses, and parasites, creating a reservoir of pathogens in standing water combined with sewage, silt, and garbage. Skin contact or exposure through broken skin to polluted floodwater can trigger skin infections, dermatitis, and gastrointestinal (enteric) infections. Stagnant water also fosters mosquitoes, increasing the risk of vector-borne diseases. During rain, avoid wading through water; if you must, minimize skin exposure and time spent in water. After returning home, thoroughly rinse and wash skin that has been in floodwater and keep skin clean and dry.

triage.headline_ja: 雨天時の冠水した水を歩かないで、国家疾病予防管理局が注意喚起：滞留水には病原菌が潜み、様々な疾病を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾患アウトブレイクではなく、豪雨後の冠水に関する一般的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 特定の病原体や具体的な症例数に関する記載はなく、一般的な予防啓発記事であるため、感染症イベントのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠阳性率上升趋缓，总体处于中流行水平，南方显著高于北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: COVID-19 positivity rate is slowing in its rise, overall at a moderate level of transmission, with the southern region significantly higher than the northern region.
article.articleSummary: China CDC's weekly acute respiratory infection sentinel surveillance (July 27–August 2) shows the national COVID-19 positivity rate slowing, with overall moderate transmission. Influenza-like illness accounts for 4.5% of outpatient visits, higher in southern provinces (5.7%) than in the north (2.9%). In outpatient respiratory samples, SARS-CoV-2 is 22.3% positive, influenza 13.3%, and enteroviruses 4.1%; among hospitalized SARI cases, SARS-CoV-2 8.2%, influenza 5.8%, and human metapneumovirus 5.5%. No unknown pathogens detected; SARS-CoV-2 NB.1.8.1 lineage remains dominant. Southern regions show higher positivity; 15–59-year-olds have the highest rates. Influenza activity is low, dominated by B(Victoria) and A(H3N2). Rhinovirus and enterovirus positivity fluctuates, higher in under-14s; parainfluenza and other pathogens are lower, greatest in 0–4-year-olds. Since Category B management, COVID-19 remains a common, usually mild respiratory disease with 1–2 seasonal waves annually; vaccination and protective measures are advised, especially for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化、全体的に中程度の流行水準、南部が北部より顕著に高い
triage.triage_reason: 定例のサーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザ等）が季節的な通常範囲内で推移していることを示すのみで、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる定例の急性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告。新型コロナは通常管理下の疾患として季節性の流行を示しており、未知の病原体は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hướng dẫn phòng ngừa các bệnh tiêu hóa và nhiễm độc từ nguồn nước sinh hoạt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guidelines for preventing gastrointestinal diseases and poisoning from drinking water sources.
article.articleSummary: Unsafe drinking water in Vietnam elevates the risk of acute gastrointestinal diseases—diarrhea, dysentery, typhoid—and food poisoning from microbial contamination (E. coli, Salmonella, Vibrio cholerae), with possible viral and parasitic infections. Long-term exposure to heavy metals (arsenic, lead, mercury, cadmium) and pesticides can accumulate, causing liver and kidney damage, neurodevelopment issues in children, and increased cancer risk. The Ministry of Health’s QCVN 01-1:2024/BYT sets 85 technical indicators across five groups for domestic water quality: microbiological (no E. coli or total coliform in 100 mL); physico-chemical (pH 6.0–8.5, turbidity ≤ 2 NTU, residual chlorine ≥ 0.2 mg/L at point of use); inorganic chemicals (e.g., arsenic ≤ 0.01 mg/L, lead ≤ 0.01 mg/L, nitrate ≤ 50 mg/L); organic pesticides (17 indicators); and radiological (α ≤ 0.1 Bq/L, β ≤ 1.0 Bq/L). Preventive measures include boiling, sealed storage, certified filtration (RO, Nano, UF) meeting QCVN for drinking water, regular tank cleaning (3–6 months), annual testing at provincial CDC labs, and protecting water sources.

triage.headline_ja: 生活用水を原因とする消化器疾患・中毒の予防ガイドライン
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、水質基準や予防policiesに関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生事例ではなく、ベトナム保健省の飲用水質基準（QCVN 01-1:2024/BYT）と予防策に関する一般的な啓発情報。実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国の該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận ca ho gà trong mùa hè
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records a case of whooping cough this summer.
article.articleSummary: 10 whooping cough cases were recorded by Hanoi CDC in the last three weeks of July, bringing the year-to-date total to 87—about 20 more than the same period previously. Bordetella pertussis infection causes respiratory illness and spreads by droplets and contact with contaminated objects. Early symptoms resemble a cold—fatigue, nasal congestion, runny nose, mild fever—before paroxysmal coughing with potential red face, post-tussive vomiting, and noisy breathing; infants may have poor feeding, cyanosis, apnea, pneumonia, seizures, or respiratory failure. Cases are year-round but pertussis typically peaks in winter–spring; seasonal transitions and incomplete vaccination may raise risk in the summer–autumn period. Prevention centers on full vaccination with boosters (ages 4–6, 9–15, every 10 years) and maternal Tdap during the third trimester. Vietnam uses vaccines containing pertussis components (5-in-1, 6-in-1, 4-in-1, 3-in-1); household vaccination and hygiene are advised.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイで夏季に百日咳の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 百日咳の症例数がわずかに増加しているが、既知の疾患で季節的変動の範囲内とみられ、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 百日咳は既知の予防接種で管理可能な疾患であり、報告数の増加も限定的（例年比+20件）。ワクチン接種率の低下や季節の変わり目が要因として言及されているが、大規模なアウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: الكوليرا تودي بحياة 13 شخصا في تشاد والإصابات تقترب من 240 حالة - اليوم 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera claims 13 lives in Chad, with infections nearing 240 cases - Today 24
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad has claimed 13 lives among 239 laboratory-confirmed cases as of August 7, 2026, according to the Ministry of Health. The epidemic, officially declared on July 24, is concentrated mainly in Hadjer-Lamé region in northern Chad and the capital Ndjamena, where 11 deaths occurred in August. The case fatality rate stands at 5.4%. More than 50,800 people have received oral cholera vaccine since the vaccination campaign began as part of an emergency plan to curb spread and protect vulnerable groups. The first cholera death was recorded on June 13, about a month before the official outbreak declaration. The spread continues amid broader African outbreaks involving the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria. Cholera transmits through contaminated water or food and is treatable with rehydration and antibiotics when needed; rapid care is crucial. Limited access to safe water and sanitation remains a challenge.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラにより13人死亡、感染者数は240人近くに - Today24
triage.triage_reason: チャドで239例中13人死亡（致死率5.4%）と重篤な影響があり、中央アフリカ共和国・DRC・ナイジェリアなど複数国にまたがる流行が示唆されており、IHR基準を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは周辺国の流行として言及されているのみで主題ではないため、地域検証ルールに従いverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Cases Top 4,000, Deaths at 1,850
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of 2026-08-07, with Ituri Province the hardest hit. UNICEF reports 330 child fatalities, and notes that children under five have a case fatality rate more than double that of adults. About 694 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, while 793 have recovered. The outbreak is severely disrupting essential health services, including immunization and maternal care, across Ituri, threatening broader gains against malaria, diarrhoea and other treatable diseases. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the situation is 'more critical than ever,' with transmission spreading at an alarming, unprecedented pace and 'no sign of slowing down.' Children comprise roughly one-quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths, underscoring the disproportionate impact on young victims.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ症例数4,000人超え、死者1,850人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数・死亡者数が大規模で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な感染拡大速度、医療体制崩壊の懸念がありIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSF・UNICEFなど国際機関が深刻な状況を警告しており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの続報。マラリア等他疾患への医療資源逼迫も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ngeri! Dalam 3 Bulan, Wabah yang Belum Ada Obatnya Ini Sudah Menewaskan 1.800 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Terrifying! In 3 Months, This Outbreak With No Cure Has Already Killed 1,800 People.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 3,973 laboratory-confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces as of August 4, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 99 new cases and 52 deaths were reported. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral for Bundibugyo; only supportive care. North Kivu hospital bed occupancy has reached 139%, signaling severe capacity strain. WHO and Africa CDC urge a rapid, community-led response: boost early case detection and daily contact tracing to at least 95%; expand testing, referrals, isolation, and treatment; increase treatment centers, laboratories, ambulances, and safe, dignified burials; protect frontline workers with timely pay; strengthen infection prevention in facilities; maintain essential health services; ensure safe access to affected areas amid security and infrastructure challenges; involve trusted community leaders. Outbreak declared May 15, 2026; WHO PHEIC declared May 16, not a pandemic per IHR.

triage.headline_ja: 恐ろしい！3ヶ月で、この治療法のない流行病はすでに1,800人を殺した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで大規模流行し、致死率が高く、PHEIC宣言・医療キャパシティ逼迫が確認されているため、IHR基準の複数該当とフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEICを宣言済み（IHRパンデミックではない）。北キブ州の病床占有率139%と医療崩壊リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-KINSHASA-PASSENGER BOAT-EBOLA CASE
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reported an Ebola-related incident after authorities intercepted a passenger boat outside the city following the death of a former passenger suspected of having Ebola. On Aug 6, 2026, a staff member of the International Organization for Migration screened passengers by taking temperatures from the intercepted boat. The article notes suspected Ebola but provides no laboratory confirmation, case counts, or described symptoms. The situation underscores ongoing vigilance for Ebola in the Kinshasa area, with authorities investigating the link between the deceased former passenger and potential exposure. No confirmed Ebola case numbers are given, and no details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided beyond the interception and screening activity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国キンシャサ：旅客船でのエボラ疑い例
triage.triage_reason: エボラは国際的に懸念の高い病原体であり、キンシャサでの疑い死亡例とそれに伴う旅客船の検疫・スクリーニング対応が報告されているため、確定診断前でも即時のフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 実験室確認や症例数、症状の詳細は記事に記載されておらず、疑い例の段階である点に留意が必要。続報でラボ確認結果を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠陽性率上升趨緩　南方顯著高於北方 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The COVID-19 positivity rate is rising more slowly; the South is significantly higher than the North - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong).
article.articleSummary: China CDC reports for July 27–August 2 that COVID-19 positivity is rising more slowly and remains at mid-epidemic levels. In outpatient influenza‑like illness, positivity is 4.5%, higher in the South (5.7%) than the North (2.9%). The most common pathogens detected in outpatient samples are SARS‑CoV‑2 (22.3%), influenza (13.3%), and enteroviruses (4.1%); among hospitalized SARI cases, SARS‑CoV‑2 (8.2%), influenza (5.8%), and human metapneumovirus (5.5%). The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the dominant SARS‑CoV‑2 variant. Southern provinces show significantly higher positivity; the 15–59 age group has the highest positivity. Influenza activity is at a low level, with B/Victoria and A(H3N2) co-circulating. No novel pathogens or major public health disruptions detected; no new variants of concern. COVID-19 remains a common, usually mild disease; preventive measures include masking, hygiene, healthy lifestyle, and vaccination for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理局：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化、南部が北部より顕著に高い - 香港文匯報
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定例サーベイランス報告であり、新規病原体や重大な公衆衛生上の異常は検出されていない。既知の変異株・既知の疾患の通常範囲内の動向であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランスレポートで、新規変異株（VOC）や新規病原体の検出はなく、既存の季節性呼吸器感染症動向の報告に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya keeps vigil to keep Ebola at bay
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in DR Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo) since mid-May: 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case fatality >45%). No approved vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain. Kenya maintains round-the-clock surveillance at Malaba One Stop Border Post on the Kenya–Uganda border, screening ~1,500 travelers daily; over 50,000 travelers screened since enhanced surveillance began ~two months ago. Cross-border movement from DR Congo and neighboring countries drives vigilance. At Malaba, travelers undergo handwashing and temperature checks with overhead and handheld thermometers; those with fever are isolated, monitored, and samples may be sent to labs, with possible transfer to the Alupe subcounty hospital isolation center in Busia County. Busia County reports three suspected Ebola cases since late May (one in Malaba, two in Busia town), all negative. Challenges include bypass routes and misinformation; ongoing public-health awareness campaigns are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ侵入阻止へ警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のブンディブギョ株エボラ大規模流行（症例3,973例、死亡1,801例、致死率45%超）で承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、国境を越えた人の移動により近隣国への拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行とその越境拡大への懸念であり、ケニア・ウガンダは対応措置（国境監視）の主体として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン未承認・治療法なしという点は既存の公衆衛生上の重大課題として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكوليرا تضرب عدة دول إفريقية.. وفاة 13 وإصابة 240 شخصا في تشاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera hits several African countries... 13 dead and 240 people infected in Chad.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports 239 cholera cases and 13 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared in July (case fatality ~5.4%), with 11 deaths in N'Djamena in August. First fatalities occurred on June 13. The northern Hadjer-Lamis region and the capital N’Djamena are affected; about 50,800 people have been vaccinated since July 24. The country notes multiple African nations reporting outbreaks recently, including the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Cholera spreads through contaminated food or water. While rehydration and antibiotics can treat the disease, it can be fatal within hours if untreated. Chad emphasizes that modern wastewater treatment has reduced cholera in wealthy countries, but limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation remains a ongoing challenge.

triage.headline_ja: コレラが複数のアフリカ諸国を襲う…チャドで13人死亡、240人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドで死亡者を伴うコレラ流行が公式宣言され、致死率約5.4%と深刻。周辺の複数アフリカ諸国（DRC含む）でも流行が報告されており国際的拡大のリスクがあるため、IHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主対象はチャド（対象国リスト外）だが、DRC・中央アフリカ・ナイジェリアでも同時期にコレラ流行が報告されているとの記述があり、対象国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。DRCでの具体的な症例数や状況の詳細は記事内に記載がなく、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt kèm co giật, bé gái 7 tháng tuổi bất ngờ mắc viêm não Nhật Bản
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-month-old girl with fever and seizures unexpectedly contracts Japanese encephalitis.
article.articleSummary: Seven-month-old girl in Ninh Bình, Vietnam, diagnosed with Japanese encephalitis after a febrile seizure. She presented with high fever and a generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes; seizures persisted en route to care. At Bach Mai Hospital’s Pediatric Center in Ninh Bình, she was stabilized, and physicians pursued etiologic testing. A lumbar puncture revealed pleocytosis after the family initially hesitated, and brain MRI showed lesions consistent with encephalitis. Subsequent testing confirmed infection with Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV). Intensive care included seizure control, management of intracranial pressure, continuous neurological monitoring, fluid-electrolyte optimization, and nutritional support. After 24 days of active treatment, she became afebrile, seizure-free, alert, and feeding well, and was discharged with follow-up plans to detect potential neurological sequelae. The case highlights that fever with prolonged seizures in infants warrants prompt evaluation and timely lumbar puncture for accurate diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱とけいれんを起こした生後7ヶ月の女児、日本脳炎と診断される
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の個別報告であり、日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病であるため異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的と考えられる。
triage.notes: 単一の小児症例報告。日本脳炎はベクター媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染しないため流行しやすさは低い。地域的なサーベイランス情報としてはWATCH候補だが、単発事例のためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد.. 240 إصابة و13 حالة وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad: 240 cases and 13 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Cholera is spreading in Chad, with 13 deaths and about 239–240 cases reported since July, concentrated in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and the capital N'Djamena. The Chadian Ministry of Health notes a case fatality rate of 5.4% across the country, including 11 deaths in N'Djamena during August. Since July 24, roughly 50,800 people have received a cholera vaccine. The first fatalities occurred on June 13, more than a month before the official outbreak declaration. The report situates Chad within a broader West and Central Africa context, noting concurrent cholera outbreaks in neighboring or nearby countries such as the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラ流行:感染者240人、死者13人
triage.triage_reason: チャドでのコレラ流行はCFR5.4%と高く、周辺のDRC・CAR・ナイジェリアでも同時発生が報告されており、IHR基準のうち重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクの2項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドでのコレラ流行であり、チャドは対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは『近隣国での同時流行』として言及されているのみで、詳細な感染状況の記述がないため、DRCを含む対象国は主題として扱わずverified_locationsから除外した。ただし地域的拡大リスクの観点から今後DRCへの波及を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا تتجاوز 4000 في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. وتسجيل 1850 حالة وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases exceed 4,000 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1,850 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: 4053 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 1850 deaths, according to the latest health update. Of these, 694 patients remain in isolation or receiving hospital care, and 793 have recovered. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that the eastern DRC outbreak is more dangerous than ever, spreading at an alarming pace with no clear sign of abatement. Separately, authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people toward Kinshasa after a prior death on July 25 suspected to be Ebola-related. The vessel, from Kisangani in the northeast, was stopped at the Maluku River Port about 65 km from Kinshasa, where a mobile lab was deployed to test all passengers and crew. The 32-year-old man suspected to have died from Ebola left the boat in Mongala Province around 550 km upstream; no samples were collected there due to limited facilities. No additional deaths among passengers have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が4000人を超え、死者1850人を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ感染者が4000人超・死者1850人に達し、国境なき医師団が拡大の危険性を警告。感染者を乗せた船がキンシャサへ向かうなど国内拡大のリスクも確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約45%と非常に高く、MSFが警告する規模の拡大が継続中。感染疑い者を乗せた船舶の移動は国内伝播リスクを示唆し、早急なフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RDC roza los 1.800 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears 1,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases, with a case‑fatality rate of 45.3%. Five eastern provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, with sustained transmission and high virus circulation. About 674 patients remain isolated or hospitalized; 776 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 75.3%. This is the second-largest outbreak by cases in RDC history, after 2018–2020, and the fastest-growing since records began, yet far from the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases). The strain is Bundibugyo; CFR estimated at 30–50%. There is no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals; symptoms include severe hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. Uganda has declared Ebola-free after 20 infections (15 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者数が1,800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、死亡者1,800人・症例致死率45.3%と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境事例）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダはDRCからの輸入症例による感染で、既にエボラ終息宣言済み。ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ Quân y khuyến cáo cách nhận biết và phòng ngừa Covid-19 trước các biến thể mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Military doctor advises on how to recognize and prevent COVID-19 in the face of new variants.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, rising Covid-19 cases across Vietnam are linked to SARS-CoV-2 variants NB.1.8.1, XFG.1.1, and BA.3.2 (Omicron), nicknamed the cicada variant. BA.3.2 is highly transmissible; current data show no evidence of greater severity than prior Omicron strains, though immune evasion may cause reinfection in those previously infected or vaccinated. Early signs include sore throat and hoarseness; other symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, headache, nasal congestion, loss of smell or taste, and sometimes nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Covid-19 is a multi-system disease; lungs are most affected, but heart, liver, and kidneys can be involved. High-risk groups—elderly, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, immunodeficiency, chronic lung disease—require closer monitoring. Preventive measures: vaccination, hand hygiene, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces. Seek medical care for severe symptoms; avoid self-medication with antivirals or antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 軍医、新変異株を前にしたCOVID-19の見分け方と予防法を助言
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでCOVID-19症例が増加し新変異株（BA.3.2等）が関与しているが、重症度上昇の証拠はなく、一般的な予防啓発記事であり緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は医療専門家による一般向け啓発情報であり、症例数の急増や医療逼迫等の具体的データは含まれていない。新変異株BA.3.2は伝播力が高いが重症度増加の証拠はないとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Gurugram: Dengue tally now 13 with three fresh cases
article.articleSummary: Gurugram, 7 August 2026 — Dengue tally reaches 13 this year after three new cases, with no dengue deaths reported. The city also has four active malaria cases. In a rapid fever mass survey on Thursday, officials surveyed 14,537 houses and collected 93 samples from suspected dengue patients, taking total samples tested this year to 4,404. Authority issued 1,073 notices under Section 214 of the Haryana Municipal Act to premises with mosquito-breeding conditions. Heavy rainfall and waterlogging have created breeding grounds, with stagnant water in drains, construction sites, discarded containers, and waterlogged areas cited. Dengue is primarily spread by Aedes mosquitoes; malaria by Anopheles. Officials say they are monitoring vector-borne disease cases citywide and urge residents to prevent water accumulation, maintain sanitation, and use mosquito protection during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: グルグラム：デング熱の累計が13件に、新たに3件確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリアの通常規模の発生報告であり、死亡例なく、当局が通常の対策（サーベイランス、通知発行）を実施している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節の蚊媒介性疾患の通常の年次発生報告。死亡例なし、症例数も小規模（デング13件、マラリア4件）で、地方自治体レベルで管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : plus de 4.000 cas confirmés, la riposte élargie (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: More than 4,000 confirmed cases, the expanded response (General Paper)
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) reports 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, with 793 recoveries across 53 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for 86.9% of cases, making this the second-largest outbreak globally and the worst in the DRC since 1976. Authorities are studying potential viral mutation and other factors driving rapid progression, while accelerating trials of vaccines and treatments. No vaccine or therapy is approved for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is being deployed more widely in Ituri and North Kivu. A mobile lab supports testing after a boat on the Congo River upstream of Kinshasa prompted quarantine of all aboard; the deceased passenger’s Ebola status is not yet lab-confirmed, and the vessel’s origin (Mongala vs Tshopo) remains disputed. Manifest lists 250 passengers, but at least 300 were aboard; all aboard are being tested and observed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ出血熱：確認症例4,000人超、対応拡大（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例4,053例・死亡1,850例に達し、1976年以降最悪規模の流行かつ世界2番目の規模。ウイルス変異の可能性やコンゴ川船舶での検疫事案など、国際的拡大リスクと異常性が高くフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: コンゴ川の船舶検疫事案は感染拡大経路の懸念材料だが、乗客のエボラ感染は未確定。ウイルス変異の可能性を当局が調査中である点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Một chi tiết giúp bác sĩ chẩn đoán bé 7 tháng mắc bệnh nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A detail helps doctors diagnose a 7-month-old baby with a dangerous disease.
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) encephalitis diagnosed in a 7-month-old girl at Bac Mai Pediatric Center, Ninh Binh, Vietnam. She was admitted with fever and a prolonged generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes, with seizures persisting during transport. The emergency team secured airway and circulation and closely monitored neurologic status. Given the infant’s age and persistent seizures, clinicians suspected CNS involvement beyond simple febrile seizures. Lumbar puncture was performed after counseling, revealing CSF leukocytosis suggestive of CNS inflammation. MRI of the brain showed lesions compatible with encephalitis. Subsequent tests confirmed JEV positivity. Critical care included seizure control, management of cerebral edema, continuous neuro monitoring, fluid-electrolyte adjustment, and nutritional support. After 24 days, the child’s fever resolved, seizures ceased, she was alert and feeding well, with stable vital signs and discharge planned. The article underlines LP’s diagnostic value in suspected meningitis/encephalitis and urges timely care for fever with prolonged seizures.

triage.headline_ja: ある所見が7ヶ月児の危険な病気の診断に役立った
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの流行地域で発生した単一の日本脳炎症例報告であり、疾患自体は既知でヒト-ヒト感染もないため、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 単一の小児症例に関する医療記事であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病性疾患。

article.articleHeadline: Congo tests passengers after suspected Ebola death on boat
article.articleSummary: Ebola scare in the Democratic Republic of Congo as Kinshasa-area authorities intercept a passenger river boat at Maluku, 65 km upstream, prompting screening of more than 300 travellers after the July 25 death of a 32-year-old man suspected of Ebola who reportedly travelled on the vessel. A mobile laboratory was deployed; four feverish passengers were sampled with results due today (2026-08-07). Conflicting accounts place the man’s infection timeline: some say illness on board, others after disembarking; origins cited include Mongala province (no confirmed cases there) versus Kisangani, with officials differing on where he boarded. Separately, authorities plan to expand vaccination against Zaire ebolavirus and widen remdesivir use in affected areas, noting the current outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The incident underscores ongoing transmission risks and cross-provincial tracing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ボート上でエボラ疑い死亡後に乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い死亡例を発端に300人超の乗客を検査するなど、DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関連する新たな伝播リスクが確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染経路や発症地（Mongala州かKisangani）について当局間で情報が食い違っており、確定情報待ちの段階。現在の流行はBundibugyoエボラウイルス株によるものと報告されているが、今回の疑い例との関連は未確定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO dan Mitra Sepakati Strategi Bersama untuk Menghentikan Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Partners Agree on a Joint Strategy to Stop Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has prompted WHO and partners to adopt a joint strategy to halt the spread. The current outbreak is the second-largest globally by case count, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths since mid-May. It spans 51 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, with Ituri as the epicenter, accounting for 87.1% of cumulative cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus and Africa CDC leaders met Kinshasa officials to align response, stressing protection and support for frontline health workers through PPE provision and compensation. Africa CDC estimates a continental funding need of $1.4 billion, with more than $420 million already mobilized. Measures emphasize early detection, contact tracing, access to quality health services, and community engagement. Separately, authorities intercepted a boat carrying about 200 people from Tshopo toward Kinshasa after a suspicious Ebola-related death; a mobile lab was dispatched for screening.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとパートナーがコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ流行阻止のための共同戦略に合意
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は世界第2位の規模（症例3,973件、死亡1,801人）で、複数州にまたがり拡大リスクがあり、WHO・Africa CDCが多額の資金支援を要請するなど国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Kinshasa）でのエボラ流行に関するもので、他対象国への言及はない。致死率約45%と非常に高く、Ituriが症例の87.1%を占める点、及びTshopoからKinshasaへの不審死疑い者を乗せた船の拿捕事案は拡大リスクの高さを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Turns to Merck Vaccine, Gilead Drug as Congo Outbreak Worsens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to worsen, described as the fastest-growing outbreak on record. The response pivots to expanding use of Merck’s Ebola vaccine and Gilead Sciences’ antiviral drug to blunt transmission. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, together with Congolese officials, plan broader access to the vaccine and antiviral treatment in affected eastern Congo. The move signals a shift toward wider immunization and therapeutic coverage as case numbers rise, though the excerpt does not provide specific counts of cases or deaths. The strategy emphasizes accelerating vaccination campaigns and antiviral deployment to curb spread amid ongoing transmission in the region, reflecting intensified international and national public health efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行悪化、対応はメルクのワクチンとギリアドの薬剤へシフト
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で「記録上最速の拡大」と報じられ、国際的な対応（ワクチン・治療薬の拡大）が進められていることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高いシグナルと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・死亡数を示していないが、「記録上最速の拡大」との記述から深刻度が高いと推測される。Africa CDCと国レベルでの対応拡大が報じられており、フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Tops 4,000 Cases Amid Mutation Fears
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases as of 7 August 2026, one of the largest in the nation’s history. Authorities fear the virus may be mutating; investigations are underway to determine if any changes affect transmissibility or severity. The surge strains the healthcare system, prompting intensified surveillance, treatment, and vaccination efforts in affected regions, along with ongoing contact tracing and community awareness campaigns. Experts are monitoring genetic changes for potential impacts on vaccines, treatments, and diagnostic tools. The outbreak has renewed concerns about containment amid humanitarian and security challenges, and health authorities urge continued vigilance and international support to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、変異への懸念の中4,000症例を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ症例が4,000例を超え同国史上最大規模の流行の一つとなっており、変異により感染性・重症度が変化する可能性が懸念されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 変異の感染性・重症度への影響は調査中であり確定情報ではない。続報でのゲノム解析結果の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠阳性率上升趋缓，总体处于中流行水平，南方显著高于北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The rise in COVID-19 positivity rate is slowing; overall transmission is at a moderate level, with the south significantly higher than the north.
article.articleSummary: On August 6, 2026, the China CDC released the July 27–August 2 national sentinel surveillance for acute respiratory infections. The SARS-CoV-2 positivity rate is rising but slowing, with overall transmission at a moderate level; the main circulating lineage remains NB.1.8.1. Positivity is notably higher in southern provinces than in northern ones. The influenza-like illness (ILI) proportion among total outpatient and emergency visits is 4.5% nationwide, 5.7% in the south and 2.9% in the north. Among outpatient/ED ILI samples, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2 22.3%, influenza virus 13.3%, and enterovirus 4.1%. Among hospitalized SARI patients, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2 8.2%, influenza virus 5.8%, and human metapneumovirus 5.5%.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化、全体は中程度の流行水準、南部が北部より顕著に高い
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の定期サーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス、hMPV）の通常の流行状況を示すもので、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる定期的な急性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、既知病原体の季節的変動を示す通常の公衆衛生情報。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例超4000例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths and 793 recoveries as of Aug. 5, 2026, per the DRC health ministry. Africa CDC director Kasaye warned that actual infections may be higher than reported, noting unprecedented outbreak severity and planned studies to check for possible viral mutation. The main challenge cited is not funding but mobilizing affected communities, including local leaders, women, and youth organizations. The WHO and Africa CDC urged intensified, community-led responses: early case finding, contact tracing, accessible healthcare, support for frontline workers, and faster aid delivery. Separately, Kinshasa authorities intercepted a riverboat about 65 km from Kinshasa after a passenger developed symptoms and died post-disembarkation; the manifest lists 250 passengers, possibly 300 aboard, with ongoing verification to prevent spread into the capital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が4000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000例超・死者1,850人に達し、ウイルス変異の懸念や首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクも報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: Africa CDCはウイルス変異の可能性を調査中と警告。首都キンシャサへの流入阻止のため河川船舶を検疫。前例のない規模の流行とされ、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreading at 'unprecedented speed', says WHO boss
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at unprecedented speed, with nearly 3,900 confirmed infections and more than 1,700 deaths across five provinces, led by Ituri as the epicenter. The World Health Organization warns the true case load could be several times higher, with many infections undetected as contact tracing misses transmission chains; 80% of community deaths occur outside the listed contacts. Frontline responders work in dangerous conditions, while some staff strike over unpaid allowances even as teams disinfect homes of Ebola victims. Insecurity and attacks on treatment centers slow the response. Authorities intercepted a river boat carrying about 200 passengers after a traveler showed Ebola symptoms, highlighting the risk of spread toward Kinshasa. WHO Director-General Tedros says the outbreak can be stopped if the response outruns the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が『前例のない速さ』で拡大していると WHO トップが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で約3,900人感染・1,700人以上死亡というエボラ流行がWHOにより『前例のない速さ』と警告され、キンシャサへの拡大リスクや治安上の対応困難も指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接コメントしており、致死率・拡大速度・治安リスク（治療センターへの攻撃、資金未払いによるストライキ）など複数の懸念要因が確認される。キンシャサへの拡大兆候（河川船での感染疑い者の発見）は国際的拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: 食腦蟲｜男子泰國狂食生醃海鮮染「食腦蟲」腸道嚴重潰爛 反覆大出血休克險死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brain-Eating Worm (Angiostrongylus cantonensis): Thai Man's Binge on Raw, Brined Seafood Causes Severe Intestinal Ulceration, Recurrent Massive Bleeding and Shock, Nearly Died
article.articleSummary: One Shanghai man, Xu (pseudonym), contracted Entamoeba histolytica after extensive consumption of raw and brined seafood during a business trip to Thailand. Upon return, he developed fulminant amebic enteritis with widespread intestinal ulcers, recurrent massive bleeding, and septic shock. Despite multiple surgeries, he remained critically ill, with severe inflammation, coagulation dysfunction, and hemoglobin dropping below 6 g/dL, risking intestinal perforation and death. He was transferred to Shanghai Public Health Clinical Center for emergency care, where a personalized, multidisciplinary treatment plan over more than 30 days controlled bleeding and infection, ultimately achieving survival. Entamoeba histolytica infections are common in tropical/subtropical regions; foodborne exposure through raw seafood is a notable risk. Travelers are advised to enforce strict food and water hygiene and seek urgent care for severe abdominal pain, diarrhea, or vomiting, especially in hot weather. The report also notes parasitic risks associated with seafood consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 食脳虫｜男性がタイで生の塩漬け海鮮を大量摂取し「食脳虫」感染、腸管が重度潰瘍化 繰り返す大量出血でショック状態に陥り九死に一生
triage.triage_reason: 単一の渡航者（個人）における赤痢アメーバ感染の重症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の広範な脅威を示す情報はない。散発的な食品媒介感染事例として社会的関心・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 感染は上海在住の男性がタイ出張中に生の海鮮を摂取したことで発症した個別症例。赤痢アメーバ（Entamoeba histolytica）はヒト-ヒト感染が主体ではなく、食品媒介性の散発例。中国（上海）は治療地であり感染発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını büyüyor: Virüs mutasyona uğramış olabilir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is growing: The virus may have mutated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) linked to the Bundibugyo strain exceeds 4,000 confirmed cases, with 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths reported as of August 4, 2026; Africa CDC director confirms the total surpassed 4,000. The January-present outbreak, first reported May 15, is the second-largest on record, with mutation investigations planned by Africa CDC and WHO as authorities escalate the response. Contact tracing is weak (expected 40 contacts per patient, only about 10 identified), prompting a shift to active case finding with door-to-door visits by community health workers in Ituri (Bunia) and across North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; Uganda reports 20 cases linked to the outbreak. Remdesivir will be used for humanitarian reasons; Ervebo vaccine’s applicability against Bundibugyo is being tested. A suspected Ebola death on a boat near Kinshasa triggers investigations. UNICEF warns of service disruptions and measles vaccination drop to 69% in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大：ウイルスが変異した可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（症例4000超、死者1800超）が拡大しており、変異の可能性やウガンダへの越境伝播も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例波及（20例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。麻疹ワクチン接種率低下（Mongbwalu 69%）も副次的懸念として言及されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Delhi logs 1,349 swine flu, 1,379 dengue cases this monsoon; no fatalities
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Delhi reports 1,349 H1N1 swine‑flu cases this season with no deaths, up from 229 by September last year. Dengue totals reach 1,379 cases, including about 200 patients from outside Delhi. Health authorities say hospitals are fully prepared, with regular H1N1 testing and all patients under treatment; many have recovered and gone home, with no mishaps attributed to dengue or H1N1. Monsoon season coincides with rising case counts, and officials are urged to monitor hotspot areas and ensure prompt treatment. H1N1 symptoms described include fever and related signs such as body aches, chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose, eye irritation, fatigue, and, in children, diarrhea. The article notes ongoing testing and vigilance across the capital, including dengue cases imported from outside Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで今モンスーン期に豚インフルエンザ1,349件、デング熱1,379件を確認、死亡例なし
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1・デング熱の症例増加だが死亡例なく医療体制も対応可能とされており、IHR基準の該当は低いが、モンスーン期の流行状況として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、病院は対応可能と報告されており重篤度は低い。モンスーン季節性の増加としてホットスポット監視が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak crosses 4,000 cases as UNICEF raises alarm
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, according to health authorities on 2026-08-07. UNICEF reports 330 children have died. Of the confirmed cases, 694 patients remain in isolation or hospital care, while 793 have recovered. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the eastern DRC outbreak is 'more critical than ever,' with transmission accelerating at an unprecedented pace and no signs of slowing. The update underscores sustained transmission in the eastern region, highlighting the heavy burden on healthcare facilities as isolation and treatment capacity remains stretched. No details are given on infection source or imported or exported cases in the article. This marks a high-severity phase of the current outbreak, with international aid groups warning of continued spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4,000症例を突破、UNICEFが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000症例・1,850死亡と大規模化し、MSFが感染拡大加速と医療体制逼迫を警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: MSFやUNICEFなど国際機関が介入・警告を発しており、東部DRCでの感染拡大が継続中。医療体制の逼迫が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉毒株「恐已突變」！　民主剛果確診破4000例、1800死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus strain may have mutated! Democratic Republic of the Congo records over 4,000 confirmed cases, 1,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo strain. By Aug 4, Africa CDC reports 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths; total cases have surpassed 4,000. Began May 15, this is the second-largest outbreak on record, far exceeding the 2014–2016 West Africa pandemic (28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths). Officials warn of a possible viral mutation and will conduct urgent studies. Community transmission dominates, with over two-thirds of deaths occurring outside facilities; in Bunia, Ituri Province, MSF reports about 90% of admitted patients were not on official contact lists, signaling hidden spread. A suspected death aboard a northeast-to-Kinshasa boat prompted quarantine and testing of all passengers. UNICEF notes a 69% drop in measles vaccination in Mongbwalu. Remdesivir will be used under compassionate use, and Ervebo vaccine may be evaluated for emergency use.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス株が「変異した恐れ」！　コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例4000例超、死者1800人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例4000超、死者1800超）で史上第2位の規模、コミュニティ内伝播が拡大しウイルス変異の懸念もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 麻疹（Measles）はUNICEF報告のMongbwalu地区でのワクチン接種率69%低下として付随的に言及されているが、主題はエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。ウイルス変異の可能性、船舶での検疫、Remdesivir・Erveboワクチンの緊急使用検討など複数の懸念材料あり。Angolaは地図上の周辺国として表示されているが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola threatens internally displaced person camps in the DRC, yet Christians continue to minister
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Ebola outbreak threatens internally displaced person (IDP) camps in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, where about 20,000 displaced people live amid ongoing violence; thousands have fled one crisis only to confront another. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids, and IDP camps suffer very poor sanitation, with soap scarce and latrines often emptied by hand. Government measures to dispose of Ebola victims and limit traditional funerals have sparked family unrest over burial practices. Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) continues to minister in IDP camps, providing food, teaching, language-learning, counseling, and flying in needed medical supplies to support outbreak response. The article ties the situation to the broader post–Second Congo War context, noting widespread displacement and the strain on humanitarian efforts during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の国内避難民キャンプを脅かす中、キリスト教徒は支援活動を続ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの過密なIDPキャンプ（衛生状態劣悪）で拡大するリスクがあり、重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の観点から懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は宗教系メディア(MNN)によるもので、既知のDRC国内避難民キャンプでのエボラ流行を背景にした人道支援活動の報告。新規発生報告ではなく既存アウトブレイクの継続状況を示すため、続報で公式統計・WHO報告の確認が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: 哨点医院新冠阳性率冲到22.3%仍排第一，但升势在趋缓了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sentinel hospitals' COVID-19 positivity rate surges to 22.3% and remains the highest, but the upward trend is easing.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity among sentinel hospitals’ outpatient and emergency visits reached 22.3% in Week 31 of 2026 (July 27–August 2), remaining the top pathogen, though the rise is slowing. Influenza viruses and enteroviruses followed at 13.3% and 4.1%, each with declines versus the prior week. Among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases, COVID-19 positivity was 8.2% (down 1.3 pp), influenza 5.8% (down 0.4 pp), and human metapneumovirus 5.5% (up 1.3 pp). No unknown pathogens detected; NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the dominant strain. Southern provinces show higher positivity than northern regions; 15–59-year-olds have the highest infection rate. Influenza activity is low, driven mainly by B Victoria and A(H3N2) subtypes. Rhinovirus and enterovirus positivity fluctuated downward, especially in ≤14-year-olds; parainfluenza declined. Public health measures—masking, good hygiene, vaccination—are encouraged; antivirals are effective; elderly and chronically ill remain high-risk.

triage.headline_ja: 哨点医院新冠陽性率22.3%に達し依然トップ、ただし上昇傾向は鈍化
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内でCOVID-19の定点医療機関陽性率が高水準だが上昇は鈍化しており、既知の変異株（NB.1.8.1）による季節的流行と考えられ、国際的な異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は現時点で明確ではない。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株（NB.1.8.1）による季節性の呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、重症度や異常性の増大は認められない。継続的なモニタリングが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: PhilHealth offers leptospirosis benefit package
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis benefit package launched by PhilHealth amid widespread flooding in the Philippines. The state insurer offers medical consultation and laboratory tests at Yakap clinics for floodwaters waders; doxycycline may be dispensed free of charge at Gamot facilities. For moderate to severe leptospirosis, PhilHealth's benefit packages range from P170,000 to P411,000, covering room and board, diagnostic imaging, medications, laboratory tests, and oxygen therapy. The Department of Health warned the public about leptospirosis risk on Aug 6, 2026, as torrential rains continue. DOH had recorded 2,877 leptospirosis cases nationwide as of July 18. The initiative aims to assist flood-hit individuals at risk and emphasizes timely action when wading through floodwaters; do not neglect health.

triage.headline_ja: フィルヘルス、レプトスピラ症給付パッケージを提供
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症症例が2,877件確認され、政府（DOH・PhilHealth）が給付制度を新設するなど積極的な対応を行っており、社会的・行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年雨季・洪水期にフィリピンで発生する季節性疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。今回はDOHとPhilHealthによる既存の対応強化が主眼であり、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के प्रकोप से अब तक 1850 की मौत, बच्चों पर सबसे ज्यादा असर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed 1,850 people so far, with children most affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has intensified, with 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths reported as of August 7, 2026. Of the patients, 694 remain isolated or hospitalized, and 793 have recovered. Ituri province is the most affected region. UNICEF notes 330 child deaths to date; children account for about a quarter of confirmed infections but roughly one-third of fatalities, with under-5s bearing the highest mortality. Fear and health-centre closures are driving families away from care, undermining vaccination, maternal health, and other essential services. Médecins Sans Frontières and Doctors Without Borders warn that the eastern DRC outbreak is advancing at an unprecedented pace, with bed shortages, overwhelmed health staff, and community fear hindering timely treatment. The report highlights strain on the wider health system and risk to other treatable conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、これまでに1850人が死亡、子供が最も影響を受けている
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC東部で急拡大しており、症例数・死亡者数ともに大規模で、医療体制崩壊のリスクが高いためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: MSF/国境なき医師団が前例のない速さでの拡大を警告しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。ワクチン接種や母子保健など他の医療サービスへの影響も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại Congo vượt khả năng kiểm soát, tỷ lệ tử vong 45%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo spirals out of control, 45% fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: As of August 3, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, has 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths (45% CFR). Ituri province is the epicenter, with spread from Mongbwalu health zone to five other provinces across 49 health zones. This is the largest outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally since the West Africa 2014–2016 epidemic (28,000 cases, 11,000 deaths). Transmission begins from fruit bats to humans, then human-to-human via contact with blood and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early fever, fatigue, and muscle pain progress to gastrointestinal symptoms, multiorgan failure, and bleeding. No licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. MSF warns the outbreak remains alarmingly spreading; contact tracing is hampered, with 60–70% of new infections outside monitoring lists. Bunia, Ituri’s capital, faces healthcare worker strikes over late salaries, worsening access. CDC Africa and WHO urge urgent, coordinated, community-centered action to reach all areas and protect health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、制御不能に陥り致死率45%に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、致死率45%、49保健地域に拡大、接触者追跡が困難な状況であり、IHR基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: MSF、CDC Africa、WHOが緊急かつ協調的な対応を求めており、医療従事者のストライキが対応をさらに困難にしている。ワクチンや特異的治療法が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: CG News : मलेरिया का कहर, सिम्स में बैगा महिला की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CG News: Malaria wreaks havoc, Baiga woman dies in SIMS.
article.articleSummary: Malaria continues to wreak havoc in Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh. In Oraapani village, Kota area, 37-year-old Rekha Baiga died at SIMS Hospital after malaria was confirmed; she had been admitted to Ghaniyari PHC and was referred to SIMS as her condition deteriorated. A new malaria patient was detected at a health camp held in Kota on Thursday, signaling ongoing transmission in the area. The death has raised questions about the health department’s preparedness and preventive measures. In Kanker district, malaria claimed two more young lives: 9-year-old Kareena Vishwakarma and 9-year-old Subhash Kumeti. Health teams are conducting camps to test and treat residents in affected areas. The report underscores persistent malaria outbreaks and growing scrutiny of authorities’ response and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: CGニュース：マラリアが猛威、SIMSでバイガ族の女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州で複数のマラリア死亡例が報告されているが、地方の季節性流行の域を出ておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: チャッティースガル州ビラースプル及びカンケール地区で複数のマラリア死亡例（成人1名、子供2名）が報告され、保健当局の対応・予防措置に対する批判が高まっている。地方ローカルニュースソースであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は現時点で確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: 夏季新冠病例小幅回升，上海德达医院教你区分新冠与流感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer COVID-19 cases rise slightly; Shanghai Deda Hospital teaches you how to distinguish COVID-19 from influenza.
article.articleSummary: Summer 2026 sees a slight uptick in COVID-19 in Shanghai, with Shanghai Deda Hospital providing guidance to distinguish COVID-19 from influenza and to manage home care during the season. COVID-19 typical symptoms center on the upper respiratory tract—sore throat, dry cough, fever, and notably loss of smell or taste. Influenza is caused by orthomyxoviruses A and B, with abrupt onset of high fever, chills, and systemic aches; annual vaccines are updated accordingly. COVID-19 can spread via aerosols, has a 1–14 day incubation, and may be transmitted by asymptomatic individuals, complicating control. Antivirals differ: influenza uses oseltamivir and baloxavir marboxil within 48 hours; COVID-19 relies on symptomatic care, with nirmatrelvir/ritonavir (Paxlovid) for high-risk patients. Home care is advised for mild cases; hospital care for high-risk or persistent symptoms (fever >3 days, chest tightness). Emphasis on masking, ventilation, hand hygiene, and prompt medical evaluation for the elderly and chronically ill.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季新型コロナ症例が小幅増加、上海徳達病院が新型コロナとインフルエンザの見分け方を指南
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19とインフルエンザの一般的な鑑別・啓発記事であり、異常な増加や重症化、国際的拡大等の懸念は示されていない。
triage.notes: 既存の季節性感染症（COVID-19・インフルエンザ）に関する一般啓発記事であり、新規性・異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病毒检测阳性率上升，夏季如何做好科学防护？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising COVID-19 test positivity rate: how to protect yourself scientifically this summer?
article.articleSummary: China reports rising SARS-CoV-2 activity in week 30 of 2026, with 20.3% of tested fever/flu-like cases at sentinel hospitals positive for COVID-19—the top pathogen among circulating respiratory illnesses. The trend underscores ongoing transmission into summer, fueled by travel, gatherings, and time in enclosed, poorly ventilated spaces, plus waning immunity since prior infection or vaccination. Infections remain predominantly mild, with fever, sore throat, dry cough, fatigue, and nasal congestion; most healthy adults recover with rest and fluids. Yet older adults, and those with cardiovascular, metabolic, or chronic respiratory diseases, cancer patients, organ transplant recipients, and people on immunosuppressants are at greater risk of progression. Preventive measures include masking in crowded or poor-ventilation settings, cough etiquette, hand hygiene, and ventilation; seek prompt care for red-flag symptoms. For high-risk groups, individualized management may include nutrition, infection monitoring, disease control, and, under physician guidance, thymosin alpha-1.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス検査陽性率が上昇、夏の科学的な予防策とは？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19陽性率上昇に関する一般向け予防啓発記事であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクなどのシグナル基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性COVID-19流行動向に関する公衆衛生啓発記事であり、新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 7 tháng tuổi mắc viêm não, bác sĩ cảnh báo điều bố mẹ tuyệt đối không được chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven-month-old girl contracts encephalitis; doctors warn parents not to be complacent.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, a seven‑month‑old girl in Ninh Bình province, Vietnam, was diagnosed with Japanese Encephalitis Virus (JEV) encephalitis after fever and a prolonged generalized seizure (~20 minutes). Treated at Bach Mai Hospital, Ninh Bình campus, she initially had ongoing seizures; emergency care stabilized breathing and circulation. Cerebrospinal fluid showed pleocytosis, and MRI revealed brain parenchymal lesions consistent with encephalitis; subsequent testing confirmed JEV infection. The patient stabilized and was discharged with follow‑up. The report emphasizes that lumbar puncture is a critical diagnostic tool in suspected encephalitis and should not be delayed. JEV transmission occurs via Culex mosquitoes, with pigs, horses, and birds as reservoirs; transmission peaks May–August and affects all ages, though children are most at risk, with 25–35% mortality or lasting neurological sequelae. Prevention centers on vaccination: three-dose primary series at 12 months, 1–2 weeks after the first dose, and 1 year after the second, with boosters every 3–5 years until age 15.

triage.headline_ja: 生後7ヶ月の女児が脳炎を発症、医師が両親に油断しないよう警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの流行期（5〜8月）における日本脳炎の単発症例報告であり、地域的に季節性・地方流行性の既知疾患であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はベトナムの流行期（5〜8月）に発生する地方流行性疾患であり、本記事は単一症例に基づく医療啓発・注意喚起の内容。ワクチンによる予防が可能で、アウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Agricultura dice observa focos de PPA mientras Brasil vigila
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agriculture says it is observing African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreaks as Brazil monitors.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreaks detected in the Dominican Republic, with small-scale pig breeders reporting foci in Moca, Sánchez Ramírez, and the Cibao region. Agriculture Minister Oliverio Espaillat says authorities are enforcing biosecurity protocols in coordination with pig-raisers associations. The case pattern involves backyard producers; no mortality numbers provided. The move aligns with Brazil’s warning from the ASF Americas Prevention Group, and the Dominican Republic remains under alert and continuous surveillance due to the virus’s persistence on the island. Espaillat corroborates the effectiveness of the local epidemiological fence and ongoing cooperation with international agencies, including USDA APHIS. He stresses an unprecedented continental biosafety program, certifying commercial facilities and immediately addressing informal backyard farming to stabilize the pork sector. At SIAVS in São Paulo, ABPA indicated Brazil maintains a coexistence approach with the disease, with regional veterinary health continually monitored.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、アフリカ豚熱(ASF)の発生を監視中、ブラジルも警戒
triage.triage_reason: 本事案はドミニカ共和国におけるASF（動物疾患・非人獣共通感染症）の発生であり、対象国リストに含まれていない。ブラジルは監視・警戒の立場であり、実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに影響する動物疾患であり人への健康影響はない。発生国はドミニカ共和国（対象国リスト外）。ブラジルは監視・警戒の立場であり、実際の発生は確認されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के प्रकोप से अब तक 1850 की मौत, बच्चों पर सबसे ज्यादा असर | Mongbwalu: Health workers respond to Ebola cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ebola outbreak has caused 1,850 deaths so far, with children most affected | Mongbwalu: Health workers respond to Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continue to rise, with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 7, 2026. Eastern DRC, especially Ituri Province, bears the brunt. 694 patients are in isolation or hospital care, and 793 have recovered. UNICEF reports 330 child deaths; children constitute about a quarter of confirmed cases but nearly a third of deaths, with under-5s most affected (mortality > adults). Fear and disruptions to health centers are hampering routine immunization, maternal health, and other essential services. MSF warns transmission is at an unprecedented speed with no signs of slowing, while Doctors Without Borders cites bed shortages, staff pressure, and community fear hindering timely care. The outbreak heavily strains health systems and worsens child health in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染拡大、これまでに1850人死亡、子どもに最も深刻な影響
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,053例・1,850人死亡と大規模化しており、致死率の高さ、拡大速度、医療体制への深刻な負荷からIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSF/国境なき医師団が病床不足・人員不足・地域社会の恐怖による対応遅延を警告。子どもの死亡率が高く、基礎医療サービス（予防接種、母子保健）にも悪影響。国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के प्रकोप से अब तक 1850 की मौत, बच्चों पर सबसे ज्यादा असर - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has caused 1,850 deaths so far, with children the most affected - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is escalating, with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths reported. Of those affected, 694 are in isolation or hospitalized, and 793 have recovered. The eastern DRC, especially Ituri province, bears the worst burden. UNICEF notes 330 child deaths; children comprise about a quarter of confirmed cases but around a third of deaths, with under-five children most affected. Fear and health-center disruptions are sharply reducing essential services, including childhood vaccination and maternal health, jeopardizing broader health outcomes such as malaria and diarrhea. International agencies warn the situation is unfolding at an unprecedented pace with no clear slowdown signals. Doctors Without Borders cites bed shortages, overwhelmed healthcare workers, and community fear as factors delaying timely care in affected areas. Published date: 2026-08-07; ongoing outbreak considerations and imported/exported-case details remain critical for public health planning.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、これまでに1,850人が死亡、子どもへの影響が最も深刻
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が4,053例・1,850死亡と拡大しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: UNICEFやMSFなど国際機関が状況悪化を警告しており、致死率が高く小児への影響が顕著。続報でのケース数・国際的波及の推移を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: उरण परिसरात पावसाळी आजारांचा 'ताप'; डेंग्यू, मलेरिया रुग्णसंख्येत वाढ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon fever in the Uran area; dengue and malaria cases on the rise.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the Uran area reports a surge in monsoon illnesses, with dengue and malaria among the notable diseases rising in incidence. The report also lists non-specific symptoms such as cold, cough, body ache, kavhil, and headaches, indicating a broad spike in illness during the monsoon.
