Residents say the overall number of cases this year has doubled compared with July–August of last year. The piece does not provide exact case counts, laboratory confirmations, or identified infection sources. There is no information on imported or exported cases. This depicts a seasonal upsurge in dengue and malaria alongside common respiratory and musculoskeletal symptoms during the monsoon, raising local public health concerns and the need for enhanced surveillance during this period.

triage.headline_ja: ウラン地域でモンスーン期の疾病が「発熱」；デング熱とマラリアの患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性のデング熱・マラリア患者増加の報告だが、具体的な症例数や検査確認情報がなく、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠は不足している。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の季節性感染症増加に関する地方報道であり、詳細な疫学データ（症例数、検査確認、発生源）が欠如しているため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Debaten sobre el control o vigilancia de la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They debate the control or surveillance of swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Dominican Republic fights African swine fever (ASF) on its pig farms. Brazil has kept the Dominican Republic under high ASF surveillance, though authorities say the disease is not active nationwide, with sporadic, very mild foci. Minister of Agriculture Francisco Oliverio Espaillat Bencosme noted cases in the Cibao region, including Sánchez Ramírez and Espaillat, primarily affecting smallholders. He has not ordered mass culling yet, but surveillance continues and projects with pig farmers aim to eradicate ASF. Since May 2026, an eradication effort via depopulation in the Cibao region has reportedly eliminated about 70% of the pig population, per Ambiorix Cabrera, president of Approamoli. Production shortfalls have forced imports of nearly 80% of pork to meet a 3.4 million quintales demand. Farm-gate prices have risen (around RD$170/kg). The ANPA calls for stronger FAO/OMSA-aligned protocols and a relaunch of a national integrated ASF control plan involving producers, veterinarians, and authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 豚熱の防疫・監視をめぐり議論
triage.triage_reason: ドミニカ共和国における家畜(豚)のアフリカ豚熱に関する記事であり、ヒトへの感染症ではなく、対象国（ブラジル含む）で実際に発生している事案でもないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒトへの健康被害はない。ブラジルは監視強化を行っているのみで発生国ではなく、実際の発生国ドミニカ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: [미국 특징주] 콩고 에볼라 빠른 확산에 머크 백신 수요 급증
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [U.S. Featured Stocks] Rapid spread of Congo Ebola drives a surge in Merck vaccine demand.
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC (Ituri and North Kivu) faces the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak, with about 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths after 12 weeks. Merck’s Ervebo vaccine and Gilead’s remdesivir antiviral are being deployed to broaden access to curb transmission. The Bundibugyo variant’s impact on vaccine and antiviral efficacy remains unproven, but early Congo data and Uganda treatment experience suggest some protection: deaths have occurred in unvaccinated individuals, while vaccinated people have not among observed cases. Africa CDC is fast-tracking studies to determine whether vaccination prevents infection, severe disease, and death; a small cohort study could start within about two weeks pending ethical approvals. Gavi commits about $40 million to supply 500,000 vaccine doses at around $98 per dose from a global stockpile; work with Wellcome Trust and Hilleman Laboratories explore scaling production and heat stability.

triage.headline_ja: 【米国注目株】コンゴのエボラ急速拡大でメルクのワクチン需要が急増
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で約4,000症例・1,800人超の死亡が確認され、12週間で最速拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（イトゥリ・北キブ）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの言及は治療経験の参考としてのみで、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。渡航・貿易制限については本文に明記がないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع وفيات الكوليرا في تشاد إلى 13 شخصاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera deaths in Chad rise to 13.
article.articleSummary: Chad’s Ministry of Health reports cholera deaths rising to 13 with 239 infections since the outbreak was officially announced in late August. The majority of cases and 11 deaths occurred in July in the Hadjer-Lamis region and the capital, N'Djamena, with a case fatality rate of 5.4%. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated since August 24 as part of outbreak containment. Although the outbreak was declared in August, the first deaths were recorded on June 13. Ongoing cholera activity is noted in the region, with cases in the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Cholera spreads through contaminated water or food and is treatable with rehydration and antibiotics, but can be fatal within hours without care. Limited access to safe water and sanitation remains a major challenge in Chad.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでのコレラ死者数、13人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 死亡13人・感染239人（CFR5.4%）と重症度がありながら、中央アフリカ共和国・DRC・ナイジェリアなど周辺国にも症例が及ぶ地域的拡大の兆候が見られるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは『地域での継続的な活動』として付随的に言及されているのみで、記事の主題としての発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera Outbreak In Chad Kills 13
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad has caused 13 deaths among 239 confirmed cases (case-fatality rate 5.4%), with 11 of the deaths occurring in N’Djamena during August. The northern Hadjer Lamis province and the capital are affected. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated since the outbreak was declared on 24 July; first deaths were reported on 13 June. As of Monday, Chad recorded 239 cases nationwide. The situation follows broader regional cholera activity, with outbreaks in the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria. Ongoing vaccination campaigns and surveillance are underway to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラが流行、13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コレラの地域的流行（チャド、中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ民主共和国、ナイジェリア）により死者が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国はチャド（対象国リスト外）だが、記事内で中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ民主共和国、ナイジェリアでも同時期にコレラ流行が発生していると明記されているため、対象国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'ONU appelle à une réponse commune et plus forte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the UN calls for a common and stronger response.
article.articleSummary: On 4 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths (case fatality 45%), with the outbreak edging past 4,000. The Ituri province accounts for about 90% of cases, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu as epicenters; in the prior 24 hours, 99 new cases and 52 deaths were recorded. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine; Ervebo and remdesivir are under study. Only 75% of contacts are being followed (target 95%), averaging ~10 contacts per patient (versus ~40 expected); 60–70% of new cases occur outside surveillance. Health workers in Ituri have gone on strike over unpaid salaries, disrupting services. The U.S. Department of State announced 242 million USD in additional funding, bringing total support to over 512 million USD to expand treatment centers in North Kivu and bolster surveillance; OMS and Africa CDC called for a coordinated, community-centered response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：国連が共同かつより強力な対応を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が4,000例に迫り、致死率45%、接触者追跡率も目標を大きく下回るなど深刻化しており、国際的な資金支援・対応強化が呼びかけられているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ・米国が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にイトゥリ州）での流行拡大のみが主題であり、ルワンダでの症例発生は言及されていないため除外した。接触者追跡率の低さ（75%、目標95%）や監視外での新規症例が60-70%に上る点から、地域的拡大・アウトブレイク管理の困難さが強く示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Outbreak: Causes, Symptoms, Treatment and Prevention As Gujarat, Rajasthan Battle CHPV Surge
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Gujarat and Rajasthan are contending with a Chandipura virus disease (CHPV) outbreak. Gujarat reports 35 laboratory-confirmed infections and 22 child deaths; seven children remain under treatment, with several discharged. NJORT has been deployed to strengthen surveillance, treatment and containment. CHPV is an RNA virus in the Rhabdoviridae family, first identified in Chandipura, Maharashtra (1965), and primarily affects children under 15, causing Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES). Sandflies of the Phlebotomus genus are established vectors; researchers are examining other possible vectors. The virus is not contagious person-to-person and is considered zoonotic. Symptoms begin with high fever, severe headache and vomiting, progressing rapidly to seizures, confusion, drowsiness or coma within 24–48 hours. There is no antiviral or vaccine; care is supportive. Prevention focuses on vector control—repellents, long sleeves, bed nets, sealing cracks, eliminating standing water, hygiene. Public health response includes IDSP surveillance and activation of NCDC’s Public Health Emergency Operations Centre; ICMR, DAHD, and ICAR institutes are studying transmission and treatment options.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の発生:原因、症状、治療、予防—グジャラート州・ラージャスターン州でCHPVが急増
triage.triage_reason: インドのグジャラート州・ラージャスターン州で小児の急性脳炎症候群を引き起こすチャンディプラウイルス(CHPV)感染症が発生し、35例の検査確定例と22人の小児死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象と判断される。
triage.notes: CHPVはサシチョウバエ媒介のズーノーシスでヒト-ヒト感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、致死率が高く小児に重症化しやすいため注視が必要。国家レベルでNCDC・ICMR等が対応中で、外部支援の必要性については記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 4,000 as authorities broaden response
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths, and 793 recoveries as of Aug 5, spanning 53 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri is the epicenter, driving 86.9% of cases, in what authorities describe as the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally and the largest in the DRC since 1976. Investigations will seek whether viral changes or mutations contribute to severity. Africa CDC warns that community mobilization remains the key gap, urging a shift to a more community-led response with earlier detection and stronger contact follow-up. No licensed Bundibugyo vaccine or targeted treatment exists; Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) is being expanded in Ituri and North Kivu, while Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna candidates are in early Phase 1 trials. Vaccination is one component alongside surveillance, testing, care, IPC, safe burials, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ症例が4,000人を超え当局が対応を拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大級（1976年以降最大）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率も高く、ワクチン・治療法が未確立であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当し社会的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる史上2番目に大きい世界的アウトブレイクであり、DRCでは1976年以来最大規模。承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、Africa CDCはコミュニティ主導の対応強化を要請。国際的な支援（Ervebo拡大、Oxford/Serum Institute、Moderna候補薬の治験）が進行中で、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: One man works to slow the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, and he's doing it unpaid
article.articleSummary: At a hospital in Bunia, Ituri province, Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak declared in mid-May has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,800 deaths, making it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Ituri accounts for nearly 90% of cases. The virus is spread by direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials; patients can present with bleeding and vomiting blood. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. Front-line workers, including infection-control staff, burial teams and drivers, continue showing up despite unpaid salaries (about $510 monthly promised). Payment has been irregular; some staff were paid via mobile money, but many remain unpaid or underpaid, fueling strikes and disruptions that hamper response. Health workers face threats, mistrust, and community resistance to prevention measures, complicating containment efforts amid ongoing insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを食い止めるため、無給で働く一人の男
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ型エボラの過去最速の流行が発生し、4000例超・死者1800人超に達しており、承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、対応要員への未払いや地域社会の抵抗が封じ込めを困難にしているため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス（承認ワクチン・治療薬なし）の史上最速拡大流行。人員の未払い問題や地域社会の不信・抵抗が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد يودي بحياة 13 شخصاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad kills 13 people.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports a cholera outbreak with 239 infections and 13 deaths (case fatality rate ~5.4%), declared in July and continuing into August. About 11 of the deaths occurred in N’Djamena during August, with transmission primarily in the Hadjer-Lamé region in the north and the capital. Vaccination efforts have reached about 50,800 people since the outbreak was announced on July 24. The first deaths were recorded on June 13. As of August 3, 239 infections have been reported nationwide. Several neighboring African countries—Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria—have also reported cholera outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラが流行、13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: チャドで239例・13死亡（致死率約5.4%）のコレラ流行が継続中で、周辺複数国（DRC等）にも拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」の2項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国であるチャドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事中で「近隣国でもコレラ流行が報告されている」と明記されており実際の発生国として検証済みのため含めた。中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DRC surpass 4,000 as outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 cases, with 694 patients in isolation or hospital and 793 recovered. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the outbreak is 'more critical than ever', with the virus spreading at an 'alarming and unprecedented pace' and showing 'no sign of slowing down'. These developments come as Moderna has launched a Phase 1 trial of its experimental mRNA-1469 vaccine targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV), one of the Ebola viruses, illustrating vaccine development efforts amid the crisis. The article does not provide a current death toll. Vaccine development efforts are underway to address the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ患者数が4,000人を突破し流行悪化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000人を超え、国境なき医師団が『前例のない速さで拡大中』と警告しており、重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: MSFが『前例のない速さ』と警告し、Modernaがワクチン第1相試験を開始するなど国際的関与が進んでいる重大な進行中アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात में पशुओं को जकड़ती है लंपी बीमारी, नीम, हल्दी और कपूर का ये घोल दूर करेगा रोग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy Skin Disease grips animals during the monsoon; this neem, turmeric and camphor concoction will cure the disease.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) poses a major threat to livestock during the monsoon in Bihar, with Samastipur-based veterinarian Dr. Sushma Suman highlighting heavy economic losses if not prevented. Alongside vaccination and hygiene, she prescribes a home-made bath solution: boil roughly 1 kg neem leaves in 2 liters of water until the liquid is reduced to about 1 liter, cool, then add 50 g turmeric powder and 8–10 camphor tablets and bathe animals regularly. Neem offers natural antibacterial and antiviral properties; turmeric aids in infection resistance; camphor helps deter pests. Keep animal housing clean and consider neem leaf use nearby to minimize spread. Vaccination is essential; deworming should be given on schedule. If animals show lethargy, lumps on the body, fever or skin lesions, contact a veterinarian. LSD vaccine exists; Bihar’s Department of Animal Husbandry conducts periodic campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期に家畜を襲うランピースキン病、ニーム・ウコン・樟脳の溶液が病気を防ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 動物のランピースキン病に関する家庭療法・予防啓発の記事であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクや公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家畜のランピースキン病）に関する予防啓発記事であり、人獣共通感染症としての報告ではない。人への健康影響は言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: (وسائط متعددة) عدد الإصابات المؤكدة بالإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Multimedia) The number of confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 4,053 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,850 deaths. The outbreak, centered in eastern DRC, left 694 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 793 recoveries. The total surpasses 4,000 cases, indicating sustained transmission nationwide. A caption notes an IOM officer measuring a passenger’s temperature on a boat intercepted outside Kinshasa, illustrating ongoing surveillance. Médecins Sans Frontières warned the eastern Congo outbreak is now “more dangerous than ever,” spreading at an alarming, unprecedented rate with no clear sign of decline. The update underscores continued transmission, ongoing hospitalizations, and the urgent need for intensified public health responses. Keywords: Ebola, DRC, Kinshasa, outbreak, MSF, surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: （マルチメディア）コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定感染者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000人超・死者1,850人と大規模化し、MSFが「かつてないほど危険」と警告するなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKinshasaが記載されているが、サマリーによれば流行の中心は東部DRCであり、キンシャサは監視活動（船上での検温）の一例として言及されているのみ。国全体としてDRCを対象国とした。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết ở xã Kỳ Hoa với 5 người mắc bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak detected in Ky Hoa Commune with 5 cases.
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases detected in Ky Hoa Commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, in Tan Duc Hamlet. The index case began on 1 August 2026: a female resident (born 1959) with fever, fatigue, headache, and myalgia/arthralgia. She sought care on 2 August at Ky Anh General Hospital; rapid dengue testing on 4 August was positive. By 7 August, four additional cases were identified, for a total of five. An epidemiologic investigation found multiple Aedes breeding sites and larval habitats in a densely populated area with inadequate sanitation, elevating transmission risk. Ha Tinh CDC and Ky Hoa authorities initiated urgent responses: vector surveillance, environmental cleanup, larval source reduction, and spraying of insecticide around surrounding households; 12 litres of pesticide supplied; 24/7 outbreak response staff; daily reporting. Weather with alternating rain and sun and high humidity favors mosquito proliferation. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water and participate in vector-control activities.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省キーホア村で5人が感染するデング熱の発生集団を発見
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域での小規模なデング熱クラスター（5例）であり、地方当局が迅速に対応中。デング熱は同地域で流行性が高く、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方CDCが既に媒介蚊対策・殺虫剤散布・24時間監視体制を実施しており、地域レベルで管理可能な小規模事例。デング熱はベトナムで季節性・流行性の疾患であり特段の異常性はない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Fear of catching Ebola sees use of hospital health services drop
article.articleSummary: Fear of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s north‑east Ituri region is driving a 42% drop in use of essential hospital services (April–June) in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi and Rwampara, including births and immunisations. Bunia’s Bigo Hospital head nurse Losha Dhedda says patients who avoided care have died, increasing community fear. WHO figures show 3,874 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,751 deaths in the DRC since mid‑May. In response, infection prevention and control kits are being distributed to protect health workers amid PPE shortages. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak is spreading faster than the response scale‑up, with new cases doubling in some hotspots over the past week and a need to massively scale up efforts to reach affected communities despite insecurity. Nearly 90% of cases are in Ituri; five eastern provinces are affected. The United States has allocated over $242 million in additional funding.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ感染への恐怖から病院医療サービスの利用が減少
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例3,874人、死者1,751人に達する大規模エボラ流行が進行中で、WHO事務局長も対応の遅れを警告しており、複数州に拡大し国際支援も行われているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国が2億4200万ドル以上の追加資金を拠出しており国際的関心も高い。ルワンダは地理タグに含まれるが記事本文では発生地として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के प्रकोप से करीब 330 बच्चों की मौत, यूनिसेफ ने जाहिर की चिंता -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed about 330 children, UNICEF has expressed concern.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed about 330 children, UNICEF warns. Among confirmed Ebola cases, one-third of deaths are children; under-5s are most affected as vaccination and essential health services collapse due to fear of seeking care. The health system is under severe strain, with malaria, diarrheal diseases and other treatable illnesses disrupted, driving child mortality higher. UNICEF representative John Agbor notes the outbreak is crippling health services across the country. Doctors Without Borders warns the eastern DRC situation is graver, with the outbreak spreading rapidly and no signs of slowing. Since the May 15 declaration, 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths have been reported in the country. In Kinshasa, a passenger boat was halted after a former traveler died with suspected Ebola; fever and diarrhea were observed, and passengers are being tested with mobile labs in Mongala Province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行により約330人の子どもが死亡、ユニセフが懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は死者1,801人・確認症例3,973人に達し、保健システムの崩壊や国際機関（UNICEF、国境なき医師団）の警告があり、国際的拡大や公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（モンガラ州、キンシャサ含む）でのエボラ流行に関するもので、他対象国への言及なし。マラリア等は流行に伴う二次的健康被害として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉毒株恐已突变 民主刚果确诊破4000例 1800死 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus strain may have mutated; Democratic Republic of the Congo confirms over 4,000 cases and 1,800 deaths | China Press
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered around Kinshasa. The Africa CDC confirms over 4,000 cases and at least 1,801 deaths. The Guardian reported the outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola lineage, first reported May 15 and rapidly spreading. Authorities warn that the virus may have mutated, rendering standard containment measures insufficient, and announce a door-to-door house-to-house search to locate potential patients. As of Aug 4, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths were recorded; on Aug 6, Africa CDC director Kasaya confirmed the total cases have surpassed 4,000. The article emphasizes escalating severity and the need for intensified surveillance and case finding in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス株が変異した恐れ、コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例4000例超・死者1800人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者数・症例数が急増しており、稀な系統(ブンディブギョ株)による変異の懸念や国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCおよびThe Guardianの報道に基づく。ウイルス変異の有無は未確認であり、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: कोटा में मलेरिया का कहर : सिम्स में इलाज के दौरान आदिवासी महिला ने तोड़ा दम, स्वास्थ्य विभाग की तैयारियों पर उठे सवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malarial havoc in Kota: A tribal woman dies during treatment at SIMS, questions raised about the health department's preparations.
article.articleSummary: Malaria continues to strain health services in Kota development block, Bilaspur district, Chhattisgarh, after the death of a 37-year-old tribal woman, Rekha Baiga, during treatment for malaria. She was from Orapani village, initially treated at Ganiyar Primary Health Center and, with deteriorating condition, referred to SIMS Hospital in Bilaspur, where she died. The death has raised questions about the district's malaria preparedness and preventive measures in rural areas, with locals saying ongoing transmission persists despite control attempts. The district health department reports six active malaria cases, with new patients repeatedly appearing in Kota, signaling ongoing transmission risk. Authorities say surveillance and containment efforts will be intensified in affected areas. This incident highlights gaps between peripheral case management and tertiary care amid malaria concerns in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コタでのマラリア猛威：SIMSでの治療中に部族女性が死亡、保健局の対応に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州の一地区における単発のマラリア死亡例と少数の活動性症例報告であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、地域内での継続的な感染伝播が示唆されており今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道による地域限定のマラリア事例。チャッティースガル州ビラースプル県コタ開発区で6件の活動性症例が報告され、住民は伝播が継続していると指摘。保健当局は監視強化を表明しているが、国際的拡大リスクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الكوليرا في تشاد يودي بحياة 13 شخصا وإصابة نحو 240 آخرين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad kills 13 and infects about 240 others.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad has infected 239 people and caused 13 deaths (case fatality rate: 5.4%). The majority of cases are in Hadjer-Lamis Governorate in the north and in the capital N'Djamena, where 11 of the 13 deaths occurred during August. Since the outbreak was officially announced on 24 July, about 50,800 people have been vaccinated to curb spread, though the first fatalities were recorded on 13 June. Ongoing transmission is concentrated in urban settings and remains a concern for public health authorities. The report notes concurrent cholera activity in Africa, with cases and deaths in the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria, suggesting a wider continental outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラが発生、13人死亡・約240人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドを中心に複数のアフリカ諸国（中央アフリカ、コンゴ民主共和国、ナイジェリア）で同時多発的なコレラ流行が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクの両方が認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドでの流行だが、チャドは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは同時流行国として明示的に言及されているため含めた。中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la peur d'Ebola détourne les habitants des hôpitaux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Fear of Ebola keeps residents away from hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Fear of the Ebola outbreak in northeast DRC’s Ituri province is driving people away from essential health services, with a 42% drop in April–June 2026 in Bunia health facilities, affecting consultations, hospital births, and vaccinations. At Bunia’s Bigo Hospital, care for Ebola patients has been hampered by limited capacity and distrust, with some transferred patients dying. A 100‑bed Ebola Treatment Center opened in Bunia to boost capacity. The current outbreak, declared May 15, is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists; vaccines are in trials (Moderna, Oxford). Experimental therapies MBP134, remdesivir, obeldesivir are under evaluation in Ituri. WHO reports 3,874 confirmed cases and 1,751 deaths as of 7 Aug 2026; about 90% of cases in Ituri. US aid exceeds $242 million (total >$500 million).

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラへの恐怖が住民を病院から遠ざける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定3,874例、死亡1,751例）であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の株による深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際支援の必要性が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知の第17次DRCエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）に関する続報。医療忌避による死亡率上昇や治療アクセス低下が新たな懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını büyüyor: Virüs mutasyona uğramış olabilir - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is growing: The virus may have mutated.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri with spillover to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo) has surpassed 4,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths by early August. As of August 4, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths were reported; Africa CDC later confirmed more than 4,000 cases. The outbreak is the second-largest Ebola epidemic in history, after the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,000+ cases, 11,000+ deaths). Authorities are investigating a possible viral mutation with WHO and Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Transmission remains intense, with many deaths in communities; contact tracing is weak (roughly 10 contacts per patient vs the expected 40). The response includes MSF treatment facilities in Bunia (Ituri), expanded door-to-door surveillance, and plans to use remdesivir; Ervebo vaccine for Bundibugyo is being evaluated. Uganda reports 20 cases; a suspected Ebola death on a boat linked to Kinshasa prompts further testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大：ウイルスが変異した可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4000例以上・死者1800人超の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが進行中で、変異の可能性やウガンダへの拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの20例報告やキンシャサ関連の疑い例もあるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ウイルス変異の可能性についてはWHOが調査中で未確定。

article.articleHeadline: 4000 er bekræftet smittet med ebola i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,000 are confirmed to be infected with Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to more than 4,000 confirmed cases. The surge began in mid-May, and government figures cited by Reuters show a continued rise in infections. As of 7 August 2026, the outbreak remains ongoing with sustained transmission, reflecting a major public health challenge for the DRC. The excerpt provides limited detail on deaths, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or control measures. The report emphasizes the scale of the outbreak and the ongoing need for surveillance and response, with Reuters serving as the source of the official figures. No information on geographical hotspots or risk groups is provided in the summary.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染確認者が4,000人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000人超の確認例に拡大し持続的な感染が続いており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべきである。
triage.notes: 死亡者数、検査確定状況、感染源、対策措置など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time in the current outbreak, with a total of 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported as of Aug 7, 2026. The outbreak is active in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, and is described as the world's second-largest and the fastest-spreading on record. Experts believe infections began circulating months before the May 15 declaration, and the true case count could be higher than the official tally. Contributing factors include delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the Ebola virus species involved. By comparison, the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak exceeded 28,000 cases across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、症例数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は4,000症例・1,850死亡に達し、史上第2位・最速拡大とされる異常事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-16年流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチン・治療薬不足、紛争地域での活動困難、サーベイランス遅延が拡大要因とされ、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Le grand invité Afrique - Ebola en RDC: "C'est l'engagement communautaire qui a manqué"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Grand Guest Africa - Ebola in the DRC: "It's the community engagement that was missing."
article.articleSummary: Jean Kaseya, director of Africa CDC, completed a visit to the Democratic Republic of Congo focusing on the Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province. The Bundibugyo-ebola virus strain, declared almost three months ago, has tallied more than 3,970 cases and 1,800 deaths. Joined by the World Health Organization director, he briefed President Félix Tshisekedi on the response and ongoing containment challenges. The trio acknowledged difficulties in stopping transmission and emphasized the need to change tactics. Kaseya underlined that community engagement had been missing and is now being prioritized to strengthen outbreak control. The remarks reflect high-level coordination between Africa CDC, WHO, and the Congolese government as efforts continue to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカからのゲスト - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱: 「欠けていたのはコミュニティの関与だった」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（症例3,970件超、死者1,800人超）に対し、アフリカCDC・WHO・大統領による高レベル協議が行われており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクは約3ヶ月前に宣言済みで、致死率が高く（約45%）伝播阻止に苦戦中。コミュニティ関与不足が課題として指摘されており、戦術転換が必要とされている。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する言及は記事中になし。

article.articleHeadline: V Kongu hrozí mutace eboly, obávají se virologové
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, an Ebola mutation threatens, virologists fear.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest outbreak in history. The epicenter is Ituri Province, centered in Bunia, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, and spillover into Uganda; authorities are investigating deaths on a boat bound for Kinshasa. Officials warn a mutation in the Bundibugyo strain could drive greater transmission, though airborne spread remains unlikely. RNA Ebola viruses mutate rapidly, increasing risk as outbreaks grow. The WHO believes the outbreak may have started in January; the official declaration came May 15. Africa CDC and WHO will study potential mutations. MSF is shifting from contact tracing to active case finding door-to-door in Bunia. Treatments under consideration include remdesivir — developed by American researchers led by Czech biochemist Tomáš Cihlář — and the Ervebo vaccine, with preliminary data suggesting milder disease and no deaths among vaccine recipients.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ変異の恐れ、ウイルス学者が懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例が4,000人を超え史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行となっており、ウガンダへの越境拡大や変異株による感染力増大の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報じられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株の変異による感染力増大の可能性がWHO・Africa CDCにより調査中。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola avanza en paro de sanitarios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances amid health workers' strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, Bunia) continues amid a health workers' strike demanding back pay and delayed salaries and bonuses. As of Tuesday, official counts report 3,973 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths, making this the second-largest outbreak in history after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. About 90% of infections are centered in Bunia, the provincial capital of Ituri, where most transmissions occur. The outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in the country, with humanitarian groups warning that the disease is spreading at an alarming rate. The protest underscores operational challenges in outbreak response due to unpaid health workers since mid-May. The article does not specify the virus source, nor details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、医療従事者はストライキで抗議
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模となるエボラ流行（確定症例3,973件、死者1,801人）が継続中で、医療従事者のストライキにより対応能力が損なわれている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、医療従事者への未払い賃金によるストライキが対応能力に深刻な影響を与えている。感染の90%がブニアに集中しており、急速な拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا.. الإصابات تتجاوز 4000 حالة للمرة الأولى منذ تفشي الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: infections surpass 4,000 cases for the first time since the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 laboratory-confirmed infections for the first time since the outbreak began in May. Latest figures indicate around 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths, with the previous day reporting just over 3,900 cases. This represents eightfold higher case numbers and more than sixfold higher deaths than the same stage of the 2014 West Africa outbreak. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kasia warns the outbreak’s severity is unprecedented for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and notes that authorities should assume about 4,000 cases. Three months into the outbreak, new infections are rising rapidly in the hardest-hit areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa amid healthcare worker strikes, says the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history is stretching control efforts, prompting joint mutation-investigation Work with WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、流行開始以来初めて感染者数が4000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に複数該当し、史上最速拡大とされる大規模エボラ流行（4000例超、死者1800人超）であり、社会的・国際的関心も極めて高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、2014年西アフリカ流行の同時期と比べ症例数8倍、死者数6倍以上。医療従事者ストライキが対応を圧迫し、WHO事務局長がキンシャサを訪問、変異調査も実施中。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文に言及なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 cases as Africa CDC and UNICEF raise response concerns
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports over 4,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths as of 7 August 2026, with 694 patients in hospital or isolation and 793 recovered. The outbreak has expanded from 9 to 51 health zones in eastern DRC, larger than prior episodes. UNICEF records 743 children under 18 contracted Ebola and 330 fatalities; minors are under a quarter of cases but account for nearly one-third of deaths, with under‑five fatality rate more than double that of adults. Fear of infection has reduced routine vaccinations and maternal care in Ituri Province. MSF says transmission is accelerating and the outbreak is more critical than ever. Africa CDC cites constraints: sub-standard contact tracing, limited bed capacity, funding shortfalls, insecurity, and potential viral mutations. Uganda interrupted local transmission; 11 regional nations (South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya) are high-risk, calling for greater international support to close containment gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が4,000例を突破、アフリカCDCとUNICEFが対応への懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例が4,000例・死者1,850人を超え、51保健区域に拡大する過去最大規模の流行となっており、近隣国への越境リスクと国際支援の必要性が明確なためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda等が含まれるが、記事本文では『高リスク地域』としての言及に留まり、実際の感染確認はDRC（特にイトゥリ州含む東部）に限定される。ウガンダは感染連鎖を遮断済みと記載あり。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 13 وفاة و240 إصابة بالكوليرا في تشاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13 deaths and 240 cholera cases in Chad.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports a cholera outbreak with 13 deaths and 239 confirmed cases since the official outbreak declaration on July 24, yielding a case fatality rate of 5.4%. The epidemic is concentrated in Hadjer-Lamis Governorate in the north and in the capital, N'Djamena, where 11 of the 13 fatalities have occurred so far in August. Public health authorities say about 50,800 people have been vaccinated since July 24 in a campaign to curb transmission, even though the first deaths were recorded on June 13. The data highlight urban hotspots and rising severity in the capital. The cholera surge coincides with outbreaks in other African countries, including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria, signaling broader continental transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラにより13人死亡、240人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドでコレラの死亡13名・症例240例（CFR5.4%）が報告され、中央アフリカ共和国・DRC・ナイジェリアなど複数のアフリカ諸国で同時期に流行が発生しており、大陸規模での国際的拡大リスクが示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャド（対象国リスト外）でのコレラ流行だが、DRCを含む複数アフリカ諸国での同時流行が言及されており、大陸規模の伝播懸念としてDRCを検証済み地域に含めた。チャド国内の詳細（CFR5.4%、都市部での重症化）は続報での確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 7 Fakta Ratusan Korban Dugaan Keracunan MBG di Jayapura: Bakteri E. coli hingga Kepala SPPG Dicopot
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7 Facts About Hundreds of Suspected MBG Poisoning Victims in Jayapura: From E. coli Bacteria to the Removal of the SPPG Chief
article.articleSummary: In Jayapura, Papua, Indonesia, a suspected MBG poisoning linked to the Free Nutritious Meal program run by SPPG under Yayasan Kasih Iman Samuel Papua has affected 527 people in Depapre District, Jayapura Regency. Victims include toddlers, PAUD, primary and secondary students, and some parents, with symptoms of abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, and weakness. As of 7 Aug 2026 15:45 WIT, 219 remain in health facilities across RSUD Yowari, Puskesmas Depapre, RS Abepura, RS Kemenkes, RS Dian Harapan, Puskesmas Sentani, RS Dok II Jayapura, Puskesmas Komba, and Puskesmas Kampung Harapan. The kitchen has been suspended; the SPPG chief removed after findings of gross SOP violations, unsanitary conditions, and wastewater treatment installation not meeting standards. Preliminary investigations point to early cooking and possible spoilage of tempe bacem. Lab tests detected Escherichia coli in MBG foods from Jayapura and Semarang.

triage.headline_ja: ジャヤプラでのMBG（給食プログラム）食中毒疑い、数百人被害の7つの事実：大腸菌検出からSPPG責任者解任まで
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジャヤプラの学校給食プログラムに関連した集団食中毒（527人発症、219人入院）で大腸菌が検出され、行政・世論の関心が高く、続報の確認が必要なためピックアップと判断。
triage.notes: 食品由来の大腸菌感染による集団食中毒事例であり、人-人感染の証拠はなし。給食施設の衛生管理不備が原因とされ、政府による調査・責任者解任等の対応が進行中。国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、政治的・社会的関心が高いため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratyczna Republika Konga: wojna, ebola, pomoc Kościoła
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: War, Ebola, Aid from the Church.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst Ebola outbreak in its history, amid conflict that has displaced about 50,000 people since mid-July. WHO-confirmed Ebola cases reach 3,605 with 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%), and the outbreak, which began in May in Ituri Province, has spread to four other provinces and continues to surge. The crisis worsens maternal health: UNFPA notes maternal deaths in Ituri rising from 3.1 to 5.8 per week as fear of infection and isolation drives women away from prenatal care and hospital births. A strained health system—with staff strikes and frequent attacks on facilities—hinders responses. The Catholic Church and Caritas are aiding with essentials and health education, urging avoidance of risky gatherings and traditional funeral rites, and enforcing safety measures in services while coordinating with missionaries and medical services.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：戦争、エボラ、教会による支援
triage.triage_reason: WHO確認済みでケース数3,605人・死者1,587人（致死率44%）の史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、紛争による医療崩壊も重なっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模とされるDRCのエボラ流行。紛争による人口移動（約5万人）、医療スト、施設への攻撃、妊産婦死亡率上昇など複合的な人道危機。5州へ拡大しており国際的拡大リスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: टीबी के लक्षणों को नजरअंदाज नहीं करें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore the symptoms of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Champawat district in India launched a TB-free India awareness drive. District TB Officer Dr. Sonali Mandal urged residents not to ignore TB symptoms. People experiencing cough for more than two weeks, persistent fever, weight loss, or night sweats should visit a government health center for testing. The campaign emphasizes early detection through free screening, diagnosis, and treatment. In Champawat, TB testing, treatment, and essential medicines are provided at no cost through public health facilities. Early diagnosis and accessible care are highlighted as key to controlling TB in the district. The message targets timely care to prevent transmission and protect community health under the TB-free India initiative.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の症状を無視しないでください
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例のTB啓発・早期発見キャンペーンに関する記事であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Fever Season in Jaipur: Dengue, Malaria and Typhoid Cases on the Rise -- Early Warning Signs Every Family Should Watch
article.articleSummary: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, faces concurrent rises in dengue, malaria and typhoid during the monsoon, with cases typically climbing from July and staying high through September–November. Aedes mosquitoes (dengue) and Anopheles (malaria) breed in standing water formed by heavy but short rains followed by dry spells; typhoid spreads via contaminated water and food. Health department records label Jaipur among the state’s worst-affected districts during the season. All three illnesses begin with fever, but present distinct patterns: dengue with rapid high fever, retro-orbital headache, body and joint pain, possibly a rash and bleeding; malaria with cyclical chills, fever and sweating every two to three days; typhoid with gradual fever, abdominal discomfort, poor appetite, weakness. Early blood testing is essential; doctors warn against guessing. Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory promotes testing, and offers Monsoon Package Dengue, Malaria Tests in Jaipur to confirm diagnosis and guide treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプールでモンスーン熱季到来：デング熱、マラリア、腸チフスの症例が増加中――全ての家庭が注意すべき早期警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャイプールにおけるモンスーン期の季節性感染症（デング熱・マラリア・腸チフス）の毎年恒例の増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は民間検査機関の宣伝的内容を含み、毎年季節性に発生する蚊媒介・水系感染症に関する注意喚起記事。具体的な症例数や異常な増加傾向のデータは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: New study suggests Covid-19 can awaken dormant viruses in some people
article.articleSummary: New Delhi reports that severe Covid-19 may reactivate dormant viruses, potentially contributing to Long Covid. A Nature-published study by the University of Texas at Austin analyzed 1,154 unvaccinated patients hospitalized with Covid-19 across 20 US hospitals (May 2020–March 2021), examining over a billion data points and measuring viral RNA. Within the first 40 days, RNA from 11 reactivated viruses was detected, notably Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), herpes simplex virus-1 and Anelloviridae. Anelloviridae reactivation strongly associated with Long Covid and long-term disability. In severe cases, EBV in the nasal cavity or CMV in the respiratory tract linked to higher one-year mortality and complications such as kidney problems, stroke, bloodstream infections and shock. While causality is not proven, systemic inflammation may trigger reactivation. Monitoring dormant viruses could help identify high-risk patients and inform future therapies targeting immune dysfunction and viral reactivation.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな研究、新型コロナが一部の人で休眠ウイルスを再活性化させる可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: 米国での過去の入院患者コホートを対象とした研究報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や発生事象ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 研究対象は米国の入院患者データ（2020年5月〜2021年3月）であり、インドやその他対象国での発生事象ではない。学術研究の紹介記事であり、新規感染症イベントではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف إصابة بـ"إيبولا" وتحقيق بشأن تحوّر الفيروس - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 4,000 Ebola cases and an investigation into the virus's mutation - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan, and the world
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 Ebola virus disease cases for the first time since the outbreak began, with reports showing over 3,900 cases the day prior and authorities now listing about 4,000. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is described as unprecedented in intensity. Africa CDC and the World Health Organization plan a joint investigation into a possible mutation in light of the rapid spread. The DR Congo situation is more than eightfold higher than the number at a comparable point during West Africa’s 2014 outbreak, the previous record for severity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Congo amid a health workers’ strike over pay, says the outbreak remains faster than containment efforts. Authorities are initiating studies to confirm mutation and understand transmission drivers, with implications for public health response and international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染者4000人超え - ウイルス変異について調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ症例が4000人を超え、2014年西アフリカ流行を大幅に上回る前例のない規模となっており、ウイルス変異の可能性やWHO/Africa CDCによる国際調査が行われているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文では言及がなくDRCが主題のため除外。WHO事務局長がコンゴ訪問中、医療従事者のストライキも発生しており対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have exceeded 4,000 for the first time in the current outbreak, reaching 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths, according to the public health institute as of Aug 7, 2026. The epidemic, the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak and described as the fastest-spreading on record, has spread across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Experts say infections circulated for months before the May 15 declaration. A Science journal analysis estimated start as early as January or before. Containment has been hampered by delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the virus species involved. The 2014-16 West Africa outbreak remains larger, with over 28,000 cases across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、感染者数4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模かつ急速に拡大するエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、致死率も高く、封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-16年流行の歴史的比較として言及されているのみで、現行流行の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: أوغندا تسيطر على إيبولا محليا واستمرار تفشى الفيروس فى الكونغو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Uganda has locally contained Ebola, while the virus outbreak continues in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has locally contained the Ebola outbreak, reporting 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; all previously registered contacts completed follow-up, and Uganda declared the outbreak over on 28 July 2026. The Congo (DRC) continues to face an Ebola outbreak, with Bunia cited as a focal point; neighboring countries remain at risk as transmission persists. A joint high-level mission to Uganda and the DRC on 4–5 August, led by WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Africa CDC Director-General Dr. John Kassia, and WHO Africa Regional Director Dr. Mohammed Janabi, assessed progress, identified operational gaps, and relayed communities' concerns to Kinshasa's leadership. The mission highlighted that early detection, rapid contact tracing, a coordinated national response, community engagement, frontline worker support, and swift resource delivery are critical for containment and readiness across borders.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ウガンダはエボラを局地的に制圧、コンゴでは流行継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であり、DRCで流行が継続し越境リスクがあるため、WHO・Africa CDCによる合同ミッションが実施されるなど国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは2026年7月28日にアウトブレイク終息を宣言済みのため対象外。DRC（ブニアが焦点）で流行継続中。ウガンダはWPRO・IHR対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-udbrud: 4000 smittede
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: 4,000 infected
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, per the national health institute as of May 15. The country’s 17th Ebola outbreak is affecting Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. It likely began in January or earlier in Ituri. Over 500 suspected cases were identified between mid-January and May 15. The World Health Organization warns of an unusually rapid spread and calls for intensified response. Contributing factors include delayed contact tracing, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatment for the circulating virus variant. The eastern DR Congo has seen hospital attacks, hindering the response. Ebola typically causes severe fever and bleeding; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:感染者4000人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、確定症例4,053人・死亡1,850人に達し、WHOが異常な速さの拡大を警告しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يخرج عن السيطرة في الكونغو.. الإصابات تتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in Congo... infections exceed 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed infections for the first time in the current outbreak, totaling 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 7, 2026. Five eastern provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science study published last month found the outbreak likely began in January or earlier in Ituri, with more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15, when the outbreak was declared. Contributing factors include delayed detection, surveillance challenges, ongoing armed conflict, and shortages of vaccines and therapies for the circulating Ebola virus strain, intensifying spread. The outbreak is described as the second largest globally and the fastest-spreading; the only larger one was West Africa’s 2014-2016 epidemic, with over 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴで制御不能に…感染者数4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者が4,053人、死者1,850人に達し「制御不能」と報告され、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大の流行とされているため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Châu Phi triển khai vaccine và mở rộng điều trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Africa rolls out vaccines and expands treatment
article.articleSummary: On Aug 6, Africa CDC announced a vaccination campaign against Ebola Zaire in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to reduce mortality amid a Bundibugyo-driven outbreak, with vaccines deployed in Ituri and North Kivu. Although the vaccine targets Ebola Zaire, early data suggest vaccinated individuals can still be infected but have not yet died, indicating partial protection. Remdesivir treatment will be expanded alongside vaccination, drawing on Uganda’s experience where mortality fell to about 10% after antiviral use; Uganda declared the outbreak over in mid-July after the final patient was discharged. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 4,053 cases, 1,850 deaths, 793 recoveries, and 694 still in treatment or isolation. MSF warns the outbreak is spreading at an alarming, unprecedented rate. Near Kinshasa, authorities quarantined nearly 200 ship passengers after a traveler who died with Ebola symptoms was on board; no confirmed Kinshasa cases yet.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:アフリカでワクチン展開と治療拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（4,053症例、1,850死亡）が継続中で、MSFが「前例のない速度」で拡大していると警告。首都キンシャサ近郊でも感染疑い者の隔離が発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでは既に終息宣言済み（7月中旬）。DRC東部（イトゥリ州、北キブ州）で流行継続中、Bundibugyo株による流行にワクチン（Ebola Zaire対象）の部分的効果が示唆されている。キンシャサでは船舶乗客約200人を隔離したが確定症例はまだ報告されていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF: 330 anak meninggal akibat Ebola di RD Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF: 330 children died from Ebola in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in eastern Ituri province, has caused 330 child deaths among 743 confirmed cases in children aged 17 and under as of August 2, 2026, UNICEF said. Although children account for about 25% of confirmed cases, they make up nearly 30% of fatalities, with under‑5s bearing the highest burden and a case fatality rate more than twice that of adults. The outbreak has severely disrupted routine immunization, maternal health services, and other essential healthcare, as fear of transmission and disrupted facilities deter families from seeking care. Doctors Without Borders warned the situation in eastern DRC is more critical than ever, with transmission continuing at alarming levels. Since May 15, 2026, the outbreak has produced 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,801 deaths as of August 4, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより330人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、死亡者数・症例数が多く、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日以降、DRCで3,973例の確定症例、1,801人の死亡者が報告されており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続を示す。UNICEFとMSFが深刻な状況を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病毒检出率仍居首位，但上升趋缓 -- 新京报
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The SARS-CoV-2 detection rate remains the highest, but the upward trend is slowing.
article.articleSummary: China’s latest surveillance shows SARS-CoV-2 detection rising but at a slower pace, overall at a moderate level, with NB.1.8.1 lineage predominating. In Week 31 of 2026 (Jul 27–Aug 2), sentinel hospitals report influenza-like illness (ILI) at 4.5% of outpatients; southern provinces higher (5.7%) than northern (2.9%). Among respiratory samples from ILI outpatients/ED, SARS-CoV-2 accounts for 22.3%, influenza virus 13.3%, enterovirus 4.1%; among inpatients with severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), SARS-CoV-2 8.2%, influenza 5.8%, human metapneumovirus 5.5%. No unknown pathogens detected; tested pathogens align with known circulating strains. COVID-19 infections remain a common, cyclical respiratory disease since Category B management, with 1–2 waves annually; the current rise is waning, similar to prior years. Highest positivity in ages 15–59; elderly and those with chronic disease remain high-risk. No major new variants or public-health disruptions identified.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの検出率は依然として首位だが、上昇は鈍化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、既知の病原体・株のみで新規性や異常性がなく、公衆衛生上の重大な影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性COVID-19・インフルエンザ・hMPV・エンテロウイルスの通常サーベイランスであり、新規変異株や未知病原体の検出なし。既知の周期的流行パターンと一致。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Congo surpass 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, per a health authorities update. Of the confirmed cases, 694 patients remain in isolation or receiving hospital treatment, and 793 have recovered. The update signals sustained transmission in the eastern Congo, with officials warning that the outbreak is now more dangerous than at any previous moment. An international humanitarian medical organization described the situation as spreading at a worrying and unprecedented pace, with no signs of abating. The figures reflect ongoing case counts and outcomes, underscoring the critical need for intensified control measures, surveillance, and treatment access in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者、4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で4,000例超・死者1,850人に達し、当局が「過去最も危険」と警告する持続的な流行拡大がみられるため、IHR・WPRO双方の基準に複数該当する。
