article.articleHeadline: Бројот заразени со ебола во Конго надмина четири илјади
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in Congo exceeded four thousand.
article.articleSummary: 4,053 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as of August 7, 2026. The outbreak began in late April 2026, with a mortality rate of 43.9%. About 90% of cases are in Ituri Province, near the borders with Uganda and South Sudan. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted through contact with an infected person or bodily fluids. The report contrasts with the 2014–2016 Congo outbreak, which reached about 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths; eight months into that outbreak, around 1,000 deaths had occurred. The article provides current confirmed counts and highlights the geographic concentration in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が4千人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約44%、感染者4,053人・死者1,850人という大規模流行で、国境地帯(ウガンダ・南スーダン)への波及リスクもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・スーダンが含まれるが、記事本文で感染確認が述べられているのはコンゴのみ（国境近接地域として言及）。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストのウガンダ・スーダンとは別国（南スーダンは対象国に含まれない）であり、いずれも実際の感染確認地域としては記載されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉确诊病例超4000起
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 4,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths, and 793 recoveries reported as of Aug 5, 2026. Chiefly in areas near Kinshasa, the health ministry warns the true infection count may be higher. The Africa CDC director Kasaye said the outbreak’s severity is unprecedented and that authorities may study possible viral mutation to adjust measures. To prevent spread toward Kinshasa, officials intercepted a boat about 65 kilometers from the capital after a passenger who had boarded the vessel died following the appearance of suspected Ebola symptoms; the ship’s registry lists 250 passengers but actual numbers could exceed 300. The WHO, in a joint bulletin with Africa CDC, urged stronger community-led interventions, including early detection, contact tracing, improved healthcare access, support for frontline workers, and faster aid to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確定症例が4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で大規模流行し（確定4,053例、死亡1,850例）、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクや変異の可能性も指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDC責任者が流行の深刻さを「前例のない」と表現し、ウイルス変異の可能性も言及。首都キンシャサへの拡大阻止のため船舶を検疫するなど、国際的な支援・介入（WHO・Africa CDCの共同声明）が既に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: US maintains travel ban on Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the United States maintains a Level 4 Do Not Travel advisory for Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and South Sudan, despite Africa CDC and WHO urging reconsideration of Uganda travel limits. The State Department says the priority is protecting Americans and containing Ebola at the source. Uganda’s Ebola outbreak, announced May 15 and linked to DR Congo transmission, produced 20 cases, 2 deaths, and 18 recoveries; 15 cases were imported from DR Congo. Uganda declared the outbreak over on 28 July after discharging the last patient on 16 June. The United States announced an additional $242 million for Ebola response (total direct Ebola funding now $512 million) plus $350 million in humanitarian aid; China’s contributions are described as under 1% of US support. Uganda’s health minister urged lifting restrictions to aid the economy; WHO Africa regional director Prof. Mohamed Yakub Janabi congratulated Uganda on outbreak control. Response activated within 24–48 hours of first reports.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国はウガンダへの渡航禁止を維持
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ流行は既に終息宣言されているが、DRCからの症例輸入や米国の渡航制限継続を巡る政治的議論が続いており、今後の動向（DRCでの感染状況や渡航制限解除の可否）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダのアウトブレイクは2026年7月28日に終息宣言済み（20例、死亡2例）。記事の主題は米国の渡航禁止継続を巡る外交的・政治的対立であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクというより既存流行の収束後の渡航制限議論。ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、感染源として言及されたDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Zamboanga mayor wants more fogging machines as dengue deaths hit 12
article.articleSummary: Zamboanga City, Philippines, reports 12 dengue fatalities among 1,241 cases year-to-date as of 7 August 2026, with the city declaring a dengue epidemic threshold. Mayor Khymer Adan Olaso urged the city council to secure additional fogging machines for barangays and to intensify the anti-dengue campaign, including sanitation and environmental cleanup. The city government will procure more fogging equipment and urged barangays to allocate funds for dengue-control gear in their supplemental budgets to bolster prevention and response. Most cases are concentrated in Barangays Calarian, Santa Maria, Talong-Talon, Ayala, and Putik. The outbreak has sparked discussions on executive-legislative cooperation, with officials defending the mayor’s urgent appeal and others noting the need for separation of powers; the presiding councilor described the briefing as an urgent appeal, not overreach.

triage.headline_ja: サンボアンガ市長、デング熱死者12人受けて防疫用噴霧機の増強を要請
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・サンボアンガ市での季節性デング熱流行で死者12人・症例1,241件と増加傾向にあり、市が流行閾値を宣言し対策強化を進めているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域内の公衆衛生対応事案として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年フィリピンで季節性流行するため異常性は低いが、死亡者数の増加と市による流行閾値宣言、行政・議会間の対応議論が見られるため、今後の症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 8년 전보다 6배 빨라...민주콩고, 에볼라 누적 확진자 4000명 넘어서 - 동행미디어 시대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six times faster than eight years ago... Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 cumulative Ebola cases — the Donghaeng Media era.
article.articleSummary: As of August 6, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 4,053 cumulative confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths. There is no approved vaccine or therapy. The eastern DRC outbreak includes a MSF-run Bunia treatment facility, where 90% of hospitalized patients were not on contact lists, hindering containment. The disease was first reported May 15, but spread may have begun in January. This outbreak reached 1,000 cases in 40 days, six times faster than the 2018 Zaire ebolavirus outbreak, which took 235 days. Containment relies on contact tracing, but many infections occur via unknown transmission chains, complicating mitigation.

triage.headline_ja: 8年前より6倍速い...民主コンゴ、エボラ累積感染者4000人突破 — 東行メディア時代
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で急速に拡大し累積4,053例・死亡1,850例に達し、感染経路不明のケースが多く封じ込めが困難な状況であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、接触者リストにない患者が90%を占めるなど感染経路の追跡が困難であり、致死率も高い（約45.6%）。2018年のザイールエボラウイルス流行より6倍速い拡大速度である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Al menos cinco campamentos de desplazados en la provincia de Ituri afectados por el brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least five internally displaced persons camps in Ituri Province affected by the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 7, 2026, UNHCR (ACNUR) reported that at least five of 69 internally displaced camps in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, have recorded Ebola cases amid the outbreak declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain is spreading rapidly, with 19 internally displaced people infected and five deaths in camps. Ituri accounts for about 87.1% of cumulative cases; North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo are also affected, hosting roughly 4.4 million displaced people. The latest official balance tallies 3,973 confirmed cases, 674 in isolation or hospitalized, and 1,801 deaths, equating to a case-fatality rate of 45.3%. Poor water and sanitation in camps and distrust of health services create a favorable environment for transmission, challenging ongoing outbreak control by humanitarian agencies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、イトゥリ州の国内避難民キャンプ少なくとも5カ所に影響
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で致死率45.3%と極めて高く、避難民キャンプでの感染拡大により国際的拡大・人道的懸念が強いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 累計確認症例3,973例、死亡1,801例、致死率45.3%。避難民キャンプでの水衛生状態の悪さと保健サービスへの不信が感染拡大の要因とされる。既に大規模流行として認識されている継続事案であり、フルRRA（または既存評価の更新）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia traps monkey following two-week rampage that wounded 18 people on Sumatra island
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Sumatra island town of Tembilahan recorded a two-week rampage by an adult long-tailed macaque, injuring 18 residents across 19 attacks (one person attacked twice). Victims included children and the elderly; several required stitches and rabies shots. The macaque was captured late on Aug 6, 2026, and transferred to Pekanbaru, Riau province, for blood and observational tests to determine disease carriage. About 40 schools remained closed with three days of online learning for hundreds of pupils, with doors to reopen next Monday if deemed safe. Officials warned the animal could have acted as part of a gang and that other monkeys may attack. The incident underscores human–animal conflicts in Southeast Asia, linked to rainforest clearance for palm oil plantations that shrink primate habitats.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、スマトラ島で2週間にわたり18人を負傷させたサルを捕獲
triage.triage_reason: サルによる連続襲撃事件で狂犬病感染は未確認（予防的にワクチン接種のみ）。人獣共通感染症としての監視は必要だが、現時点で確定症例や重篤な公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 捕獲されたサルは血液検査・観察により狂犬病等の疾病保有の有無を確認中。狂犬病確定例ではなく、咬傷後の予防的ワクチン接種が実施された事案。パーム油農園開発による生息地縮小が背景にあるとされ、人獣共通感染症リスクとしての継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Genetic characterizations and seroprevalence of hepatitis B virus among non-human primates and human caretakers in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA is detected in Indonesian non-human primates (NHPs) and human caretakers across four islands, in an unedited study of 237 NHPs across 10 species and 65 human handlers. First detection of HBV DNA in the East Javan langur (Trachypithecus auratus) with 2/46 tested positives, plus serological exposure. HBV DNA is also detected in gibbons (17/68), orangutans (4/50), and humans (5/65), but not in macaques (0/73). Serology shows HBcAb and HBeAb positivity in the langur, and HBsAb positivity in six additional langurs (8/46 total) and in 6/68 macaques. HBsAb is found in gibbons (7/47) and orangutans (16/46). Phylogenetic analyses place the langur HBV strains within the gibbon HBV clade. Langur viral DNA levels are low and undetectable on resampling after six months in one case; findings warrant mechanistic follow-up and sustained primate-human interface surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの非ヒト霊長類とヒト飼育員におけるB型肝炎ウイルスの遺伝学的特性と血清有病率
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な血清疫学調査であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行の報告ではないため、フルRRAに進む必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本研究は霊長類-ヒト接触面におけるHBV検出に関する学術的サーベイランス報告であり、アウトブレイクや急性感染症イベントではない。継続的なサーベイランスの重要性を示唆するのみ。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y el Africa CDC urgen a reforzar la respuesta comunitaria para contener el brote de ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC urge the strengthening of the community response to contain the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 4 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces, with 99 new cases and 52 deaths in the last 24 hours. Ituri accounts for ~90% of cases, with Bunia as the outbreak’s epicenter and the Rwangole Ebola Treatment Center visited by a joint Africa CDC–WHO mission. North Kivu treatment centers were at 139% occupancy. Uganda ended its separate outbreak on 28 July after 20 cases and 2 deaths. Africa CDC and WHO urge immediate expansion of community-led response, early case detection, and rapid contact tracing (75% vs 95% target), plus diagnostics and treatment access, expanded capacity, infection prevention, health worker protection, safe access to affected areas, and faster funding. Obstacles include delayed detection, limited access, resistance to measures, supply shortages, and insufficient frontline support. Emphasizes coordinated leadership and cross-border surveillance without travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を封じ込めるためコミュニティ対応の強化を強く要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（3,973例、1,801死亡）が継続しており、WHO・Africa CDCが緊急対応強化を要請していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも別系統の流行があったが7月28日に終息済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。渡航制限は明示的に否定されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 4053 ووصف الوباء بالأسوأ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,053, and the outbreak has been described as the worst.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,053 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths, making this the fastest-spreading outbreak in the virus history and the second-largest globally. Officials say infections began months before the May 15 declaration, with the total likely higher than reported. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A January start in Ituri is reported, with more than 500 suspected cases from mid-January through May 15. Contributing factors include delays in detection, extensive surveillance, ongoing armed conflict, and shortages of vaccines and treatments, hindering containment. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak—Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone—exceeded it in scale, with more than 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が4,053人を超え、史上最悪の流行と評される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認例4,053件・死亡1,850人に達し、史上最速拡大かつ史上2番目の規模とされるエボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行との規模比較のための言及であり、現行の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。武力紛争地域でのワクチン・治療薬不足が封じ込めを阻害している点も重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola en Congo superan los 4.000 por primera vez desde el inicio del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo surpass 4,000 for the first time since the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have topped 4,000 for the first time in the current outbreak, with the government reporting 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths as of 2026-08-07. This outbreak is the second largest globally, after the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, and described as the fastest-spreading on record. Experts say transmission began months before the May 15 declaration, and the true toll may be higher than official counts. Cases have been detected across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science journal study published last month linked the outbreak to initiation in January or earlier in Ituri, identifying more than 500 suspected cases before the declaration. Factors hindering containment include late detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and lack of vaccines and treatments for the circulating Ebola virus species.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数、流行開始以来初めて4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が4,000症例・1,850死亡に達し、史上最速の拡大速度とされる大規模アウトブレイクであり、紛争地域での対応困難さも重なりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリー上ではDRC国内5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）の流行のみが言及されており、アンゴラでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Knowledge Nugget | Leptospirosis: Why does a hidden health threat spike during monsoon?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a waterborne bacterial disease caused by Leptospira, is rising with the Indian monsoon, as heavy rains, floods and waterlogging contaminate floodwater with infected animal urine. In Navi Mumbai, a patient with fever and painful red rashes was diagnosed; authorities warn across several parts of India. Transmission occurs through cuts or abrasions in skin contacting contaminated water; rodents, cattle, dogs and cats are common reservoirs. Diagnosis combines clinical history with labs: PCR detects Leptospira in the first week; Rapid IgM and ELISA IgM from about day five; Microscopic Agglutination Test (MAT) is the international gold standard but limited to specialized labs. Symptoms range from fever, headache, muscle pain, rash, red eyes to severe jaundice; untreated disease can cause kidney damage and death. Prophylaxis with doxycycline is used in high risk; severe cases require IV antibiotics, fluids, dialysis; vaccines do not offer broad protection due to 200+ strains.

triage.headline_ja: ナレッジナゲット | レプトスピラ症：モンスーン期に潜む健康リスクはなぜ急増するのか？
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期に例年見られるレプトスピラ症に関する教育的・解説記事であり、異常な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性レプトスピラ症の一般的な健康啓発・解説記事（UPSC試験対策コーナー）であり、単一症例の報告のみで大規模アウトブレイクの証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters - Έμπολα: Ξεπέρασαν τις 4.000 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters - Ebola: Confirmed cases surpass 4,000 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time in the current outbreak, with the National Institute of Public Health reporting 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths. The epidemic is now spreading across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Scientists estimate the virus has been circulating for months prior to the official declaration on May 15, and the true case total may be significantly higher. A Science study published last month concluded the outbreak likely began in January or earlier in Ituri, with more than 500 suspected cases before confirmation. Experts attribute rapid spread to delayed detection, strained surveillance, ongoing armed conflict hampering health work, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for this strain. The only Ebola outbreak with more cases was West Africa in 2014–2016 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone).

triage.headline_ja: ロイター - エボラ：DRコンゴで確認症例が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており（4,000人超の確定症例、1,850人死亡）、5州に拡大、武力紛争による対応の困難さもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事はDRコンゴ国内（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Haut-Uele、Tshopoの5州）での流行を主題としている。リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較で言及されているのみで、現行流行地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。また対象国リストに含まれないため元々対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se extinde în RD Congo. Autoritățile investighează posibile mutații ale virusului
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in DR Congo. Authorities are investigating possible mutations of the virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is worsening, with confirmed cases surpassing 4,000 and over 1,800 deaths. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, was in May, but transmission may have begun in January. Authorities are investigating possible mutations and expanding response, including active case finding to rapidly identify symptomatic individuals and curb transmission. Transmission remains hard to control: most deaths occur in communities, and many infections are not linked to known contacts, with Africa CDC warning that contact tracing is insufficient. Remdesivir is under consideration for treatment; the Ervebo vaccine is being evaluated for use against the strain after preliminary favorable data. UNICEF warns health services are disrupted, including measles vaccination in Ituri. The outbreak has spread to eastern and northeastern provinces, and a suspected Ebola death aboard a vessel bound for Kinshasa is being investigated, with passengers to be tested and quarantined.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴで拡大。当局はウイルスの変異の可能性を調査中
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ症例4,000人超・死者1,800人超と深刻化し、変異の可能性、感染追跡不十分、船舶での死亡例による拡散リスクなどIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 麻疹はエボラ流行による医療サービス混乱の文脈（イツリでの麻疹ワクチン接種中断）で言及されているのみで、独立した麻疹アウトブレイクの主題ではない。船舶での疑い死亡例はキンシャサ行きであり、国際的拡散リスクとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया के आंकड़ों ने बढ़ाया टेंशन : बस्तर में इस साल अब तक 15 हजार से ज्यादा केस आए सामने
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria data have raised concerns: In Bastar, more than 15,000 cases have been reported so far this year.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Bastar division, Chhattisgarh, has risen to over 15,000 confirmed cases in 2026 to date. After substantial reductions since 2015, annual positives climbed from 4,496 (2024) to 16,544 (2025) and 15,934 (2026 to date). From 2020–2026, testing remains high: 2022 saw 16,066 positives from 53,77,667 tests. The current year’s burden is highest in Bijapur, Sukma and Dantewada, with all seven Bastar districts affected; dense forests and remote villages delay access to health facilities. Since 2020, malaria deaths in the region total 127, distributed as Bastar 30, Kanker 7, Kondagaon 17, Narayanpur 4, Sukma 21, Dantewada 28, Bijapur 20. Mixed infections with Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax are increasingly reported, with P. vivax reinfection risk. Health officials urge prompt care at health centers as the 14th phase of Malaria-Free Bastar campaign continues.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアのデータが懸念を高める：バスタルでは今年これまでに1万5000件以上の症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州バスタル地域における既知の風土病マラリアの症例増加報告であり、地域限定的かつ既存の対策キャンペーンが継続中だが、死亡例の蓄積や混合感染増加が見られるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはインド国内の既知の風土病であり、地域保健当局が『マラリア・フリー・バスタル』キャンペーン第14期を継続実施中。国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いが、森林地帯・遠隔地でのアクセス困難による曝露継続と混合感染（P.falciparum/P.vivax）増加傾向は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 의심 증상 승객, 3주 전 하선 뒤 사망...동승자 200명 격리
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Passenger with suspected Ebola symptoms dies three weeks after disembarking; 200 fellow passengers quarantined.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling a large Ebola outbreak. In June, health workers in Bunia disinfected the coffin of a university student who died with Ebola-like symptoms. About 200 passengers who rode the same boat as the deceased were quarantined near Kinshasa; the patient’s infection status was not yet confirmed, and Kinshasa had no confirmed cases. Authorities preemptively isolated even asymptomatic travelers to block potential transmission. The deceased had shown symptoms for more than three weeks and died after disembarking more than 1,000 km away at Pimu in Mongala Province along the Congo River. Since May, roughly 4,000 cases and over 1,800 deaths have been reported. 60–70% of new infections come from people not linked to known contacts. In Ituri Province, about 90% of cases are concentrated; healthcare workers have faced wage arrears and strikes. WHO and MSF cite barriers from conflict and access constraints.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い症状の乗客、下船3週間後に死亡…同乗者200人を隔離
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が進行中（約4000症例、1800人超死亡）であり、感染経路不明例が60-70%を占めるなど地域拡大・国際拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 感染者が1000km以上移動し多州にまたがる拡大が確認されており、接触者不明の二次感染が多数を占める点が特に懸念材料。WHO・MSFも紛争等によるアクセス制限を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: ডিআর কঙ্গোতে ইবোলা আক্রান্তের সংখ্যা ৪০০০ ছাড়াল
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola infections in DR Congo has surpassed 4,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 4,000 as of August 7, 2026. In a separate Science publication, Stanford researchers used generative AI models Evo1 and Evo2 to design fully synthetic viral genomes, demonstrating for the first time that AI-created designs can form functional bacteriophages. Of 302 candidate designs, 16 successfully lysed Escherichia coli in laboratory tests. The AI systems were trained on viral, bacterial, plant, and human genetic data and evolved to target specific bacteria. All work occurred in high-containment facilities with safeguards, excluding experiments that could infect humans. While bacteriophages could offer new avenues against antibiotic-resistant infections, experts warn of urgent biosafety and biosecurity concerns regarding potential misuse. Some scientists call this a turning point in biology, with broad implications for AI-driven genome design and future therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ感染者数が4000人を超えるという大規模な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、国際拡大リスク、渡航貿易制限リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ感染者数4000人超えを主題とする。後半のAI合成バクテリオファージに関する研究情報は別トピックであり、DRCとは無関係のためlocationには含めない。感染者数の急増は継続的なアウトブレイクの深刻化を示唆し、フルRRAでの詳細評価（致死率、地理的拡大範囲、対応状況等）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：冠病阳性率上升趋缓
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: COVID-19 positivity rate rising at a slower pace
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity in China is rising at a slower pace, staying at a mid-epidemic level, according to China CDC sentinel-site data for July 27–August 2. Outpatient influenza-like illness (ILI) accounted for 4.5% of total ED visits, higher in the south (5.7%) than the north (2.9%). In outpatient respiratory samples, SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 22.3%, influenza 13.3%, and enteroviruses 4.1%. In hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections, SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 8.2%, influenza 5.8%, and human rhinovirus 5.5%. All detected pathogens were known; no unknown pathogens identified. The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains the major circulating SARS-CoV-2 variant; southern provinces show higher positivity, and the 15–59 age group has the highest positivity. Since COVID-19 was categorized as a Class B disease with B-level control, outbreaks are cyclical and of comparable intensity to the past two years. Most cases are mild; elderly and chronically ill remain high-risk. No major public-health risk from new variants.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病管理予防センター：新型コロナ陽性率の上昇は鈍化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体による定期的なサーベイランス報告であり、流行は季節的・周期的で過去2年と同程度の強度。新規変異株による公衆衛生上の重大リスクもないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 中国のCOVID-19/インフルエンザの定点サーベイランスデータで、既知の病原体のみ検出。B類感染症としての管理下で周期的流行の範囲内、重症例の多くは高齢者・基礎疾患保有者に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija opasnog virusa širi se: Sumnja se da mjesecima nitko nije reagirao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak of a dangerous virus is spreading: There is suspicion that for months no one has reacted.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces its second-largest Ebola outbreak by cases, with 4,053 confirmed infections and 1,850 deaths. Cases have been reported across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—and the outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading Ebola event on record. Health authorities indicate transmission began months earlier, possibly in January, with more than 500 suspected cases before May 15, when the outbreak was formally proclaimed. Contributing factors include delayed detection, an overwhelmed epidemiological surveillance system, ongoing armed conflict, and a lack of vaccines and effective therapies for this Ebola strain. The report notes that the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic was larger, with over 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルスの流行が拡大：数カ月間誰も対応しなかった疑いがある
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が発生し、4,053例・1,850人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン不足や紛争により国際支援の必要性も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの現行エボラ流行（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）を主題としている。シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年流行との比較で言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة الأفريقية: إيبولا يتجاوز 4 آلاف إصابة في الكونغو " وكالة بغداد اليوم الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Health: Ebola surpasses 4,000 cases in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 cases for the first time since it began in May 2026. As of 7 August 2026, authorities report more than 4,000 confirmed Ebola infections and over 1,800 deaths caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus). The transmission is described as the fastest in Africa to date and the most intense since the outbreak began. Africa CDC Director-General Jan Kasia said joint investigations with the Africa Health Organization and the World Health Organization are examining a possible mutation in light of rapid spread. Health authorities were urged to assume around 4,000 cases, with the current figure exceeding 3,900 the previous day. The outbreak has persisted since May, with ongoing case confirmation and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ保健当局：コンゴでエボラ感染者数が4000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が4000人以上、死者1800人超に達し、急速な感染拡大と変異の可能性が調査されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であるため。
triage.notes: 致死率は約45%と高く、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による大規模流行。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが変異の可能性を調査中で、国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | إيبولا.. الإصابات تتجاوز 4000 حالة للمرة الأولى منذ تفشي الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | Ebola.. Infections exceed 4,000 cases for the first time since the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 4,000, the first time this threshold has been reached since the outbreak began in May. Over 1,800 deaths are reported, with the surge concentrated in the most affected regions. Africa CDC and the World Health Organization are launching a joint investigation into a possible mutation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus that could be driving rapid transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Kinshasa amid a health-worker pay strike, described the outbreak as the fastest-spreading in history and noted new infections have doubled in some hard-hit areas about three months into the outbreak. Authorities are intensifying surveillance and response as laboratory confirmation continues to track the evolving outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱..感染者数、流行発生以来初めて4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染者数が4000人を突破し死者1800人超、変異株の可能性も調査中でWHO事務局長が「史上最速の拡大」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルスの変異可能性についてAfrica CDCとWHOが共同調査中。医療従事者のストライキも発生し対応能力に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Поступило предупреждение о мутации вызвавшего массовую вспышку вируса Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A warning has been issued about a mutation that caused a massive outbreak of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has triggered a massive outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, spreading from Ituri to North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele and Chopo. As of August 4, DR Congo reports 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths; by August 7, cases exceed 4,000, making it the second-largest outbreak on record. Uganda reports 20 cases. Officials warn the virus may be mutating; Africa CDC plans expanded response and a shift from passive tracing to door‑to‑door case finding. Weak contact tracing (about 10 contacts per case vs. ~40 expected) and 90% of patients in Bunia hospital without listed contacts indicate high undetected transmission. Remdesivir will be used for treatment; Ervebo vaccine trials will begin in the affected province, citing reportedly milder disease and zero mortality among the vaccinated for Bundibugyo. A ship death triggers passenger quarantine and testing. UNICEF notes disruptions to essential services, including a 69% drop in first-dose measles vaccination in Mongbvalu.

triage.headline_ja: 大規模流行を引き起こしたエボラウイルスの変異について警告が発せられた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行が拡大し、ウガンダにも越境、死亡率も高くウイルス変異の懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ウイルス変異、接触追跡の不備、麻疹ワクチン接種率低下など複合的リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Počet obětí eboly v Kongu stoupl na 1850, nemoc se rychle šíří
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Congo rises to 1,850 as the disease spreads rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,850 Ebola deaths and 4,053 confirmed cases as of Friday, Aug 7, 2026, up from 1,801 deaths and 3,973 cases a day earlier. Declared on May 15, the outbreak has spread from Ituri to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with transmission extending to neighboring Uganda. The strain involved is Bundibugyo, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. Public health response is hindered by delays in contact tracing, difficult access to affected areas, distrust among communities, and violence by armed groups and some residents. This outbreak is outpacing previous ones, with the 2014–2016 epidemic recording about 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths. Ebola is a viral disease spreading through contact with infected people or contaminated material, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数が1,850人に増加、感染が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州からウガンダへ越境拡大し、死者・症例数が急増、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株であることからIHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。2014-2016年流行を上回るペースで拡大しており、既にWHO等で継続的にモニタリングされている大規模アウトブレイクである可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Deaths : दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू से 2 मौतें, कैसे फैलती है ये बीमारी, डॉक्टर से जानें लक्षण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Deaths: 2 Deaths Due to Swine Flu in Delhi; How This Disease Spreads, Learn Symptoms and Prevention From a Doctor.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths from H1N1 influenza (swine flu) have been reported in Delhi, India, as cases rise during the monsoon season. Delhi health authorities are on alert, with physicians noting that H1N1 cases increase in this period. H1N1 is a type of Influenza A virus; the 2009-10 season led to a pandemic, with about 284,400 global deaths, and WHO declared the pandemic over in August 2010, though the strain remains a seasonal cause of illness. People with fever and flu-like symptoms should seek hospital care, where a laboratory test for H1N1 is conducted and treatment is guided by results. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing and by touching contaminated surfaces then the face. Prevention: regular handwashing, mask use when ill, seasonal flu vaccination, and avoiding close contact with infected individuals. Source: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1による死亡: デリーでスワインフルーにより2人死亡、この病気の広がり方と症状・予防法を医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1（季節性インフルエンザ）による死亡例が報告されているが、季節的に毎年見られる現象であり、大規模な異常拡大や国際的懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる死亡例の報告であり、毎年モンスーン期に増加が見られる既知のパターン。地域保健当局は警戒しているが、パンデミックや異常な拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Caritas: Ebola-Epidemie in der DR Kongo noch längst nicht besiegt / Zahl der betroffenen Provinzen auf fünf angestiegen - Caritas stellt weitere Ebola-Nothilfe bereit und bittet um Spenden
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caritas: Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo far from defeated / number of affected provinces has risen to five — Caritas provides further Ebola emergency relief and calls for donations.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand, described as the country’s worst and deadliest. After initial cases in May made Ituri the outbreak hotspot, by early August five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. WHO reports more than 3,600 infections and 1,587 deaths. Outcomes hinge on access to treatment in health centers, many of which are operated with Caritas support, and on community awareness campaigns; maintaining functioning centers and adequate PPE is crucial. Caritas International has allocated over 70,000 euros for Ebola emergency relief and is calling for additional donations to strengthen health facilities and response in the northeast Congo.

triage.headline_ja: カリタス:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行はいまだ収束せず／被害を受けた州の数が5州に増加―カリタス、さらなるエボラ緊急支援を実施し寄付を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク(感染者3,600人超、死者1,587人)が5州に拡大しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・国際的拡大リスクともに高い。
triage.notes: WHOの報告によれば感染者3,600人超、死者1,587人で致死率が非常に高く、同国史上最悪・最多死者数のエボラ流行とされる。国際支援団体(カリタス)による緊急支援活動も継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Uzbuna u DR Kongu: Preko 4000 potvrđenih slučajeva ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in DR Congo: Over 4,000 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time in the current outbreak. As of August 7, 2026, government data report 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths. The outbreak is described as the second-largest globally by case count and the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. Experts believe the virus began circulating months before the official declaration on May 15, and the true number of infections may be higher than officially confirmed. Cases have been confirmed in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The data highlight the ongoing, severe transmission dynamics and the need for sustained public health response.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴで警戒:エボラ確定症例4000人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRコンゴ5州に拡大し、確定症例4000人・死者1850人を超える過去最速の流行と報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Od ebole u Kongu umrlo 1850 ljudi. Preko 4000 je oboljelo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,850 people have died of Ebola in Congo. More than 4,000 have become ill.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths among 4,053 infections. It is the second-largest Ebola epidemic by case count and the fastest-spreading on record. Cases have been reported in five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, but researchers say transmission began months earlier, likely in January in Ituri, with more than 500 suspected cases identified through May 15. Late detection, an overwhelmed surveillance system, armed conflict, and a lack of vaccines and effective therapies for the strain hinder containment. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected people or their bodily fluids and is often fatal. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the eastern DRC outbreak has reached its largest scale to date.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急拡大、複数州への拡大）およびWPRO基準5項目すべて該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ξεπέρασαν τις 4.000 τα κρούσματα Εμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo surpass 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time in this outbreak, with total infections reaching 4,053 and 1,850 deaths reported by the country’s Public Health Institute. The outbreak is the second-largest globally and the fastest-spreading in history. Infections likely began months before the May 15 official declaration. A Science study published last month traced the outbreak back to January or earlier in Ituri province, identifying over 500 suspected cases from mid‑January to May 15. Delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, armed conflict, and lack of vaccines and therapeutics for this Ebola strain have facilitated rapid spread. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak remains the largest with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者が4,000人を超え、史上最速拡大の大規模アウトブレイクであり、複数州に拡大、武力紛争や医療体制の脆弱性により国際的拡大リスクと支援必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Liczba potwierdzonych przypadków eboli przekroczyła 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: The number of confirmed Ebola cases has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 4,000, with 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths reported by the national public health institute, Reuters citing authorities. WHO data show that only West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak exceeded those totals, with more than 28,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱の確定症例数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、症例数・死亡者数ともに急増しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Kian Tak Terkendali, WHO Akui Penularan Kini Lebih Cepat dari Respons Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Kongo is increasingly out of control; WHO admits that transmission is now faster than the health response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spiraling, with Ituri province as the epicenter, notably Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu health zones. By August 4, 2026, the DRC had 3,973 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries. In the previous 24 hours, 99 new cases and 52 deaths were reported, signaling ongoing intense transmission. North Kivu hospitals are overwhelmed, with Ebola care centers at 139% capacity. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC warn that transmission is outpacing the health response, and urgent strengthening of all response components is needed to halt spread. A high-level WHO/Africa CDC delegation visited Uganda and the DRC on August 4–5, 2026 to assess field conditions and accelerate control measures. Weak contact tracing is highlighted as a major driver of continued spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能に拡大、WHOは感染拡大が保健対応を上回っていると認める
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラの大規模流行が進行中で、死亡者・症例数が急増し医療体制が逼迫、WHO/Africa CDCが緊急対応を要請しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・ルワンダが含まれるが、記事本文では感染拡大はDRC国内（Ituri州、North Kivu）が中心。ウガンダ・ルワンダへの実際の感染拡大は明記されておらず、WHO/Africa CDC代表団の訪問先として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにウガンダ・ルワンダは含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情陰霾　民主剛果破4000例確診1850人亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak casts a shadow as the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases with 1,850 deaths (DRC Public Health Institute data: 4,053 infections, 1,850 fatalities). The affected regions span five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Reuters characterizes it as the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-spreading on record. Experts caution the virus circulated months before the May 15 outbreak declaration, with official counts likely underestimating true burden. A Science study reported over 500 suspected cases in Ituri from January through May 15, suggesting earlier emergence. Contributing factors include detection delays, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing armed conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the circulating strain. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone exceeded 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行拡大、コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例4,000例超・死者1,850人に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が5州に拡大し、死者1,850人・症例4,000例超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける現在進行中のエボラ流行について述べており、Guinea/Liberia/Sierra Leoneは2014-2016年の過去事例との比較として言及されているのみで、現発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 印度暴发罕见传染病 22名儿童不幸遇难
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of a rare infectious disease in India leaves 22 children dead.
article.articleSummary: Kindipla virus, a rare bullet-shaped member of the Rhabdoviridae family related to rabies, is causing a deadly outbreak in India. In Gujarat state, as of August 3, 2026, there have been 184 suspected cases and 35 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 7 children in intensive care. The outbreak has killed 22 children under 15 years old. First incubation is 48–72 hours from fever and headache to coma or death. Transmission occurs mainly via sandflies, which breed in rural, damp environments such as mud-wall cracks, livestock sheds, and monsoon-affected areas; barefoot children are at highest risk. No vaccine or specific antiviral exists. Rural health infrastructure deficiencies delay diagnosis and treatment, contributing to fatalities. A previous Gujarat outbreak occurred in 2024; by 2026, Rajasthan reported 3 cases as well. Climate-change–driven longer monsoon and expanded sandfly activity facilitate spread.

triage.headline_ja: インドで希少な感染症が発生、22人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州を中心に希少なラブドウイルス科ウイルス（チャンディプラ様ウイルス）による小児死亡が22例発生し、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象であるため。
triage.notes: サンドフライ媒介の稀少なラブドウイルス（Chandipura様、Kindiplaと呼称）による小児死亡例。ワクチン・特異的治療なし、農村部の医療インフラ不足が致死率に影響。2024年にも同州で流行歴あり、2026年にはラジャスタン州にも拡大。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、モンスーン気候変動によるベクター拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo w potrzasku wojny i eboli. Kościół rusza z pomocą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo in the grip of war and Ebola. The Church steps in to help.
article.articleSummary: Conflict-driven displacement in the Democratic Republic of the Congo coincides with the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in its history. By mid-July nearly 50,000 people had fled their homes as the epidemic, which began in May in Ituri province, spread to four other provinces. WHO-confirmed cases total about 3,605, with 1,587 deaths (44% case-fatality). Reuters reports the toll exceeding 4,000 confirmed cases (about 4,053) and 1,850 deaths, marking the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever and the fastest-spreading. Health services are overwhelmed; strikes, hospital attacks, and resource shortages hinder response. In Ituri, UNFPA notes maternal mortality rising from 3.1 to 5.8 deaths per week, with more births occurring outside facilities. The Catholic Church and Caritas are delivering aid, providing essential supplies and health education, enforcing safety in services, urging avoidance of risky gatherings and traditional funerals in coordination with missionaries and medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争とエボラに揺れるコンゴ。教会が支援に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最も感染拡大が速いエボラ流行が発生し、致死率44%、複数州に拡大、保健医療体制が崩壊しつつあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 報道間で症例数・死者数に差異あり（WHO:3,605例/1,587死亡 vs Reuters:約4,053例/1,850死亡）。史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされる大規模流行であり、紛争による人口移動、医療体制崩壊、産科死亡増加など複合的危機が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se dispara en la RD Congo: supera los 4.000 casos y roza el 46 % de letalidad tras sumar 1.000 contagios en 15 días
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surges in DR Congo: surpasses 4,000 cases and approaches a 46% case fatality rate after recording 1,000 infections in 15 days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 5, 2026, a case fatality rate of 45.7%. Declared May 15 in eastern DRC, the outbreak continues spreading at an unprecedented pace with suspected cases emerging in new areas beyond established transmission chains. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns there is no slowdown two and a half months after the declaration and urges an expanded international response. Currently, 694 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 793 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 77.7%. In Ituri province, only 59% of contacts have been located, highlighting difficulties in tracing and interrupting transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急拡大：4,000例を超え、致死率46%に迫る中、2週間で1,000例増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており、致死率が高く、国際的な支援要請も出ているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSFが国際的な対応拡大を要請しており、接触者追跡率も地域により低いため感染拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تدعو لتعزيز الاستجابة لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for strengthening the response to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC and the World Health Organization call for urgent strengthening of the community-based response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In a late Thursday post on X, WHO emphasized expanding early detection of cases, rigorous contact tracing, and sustained access to health care for affected populations, with support for frontline health workers and rapid delivery of resources to affected communities. The statement also underscored local community leadership and improved coordination between national health authorities and local administrations to contain transmission and protect residents and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、WHOとAfrica CDCが緊急の対応強化を呼びかけていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国で継続中の既知の流行であり、WHO・Africa CDCが対応強化を求めている。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・地理的拡大範囲は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: One monkey, 18 human victims: Sumatra finally catches attacker after two-week rampage forced island-wide school shutdown
article.articleSummary: Sumatra's Tembilahan in Indonesia experienced a two-week rampage by an adult long-tailed macaque that attacked 18 people across 19 incidents. Forty schools were closed, with hundreds of pupils learning online through at least Monday. As of Aug 7, 2026, 18 victims required medical care, with several needing more than a dozen stitches and rabies shots. The captured macaque was trapped on Thursday and later transported to Pekanbaru, the capital of Riau province, for tests to determine whether it is carrying any diseases. Officials warned the possibility of other monkeys acting aggressively, signaling broader human–wildlife conflict linked to habitat loss from palm oil expansion. Conservationists suggested the animal’s behavior may reflect human interaction or prior captivity; some noted it may have previously been kept as a pet. Authorities will decide on reopening schools after further assessments.

triage.headline_ja: 猿1匹、人間の被害者18人：2週間の暴走で島全体の学校が休校に追い込まれたスマトラ島、ついに加害猿を捕獲
triage.triage_reason: 野生の猿による多数人への咬傷事件で学校閉鎖など社会的影響は大きいが、狂犬病感染の確定情報がなく、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクもないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 捕獲された猿は狂犬病等の検査のためPekanbaruへ搬送されたが、結果は未報告。人への感染確定情報はなく、狂犬病ワクチン接種は予防的措置として実施された可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ponad 4 tysiące przypadków eboli w DRK. Epidemia znów przybiera na sile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 4,000 Ebola cases in DR Congo. The epidemic is gaining strength again.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 4,053 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths, up from 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths the prior week. In seven days, cases rose by more than 500, indicating a rapidly expanding epidemic, described by experts as the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history and the fastest-growing on record. Officials caution that the virus may have circulated before the 15 May official outbreak declaration, suggesting the true burden could be higher than official tallies. The World Health Organization and the Congolese Public Health Institute acknowledge ongoing logistical challenges and potential undercounting. While not yet at the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone, with over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths), the Congo epidemic strains local health services and underscores the need for modern diagnostics and broad public-information campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者4,000人超。流行が再び勢いを増す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例が急増し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速のアウトブレイクと報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の主題はDRCのエボラ流行である。

article.articleHeadline: للمرة الأولى منذ بدء التفشي: إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز عتبة الـ 4 آلاف حالة والمخاوف تتزايد من تحوّر الفيروس الفتاك - جنوبية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the first time since the outbreak began: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass the 4,000 mark, and concerns are growing about the mutation of the deadly virus - South.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time since the outbreak began, with over 1,800 deaths among confirmed cases. The outbreak, driven by the Ebola Bundibugyo strain, has accelerated over roughly three months since its May appearance, prompting urgent international action. Africa CDC, collaborating with the World Health Organization, will conduct joint laboratory and genetic studies to assess a possible viral mutation driving the rapid spread. Case numbers are markedly higher than those seen in the 2014 West Africa outbreak—more than eightfold in infections and over sixfold in deaths at comparable points. The health system is strained by an ongoing healthcare worker strike over pay and working conditions in the DRC, risking reduced containment and potential spread to neighboring countries, with officials meeting in Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイク開始以来初めて:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が4,000人を突破、致死性ウイルスの変異への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: 感染者数4,000人超・死者1,800人超と過去の流行を大幅に上回り、ウイルス変異の懸念や医療従事者ストによる対応能力低下、周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ含む）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、アンゴラは周辺国としての言及に留まるため verified_locations には含めていない。ウイルス変異の可能性についてAfrica CDCとWHOが共同調査予定であり、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев лихорадки Эбола в ДРК превысило 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the DRC has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, reaching 4,053 with 1,850 deaths reported to date. As of August 7, 2026, 694 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 793 have recovered, according to health authorities in Kinshasa. The update signals a sustained outbreak centered in eastern DRC. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the eastern outbreak is more serious than ever, spreading at alarming and unprecedented speeds with no signs of slowing. The report highlights a growing burden on health facilities and reiterates the urgent need for continued international humanitarian response to control transmission and support patient care across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の確定症例数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC東部で確定症例4,000人超・死者1,850人に達し、国境なき医師団が過去最悪の拡大速度と警告するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: MSFが過去最速・過去最悪レベルの拡大と警告しており、致死率も高い（約45.6%）。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 4.000 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό

triage.triage_reason: 5州にまたがり4,000例超・死亡1,850人と規模が急拡大しており、ワクチン・治療薬不足や紛争による対応困難も重なるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki Ebola salgınında 330 çocuk hayatını kaybetti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF: 330 children died in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF says 330 children have died in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of August 2, 2026, 743 confirmed cases have been recorded among people aged 17 and under, with 330 deaths. Children make up roughly a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of fatalities. Mortality among those under five is about double that of adults. The Ituri province is the hardest hit, where essential health services are severely disrupted. Fear of infection and disruptions at health facilities are deterring families from seeking care, leading to declines in vaccination, maternal health services, and other basic care. UNICEF Congo Representative John Agbor warned the outbreak is straining the health system and worsening outcomes for treatable conditions such as malaria and diarrhea in children.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行で子ども330人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、致死率が高く保健システムに深刻な影響を与えているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: UNICEFが公表したエボラ流行の子ども死亡者数に関する報告。イトゥリ州で保健システムが崩壊し、マラリアなど他疾患の管理にも悪影響が波及している。国際的拡大や渡航制限の記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Monyet Liar di Tembilahan Berhasil Ditangkap, 18 Orang Jadi Korban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wild Monkey in Tembilahan Captured, 18 People Became Victims.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, a wild long-tailed macaque captured in Tembilahan, Indragiri Hilir Regency, Riau, Indonesia, has attacked 19 people over two weeks, injuring 18 (one victim twice). Victims include children and the elderly; some wounds required stitches and rabies injections. The monkey was trapped Thursday night; Damkar released footage showing the stressed animal in a cage. Local officials warn there may be more macaques in the group. Forty schools in Tembilahan remain closed, with hundreds of students learning online for three days. The macaque has been moved to Pekanbaru for blood tests and observation by BBKSDA Riau to determine whether it carries disease. The incidents reflect ongoing human–wildlife conflict, linked to deforestation and habitat loss from palm-oil expansion in the region.

triage.headline_ja: テンビラハンで野生の猿を捕獲、18人が被害に
triage.triage_reason: 野生猿による連続咬傷事件で狂犬病予防注射が行われたが、動物の感染有無は血液検査待ちで未確定。感染症シグナルとしては情報不足のため続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا.. الإصابات تتجاوز 4000 للمرة الأولى منذ تفشي الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola... cases surpass 4,000 for the first time since the outbreak.

The effort aims to understand transmission dynamics and inform ongoing public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱…感染者数が流行開始以来初めて4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)感染者が4000人を突破し過去最大規模、ウイルス変異の可能性についてAfrica CDCとWHOが共同調査を開始しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: Africa CDCとWHOがブンディブギョ株の変異可能性について共同調査を開始したことは、感染拡大の要因解明とリスク評価に重要な情報であり、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo noch nicht besiegt -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Congo not yet defeated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, now spanning five provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo, after Ituri became the hotspot in May. The World Health Organization reports over 3,600 infections and 1,587 deaths. Survival depends on timely medical care in health centers, many operated with Caritas support. Caritas Internationalis has mobilized additional Ebola relief funds, including urgently needed personal protective equipment for staff; total contributions exceed €70,000. Containment hinges on community awareness campaigns, with infections reported across 49 health zones and potential for further growth. The outbreak remains active with no clear end in sight, and aid is being solicited to sustain response and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、いまだ収束せず
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで複数州（5州49保健地区）に拡大し、3,600人超の感染、1,587人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はCaritas Internationalisによる支援活動を中心に報じているが、WHOの死者数・感染者数データを引用しており、継続中の大規模アウトブレイクとして扱う必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: डीआर काँगो: विस्थापन शिविरों तक पहुँचा इबोला वायरस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola virus reaches displacement camps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, has reached displacement camps in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In Ituri province, at least five of 69 camps have reported Ebola cases, with 19 internally displaced people infected and 5 deaths. Since the outbreak was declared in May, roughly 4,000 cases and over 1,800 deaths have been recorded, with Ituri the most affected. Provinces reporting cases include Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo, where about 4.4 million internally displaced people reside. Refugees or asylum-seekers in camps have not yet shown infections, but cross-border spread risk remains. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of rapid transmission stressing health systems. UN agencies and partners are expanding surveillance, testing, treatment, and risk communication; CERF has pledged up to $60 million. Response efforts emphasize government coordination, health worker safety, rapid patient care, and safe burials; some areas report doubling weekly cases.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ:エボラウイルスが避難民キャンプに到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴの避難民キャンプに拡大し、約4,000例・1,800人以上の死亡、週次症例倍増の報告もあり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が急速な感染拡大とヘルスシステムへの負荷を警告。CERFが最大6000万ドルの緊急支援を表明。避難民キャンプでの拡大は越境感染リスクを高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Food Poisoning Odisha | 102 People Fall Sick After Feast, Treatment Underway
article.articleSummary: 102 people fell ill after attending a feast in Odisha, India, due to suspected food poisoning. Affected individuals report vomiting and diarrhoea and are undergoing treatment in hospitals as health officials monitor the situation. The exact cause is under investigation, with authorities reviewing food safety and hygiene practices at the community gathering. No laboratory confirmation details are provided in the report. The incident underscores concerns about food safety during mass events in Odisha and the need for ongoing surveillance to identify the infection source and prevent further cases. Published 7 August 2026 by Kanak News.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州で食中毒、宴会後に102人が体調不良、治療進行中
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒疑い事例であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限リスクは低く、感染症としての人-人感染の懸念も低いため、フルRRAは不要と判断。
triage.notes: 食中毒（疑い）事例であり感染症の国際的懸念は低い。ラボ確認情報なし、続報があれば経過観察の余地あり。
