article.articleHeadline: RDC-Ouganda: 242 millions $ supplémentaires des USA pour renforcer la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC-Uganda: $242 million in additional funding from the United States to bolster the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On August 5, the United States announced an additional 242 million dollars to bolster the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), lifting direct U.S. support to over 500 million and funding Ugandan preparedness and humanitarian aid. The funds will enhance epidemiologic surveillance, border screening, isolation and treatment capacity, health-system infrastructure, and risk-communication to counter misinformation. They complement 350 million dollars in emergency aid to the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of a 1.8 billion UN OCHA package. The DRC outbreak—now the largest on record—began in Mongbwalu, Ituri, and has spread to five provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo) across 49 health zones. By July 30, 2026, 3,626 confirmed cases (3,605 DRC, 20 Uganda, 1 France) and 1,589 deaths (44% CFR). Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28; France had one imported, recovered. WHO notes ongoing regional preparedness; reintroduction risk in Uganda persists due to transmission in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ：エボラ対策強化のため米国が2億4200万ドルを追加拠出
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模とされるDRCのエボラ流行が5州49保健地区に拡大し、致死率44%、国境を越えた感染例（ウガンダ、フランス）も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月28日に自国の流行終息を宣言済みだが、DRCでの感染継続により再流入リスクが指摘されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز 4 آلاف إصابة في ثاني أكبر تفشٍ عالمي | الصحافة اليوم - يومية اخبارية جامعة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 cases in the world's second-largest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases for the first time in the current outbreak, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported by the DRC Public Health Institute. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science journal report published last month concluded that transmission likely began in Ituri in January or even earlier, with the outbreak declared on 15 May. Experts caution that the true number of infections is likely higher than official tallies. The event constitutes the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest-spreading, behind only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak that infected more than 28,000 people across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、感染者数が4000人を突破し世界史上2番目の規模の流行に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱が4,000人超の感染、致死率約46%と深刻で、史上2番目の規模・最速拡大の流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にリベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネが含まれているが、これらは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC welcomes President Tshisekedi's direction and guidance for a Village-Centered, Accountable and Intensified Response to the Ebola Bundibugyo Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Africa CDC welcomed President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi’s leadership to accelerate the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. A high-level crisis meeting (5–6 August) in Kinshasa, with Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, Africa CDC DG Jean Kaseya, WHO DG Tedros, and partners, endorsed a six‑month plan following a field mission in Uganda and Bunia, Ituri Province. Uganda reported interruption of local transmission, while the delegation noted ongoing community transmission in the DRC, including during funerals, with delayed detection, gaps in contact tracing and infection prevention and control, insecurity, displacement, disrupted services, and stressed frontline staff. Eight immediate priorities were agreed, including: 1) a village-centered, community-led response; 2) free healthcare for Ituri and North Kivu with protections and supplies for workers; 3) digital transformation via an interoperable real-time platform; 4) safeguarding September school reopenings with infection control measures. Emphasis remains on community engagement and rapid, transparent response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクへの村落中心・説明責任型・強化対応に関するチシケディ大統領の指導方針を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクでDRC国内での市中感染が継続し、ウガンダとの越境事例も報告されており、大統領・アフリカCDC・WHOが関与する高レベル対応が行われているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの伝播は遮断されたと報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCでは葬儀を介した市中感染、接触者追跡やIPCの不備、治安不安、住民避難など継続的なリスク要因が複数指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aap die in twee weken achttien mensen verwondde gevangen in Indonesië
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A monkey that wounded eighteen people in two weeks was captured in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: An adult long-tailed macaque that roamed the city of Tembilahan on eastern Sumatra over two weeks attacked 18 residents, with 19 attacks recorded. Victims were bitten or scratched; some wounds required more than 12 stitches. The incidents prompted school closures and online learning for hundreds of students, with schools expected to reopen Monday. The macaque was captured last night in a government trap and is being transported to Pekanbaru for blood tests and behavioral observation to determine whether it carries diseases. Authorities say the animal is one of several suspected wild monkeys that attacked residents; people are urged not to approach or feed wild monkeys and to contact authorities if one is seen. The episode underscores human-wildlife conflict linked to habitat loss, and some victims were vaccinated against rabies.

triage.headline_ja: 2週間で18人を負傷させたサルがインドネシアで捕獲される
triage.triage_reason: 野生マカクによる連続咬傷事件だが、狂犬病感染は現時点で未確認（検査中）であり、確定情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 捕獲されたマカクの血液検査・行動観察結果（狂犬病等の病原体保有有無）が続報として重要。一部被害者は狂犬病ワクチン接種済みだが感染確定情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Unpaid health worker opens up on battle to slow fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province linked to Bundibugyo virus—the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Confirmed cases exceed 4,000 with over 1,800 deaths; Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases. Context notes the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (over 28,000 cases, >11,000 deaths) as the largest, and a 2018–2020 outbreak with at least 2,200 deaths. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; frontline workers disinfect contaminated areas, check visitors’ temperatures, and enforce handwashing. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments. The response is hampered by armed conflict and violent attacks on health teams and facilities. Front-line staff—including burial teams and drivers—continue working without pay; the average promised salary is $510 monthly, with many never paid. Mobile-money payments have been attempted, but strikes and unpaid wages disrupt care amid mid-May outbreak declaration and rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: 無給の医療従事者、史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクとの闘いを語る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）が発生し、感染者4000人超・死者1800人超、ワクチン・治療法なし、武力紛争により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではAngolaでの発生に関する記述がないため verified_locations から除外した。ブンディブギョウイルスはワクチン・治療法未承認であり、武装紛争と未払い賃金によるストライキが対応を著しく阻害している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Over 70, including 30 children, fall ill after community feast in Odisha's Balasore
article.articleSummary: Over 70 people, including 30 children, fell ill after a community feast in Kharida village, Balasore district, Odisha, held during a housewarming wedding function. Diarrhoea and vomiting began Friday among attendees; officials suspect contaminated food or drinking water, with samples collected and sent to a laboratory for testing. About 50 with severe symptoms were admitted to Jaleswar hospital; others received first aid. A medical team has been deployed to monitor the village and provide care. The incident follows two earlier major suspected food-poisoning outbreaks in different parts of the country, where more than two dozen were admitted to private facilities, six were referred to Sundargarh district hospital and one critically ill moved to VIMSAR, Burla; deaths were reported in Sundargarh and Jharsuguda districts. Lab confirmation is awaited to determine the exact cause.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州バラソール郡での共同宴会後、子ども30人を含む70人以上が体調不良
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州で発生した集団食中毒疑い事案で、複数の同種事案も報告されているが原因は検査待ちで不明な点が多く、国際的拡大やIHR基準への該当は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 汚染された食品または飲料水が原因と疑われる集団発症事案。ラボ検査結果待ちであり、感染症（人-人感染）ではなく食中毒の可能性が高い。同国内で他に類似の食中毒事案（死亡例含む）が報告されている点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Mislite, da je kuga stvar zgodovine? Še vedno je med nami in še vedno je smrtonosna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Do you think the plague is a thing of history? It is still among us and still deadly.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains a global health concern despite its association with the Black Death. Today it persists in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and, occasionally, the western United States, with pneumonic plague posing the highest risk due to human-to-human airborne transmission. Infections come from fleas and rodents, with bubonic plague causing swollen lymph nodes and severe pain, septicemic plague in the bloodstream, and pneumonic plague rapidly fatal if untreated—often within 48 hours for pulmonary cases. Between 2010 and 2015, roughly 3,000 worldwide cases and over 500 deaths were recorded, with Madagascar reporting the most annual cases; the last major outbreak occurred in 2017. Europe has been nearly free of plague since 1945, though travellers could reintroduce cases. Early diagnosis is crucial, as symptoms mimic flu; delays in antibiotic delivery in remote Madagascar areas remain a concern. A misdiagnosis example in Oregon underscores the need for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ペストは過去のものだと思いますか？今も私たちの中に存在し、今も致命的です
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報告する記事ではなく、ペストに関する一般的・歴史的な解説記事であるため、シグナルとして扱う根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はペストの歴史・疫学に関する一般解説記事であり、特定の新規発生事例や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。DRCは記事内でペストが持続的に存在する地域として言及されているが、具体的な新規イベント情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : plus de 4.000 cas confirmés, la riposte élargie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: more than 4,000 confirmed cases, the expanded response.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths, and 793 recoveries as of August 6, 2026. It is the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the most severe in the DRC since the virus’ identification in 1976. The epidemic spans 53 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces, with Ituri bearing 86.9% of confirmed cases. Jean Kaseya, director-general of Africa CDC, stated that the real number of cases may exceed official counts, noting that more cases may escape notification.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:確認症例4,000人超、対応拡大へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上2番目の規模に拡大し、死亡者数も多く、複数州にまたがる広域感染となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: Africa CDC責任者が実際の症例数は公式集計を上回る可能性を指摘しており、報告不足の懸念あり。史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、国際的な支援・監視の継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكوليرا تتفشى في تشاد.. 239 إصابة و13 وفاة | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera is spreading in Chad... 239 cases and 13 deaths | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: Cholera is spreading in Chad, with the Ministry of Health reporting 239 cases and 13 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared on 24 July, raising the case-fatality rate to 5.4%. The nationwide tally through last Monday shows 239 infections and 13 fatalities, underscoring the epidemic's severity in affected areas. Deaths are concentrated in Hadjer-Lamis governorate in the north and in the capital, N'Djamena, which alone accounted for 11 of the 13 August fatalities, indicating urban transmission in densely populated areas. In response, about 50,800 people have been vaccinated since the outbreak began, as part of an effort to curb spread. Notably, the first cholera deaths were recorded on 13 June, over a month before the official declaration. The report also notes ongoing cholera outbreaks in Africa, including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラが流行…239人感染、13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 本事象はチャドで発生しており、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは「アフリカで進行中のコレラ流行」の一例として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため対象国として検証されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行（239例、13死亡、CFR5.4%）。DRC・中央アフリカ・ナイジェリアは他地域の流行事例として簡潔に触れられているのみで、詳細情報がないため対象国としては検証しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spreads to DR Congo's Displacement Camps
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens: 19 internally displaced people infected and five deaths reported in displacement camps in Ituri province; no cases detected among refugees or asylum-seekers. Ebola has been confirmed in the provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, hosting about 4.4 million internally displaced people. Since the outbreak was declared in May, authorities have reported nearly 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The World Health Organization says the virus is overwhelming response efforts, particularly in conflict-affected areas where overcrowded camps, poor sanitation, and limited access to healthcare increase transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国の避難民キャンプにも拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの複数州で拡大し約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死亡が報告され、避難民キャンプなど脆弱な地域で対応能力が圧迫されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが対応能力の限界を指摘しており、紛争地域での感染拡大リスクが高い。継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus HIV di Kabupaten PPU Meningkat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Cases in North Penajam Paser Regency Rise
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS cases in North Penajam Paser Regency (PPU), East Kalimantan, rise in 2026, with 17 new HIV diagnoses by June and a total of 110 ODHIV (people living with HIV/AIDS) by July. Six of the June cases were deaths. Distribution by subdistrict: Penajam 64, Sepaku 26, Babulu 11, Waru 9. Officials attribute the uptick to expanded HIV testing and treatment access in Sepaku, not migrant inflows related to the IKN project. Service expansion since 2021–2025 includes Sepaku III, RSUD Pratama Sepaku, and three new facilities, enabling ART and viral load testing under Layanan Perawatan, Dukungan, dan Pengobatan (PDP). The key population driving growth is men who have sex with men (LSL); 7 LSL cases were recorded in June 2026. Age distribution: 92 of 110 cases are 20–40 years old. 11 Puskesmas and 2 government hospitals provide testing and PDP; private hospitals Hermina Nusantara and Mayapada Nusantara offer HIV testing but not PDP.

triage.headline_ja: 北ペナジャム・パセール県でHIV症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体レベルでの通常のHIVサーベイランス報告であり、検査体制拡充による診断数増加と説明されている。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、公衆衛生上の緊急性も低い。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、地域保健当局が検査拡充の結果と説明。ヒト-ヒト感染の急速拡大やアウトブレイクの性質はなく、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Επέστρεψε ο εφιάλτης της χολέρας στο Τσαντ: 13 νεκροί και 239 κρούσματα από την επιδημία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The cholera nightmare has returned to Chad: 13 dead and 239 cases from the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Chad faces a severe cholera outbreak with 13 deaths and 239 cases since the disease was officially recognized on July 24, yielding a case fatality rate of 5.4%. Most cases are in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and in the capital N'Djamena, where 11 deaths occurred in August. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated against cholera to date. The first death was recorded on June 13. This outbreak coincides with several African countries—Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria—also reporting cholera cases in recent months.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラの悪夢が再来：死者13人、感染239人の流行
triage.triage_reason: チャドで死亡13人・症例239人（致死率5.4%）のコレラ流行が発生し、中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ民主共和国・ナイジェリアでも同時期に症例が報告されており、地域的拡大の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 主要な発生地はチャド（対象国リスト外）だが、記事はコンゴ民主共和国など近隣国でも同時期にコレラ症例が報告されていると明記しているため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として計上した。チャド国内の詳細（ワクチン接種状況等）は参考情報として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Schlimmer Verdacht: Ist das Ebola-Virus im Kongo mutiert?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious suspicion: Has the Ebola virus mutated in the Congo?
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province, health authorities are examining a possible mutation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid an unprecedented Ebola surge. Africa CDC and the WHO report more than 3,900 confirmed cases with an estimated 4,000, as of August 5, in a outbreak centered on Bunia, with Mongbwalu about 90 km away. The first confirmed case was a nurse presenting on April 24; the region’s mining-driven mobility and armed groups hinder access. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has a case fatality of about 30–50%, lower than the Zaire ebolavirus variant, and there is currently no vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo, though vaccines against Zaire exist. Transmission requires contact with symptomatic individuals or infectious animals; no evidence supports airborne spread. Virologist Jean-Jacques Muyembe warns the outbreak could spread rapidly in this densely populated, conflict-affected area. Separate ongoing epidemiological investigations aim to determine the outbreak’s sources and dynamics in Ituri and surrounding localities.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻な疑惑：コンゴのエボラウイルスは変異したのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で3,900人以上の確定症例を伴う前例のない規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が続いており、変異の疑いや治療薬・ワクチン不在、紛争地域でのアクセス困難など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: Africa CDCおよびWHOが既に大規模流行として報告している事案であり、ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点、紛争・鉱山関連の人口移動によりアクセスが困難な点が特にリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını alarmı: Vaka sayısı 4 bini geçti!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak alert: The number of cases has surpassed 4,000!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is expanding, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain. First reported May 15, with possible spread since January. As of 4 August, 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths were reported; Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya said cases have surpassed 4,000. The outbreak is the second largest in Ebola history, with counts rivaling the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Investigations into possible mutation are underway with WHO involvement. Most deaths occur in the community rather than health facilities; in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province, about 90% of hospitalized patients had not been identified as contacts. The outbreak has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Uganda has 20 cases before control. Response shifts to active case finding and household visits; remdesivir will be used under humanitarian use, and Ervebo against Bundibugyo will be evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク警報：症例数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが4,000症例・1,801死亡に達し、複数州及びウガンダへ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。変異の可能性についてWHOが調査中との情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: les médias appelés à intensifier la sensibilisation communautaire contre l'épidémie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Media urged to intensify community awareness-raising against the Ebola outbreak - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, media professionals were urged to intensify community awareness to curb the Ebola outbreak during a meeting of the National Union of the Congo Press (UNPC) Beni subsection. About twenty journalists analyzed the media's role, the community, and response actors, concluding responsibilities are shared, though some journalists and responders fall short, and segments of the population continue to minimize Ebola. Journalists were urged to drive behavior change through magazines, radio spots, and interactive programs, stressing contextualized outreach. The group welcomed logistical support from the Swiss-funded Direction du Développement et de la Coopération (DDC) for content production. UNPC/Beni called for stronger mobility and equipment backing to maintain a field presence. A community-centered strategy, leveraging local languages and cultures, is seen as essential to rebuild trust and end the outbreak in North Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:メディアにエボラ流行に対するコミュニティ啓発強化を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ・イツリで進行中の既知のエボラアウトブレイクに関するメディア啓発活動の報告であり、新規発生や急変を示す情報はないが、アウトブレイクが継続中であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに対するコミュニティ啓発・メディア対応の会議報告であり、新規症例や感染拡大の具体的データは含まれていない。既存アウトブレイクのフォローアップとして継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Moderna Begins World's First Human Trial for Bundibugyo Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Moderna launches the world’s first human trial of mRNA-1469, an investigational vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). This Phase 1, randomized, observer-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-escalation study in the Democratic Republic of the Congo follows WHO data marking the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date: 3,748 confirmed cases, 1,657 deaths, and 708 recoveries across 49 health zones in five provinces as of Aug. 1, 2026. No licensed Bundibugyo vaccine exists; vaccines against Zaire ebolavirus are available. The first participant has received mRNA-1469, with the trial evaluating safety, local and systemic adverse reactions, medically attended and serious adverse events, and Bundibugyo-specific antibody responses to guide later efficacy studies. Moderna’s mRNA platform underpins the candidate, with CEPI funding up to $50 million for preclinical and Phase 1 work, and a pledge to provide at least 500,000 doses for LMICs if licensed. Four Ebola species exist, underscoring Bundibugyo protection gaps.

triage.headline_ja: モデルナ、ブンディブギョ型エボラワクチンの世界初のヒト治験を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（3,748症例、1,657死亡、5州49保健地区）が進行中であり、ワクチン未承認という深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はワクチン治験開始だが、背景にDRCでの史上最大級ブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（致死率約44%）があり、これ自体が重大なシグナルとなる。続報でWHOの公式リスク評価や国際的対応の詳細を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 印尼猴子疯狂袭18人终落网 - 国际 - 国际拼盘
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesian monkeys go on a rampage, attacking 18 people, and are finally captured - International - International Platter.
article.articleSummary: An adult long-tailed macaque in Tembilahan, Sumatra, Indonesia, went on a two-week rampage, injuring 18 people across 19 attacks, many of them when victims were alone; children and the elderly were among the injured. Some victims required stitches and rabies vaccination. The monkey was finally captured on Thursday in a town trap; a video released on Friday shows it confined in a cage, stressed but alive. Local officials warn the troop may include other monkeys and urge residents to remain vigilant. As of Friday, 40 schools remained closed, with hundreds of students learning online for three days; officials hope to reopen schools next Monday if safety is confirmed. The captured macaque has been transferred to the provincial capital of Riau Province for blood tests and observational monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの猿が凶暴化し18人を襲撃、ついに捕獲される - 国際 - 国際プレート
triage.triage_reason: 単一のマカクによる咬傷事件で狂犬病ワクチン接種者が出ているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、地域限定の公衆衛生対応事案として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の確定診断は記事中に明記されておらず、捕獲された猿の血液検査結果待ちの段階。学校閉鎖など地域社会への影響はあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança no Congo com mais de 4 mil casos confirmados; estudo indica que vírus circulava antes do surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in Congo with more than 4,000 confirmed cases; a study indicates that the virus was circulating before the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds 4,000 confirmed cases (4,053) and 1,850 deaths across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The outbreak, the second-largest Ebola epidemic globally, may have begun earlier than its official declaration, with a July Science study estimating it started in mid-January in Ituri; more than 500 suspected cases had been identified by May 15. Officials say the true number is likely higher, and Reuters notes experts believe infections may be undercounted. Containment has been hindered by late detection, overwhelmed surveillance systems, armed conflict, and lack of vaccines and treatments for the strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ拡大、確認症例4000人超；研究は流行前からウイルスが循環していたことを示唆
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が4,000例超・死亡1,850人と大規模流行し、複数州に拡大、武装紛争や監視体制の限界により封じ込めが困難であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 第二次世界最大規模のエボラ流行とされ、ワクチン・治療薬不足、武装紛争による対応困難が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RaillyNews - Chandipura Virus Outbreak in India: 22 Children Loss Their Lives
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, India is grappling with a Chandipura virus outbreak that has claimed 22 children. Chandipura virus, in the Rhabdoviridae family, is carried by insect vectors including sandflies, mosquitoes, and ticks, with activity peaking during the monsoon season. Transmission occurs through bites from infected vectors; human-to-human spread is not significant, though crowded conditions can raise exposure risk. Children under 15 are disproportionately affected due to developing immunity and outdoor exposure. Symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses and can escalate to encephalitis, with sudden high fever, severe headache, nausea, neck stiffness, and altered mental status or seizures. There is no specific antiviral therapy; care is supportive—IV fluids, antipyretics, respiratory support, and neurological monitoring, ideally with early hospitalization. Prevention centers on vector control and community awareness; ongoing surveillance in India and South Asia is essential during monsoon seasons.

triage.headline_ja: インドでチャンディプラウイルス感染症が流行、子ども22人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 子ども22人の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、チャンディプラウイルスによる脳炎流行は稀で異常な事象であるため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは過去にもインド（特にグジャラート州など）でモンスーン期に散発的流行が報告されており、媒介昆虫（サシチョウバエ等）による感染で人-人感染は稀。今回の流行規模・地域・対応状況の続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola Cases Surpass 4,000 in Record-Spreading...
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 4,053 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 1,850 deaths in its current outbreak, the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic to date. The surge affects Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces, with officials warning the true caseload exceeds official tallies. The outbreak was declared on May 15, but transmission may have begun as early as January 2026, with more than 500 suspected cases before declaration. Contributing factors include delayed detection, weak surveillance, ongoing armed conflict, and the absence of approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak now ranks as the world’s second-largest Ebola episode, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). No vaccine or treatment is approved for Bundibugyo, leaving containment hampered by insecurity and late detection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が4,000人を超え過去最速の拡大を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000人超・死者1,850人という大規模かつ急拡大するエボラ流行が発生しており、承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在、武力紛争による対応困難など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的比較としてシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアの2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に言及しているが、これらは現行の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が承認されておらず、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 4.053 Ebola-Fälle - Tödliches Virus breitet sich aus | Heute.at
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,053 Ebola cases - Deadly virus spreading | Heute.at
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, making it the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. Five provinces are hardest hit: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Official confirmation occurred on May 15, but experts warn the true toll is likely higher as the virus circulated for months prior. A Science paper cites more than 500 cases between mid‑January and May 15, suggesting origins in Ituri as early as January or earlier. Control is hindered by delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflicts, and a shortage of vaccines and treatments for the specific strain. By comparison, the largest Ebola outbreak (2014–2016) affected West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染4,053例 - 致死的ウイルスが拡大 | Heute.at
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目の規模・最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が発生しており、症例数・死亡者数ともに多く、監視体制の逼迫や紛争による対応困難、ワクチン・治療薬不足も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、オート・ウエレ、チョポ州でのエボラ流行について述べている。シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは2014-2016年の過去最大流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Kịp thời khống chế các ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Timely containment of dengue fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Five dengue fever cases have been recorded in Tan Duc village, Ky Hoa commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, as of August 7, 2026. The index patient, N.T.H., born 1959 and resident of Tan Duc, presented with fever, fatigue, headache, and body aches and was diagnosed by rapid test as dengue on August 4 after hospital admission on August 2 at Kỳ Anh Town General Hospital. By August 7, four additional infections were identified. Investigations indicate high Aedes mosquito density and numerous larval breeding sites in Tan Duc, with poor sanitation and many water containers. The outbreak poses a high risk of wider spread due to population density. Ha Tinh CDC, coordinating with Ky Hoa's authorities, has implemented containment: vector surveillance, larvicide campaigns, and environmental sanitation around the outbreak; 12 liters of disinfectant for spraying; 24/7 on-call outbreak monitoring; strict treatment and referral per Ministry of Health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱発生地を迅速に封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省で小規模なデング熱クラスター（5例）が発生し当局が対応中だが、規模は限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報の注視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地域流行性が高く、当局により迅速に封じ込め対応がなされている。現時点では小規模クラスターであり、フルRRAの必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Situación crítica en la RD Congo por el ébola: más de 1.800 muertos y casi 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Critical situation in the DR Congo due to Ebola: more than 1,800 deaths and nearly 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths. Ituri accounts for 3,460 cases; North Kivu 436; Haut-Uele 67; Tshopo 7; South Kivu 3. About 75.3% of identified at-risk contacts are under follow-up. The World Health Organization warns the transmission dynamics are uncertain and neighboring countries face elevated risk due to cross-border movement near Uganda and South Sudan. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (Bunia, Tchomia); North Kivu (Beni, Goma, Butembo); South Kivu (Miti-Murhesa); Tshopo (Makiso-Kisangani); Haut-Uele (Isiro, Rungu, Wamba). Imported/exported cases include two in the United States among aid workers, a doctor in France, and a UK-resident evacuee after exposure. Spain views exposure risk as low, relying on Red UATAN for high-risk infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機的状況：死者1,800人超、症例数ほぼ4,000人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）アウトブレイクが拡大しており、死亡者数・症例数ともに非常に多く、国際的な渡航関連症例（米国、フランス、英国）も発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・フランス・英国・スペインは輸入症例または低リスク評価であり、主要発生国はDRCのみ。周辺国（ウガンダ、南スーダン）への越境リスクがWHOにより警告されているが、対象国リストにこれらは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. ACNUR alerta para avanço rápido em campos de deslocados na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. UNHCR warns of rapid spread in refugee camps in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid refugee camps. UNHCR warns the virus is spreading rapidly; 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality 45.7%). Of 69 camps, at least five have reported infections; 19 camp residents infected and five killed. Internally displaced people in Ituri (87.1% of cases), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—home to about 4.4 million—face heightened transmission amid limited water and sanitation. 694 patients are in isolation or hospitalized; 793 recoveries; 77.7% contact tracing. As of 31 July, this is the second-largest Ebola outbreak by cases in history and the largest in DRC, the 17th outbreak there and the fastest-growing since declaration. Bundibugyo strain has 30–50% mortality; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda declared Ebola-free on 28 July after 20 infections (15 imported from DRC), with two deaths. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：UNHCRがDRコンゴの避難民キャンプで急速な感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模かつ拡大速度も過去最速のエボラ流行で、致死率45.7%、避難民キャンプでの急速な感染拡大とウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月28日にエボラ終息宣言済み（DRCからの輸入症例15例含む計20例、死亡2例）だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。主流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州が87.1%を占める）。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : hausse des cas de paludisme et d'anémie à Masambo, l'automédication déconseillée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: increase in malaria and anemia cases in Masambo, self-medication discouraged.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, a resurgence of malaria and anemia is reported in the Masambo health area, Basongora group, Ruwenzori sector, Beni territory, within the Mutwanga rural health zone in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. The alert, issued on 6 August 2026 by Kambale Wanza, a nurse at Masambo Reference Health Center, links the increase to self-medication, use of inappropriate treatments, and the lack of diagnostic tests before treatment. Many patients arrive at health facilities only when critically ill, complicating management and risking preventable deaths. Authorities urge residents to abandon self-medication and seek care promptly at a health center at the first symptoms to enable early diagnosis and management of malaria and related anemia, underscoring the need for proper diagnostics prior to treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：マサンボでマラリアと貧血の症例が増加、自己判断による服薬は推奨されず
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的なマラリア・貧血症例増加の報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、自己治療の蔓延や診断体制の不備という管理可能性の懸念があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方の一保健地区（Masambo、Beni地域、Nord-Kivu州）における局地的なマラリア増加の報告。地域医療従事者からの警告で、診断不足と自己治療が主な問題として指摘されている。全国規模の流行拡大や国際的な影響を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala reports 105 confirmed chikungunya cases: Symptoms, treatment and prevention tips everyone should know
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Kerala has confirmed 105 chikungunya cases, prompting authorities to strengthen surveillance and vector control. Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted to humans by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, the same vectors for dengue and Zika. The illness is usually not fatal, but can cause highly painful joint involvement lasting weeks to months in some patients. Symptoms typically develop within 3–7 days of bite and include high fever, severe joint and muscle pain, headache, rash, and fatigue. There is no antiviral treatment; care focuses on symptom relief. Diagnosis requires laboratory testing of blood for virus or antibodies. Prevention emphasizes mosquito avoidance: DEET, picaridin or IR3535 repellents; long sleeves and pants; nets; screens; and removing standing water from containers and water storage. Kerala's climate and rainfall sustain Aedes populations, underscoring continued vector control.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でチクングニア熱105例が確認、症状・治療・予防のポイント
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のチクングニア熱発生であり重篤性・国際拡大の兆候は乏しいが、ベクター媒介感染症として継続的な監視が必要なためWATCHとする。
triage.notes: インド・ケララ州における季節的なチクングニア熱の発生。当局によるサーベイランス強化とベクター対策が実施されている。重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、致死性は低いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết tại Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Outbreak Detected in Hà Tĩnh.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak detected in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam. In Tan Duc hamlet, Ky Hoa commune, five dengue cases have tested positive for Dengue virus (NS1 antigen); no deaths reported. The first patient, a 1959-born woman, developed fever, headache, fatigue, and body pains on August 1; rapid Dengue testing was positive on August 4 and she remains stable after treatment at Ky Anh Town General Hospital. Epidemiologic investigation shows high densities of Aedes vectors and abundant standing water and waste promoting transmission. Ha Tinh CDC and local authorities have implemented containment, epidemiologic surveillance, vector monitoring, environmental sanitation, and larval source reduction, and are preparing chemical spraying. Twelve liters of insecticide were provided; staff are on 24/7 duty with intensified surveillance to detect new cases early. A student case prompted urgent prevention. Residents are urged to clean environments, remove standing water, cover water storage, and conduct weekly larval control.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省でデング熱の発生集団を検出
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はベトナムで流行性の風土病であり、5例のクラスターで死亡例もなく、地元当局が通常の対応(消毒・環境整備)を実施しているため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には至らない。
triage.notes: 地方レベルでの通常のデング熱対応事例であり、地域CDCが自力で対応している。続報の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Τσαντ: 13 νεκροί και 239 κρούσματα από την επιδημία χολέρας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad: 13 dead and 239 cases from the cholera outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Chad's Ministry of Health reports 13 deaths and 239 cholera cases since the outbreak was officially recognized on July 24, with a case fatality rate of 5.4%. Most cases are in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the northern part of Chad and in the capital N'Djamena, where 11 deaths occurred during August. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated against cholera. The first death was recorded on June 13. The Chad outbreak comes as several African countries — including the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria — have also reported cholera cases in recent months.

triage.headline_ja: チャド:コレラ流行により13人死亡、239症例
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行の主体はチャド（対象国外）であり、DRC等の対象国は『最近症例報告あり』との言及のみで記事の主題ではないため、直接のフルRRA移行基準には該当しないが、周辺地域への拡大傾向は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行（対象国リスト外）。DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは『近隣諸国で症例報告あり』として言及されているのみで、詳細な発生状況は記載されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。今後DRC等での本格的な流行拡大が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lielbritānijā jau testē vakcīnu pret Ebolas vīrusu, ko izdevās radīt tikai astoņās nedēļās
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the United Kingdom, a vaccine against the Ebola virus is already being tested, which was developed in just eight weeks.
article.articleSummary: United Kingdom researchers are testing a vaccine against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain), developed in eight weeks, though no vaccine for this strain is yet approved. WHO notes there is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, making these new studies particularly significant. The Ebola outbreak began in May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cases later observed in Uganda. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as the outbreak spread. By early August, there were over 4,000 confirmed cases and about 1,850 deaths, marking it as one of the largest Ebola outbreaks in history. The situation underscores an ongoing outbreak and the critical need for vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、わずか8週間で開発されたエボラウイルスワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクはウガンダにも拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、感染者4000人超・死者約1850人に達する史上最大級の流行であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダと英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチンが存在せず、緊急にワクチン開発・治験が進行中であることも特筆すべき点。
