article.articleHeadline: Africa, Asia experts meet in China to strengthen foot-and-mouth disease preparedness - Farmers Review Africa
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) preparedness across Africa and Asia intensifies as authorities, policymakers, laboratories and researchers meet in Lanzhou, China, for the Asian-African FMD Prevention and Control Technology Workshop. Convened by FAO and the Lanzhou Veterinary Research Institute (CAAS), the workshop addresses a shifting FMD risk landscape as SAT1, a serotype once limited to sub-Saharan Africa, is detected in North Africa, the Near East and East Asia, with discussions on revising the Global FMD Control Strategy under GF-TADs. FAO warns vaccines used in the region are unsuitable for SAT1 and has launched emergency preparedness support to strengthen early warning, risk-based surveillance and rapid laboratory diagnosis. A FAO report dated August 6, 2026, underscores the need for resilient systems that detect disease early and adapt control measures. An Africa-Asia FMD Control Alliance is proposed to improve cooperation, data sharing, harmonised diagnostics and vaccination, alongside a new FAO SAT1 preparedness project for South and Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカとアジアの専門家が中国に集結、口蹄疫への備え強化を協議
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1血清型の拡散リスクに関する国際会議・準備強化の報告であり、動物疾病でヒトへの直接的健康影響はないが、越境拡大の可能性と国際協調の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物衛生（口蹄疫）に関する専門家会議の報告であり、ヒト感染症ではない。SAT1血清型が北アフリカ・中東・東アジアで検出されたとの記述があるが、具体的な発生国名（アフリカ諸国等）は明記されておらず、会議開催地である中国のみを確認済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Africa CDC mise sur les communautés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC relies on communities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the worst outbreak on record; Africa CDC shifts to a community-centric response, guided by resolutions under President Tshisekedi. The new plan centers on: 1) deeper engagement with villages and local populations; 2) accelerated vaccine and treatment research, with broader use of existing tools; 3) humanitarian measures including safe school reentry to limit transmission; 4) universal free care with government funding health staff and ensuring facility functioning; 5) strengthened coordination and traceability of the response. The United States contributes $242 million as part of ongoing international support, with continued dialogue with USAID. Continental plans initially projected over $520 million, and nearly 60% of announced funds have been disbursed. Payroll delays persist due to beneficiary identification; Bunia protests highlight the issue. Digitalization aims to ensure accurate staff payments. Africa CDC coordinates with WHO and national governments, aiming to replicate Uganda’s earlier success in ending the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国：アフリカCDCはコミュニティ主体の対応に注力
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における「過去最悪」とされるエボラ出血熱の流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際支援の必要性が明確であるためフルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行への対応強化（コミュニティ関与、ワクチン研究、無償医療、資金拠出）を主題としており、米国・ウガンダは支援国・過去の成功例としての言及に過ぎず発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa's Foot-and-Mouth Disease Vaccine Rollout and Agricultural Reform Take Center Stage
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth disease (FMD) outbreak in South Africa prompts a rapid vaccine rollout, with Agriculture Minister Willie Aucamp underscoring public-private collaboration. At the Free State Bloemfontein congress, the Department of Agriculture announced deployment of millions of vaccines; an initial one million doses has been delivered to private sector, with four million more due in two weeks. Of the four million, one million will be publicly distributed and three million routed to private stakeholders; the state will vaccinate emerging and underprivileged farmers unable to afford vaccines and deploy teams to new outbreak zones. Ongoing concerns include infrastructure decay and rising input costs, notably failing cold-chain equipment and dilapidated gravel roads. Internationally, plans to broaden market access include a September visit to China to finalize an export protocol for South African cherry products; red meat exports are also affected by FMD. Farmers advocate alternative funding and faster action.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカの口蹄疫ワクチン展開と農業改革が焦点に
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は南アフリカの家畜疾病であり、対象国リストに南アフリカは含まれず、中国は輸出協議の文脈でのみ言及されているため、ヒト感染症としての監視対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫（FMD）は家畜疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症ではない。発生地は南アフリカ（対象国外）で、中国は農産物輸出協議の相手国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Alta nas infecções por HIV acende alerta entre autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in HIV Infections Raises Alarm Among Health Authorities.
article.articleSummary: Latin America shows rising HIV infections between 2010 and 2025, according to the UNAIDS Global Report 2026 published 2026-08-07, with Brazil noting higher incidence amid broader HIV treatment progress. The report highlights substantial advances in antiretroviral therapy and prevention, yet Latin America diverges from other continents where incidence declines. Prevention measures include pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP); when used correctly and with ongoing healthcare follow-up, these strategies markedly reduce infection risk. In Brazil, the Unified Health System (SUS) provides PrEP/PEP following clinical assessment. Testing remains central: sexually active individuals at higher risk are advised to test every three to six months and to seek care after a risk exposure. Brazil reported 38,222 new HIV infections in 2023 and 39,216 in 2024, underscoring ongoing transmission despite prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: HIV感染の増加が保健当局の間で警戒を呼び起こす
triage.triage_reason: HIVの新規感染増加は長期的傾向であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当せず、突発的な公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: UNAIDSの年次報告に基づく長期トレンドの記事であり、急性の感染症危機や新興感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي فيروس إيبولا يتجاوز جهود احتوائه في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus outbreak surpasses containment efforts in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to widen, with about 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, after talks with the DRC president, said the outbreak is surpassing efforts to contain it, highlighting an urgent need for resources to bolster the response. The situation coincides with protests by dozens of health workers in Bunia, Ituri Province, demanding overdue salaries. They warn that unpaid wages hinder outbreak response and the delivery of essential health services. The remarks emphasize the scale of the challenge and the critical funding and workforce support required to accelerate containment and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の封じ込め努力を上回る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死亡に拡大し、WHO事務局長が封じ込め失敗を認めるなど、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 医療従事者の未払い賃金による抗議活動が対応能力を弱めている点、WHOトップが直接懸念を表明している点が特に注視すべき要素。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies Vaccine: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಲೇ ಇದೆ ನಾಯಿ ಕಚ್ಚುವಿಕೆ; ಲಸಿಕೆ ಪಡೆದರೂ ರೇಬೀಸ್ ಬರಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವೇ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Vaccine: Dog bites are on the rise in India; even after vaccination, is it possible for rabies to occur?
article.articleSummary: Rabies is a mounting public health concern in India as street dogs and dog bites rise. On August 7 in New Delhi, authorities said rabies deaths are increasing and announced investigations by teams from health, veterinary, municipal and forest departments. Though post-exposure vaccination offers strong protection, rare deaths after vaccination have raised questions about vaccine failure. Rabies virus travels from an infected bite through nerves to the brain over weeks to months; once symptoms appear, death is almost certain. Prompt post-bite treatment can prevent disease. The three essential steps after exposure are: 1) immediate wound washing with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes; 2) rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) for those not previously vaccinated; 3) a vaccine dosing schedule to build long-term immunity. Delays in PEP, not giving RIG, inadequate wound care, incomplete doses, or immune deficiency undermine protection. When given correctly, the vaccine is 100% effective.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病ワクチン：インドで犬咬傷が増加中、ワクチン接種後でも狂犬病発症の可能性はあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: インドで狂犬病死亡例増加という公衆衛生上の懸念はあるが、既知の風土病であり異常性・国際拡大リスクは低く、健康啓発記事の性格が強い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドの風土病であり、本記事は予防啓発・ワクチンの有効性に関する解説記事。デリー当局による死亡例増加への調査言及はあるが、具体的な症例数や急激な増加を示すデータは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Broj oboljelih od ebole u Kongu premašio 4.000; epidemija se širi rekordnom brzinom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo has surpassed 4,000; the epidemic is spreading at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, totaling 4,053 with 1,850 deaths. The outbreak is the second-largest in history and the fastest-growing to date, spanning five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Officials warn the true case count is likely higher, given circulation months before the May 15 emergency declaration. A Science study published last month suggests the epidemic began in January or earlier in Ituri, identifying more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. Contributing factors include delayed detection, overwhelmed health surveillance, ongoing armed conflict, and a lack of vaccines and therapies for this Ebola strain. Only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak exceeded it, with more than 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が4,000人を超える；史上最速のペースで流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が確定症例4,053人・死者1,850人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ史上最速の拡大速度であり、武装紛争下でワクチン・治療薬不足という深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去最大流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго выявили свыше 4 тысяч случаев Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 4,000 Ebola cases have been detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000: total infections 4,053 and 1,850 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate of 45.6%. In the past 24 hours, 80 new cases were reported. Figures are current as of 2026-08-07, according to the DR Congo Ministry of Communications and Media Affairs and cited by Day.Az. The article provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者4000人超を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱で感染者4,053人、死者1,850人（致死率45.6%）と大規模な流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 致死率45.6%と高く、24時間で80例の新規報告があるなど流行が拡大中。詳細な感染経路や検査確定状況は記事に記載なし。続報で国際的拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 寄生虫在脊髓"安家"12年，55岁男子半身不遂__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parasites have taken up residence in the spinal cord for 12 years, leaving a 55-year-old man with hemiplegia
article.articleSummary: A 55-year-old man from Hunan, China, with a 12-year history of spinal sparganosis due to sparganum larvae of Spirometra mansoni presented with progressive neurological decline, including dizziness, occipital pain, vomiting, urinary difficulty, back pain, bilateral leg numbness/weakness, and right eye atrophy. Thoracolumbar MRI showed long-segment intradural lesions compressing the thoracic–lumbar cord and cauda equina. A multidisciplinary team at Southern Medical University Third Affiliated Hospital diagnosed spinal sparganosis, prompted by exposure history (lake-adjacent living; consumption of fish, bullfrogs, and eels; potential ingestion of undercooked meat or contaminated water, and use of frog meat on wounds/eyes). On July 23, decompression, lesion clearance, adhesiolysis, and lamina reconstruction were performed; intraoperative inspection found no live worms, but white material from parasitic activity remained. Postoperative pathology and molecular testing confirmed Spirometra mansoni sparganum. Leg strength improved from grade 2 to 3. Prevention emphasizes avoiding undercooked frog/fish meat, contaminated water, and cross-contamination. A similar 2024 case was treated at this hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 寄生虫が脊髄に12年間住み着き、55歳男性が半身不随に
triage.triage_reason: 個別の慢性症例報告（脊髄裂頭条虫症、12年の経過）であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。疾患名（類鼻疽）もBluedotの誤分類と思われる。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患分類「Glanders（類鼻疽）」は誤りで、実際にはマンソン裂頭条虫による脊髄裂頭条虫症（sparganosis）の単発症例報告。感染経路は生魚・カエル・ウナギの摂取や汚染水との接触によるもので、ヒト-ヒト感染性はなく、アウトブレイクの兆候もない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو: تسجيل 1850 حالة وفاة والآف الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: 1,850 deaths and thousands of Ebola infections recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, per the Congo Public Health Institute. Cases span five eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Out-Wili, and Chobo. Researchers identified over 500 suspected infections from mid-January to 15 May. Described as the fastest-spreading outbreak of the current wave and the second-largest globally, it reflects delays in detection, strained surveillance, and shortages of vaccines and treatments for the circulating strain. The 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic remains the largest, with more than 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. As of 7 August 2026, health authorities continue to monitor transmission dynamics and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラウイルスによる死者1,850人、感染者数千人を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続しており、死者1,850人・確定4,053例と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、急速な拡大と国際的関心が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの現行流行を主題としており、リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक! क्या हैं लक्षण, कब और कहां कराएं जांच?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Delhi! What are the symptoms, when and where to get tested?
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) in Delhi-NCR shows a rapid rise: 1,349 confirmed cases as of August 7, 2026, more than fivefold from 229 last year, with no deaths reported yet. Monsoon-related conditions are cited as aiding spread. Symptoms resemble common viral fever, prompting testing; RT-PCR on nasal or throat swabs is the preferred method. A doctor’s prescription is usually needed for private labs, though mild cases may be managed at home. Private lab test costs range from INR 3,500 to 4,600; government hospitals offer free testing. Home-sample collection is available via major labs (Redcliffe, Healthians, Max Lab, Metropolis, Dr. Dang’s); trained phlebotomists collect samples and results arrive within about 24 hours. Precautions include masking, distancing, and prompt medical consultation; most infections are mild and resolve in 5–7 days.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでスワインフルー(豚インフルエンザ)が拡大！症状は？いつ、どこで検査を受けるべきか？
triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1確定例が前年比5倍以上（1,349件）に急増しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と住民の継続的曝露が懸念されるため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の毎年見られる増加であり、死亡例は報告されておらず大半が軽症。モンスーン季節との関連が指摘されており、既知の病原体による局地的な流行拡大と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا وراء انتشار هائل في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية قد يكون في حالة تحول، يقول المسؤولون - ميزو نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus behind a massive outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be undergoing a transformation, officials say - Mezzo News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, may be mutating as confirmed cases exceed 4,000. The National Institute of Public Health reported 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths by August 4, with Africa CDC stating cases have surpassed 4,000. The outbreak is the second-largest on record, roughly eight times the West Africa 2014–2018 outbreak in cases and six times in deaths at the same point. More than one-third of deaths occur in the community. In Bunia, Ituri, 90% of admitted patients were not listed as known contacts, and only about 10 contacts per patient were identified versus an expected 40. Authorities will shift to active case finding—door-to-door visits, community health workers, digital tools, and better camp procedures. Remdesivir may be used compassionately; Ervebo vaccination is to be evaluated in the province. UNICEF warns essential health services are disrupted; measles vaccine first dose fell 69% in Mongbwalo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模流行を引き起こしているエボラウイルスに変異の可能性、当局者が指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が4,000例・1,800人超の死者に達し史上2番目の規模となり、ウイルス変異の懸念と接触者追跡の困難、医療サービス崩壊（麻疹ワクチン接種率急落）を伴うため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事サマリー上で言及がないため除外。ウイルス変異の可能性、接触者追跡率の低さ（想定40件に対し10件）、麻疹ワクチン接種率69%減少など二次的公衆衛生被害も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC expands Ebola vaccine use as Congo outbreak tops 4,000 cases
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to deteriorate, with the Bundibugyo strain driving spread while Africa CDC expands the use of Ervebo, the licensed vaccine against Zaire ebolavirus. Goma and five provinces are affected; total cases surpass 4,000 with about 1,850 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The vaccination expansion aims to curb transmission despite the absence of a licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo. Remdesivir is also being considered as part of the response. Outbreak control has been hindered by delayed case discovery, inadequate contact tracing, insecurity, and shortages of vaccines and treatments, prompting authorities to broaden immunization coverage amid persistent transmission across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴのエボラ流行が4,000症例を超える中でワクチン使用を拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,000症例・約1,850人死亡という史上2番目に大規模なエボラ流行が継続し、既存ワクチン非対応株の拡大や国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するライセンス済みワクチンが存在せず、対応にRemdesivir検討やErvebo拡大使用など複数の対策が進行中。複数州にまたがる持続的伝播が懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases in Delhi: राजधानी में तेजी से पैर पसार रहा स्वाइन फ्लू! क्या है यह वायरस, जानें इसके लक्षण व बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Cases in Delhi: Swine Flu is Spreading Rapidly in the Capital! What Is This Virus? Learn Its Symptoms and Prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Delhi reports two deaths due to H1N1 swine flu, though the government has not officially confirmed fatalities. With the monsoon, swine flu cases are rising in the capital; the health department has activated alert measures, prepared government hospitals with additional beds, and will provide rapid testing and treatment for patients presenting dengue-like symptoms. Swine flu is caused by the H1N1 virus, a respiratory infection that originated in pigs but now transmits readily between humans. A 2009 identification of a new H1N1 variant in the United States led to a global pandemic. Common symptoms include fever, muscle pains, chills and sweating, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion/runny nose, eye irritation, fatigue, and diarrhea. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughing/sneezing and contaminated surfaces. Prevention emphasizes vaccination, masks, hand hygiene, and avoiding contact with infected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでH1N1感染例が急増：スワインフルーとは何か、症状と予防法を解説
triage.triage_reason: デリーでモンスーン時期の季節性H1N1（スワインフルー）症例増加と死亡報告（未確認）があるが、新規性・異常性は低く、公式な死亡確認や詳細な症例数などの情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーにおける季節性H1N1（スワインフルー）流行の一般解説記事。死亡例は政府未確認。米国は2009年パンデミックの歴史的言及のみで現在の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in Congo surpass 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed infections for the first time in the current outbreak, with 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths reported by the DRC Public Health Institute. The outbreak, now the second-largest globally and described as the fastest-spreading ever, has affected five provinces: Ituri, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. Officials warn that transmission began months before the May 15 outbreak declaration, and the true number of cases may be higher than official tallies. A Science report published last month traced the outbreak’s origins to January or earlier in Ituri, identifying more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. The article underscores the ongoing, rapid transmission and the likelihood of earlier, undetected spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し、症例数4,000人超・死者1,850人と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクは史上最速の拡大とされ、過小報告の可能性も指摘されている。5州（Ituri, Haut-Uele, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo）に拡大中。

article.articleHeadline: OMS y África CDC reclaman una ampliación urgente de la respuesta comunitaria al ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO and Africa CDC urge an urgent expansion of the community response to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC (Democratic Republic of the Congo) prompts urgent calls from WHO Director-General and Africa CDC to expand community response. As of 4 August, the DRC reports 3,973 confirmed Ebola cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces, with 99 new detections and 52 deaths in the last 24 hours. The leaders stress the need for earlier detection, intensified contact tracing, better access to care, frontline worker support, and faster delivery of resources to affected communities, noting operational challenges in Bunia. Uganda’s successful local containment is cited as a model emphasizing rapid testing, contact tracing, coordinated national action, trusted community engagement, and cross-border surveillance. They warn of ongoing transmission in eastern DRC, with neighboring countries at risk, and call for sustained funding, expanded treatment and laboratory capacity, safe burials, and continued essential health services.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱への地域対応の緊急拡大を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（確認症例3,973例、死亡1,801例）が継続し、WHO・Africa CDCが緊急対応拡大を要請しており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の両面でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対策成功モデルとして言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダでの発生ではなく国境を越えたリスクへの言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Вірус Ебола під час спалаху у ДР Конго міг мутувати охорона здоровя країни
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus during an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could have mutated the country's public health.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) may have mutated, raising public health concern. Over 4,000 confirmed cases have been recorded, with 1,801 deaths as of August 4, 2026. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya said the outbreak is the second-largest in history, with eight times more cases and six times more deaths than the 2014–2018 West Africa outbreak, which infected more than 28,000 people and killed at least 11,000. Authorities are intensifying response efforts and will identify cases during house-to-house visits. The Bundibugyo strain first emerged on May 15, though there are suspicions that transmission may have started in January. The Guardian reports these developments; health authorities are monitoring and attempting to control spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行、ウイルスが変異した可能性を保健当局が指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、変異の可能性や史上2番目の規模という点で社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリー内で言及がなく、主題はDRCのエボラ流行のみであるため除外。ウイルス変異の可能性はAfrica CDCの見解として報告されており、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : les habitants d'un quartier appelés à la vigilance pour lutter contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: residents of a neighborhood urged to be vigilant to combat Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: 7 August 2026—In Kisangani, residents of the Île Mbie neighborhood in Kisangani commune, Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, were urged to stay vigilant against Ebola virus disease (EVD) by national deputy Jean-Pierre Maowa during a public briefing. Maowa highlighted key prevention measures to limit transmission: regular handwashing with clean water and soap; avoiding contact with sick individuals or dead bodies without protection; promptly reporting suspected cases to health authorities; and strictly following health professionals’ guidance. He stressed collective responsibility to halt Ebola spread and pledged to support government and health partners in protecting Kisangani's population. The Île Mbie neighborhood chief, Mr. Binaliele, welcomed the initiative and the information provided about parliamentary activities, thanking the deputy for raising awareness.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:ある地区の住民にエボラ対策への警戒を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は本質的に重症度・伝播性が高く、コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニで国会議員による公的な注意喚起活動が行われており、社会的・政治的関心が確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべきである。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な確定症例数や発生状況を明示しておらず、国会議員による公衆衛生啓発活動を報じるものである。実際の症例発生状況について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: أوغندا تتحكم في إيبولا محليًا والكونغو تشهد تفشيًا مستمرًا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Uganda locally controls Ebola, and Congo is experiencing an ongoing outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains ongoing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda reporting local control of Ebola transmission. A high-level mission led by Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus of WHO, along with Africa CDC officials Dr. John Kasia and Dr. Mohamed Janabi, visited Uganda (Kampala) and the DRC (Bunia and Kinshasa) on August 4–5, 2026, to assess response gaps and success factors. The teams urged urgent, community-led measures to scale up containment: expanding community engagement, accelerating case detection, enhancing contact tracing, and ensuring healthcare and frontline worker support, plus rapid resource delivery to affected communities. The Uganda experience underscores the value of early detection and community outreach, while acknowledging ongoing transmission in DRC that threatens neighboring countries and necessitates preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ウガンダは国内でエボラを制御、コンゴでは流行が継続中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で継続的に発生しており、WHO事務局長らによる現地視察が行われるなど国際的関心が高く、周辺国への拡大リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に現地での制御に成功したと報告されているため、対象国リストに含まれていないウガンダは除外。DRCでの継続的な流行が主題であり、周辺国への拡大リスクも記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев Эболы в Конго превысило 4 тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola confirmed cases have surpassed 4,000 for the first time since the current outbreak began, with 1,850 deaths among 4,053 total cases. The outbreak has spread to five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Chopo. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and among the fastest-growing. Researchers say the virus may have circulated since January, but the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Between mid-January and declaration, more than 500 suspected cases were identified. Experts warn the true case count likely exceeds official figures, due to late detection, an overwhelmed surveillance system, ongoing conflict, and shortages of vaccines and therapeutics. The 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone remains the largest, with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が4000症例・1850死亡に達し、5州に拡大する大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの現行アウトブレイクを主題としている。リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去の流行への言及であり、現行の発生地域ではないため除外。対象国リストに含まれないため元々含められない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, allarme ebola su un battello: controlli a Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, Ebola alert aboard a boat: checks in Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-07, authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo halted a river vessel near Kinshasa carrying more than 300 passengers after the death of a traveler suspected to have Ebola. The ongoing outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, has already claimed more than 1,700 lives across the country. Four passengers presenting fever and other symptoms were isolated for laboratory testing, while health teams expanded vaccination efforts to curb transmission along the river networks. Officials intensified dockside and river corridor checks in Kinshasa to prevent cross‑river spread and protect at‑risk populations as the outbreak persists. Monitoring and vaccination campaigns aim to curb transmission along the Congo River basin.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、船上でエボラ警戒：キンシャサで検査実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（死者1700人超）がキンシャサ近郊の河川船に波及した疑いがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、死者1700人超）が首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクを示す事例。河川交通網を介した感染拡大の可能性があり、国際的注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đợt bùng phát dịch tả ở Chad có tỷ lệ tử vong gần 6%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Chad has a nearly 6% fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"Chad reports 239 cholera cases and 13 deaths since the outbreak was officially declared on 24 July, yielding a case fatality rate of about 5.4%. The outbreak affects Hadjer Lamis Province in the north and the capital, N'Djamena, with 11 deaths in N'Djamena in August. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated. The first death occurred on 13 June, before the declaration. Cholera is an acute diarrheal disease caused by bacteria transmitted through contaminated food or water; it is treatable with oral rehydration solution and antibiotics but can be fatal if not treated promptly. The ministry cites ongoing challenges from limited access to clean water and sanitation. Other African countries—including the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria—are also experiencing cholera outbreaks."}

triage.headline_ja: チャドのコレラ流行、致死率ほぼ6%に達す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事の主題はチャドにおけるコレラ流行であり、対象国（DRC等）は「他のアフリカ諸国でも流行中」として付随的に言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はチャド（対象国リスト外）のコレラ流行が主題。DRC・中央アフリカ共和国・ナイジェリアは『他のアフリカ諸国でも流行中』として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina reduz notificações e mortes por dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina reduces dengue notifications and deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Londrina, Brazil, reports continued improvement in dengue epidemiology in 2026. The Municipal Health Secretariat's dengue bulletin shows significant declines: dengue notifications drop 48.7% from 20,765 in 2025 to 10,650 in 2026; confirmed dengue cases fall 72.1% from 4,739 to 1,321. Dengue-related deaths decrease from nine in 2025 to two in 2026. In the latest epidemiological week, 12 new cases brought the total to 1,321, up from 1,309. There are no confirmed cases of Zika or chikungunya in 2026. Health officials stress that reduced numbers do not end preventive efforts; continue actions from the Dengue Contingency Plan and eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites at homes. Residents can report potential breeding sites via Disque Dengue 0800-400-1893 (Mon-Fri, 8am–5pm) or online. Dengue vaccination remains free at all Londrina UBSs for children and adolescents aged 10–14, using the two-dose Qdenga schedule funded by SUS since 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナ、2026年にデング熱の報告数と死亡数を減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数・死亡数はいずれも大幅に減少しており、状況は改善傾向にある。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は改善傾向を報告する内容であり、危機的なシグナルではない。デング熱ワクチン接種など予防活動は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Chad Cholera Outbreak Claims 13 Lives | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: Chad's cholera outbreak has claimed 13 lives and 239 confirmed cases since it was officially declared on 24 July. The hardest-hit areas are Hadjer-Lamis and the capital N'Djamena, with 11 fatalities recorded in N'Djamena in August. More than 50,800 people have been vaccinated since the declaration. The first cholera-related death occurred on 13 June, about a month before the official declaration. The spread has prompted intensified regional disease surveillance and vaccination across neighboring Africa, with outbreaks reported in the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: チャドのコレラ流行、13人死亡
triage.triage_reason: チャドで13人死亡・239症例のコレラ流行が発生し、中央アフリカ共和国・コンゴ民主共和国・ナイジェリアへの拡大が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: チャド、中央アフリカ共和国、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事内で『outbreaks reported』とされているため含めたが、詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Unpaid health workers desert Ebola facilities in DR Congo -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected around 4,000 people and killed more than 1,800 since it was declared in May. Ituri province, centered on Bunia, accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases, with spread to four other eastern provinces. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo; clinical trials are underway. WHO calls it the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Dozens of health workers protested months of unpaid wages, deserting facilities and disrupting response efforts in Bunia. Africa CDC notes funding for the response exceeds $700 million, including a $242 million U.S. pledge, while stressing delivery of resources to frontline operations remains key. Plans to intensify response include door-to-door case finding. Separately, nearly 200 riverboat passengers near Kinshasa were quarantined after a traveler who had disembarked in Mongala died with Ebola-like symptoms; all tests in Kinshasa were negative.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ対応施設から無給の医療従事者が離脱
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速拡大と評価するエボラ(バンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクで感染者約4,000人・死者1,800人超、複数州へ拡大し医療従事者の離脱により対応に支障が出ているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しないバンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイク。資金は7億ドル超確保されているが医療従事者への未払い賃金が対応を妨げている。キンシャサ近郊での船客検疫は陰性で収束したが、地域拡大リスクは継続している。

article.articleHeadline: ভাইরাল জ্বরের থেকেও মারাত্মক, মস্তিষ্কে সংক্রমণ ঘটছে শিশুদের, কোন ভাইরাসের আতঙ্ক ছড়াল দেশে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More deadly than viral fever, brain infections are occurring in children; which virus has sparked fear across the country?
article.articleSummary: Chandipura vesiculovirus (Chandipura virus), a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, is triggering acute encephalitis in Indian children. Following fever with chills, vomiting and diarrhea, affected youngsters develop acute encephalitis syndrome with severe headache, seizures, loss of consciousness, brain swelling, and potential paralysis; disease can be fatal within 24–48 hours in severe cases. The virus is not spread by coughing or sneezing; transmission occurs via insect vectors—sandflies and other biting insects such as ticks—with the virus present in vector saliva and possibly via contaminated excreta. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; treatment is supportive. While cases can involve children under 5, outbreaks have spread beyond Gujarat and Maharashtra to other parts of the country. Published 2026-08-07. Health authorities advise urgent hospital care for persistent fever, vomiting, seizures, or severe headache in young children.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性発熱より深刻、子どもの脳に感染 ― 国内で恐怖を広げるウイルスの正体とは？
triage.triage_reason: 小児における致死的な急性脳炎（チャンディプラウイルス）がグジャラート州・マハーラーシュトラ州から他地域へ拡大しており、重症度・拡大性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスは過去にもインドで散発的流行歴あり（2003-2004年、2024年）。媒介生物（サシチョウバエ等）を介した感染で、ヒト-ヒト感染は報告されていない。24-48時間で致死する重症例があり、5歳未満の小児が主な被害者。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF alerte sur une propagation sans précédent et appelle à intensifier la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF warns of an unprecedented spread and calls for stepping up the response.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of unprecedented Ebola spread in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. In a August 5, 2026 press release, MSF reports the outbreak continues to accelerate two months after declaration. WHO records 3,605 confirmed cases as of August 1, 2026, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC to date, with about 1,500 deaths after 11 weeks. New suspected cases are reported daily in new localities beyond known transmission chains. MSF calls for a faster response and strengthened international medical support, noting that 90% of patients admitted to Ebola Treatment Centers were not traced contacts, and only 59% of contacts were traced across Ituri. Emphasizes stronger community engagement, collaboration with local actors, safe access for humanitarian staff, and sustained health-system support to manage malaria, measles, cholera, malnutrition, and other diseases during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC:MSFが前例のない拡大を警告し、対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が拡大中で、致死率が高く追跡できていない接触者が多いため国際的拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行。3,605例確認、約1,500人死亡（致死率約41%）。接触者追跡率59%と低く、90%の患者が既知の感染チェーン外から。マラリア・麻疹・コレラ等他疾患への医療体制への影響も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola crisis spiralling out of control: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating beyond containment, with 1,801 deaths and rising infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an urgent, massive scale-up of response measures after consultations in Kinshasa, noting new cases doubling in some hotspots over the past week. Access to affected communities is hindered by insecurity and mass displacement, underscoring the need for stronger government-led coordination, protection for frontline workers, and enhanced treatment and surveillance. Ministry of Health data show confirmed cases rising from 3,674 on 31 July to 3,973 on 4 August, with deaths up by 180 in the period. The outbreak has spread to 51 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri province hardest hit. It is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment, complicating containment. The crisis coincides with political instability, including M23 rebel activity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機、制御不能に陥る:WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が「制御不能」と警告する大規模エボラ流行で、死者1,801人・5州51保健地域に拡大、承認ワクチン/治療薬のないブンディブギョ株が原因であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自らキンシャサで協議し「制御不能」と発言。武装勢力M23の活動による治安不安・住民避難がアクセスを阻害し対応を困難にしている。承認されたワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株が原因である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo em São Paulo fazem Ministério da Saúde voltar com as vacinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in São Paulo prompt the Ministry of Health to restart vaccinations.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo region prompts Brazil's Ministry of Health to restart vaccination with a 'dose zero' for infants 6–11 months, for ages 1 year–29 years, and for adults 30–59 years, targeting São Paulo city and neighboring São Bernardo do Campo and Guarulhos, with guidance to states nationwide to support immunization. In 2026, Brazil reports 17 measles cases: 13 in São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 2 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Rio de Janeiro; 14 additional cases are under investigation in the three Paulistas, with three resolved. Measles is highly transmissible, with up to 18 secondary infections per case. The vaccination drive runs through September 1, 2026, with a possible extension. Context notes Brazil’s elimination status, once declared, briefly lost in 2029 amid widespread outbreaks, and reestablished in 2024–25, underscoring vaccination and surveillance importance.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでの麻疹症例増加を受け、保健省がワクチン接種を再開
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定国であるブラジルでの症例再発かつ政府がワクチン接種キャンペーンを再開しており、WPRO基準（異常性・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認定を受けたが2019年頃に一時喪失し、2024-25年に再認定された経緯があり、今回の再発は排除状態維持の観点から重要視される。現時点で症例数は17件と少数だが、感染力の高さ（1例あたり最大18次感染）と全国的なワクチン接種指導が行われている点から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 50 muertos al día y 99 nuevos contagios, el último balance del ébola | Diario Sur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 50 deaths per day and 99 new infections, the latest Ebola figures | Diario Sur
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, with 99 newly confirmed cases and 52 deaths reported in the last 24 hours, raising total to 3,973 cases and 1,801 deaths as of Tuesday. Contact tracing stands at 75%, below the 95% target. Health facilities are overwhelmed; treatment centers in North Kivu exceed capacity at 139%. Africa CDC and WHO call for urgent international action to ensure earlier detection, improved contact tracing, greater access to care, frontline worker support, and faster resource delivery. Uganda's containment is cited as a positive example (20 cases, 2 deaths; all contacts identified; emergency ended late July). A field mission led by Tedros Adhanom visited Kampala, Bunia, Kinshasa, stressing community engagement as pivotal to containment, with clear information, timely alerts, and safe, dignified burials.

triage.headline_ja: 1日50人死亡、新規感染99人、最新のエボラ出血熱の集計
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が制御不能となっており、死亡者数・症例数が急増し医療体制が逼迫。国際的な緊急対応が要請されておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダについても言及があるが、記事内ではウガンダの流行は既に7月末に終息したと明記されており、主題はコンゴ民主共和国の継続的な流行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 13 حالة وفاة ومئات الإصابات.. القصة الكاملة لتفشي الكوليرا في تشاد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 13 deaths and hundreds of cases: The full story of the cholera outbreak in Chad
article.articleSummary: Chad is facing a cholera outbreak, with 239 cases and 13 deaths reported nationwide since the official outbreak was declared on July 24, 2026. The case fatality rate stands at about 5.4%. Most cases are in the Hadjer-Lamis region in northern Chad and in the capital, N'Djamena, which recorded 11 deaths in August. The earliest cholera-related deaths were registered on June 13, prior to the official declaration. Health authorities have vaccinated about 50,800 people since July 24 as part of containment efforts. Cholera spreads mainly through contaminated water and food; control relies on safe water, sanitation, rapid case detection, and rehydration therapy, with antibiotics in some cases. Chad's outbreak is part of a regional pattern: neighboring Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria have reported outbreaks, highlighting the need for improved water and sanitation infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: 13人死亡、数百人感染:チャドにおけるコレラ流行の全容
triage.triage_reason: チャド国内でのコレラ流行が拡大し死者13人・症例239件に達しており、周辺国（中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ民主共和国、ナイジェリア）でも流行が報告されるなど地域的拡大の兆候があるため、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）を2つ満たしフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャド（対象国リスト外）だが、コンゴ民主共和国も同様の流行を報告している旨が明記されているため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。チャド自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Calls for Strengthened Response to Ebola Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak triggers a joint call by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention and the World Health Organization for a strengthened community response. As of 7 August 2026, officials urge rapid expansion of early case detection and contact tracing, guaranteed access to healthcare, and enhanced protection and support for frontline health workers, alongside expedited delivery of resources to affected communities. The WHO underscores the central role of community leadership and tighter coordination between health authorities and local governments to stop transmission and protect both the population and healthcare workers. The article does not provide case or death tallies. The emphasis is on intensified surveillance, community engagement, and timely resource mobilization to bolster containment efforts in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行への対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であり、WHO・アフリカCDCが対応強化を共同で呼びかけていることから公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡数の具体的データは記事に記載されておらず、規模の把握には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS appelle à un renforcement de la riposte face à l'épidémie d' 'Ebola' en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for strengthening the response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization (WHO) urged an urgent strengthening of the community response. In a Thursday evening post on X, relayed by Yemeni news agency Saba, WHO stressed the need to intensify early case detection, contact tracing, and access to care, while bolstering frontline healthcare workers and accelerating resource delivery to affected communities. It underscored the pivotal role of communities in driving the response and called for stronger coordination between national health authorities and local authorities to halt virus transmission and safeguard the public and healthcare personnel.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱流行への対応強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOとAfrica CDCが対応強化を要請していることから国際的関心・支援の必要性が確認できるため。
triage.notes: イエメンは記事の主題国ではなく、単に配信元通信社(Saba)の所在国であるため除外。エボラ発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO praises Uganda's response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-species Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, first confirmed in May 2026, with no approved vaccine. Uganda reports 19 confirmed and 1 probable case, infections largely linked to DRC and cross-border movement. The World Health Organization commended Uganda’s response amid humanitarian pressures and security challenges, noting new laboratories, strong community cooperation, and patient recoveries. WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu spent three weeks in Uganda; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus lauded robust surveillance, testing, and case management enabling rapid identification and management of cases. The last confirmed patient was discharged from Mulago National Isolation and Treatment Centre in Kampala on July 16, 2026, and the outbreak was officially declared over on July 28, 2026. Critics, including Allan Kasujja, argued declaring an outbreak harmed the economy and that Uganda’s cases were largely imported, with a few infected health workers involved.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行対応を称賛
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち複数（重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するエボラ出血熱の越境事例であり、既に終息宣言済みだが公式記録として評価対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC・ウガンダ間で発生したBundibugyo種エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年5月確認、2026年7月28日終息宣言済み）に対するWHOの対応評価記事。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。既に終息済みのため新規リスク評価の緊急性は低いが、記録として確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho aposta na ciência para enfrentar avanço das arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho bets on science to tackle the spread of arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, launches a Wolbachia-based strategy to curb arboviral diseases transmitted by Aedes aegypti, including dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Mosquitoes carrying Wolbachia bacteria will be released to reduce the population’s ability to transmit viruses, serving as a complementary tool to ongoing vector-control measures such as eliminating breeding sites and household practices. Evidence from other Brazilian cities suggests potential impact: Niterói, Rio de Janeiro, saw an 89% reduction in dengue cases after adoption, while Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, reported about a 64% drop. The article notes that efficacy depends on local conditions, sustained monitoring, transparent communication, and community involvement. The Wolbachia rollout is not a replacement for traditional prevention but adds a science-based option to strengthen public health efforts against arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ヴェーリョ、節足動物媒介性感染症の拡大に対処するため科学に賭ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱等の対策としてウォルバキア法導入を紹介する予防施策の報道であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既存のアルボウイルス対策（ウォルバキア法）の導入・拡大に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Centre steps up leptospirosis surveillance, preparedness | Today News
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, a bacterial disease transmitted via water or soil contaminated by urine from rodents and livestock, prompts renewed Centre‑level surveillance and preparedness in India ahead of and during the monsoon. The disease can rapidly progress to multi‑organ failure, jaundice, internal bleeding and death if untreated; early symptoms include fever, severe headache and muscle pain. The health ministry ordered real‑time reporting through the Integrated Health Information Platform under the Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme, with states asked to tailor local outbreak prevention plans. Emphasis on enhanced laboratory testing, uninterrupted essential medicines, rapid response teams, and drainage of standing water to reduce exposure. Vaccination and active livestock surveillance are prioritized. India reports about 10,000 leptospirosis cases annually; Kerala recorded 3,259 confirmed cases and 209 deaths in 2025, with over 1,300 more cases through mid‑2026. Monsoon spikes drive transmission and require pre‑monsoon action.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府、レプトスピラ症のサーベイランスと備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドで毎年発生する季節性（モンスーン期）のレプトスピラ症流行に対する政府の予防的対応を報じる内容であり、異常性は低いが、ケララ州での死亡者数（2025年209人）など重症度データがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はヒト-ヒト感染しない人獣共通感染症であり、モンスーン期の季節的増加は例年見られる現象。中央政府によるサーベイランス強化は予防的措置であり、新規または異常な発生ではない。ただしケララ州の症例数・死亡者数の推移は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lansia Korban Gigitan Anjing Rabies di Padang Batung HSS Masih Dirawat, Alami Luka dan Jari Patah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly Rabid-Dog Bite Victim in Padang Batung, HSS, Still Receiving Treatment, Sustains a Wound and a Broken Finger
article.articleSummary: An elderly dog-bite victim in Pandulangan village, Padang Batung District, Hulu Sungai Selatan (HSS), South Kalimantan, remains hospitalized at RSUD Brigjend H Hasan Basry Kandangan after a stray dog bite on August 5, 2026 around 06:00 WITA. The patient sustains severe wounds to both arms and fingers, with some fractures, and is conscious but under treatment. The attack involved a dog suspected to be rabies-positive; authorities note rabies-positive cases among dog-bite incidents in Padang Batung, with two of three cases confirmed rabies-positive. Village leadership, in coordination with the District Department of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Food (Distan PP) HSS, plans anti-rabies vaccination (VAR) for animals around the village. Camat Padang Batung, Ahmad Nabhan, urges calm and vigilance. First aid guidance includes washing wounds with running water and soap, seeking medical care promptly, and reporting incidents to village officials. Mass vaccination campaigns for dogs and other animals are being organized across all villages to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: パダンバトゥン(HSS)の狂犬病感染犬による咬傷を受けた高齢者、治療継続中―負傷と指の骨折
triage.triage_reason: 地域内での野犬による狂犬病陽性咬傷事例（3件中2件陽性）だが、既に地元当局によるワクチン接種対応が進行中で国際的な波及性は低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 南カリマンタン州フル・スンガイ・スラタン県の一地域での狂犬病疑いの野犬咬傷事例。地元当局が動物への予防接種キャンペーンを開始しており、地域限定の公衆衛生対応事案とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus behind massive outbreak in DRC could be mutating, officials say
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,800 deaths. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with eight times more cases and six times more deaths than 11 weeks into the 2014-18 West Africa epidemic. About two-thirds of deaths occur in community settings, indicating untracked spread. Response shifts from traditional contact tracing to active case finding, including door-to-door searches; tracing averages roughly 10 contacts per patient, far below the expected 40. The outbreak centers in Ituri province, with spread to other provinces and 20 cases in Uganda. Treatments include compassionate remdesivir use and Ervebo vaccine; preliminary data suggest protection against Bundibugyo, though Ervebo is licensed for a different Ebola variant. Public health measures alone may be insufficient; emphasis on community engagement and digital tools, amid disruptions to routine vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで大規模流行中のエボラウイルス、変異の可能性と当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（4000例超、死亡1800人超）で史上2番目の規模、ウガンダへの越境拡大やウイルス変異の懸念もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの20例拡大やアンゴラも発生地域に含むが、サマリー上で主題として明確に発生が確認できるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウイルス変異の可能性は継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện viêm gan B rồi bỏ điều trị suốt 20 năm, người đàn ông 53 tuổi phải lọc máu, vợ con cũng nhiễm bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diagnosed with hepatitis B and then stopped treatment for 20 years, a 53-year-old man needs dialysis; his wife and children are also infected.
article.articleSummary: 53-year-old man from Nam Định Province discovered hepatitis B 20 years ago; after antiviral therapy he felt well and stopped follow-up, assuming clearance. HBV can persist silently in liver cells for decades, gradually causing inflammation, fibrosis, cirrhosis, ascites, esophageal variceal bleeding, and eventual liver failure or cancer, often with no early signs. Twenty years later he presents with fatigue, abdominal distension, and infection-related complications, now dialysis-dependent. His wife and children were not tested or vaccinated until screening revealed infection. In another Nam Định family, two brothers inherited HBV from their mother; the elder was diagnosed early and adheres to treatment and prevention for his wife and children, while the younger, diagnosed at 45, also transmits to wife and son. After treatment at Bach Mai Institute of Tropical Diseases and Bach Mai Hospital, health improved. Emphasizes routine viral-load testing, fibrosis assessment, vaccination, and not stopping antivirals without medical guidance; mother-to-child transmission remains a key route.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎と診断されながら20年間治療を中断していた53歳男性、人工透析が必要な状態に。妻子も感染
triage.triage_reason: 個人の慢性B型肝炎の事例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常の家族内・母子感染のケーススタディに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 個別患者の医療啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクやクラスター発生の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo afronta el peor brote de ébola de su historia: la ciencia investiga su velocidad de propagación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst Ebola outbreak in its history: science is investigating how quickly it is spreading.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the epicenter in Ituri and spillover to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. By August 4, 2026, 3,973 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths were reported, with 674 hospitalized or isolated and 776 recoveries. It is the fastest-growing outbreak in the DRC since the virus was identified, surpassing the 2018-2020 eastern outbreaks (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths) and marking the country’s 17th Ebola epidemic. Africa CDC shifted to door-to-door active case finding due to sustained community transmission, amid insecurity and population movement that hinder early isolation. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccines or approved treatments, making containment rely on epidemiologic control. UNICEF warns the outbreak is disrupt­ing routine health services and measles vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが史上最悪のエボラ流行に直面：科学者たちが感染拡大の速さを調査
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、死者1,800人超・確認例約4,000人に達しており、IHR基準を複数満たすため直ちにフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、治安不安・人口移動が封じ込めを困難にしている。麻疹ワクチン接種活動にも影響が及んでいる点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Virusul Ebola ar putea suferi mutații. Autoritățile africane iau o decizie fără precedent după explozia numărului de cazuri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus could mutate. African authorities are taking an unprecedented decision after a surge in the number of cases.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expands, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths by August 4, 2026; Africa CDC later said cases surpassed 4,000. Announced in May but circulating since January, it is the second-largest Ebola outbreak. Authorities fear unusual severity and potential mutations; WHO and Africa CDC will study the virus, though no evidence yet. Transmission is widespread; at a Bunia MSF center, about 90% of inpatients were not on official contact lists. Response shifts to door-to-door case finding, home visits, community engagement, digital surveillance, and intensified work in IDP camps. Treatments include Remdesivir in compassionate use; Ervebo vaccination is being evaluated, with early data suggesting milder disease and no deaths among the vaccinated. A suspected Ebola death on a boat to Kinshasa triggers testing and quarantine; UNICEF warns of strain on other health services.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが変異する可能性。症例数急増を受け、アフリカ当局が前例のない決定を下す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ株エボラ流行が過去2番目の規模（確認症例3,973、死亡1,801）に拡大し、変異懸念や接触者リスト外の感染拡大、キンシャサへの拡散兆候があり、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行の拡大を主題としており、Kinshasa・Buniaは同国内の都市であるため個別国としては扱わない。ウイルス変異の可能性やワクチン効果の初期データなど、続報の確認が必要な情報も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Le virus Ebola s'infiltre dans les camps de déplacés, l'ONU redoute
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus infiltrates displaced persons camps, the UN fears.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases appear among thousands in displacement camps in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, per the United Nations on August 7, 2026. The virus’s presence in crowded shelters heightens fears of rapid spread, as extreme overcrowding and limited access to basic health care turn the humanitarian crisis into a major public health challenge. Responders warn that response efforts at camps require expanded epidemiological surveillance and intensified community awareness to rapidly identify suspected cases and interrupt transmission chains. Ongoing food distribution and humanitarian aid must be maintained alongside strict infection prevention measures. The UN warns that current efforts may be insufficient without increased international support, urging immediate mobilization of additional resources to equip health centers with appropriate care and protections, and guaranteed unhindered access for medical teams to reach all affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが避難民キャンプに侵入、国連が懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCの避難民キャンプでエボラ確定例が発生し、過密環境とヘルスケアアクセス不足によりヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高く、国連が国際支援の必要性を訴えていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連が国際社会に追加資源の動員を要請しており、避難民キャンプという過密・脆弱な環境での感染拡大リスクが高い。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Temukan 546 Kasus TB, Maros Ajukan Penambahan Mesin TCM dan X-Ray AI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Find 546 TB Cases, Maros Requests Additional TCM Machines and AI X-Ray
article.articleSummary: Maros Regency, Indonesia, reports 546 tuberculosis (TB) cases detected in the first half of 2026, or 32.13% of the annual target of 1,699. During TB screening integrated with the Free Health Check (CKG) program in Mandai, officials discussed accelerating case finding. Maros requests 13 additional Tes Cepat Molekuler (TCM) machines and one AI-powered portable X-ray unit from the Ministry of Health; the district currently has three TCM units and one portable X-ray, insufficient for all 14 sub-districts. A TB Task Force (TP2TB) has been established from district to village levels, with 103 Desa/Kelurahan designated as TB Watch Villages and Unit Kesehatan Desa/Kelurahan (UKDK) involving nurses, midwives, and health cadres. Desa Siaga TB is a key strategy toward 2030 TB elimination, with calls for funding via DAK Non-Fisik and ADD. In 2024, 943 TB cases were found (54.82% of a 1,720-target).

triage.headline_ja: 結核546症例を発見、マロス県がTCM検査機器とAI搭載X線装置の追加を要請
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地域で継続的にサーベイランスされている風土病であり、通常の症例発見・検査体制強化に関する行政報告であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核対策の年次目標に対する進捗報告および検査機器増強要請であり、通常業務の一環。突発的なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusive: Eastern, Central States Lead India's Malaria Burden; Small States Among Least Affected
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains India's top vector-borne threat, concentrated in five states—West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Tripura—over 2023–2025, with Lakshadweep, Sikkim, Ladakh, Manipur and Puducherry among the least affected. West Bengal recorded 23,428 (2023), 19,497 (2024) and 18,872 (2025), with seasonal peaks in Sept 2023 (6,094), Sept 2024 (5,510) and Aug 2025 (4,020). Across India, 142 malaria deaths occurred in the period, led by Maharashtra (56), Mizoram (17), Odisha (14), Kerala (10) and Chhattisgarh (9). Odisha posted 32,064 (2023), 56,330 (2024) and 37,665 (2025) with top monthly burdens in Aug 2023 (8,016), July 2024 (14,293) and June 2025 (11,916). Jharkhand: 29,014; 32,533; 31,035 (peaks June 2023 11,405; Sept 2024 5,264; Aug 2025 4,804). Chhattisgarh: 19,461; 24,887; 18,497 (peaks July 2023 4,047; July 2024 5,525; June 2025 4,374). Tripura: 18,048; 6,924; 4,552 (peaks July 2023 4,837; June 2024 2,741; June 2025 1,913).

triage.headline_ja: 独占：東部・中央部の州がインドのマラリア負担を主導、小規模州は影響最小
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはインドの既知の風土病であり、統計データは経年的な傾向を示すのみで、異常な増加や新規性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド国内の複数年にわたるマラリア統計の報告であり、風土病としての既知の季節的パターンを示すもので、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : avec 1 850 décès en 11 semaines contre plus de 2 000 morts en 22 mois en 2018, l'actuelle épidémie d'Ebola Bundibugyo est la plus importante jamais enregistrée au pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: With 1,850 deaths in 11 weeks versus more than 2,000 deaths in 22 months in 2018, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is the largest ever recorded in the country.
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, centered in Ituri with spread to Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele, has reached 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 5, 2026, eleven weeks after declaration—the largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the country, surpassing the 2018 event. Ituri remains the epicenter, with new suspected cases reported almost daily in additional localities outside established transmission chains. More than 1,400 MSF staff are mobilized, running seven Ebola Treatment Centers and over fifteen isolation units across Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu and Tshopo in support of the Ministry of Health. Ongoing challenges include restricted access to some areas, logistical constraints, and health-system strain from malaria, measles, cholera, and malnutrition. MSF calls for strengthened surveillance, contact tracing, community engagement, and unhindered humanitarian access to sustain the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：11週間で1,850人死亡、2018年の22カ月間で2,000人超死亡と比較し、現在のブンディブギョ・エボラ流行は同国史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の同国史上最大の流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数州への拡大、国際支援の必要性が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はイトゥリ州を中心にノールキブ、スドキブ、チョポ、オートウエレ州へ拡大。マラリア・麻疹・コレラ・栄養失調による医療システムへの負荷も同時進行しており複合的リスク事案。

article.articleHeadline: Cộng hoà Dân chủ Congo: Ebola khiến 330 trẻ em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola has killed 330 children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has 743 confirmed cases in people aged 0-17, including 330 child deaths, as of Aug 2, 2026. UNICEF calls it the most severe and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in DRC. The crisis disrupts essential health services: use of health services in core outbreak zones (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Rwampara) down 42% from April-June, and 13% province-wide. Routine measles vaccination in Mongbwalu fell 69%; May-June saw more than 23,000 fewer routine vaccines than April. Maternal health care also declined: facility births -13% province-wide; Bunia, Rwampara, Nizi declines of 38%, 30%, 70%; first antenatal visits down ~28%. Response includes training ~13,000 community health workers, reaching over 2.4 million people and 505,000 home visits; eight Ebola treatment centers supported; mental health services for 21,000+ people (5,100 children). UNICEF seeks $113.45 million to expand to 51 health zones; $23.5 million raised so far.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱で子ども330人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で子ども330人が死亡するエボラ出血熱の重大アウトブレイクが発生し、UNICEFが「最も深刻かつ急速に拡大している」と評価、保健サービス崩壊と国際支援要請（1.1億ドル超）が確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（イツリ州）の状況のみが言及されており、ルワンダへの越境拡大については記載がないため verified_locations から除外した。また対象国リストにルワンダは含まれない。麻疹ワクチン接種率の急落（69%減）も併発しており、二次的な感染症拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo battles worsening Ebola crisis as cases top grim 4,000 mark
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 4,053 confirmed Ebola infections and 1,850 deaths, with about 793 recoveries and nearly 700 patients hospitalized or in isolation. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo—affecting more than 50 health zones. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment; vaccines for the Zaire strain are used in some areas under expanded access, and experimental Bundibugyo candidates are being evaluated. Transmission likely began in January near Mongbwalu, Ituri, with more than 500 suspected cases before the mid-May declaration. Children are among the hardest hit. Uganda detected linked infections but halted local transmission, while cross-border risk remains. WHO, Africa CDC and MSF continue support amid security threats, bed shortages and incomplete contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ危機悪化で症例数が深刻な4,000人超えに達し苦闘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが5州50以上の保健区に拡大し、死者1,850人・確認症例4,053人に達しており、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも関連感染例が検出されたが現地伝播は阻止されたと記載されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療資源不足、治安上の脅威など管理困難な要素が多く、既にWHO・Africa CDC・MSFが支援中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'UNICEF alerte sur une chute de plus de 40 % du recours aux soins de santé essentiels en Ituri [Radio Okapi] https://www.radiookapi.net/2026/08/07/actualite/sante/ebola-lunicef-alerte-sur-une-chute-de-plus-de-40-du-recours-aux-soins-de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: UNICEF warns of a drop of more than 40% in the use of essential health care services in Ituri [Radio Okapi]
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri prompted UNICEF to warn that use of essential health care services has fallen by more than 40%. The notice, attributed to Radio Okapi, signals a sharp decline in health service utilization in Ituri. No Ebola case counts, transmission details, or timelines are provided in the article. It focuses on the broader public health impact of the outbreak response on access to essential services, without specifying laboratory confirmation or infection sources. No information is given on imported or exported cases. Dated 2026-08-07, the report underscores the need to safeguard routine health care during Ebola-related concerns in Ituri to avoid additional morbidity arising from reduced care. Keywords: Ebola, Ituri, UNICEF, health services, outbreak impact, Radio Okapi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：UNICEFがイトゥリ州で基本医療サービス利用が40%以上減少していると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCイトゥリ州での医療サービス利用低下は感染症対応能力への深刻な影響を示唆するため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : les relais communautaires sensibilisés à Ebola avant leur déploiement sur le terrain - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Community relays briefed on Ebola before deployment to the field - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) – on 7 August 2026, two-day Ebola awareness briefings were conducted for community relays in Kisangani's Makiso-Kisangani, Kabondo and Tshopo health zones before deployment to the field. Led by Hubert Lobanga, interim CREC coordinator of the provincial health division, the sessions covered Ebola virus disease, its abrupt fever, headache, abdominal pain, sore throat, vomiting, muscle and joint pains, fatigue, diarrhea and bleeding, and protective measures. After briefing, relays will visit households to disseminate the same messages to strengthen community resistance to Ebola and to intensify field actions promoting barrier precautions. The initiative aims to boost risk awareness and prevention at the household level.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:コミュニティ・リレー員、現地派遣前にエボラ出血熱に関する啓発を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する予防的コミュニティ啓発活動の記事であり、実際の症例発生や感染拡大に関する情報が含まれていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のエボラ症例発生を報告するものではなく、現地保健当局によるコミュニティ啓発・準備活動を報じたものである。実際の症例発生状況については別途確認が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu symptoms never to ignore: Doctor explains warning signs that need urgent medical attention
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) can start like a cold but may rapidly worsen, with New Delhi-based clinician Dr. Prabhat Ranjan Sinha warning that high fever lasting more than 2–3 days, persistent cough with breathing difficulty, and symptoms such as extreme fatigue signal possible pneumonia or other complications. Warning signs requiring urgent care include severe breathlessness, persistent chest pain, bluish lips or fingertips, confusion or seizures, and fever returning after apparent improvement; in children, refusal to feed, irritability, difficulty waking, and rapid breathing are especially concerning. Early antiviral treatment is most effective when started within 48 hours of symptom onset. Antibiotics should not be used for viral infections unless prescribed. Preventive steps include hand hygiene, masks, avoiding close contact, and staying home when unwell. The article emphasizes timely medical evaluation to reduce risk of severe illness, in the Indian context.

triage.headline_ja: 見逃してはいけない豚インフルエンザの症状：医師が緊急受診が必要な警告サインを解説

article.articleHeadline: Atrapan a un mono que dejó 18 heridos durante dos semanas en Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkey that left 18 people injured over a two-week period in Indonesia captured.
article.articleSummary: An adult male long-tailed macaque in Tembilahan, Indonesia, injured 18 residents across a two-week period, with 19 attacks in total (one person attacked twice). Several victims required more than ten stitches, and some received rabies vaccines. The macaque was captured Thursday in a local trap and later shown alive in a video behind bars. Municipal official Ari Syuria urged continued caution, fearing the animal may have been part of a group and that other macaques could attack. Forty schools remained closed, and three days of online classes were ordered for hundreds of students, with reopening planned for Monday. The macaque was transported to Pekanbaru, the provincial capital of Riau on Sumatra, where wildlife authorities will perform blood tests and behavioral monitoring to determine if the animal carries any disease. This reflects ongoing human–wildlife conflict in Southeast Asia amid deforestation and habitat loss.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで2週間に18人に負傷させたサルが捕獲される
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確定診断はまだ出ておらず、複数人がサルに襲われ一部が予防的に狂犬病ワクチンを接種したのみ。今後の血液検査結果次第で疾患の有無が判明するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病そのものの発生ではなく、野生のカニクイザルによる連続襲撃事件が主題。捕獲されたサルの血液検査・行動観察の結果で狂犬病等の病原体保有が判明する可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo do Einstein sobre hepatites virais traça panorama da doença em onze anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Einstein study on viral hepatitis maps the disease landscape over eleven years.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers from Einstein Hospital analyzed 200 studies (2013–2024) totaling data on over 14.5 million people to map viral hepatitis across Brazil. Part of the Proadi-SUS–backed project, the study aims to inform prevention and care to reach Brazil’s 2030 elimination goal for viral hepatitis, and was published in PLOS ONE. All five hepatitides A–E are covered. Hepatitis A is acute and vaccine‑preventable, with a resurgence linked to oral/anal sex among men who have sex with men and to fecal‑oral transmission via contaminated food/water; highest regional burden in the Amazon and the North/Northeast, with adults over 18 also affected in the South, Southeast, and Central‑West due to behavioral and vaccination gaps. Hepatitis B and C share sexual and blood‑borne routes; B can be chronic and is vaccine‑preventable, C lacks a vaccine but is highly curable (>95%). Hepatitis D is neglected, prevalent in Amazon riverine populations with diagnostic challenges, and often co‑circulates with B.

triage.headline_ja: アインシュタイン病院のウイルス性肝炎研究、11年間の疾病動向を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: これは学術研究の発表であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去11年間のブラジルにおけるウイルス性肝炎（A-E型）に関する後ろ向き研究のまとめであり、急性のアウトブレイクや新規シグナルを示すものではない。研究自体はブラジルを対象としているが、地理的発生イベントではなく学術的知見の共有であるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo ultrapassa 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with a total of 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported by the government. The outbreak, the second-largest global, is described as the fastest-spreading yet. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science magazine report published last month suggested the outbreak began in January, or even earlier, in Ituri, with more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. Experts warn that late detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and the absence of vaccines and treatments for the Ebola virus species involved have hindered containment. By comparison, the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 exceeded 28,000 cases across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4,000例・1,850死亡に達し、過去最速拡大とされる重大な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準複数該当・社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去のアウトブレイクとの比較として言及されており、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Chandipura Virus Outbreak: गुजरात और राजस्थान में चांदीपुरा वायरस का कहर; जानें इसके लक्षण, कारण, इलाज और बचाव के उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chandipura Virus Outbreak: Chandipura Virus Wreaks Havoc in Gujarat and Rajasthan; Learn Its Symptoms, Causes, Treatment, and Preventive Measures.
article.articleSummary: Chandipura virus (CHPV) outbreaks surge in Gujarat and Rajasthan during the monsoon. As of August 7, 2026, 35 of 184 suspected CHPV cases tested positive in labs, with 22 children dead. The Central Health Ministry has deployed the National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) to affected districts; seven children remain in ICU. CHPV is a member of the Rhabdoviridae family, an RNA virus related to rabies but causing a distinct illness. First identified in 1965 in Chandipura village, Nagpur district; chiefly affects children under 15 and causes acute encephalitis syndrome; not human-to-human contagious. Transmission mainly via sandflies (Phlebotomus); other vectors such as mosquitoes, ticks, and mites may play a role. No specific antiviral or vaccine; management is supportive. Prevention focuses on vector control and housing improvements: long sleeves, bed nets, sealing walls, insecticide dusting, and eliminating standing water.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディプラウイルス感染症の発生：グジャラート州とラージャスターン州で猛威、症状・原因・治療・予防策を解説
triage.triage_reason: インド・グジャラート州およびラージャスターン州でチャンディプラウイルス感染症（急性脳炎症候群）が発生し、184例の疑い例中35例が確定、22人の小児が死亡するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が見られ、国家対応チーム（NJORT）が派遣されていることからIHR基準複数該当と判断。
triage.notes: チャンディプラウイルスはサシチョウバエ媒介性で人-人感染はしないとされるが、致死率の高さ（22/35死亡）と小児への影響、ワクチン・特効薬の不在から警戒レベルは高い。今後の感染拡大や検査体制の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Потвърдените случаи на ебола в Конго надхвърлиха 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The confirmed Ebola cases in Congo surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported in the government data. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. It is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history and the fastest-spreading to date. Experts say the virus began circulating months before the outbreak was declared May 15, and the true number of infections is likely higher than reported. A Science study published last month concluded the outbreak began in January or earlier, initially in Ituri, with over 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. Contributing factors include delayed detection, an overstretched epidemiological surveillance system, ongoing conflicts, and a lack of vaccines and effective treatment for this particular strain. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak exceeded it, with more than 28,000 cases across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.
