article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra FDA Cracks Down On Blood Centers: Mandatory HIV, Hepatitis Testing Decreed
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-07, the Maharashtra FDA ordered mandatory testing for HIV, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, syphilis and malaria for every blood bag before it is cleared for use, tightening oversight of blood and storage centers across the state. The directive follows inspections that revealed serious regulatory violations at blood centres and aims to strengthen patient safety and ensure uniform regulatory adherence. The measure also requires facilities to perform regular self-audits and to keep records on the e-RaktKosh portal updated daily. The FDA warned that facilities failing to comply face strict legal action. The move signals a statewide crackdown to improve screening of donated blood and prevent transmission of infections through transfusion.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラーシュトラ州FDA、血液センターを取り締まり:HIV・肝炎検査を義務化
triage.triage_reason: これは規制当局による血液バンクの検査義務化という行政措置に関する記事であり、新規感染症の発生や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の血液由来感染症（HIV、肝炎、梅毒、マラリア）に対する予防的な行政規制強化であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、対象国の発生イベントとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Uasin Gishu strengthens preparedness against potential Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uasin Gishu County, Kenya, enhanced Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness with a one-day micro-planning session to craft a county-specific prevention, containment, and management blueprint. Senior health officials and development partners convened to sharpen coordination, ensure early detection, and build a practical, measurable plan with community engagement as a cornerstone. Dr. Billy Lubanga emphasized a comprehensive Ebola preparedness strategy, while Dr. Jacob Khaoya noted AMREF's technical support, capacity-building, and strengthened collaboration. The forum, which included medical and surveillance leaders, underscored ongoing efforts to bolster disease surveillance, emergency readiness, and cross-sector cooperation to shield residents from public health threats. Kenya has not recorded any Ebola cases and remains free of the virus, with heightened border screening after a Bundibugyo outbreak in the neighboring DRC, especially along transport and refugee corridors toward Turkana.

triage.headline_ja: ウアシンギシュ郡、エボラ出血熱の潜在的アウトブレイクに備え態勢強化
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクを背景にケニアが国境監視・準備態勢を強化しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事本文はケニア・ウアシンギシュ郡の準備態勢強化に焦点を当てているが、その背景として隣国DRCでのブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが実際に発生していることが述べられているため、DRCを発生地域として検証・記録した。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）埃博拉確診4053例　實際感染人數或更高 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 4,053 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; actual infections could be higher.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 4,053 confirmed cases, 1,850 deaths, and 793 recoveries reported as of August 5, 2026; actual infections may be higher per Africa CDC. An Africa CDC director warned the outbreak’s severity is unprecedented, with plans to study possible viral mutations to tailor responses. The main challenge cited is insufficient community engagement rather than funding, calling for mobilization of local leaders, women and youth groups. WHO and Africa CDC urge stronger, community-led measures: early case detection, close-contact tracing, improved healthcare access, frontline worker support, and faster aid delivery to affected communities. In Kinshasa region, Health Minister Kamba said a river-boat near the capital was intercepted; 250 registered passengers exist, but total may exceed 300 and are under verification, amid concerns to prevent the virus entering Kinshasa.

The outbreak was declared on May 15. article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'épidémie d'Ebola s'étend à deux nouvelles zones - الشروق أونلاين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak is spreading to two new areas - Shorouk Online
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to 53 health zones across five provinces, with new foci in Gombari (Haut-Uélé) and Bafwasende (Tshopo). Ituri remains epicenter, accounting for 86.9% of cumulative cases. Total: 4,053 confirmed cases, 793 recoveries, 1,850 deaths (case fatality 45.7%). 694 patients are currently isolating or hospitalized. Contact tracing improved to 77.7% nationwide in one day, with 100% in Sud-Kivu, 80% in Tshopo, and 79.3% in Ituri; 358 new contacts identified. In the last 24 hours, 1,158 of 1,288 alerts were investigated (90.3%), 98.6% in Nord-Kivu. PARTNERS and EBO-PEP trials progress in Ituri. Care centers operate in Musienene and Beni; a large-capacity site opened in Tshopo with MSF support; three ambulances deployed in Haut-Uélé. Quarantine centers, PoCs, PoEs and 249 Starlink kits bolster response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行が新たに2地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5州53保健区に拡大し、致死率45.7%、死者1,850人と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準に複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: Campos de refugiados extremamente vulneráveis ao avanço da epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: Refugee camps extremely vulnerable to the spread of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is battling an Ebola virus disease outbreak with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality 45.7%), as of July 31. More than 5 million internally displaced people, many in 69 refugee camps across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, create conditions conducive to spread, with infections confirmed in at least five camps. Ituri accounts for about 87.1% of cases. The outbreak began with notification on May 15, though evidence suggests transmission since January. WHO and CDC-Africa warn of rapid expansion, marking it as one of the fastest-growing Ebola outbreaks in history; it is the 17th outbreak in the DRC. MONUSCO has deployed units to conflict areas to monitor the epidemic. The Bundibugyo strain has 30–50% mortality; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 infections (15 imported). Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/コンゴ民主共和国：難民キャンプは疫病拡大に極めて脆弱

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma mais 7 novos casos de sarampo e total chega a 23; reforço da vacinação é recomendado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 7 more measles cases, bringing the total to 23; a booster vaccination is recommended.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state reaches 23 cases as of August 7, 2026: 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Transmission is linked to importation, with infections currently of unknown source. Authorities urge vaccination for everyone aged 6 months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo city, regardless of prior immunization. A Multivaccination Campaign to update records for children and adolescents under 15 began on July 3. On July 28, the Ministry of Health expanded vaccine advice to the same 6–59 year age group in these cities. Vaccination is free via SUS and part of the National Vaccination Schedule (D1 and D2). Dose zero (6–11 months) is recommended during outbreaks. In 2026, over 7.2 million MMR doses distributed; about 2.9 million administered. 2025 coverage: D1 92.9%, D2 78.3%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹症例が新たに7件確認され、累計23件に；ワクチン接種強化が推奨される
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で感染経路不明の麻疹症例が拡大（16→23例）し、保健省が対象年齢を拡大したワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど政府の関心も高いため、WPRO基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の伝播があり、保健当局が広範な年齢層へのワクチン接種を推奨していることから、地域内での感染拡大が懸念される。ただし国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、ブラジル国内で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: US Adds $242 Million to Ebola Response as DRC Outbreak Hits Record
article.articleSummary: US commits $242 million to Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with preparedness funding for Uganda, bringing direct State Department support to over $500 million. As of July 30, 2026, the outbreak totals 3,626 confirmed cases and 1,589 deaths (44% CFR), the largest on record for the DRC. Originating in Mongbwalu, Ituri, the virus has spread to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo—across 49 health zones. Uganda reports 20 cases; France has one imported case, from which the patient recovered; Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28 after 42 days without a local case. The funding will bolster epidemiological surveillance, border screening, patient isolation, treatment capacity, health infrastructure, and public-awareness campaigns, supplementing $350 million in emergency aid within a $1.8 billion UN OCHA package. WHO regional framework guides ongoing response; G7 previously pledged up to $500 million.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、DRCのエボラ流行が過去最悪を記録する中、対応資金に2億4200万ドルを追加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（3,626症例、CFR44%）が5州49保健区に拡大し、ウガンダ・フランスへも越境。国際的な資金投入と関心が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間新規症例なしでアウトブレイク終息宣言済み、フランスは輸入症例1件で回復済みのため、対象国リストのDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。ウガンダ・フランス・米国は対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Lampung perkuat pendampingan eliminasi TBC di Tanggamus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lampung Strengthens TB Elimination Assistance in Tanggamus
article.articleSummary: Lampung Province strengthens TB elimination in Tanggamus Regency, led by Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela, targeting 2030 elimination through active case finding, treatment completion, and stigma reduction. Tanggamus has an estimated 2,532 TB cases, but new-case notifications are only about 946 (37%), and TB preventive therapy (TPT) coverage is 13%. The district is urged to intensify active case finding, broaden screening for high-risk groups, strengthen health-facility networks, and optimize reporting via the SITB system with regular program monitoring. Policy measures include RAD Penanggulangan Tuberkulosis 2025–2030 and TP2TB, though Desa Siaga Tuberculosis SKs remain limited and should be expanded. The province has 50 TB cadres; PDPI is developing Peduli Tuberkulosis Lampung for self-screening, integrated with Free Health Check (CKG). The central government will provide 25 portable X-ray units to bolster diagnosis across districts.

triage.headline_ja: ランプン州、タンガムスにおけるTBC(結核)撲滅支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核対策プログラムに関する行政的な取り組みの記事であり、異常な集団発生や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は地域行政による通常の撲滅プログラム強化に関する内容。緊急性のある新規感染症イベントではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: In Cina torna a salire il Covid: ondata estiva senza allarme, ma attenzione alle varianti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In China, COVID-19 is rising again: a summer wave without alarm, but beware of variants.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising again in China, described as a summer wave without alarm. Between July 13 and 19, positivity among symptomatic respiratory patients reached 16.3%, up 4.3 percentage points from the prior week; over the next seven days it rose to 20.3%. Transmission is higher in southern provinces, with ages 15–59 most affected. The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention reports most cases are mild and overall viral activity now sits at moderate levels after earlier increases. The dominant lineage is NB.1.8.1; authorities say COVID-19 behaves as a common respiratory illness with one or two annual waves. The uptick reflects normal fluctuations of intensity similar to the past two years. High-risk groups—older adults and people with chronic diseases—remain more susceptible to severe disease, but targeted therapies exist. No variants currently pose significant health risk; vaccination and continued surveillance are emphasized. Mask-wearing when ill or around vulnerable people remains advised.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でコロナが再び増加：警戒するほどではない夏の波、しかし変異株には注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な夏の波であり、当局も「警戒なし」と明言。重症化率も低く、既知の変異株で新規の公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節的な流行パターン内の増加であり、既存株NB.1.8.1で重篤性の増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en la RD del Congo sigue al alza y ya supera los 4.000 casos confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to rise and has already surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to rise, now surpassing 4,000 confirmed cases with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths (case fatality rate ~45.7%). Declared May 15, the outbreak affects five provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. This is the second-largest outbreak by infections in the country’s history. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC urge an urgent, intensified community-based response: expand testing and isolation at affected sites, protect and equip frontline workers, and improve contact tracing (about 77.7% to date, below the 95% target). Emphasis on reliable community information to prompt symptom reporting and care-seeking. Cross-border surveillance is advised, modeling Uganda’s approach after it halted local transmission and declared Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、確認症例数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約45.7%、5州に拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境監視の文脈で言及されているが、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo ultrapassa 4.000 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo surpasses 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases as of August 7, 2026, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported. The outbreak, the second-largest globally, is described as the fastest-spreading yet. Health officials warn infections likely circulated months before the official declaration of the outbreak on May 15, and the true caseload may be higher than reported. Cases have been identified across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science journal report cited by the article suggests the outbreak began in January or earlier in Ituri, with over 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. Contributing factors include late detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the virus species involved. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola outbreak was larger.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、症例数が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで4,000例超・死亡1,850人に達し、複数州に拡大、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされ、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬不足、紛争による監視体制の弱さが拡大要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ、エボラ熱感染４０００人超　最速ペースで感染拡大：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, Ebola infections exceed 4,000, spreading at the fastest pace.
article.articleSummary: On August 7, 2026, authorities in the Congo report Ebola virus disease confirmed cases have surpassed 4,000 since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The current tally stands at 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths, making this outbreak the second-largest on record and the fastest-spreading. Experts say transmission began months before the declaration, and the true number of infections is likely substantially higher than confirmed. International organizations anticipate autumn-scale vaccination efforts and large-scale clinical trials in response to the Congo Ebola outbreak. The development underscores urgent public health responses, including vaccine deployment and containment measures, in Central Africa. Healthcare workers face ongoing risks amid community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ熱感染４０００人超　最速ペースで感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が過去2番目の規模・最速ペースで拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.6%（1850/4053）と非常に高く、国際機関によるワクチン展開・臨床試験の計画も報じられており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Πειραματικό εμβόλιο κατά του Έμπολα μπαίνει σε κλινική δοκιμή - Πρώτοι εθελοντές έλαβαν δόση στον Καναδά | Ειδήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An experimental Ebola vaccine enters a clinical trial - First volunteers received a dose in Canada | News
article.articleSummary: Canada launches Phase 1 trial of an experimental Ebola vaccine targeting the Bundibugyo strain, with about 80 volunteers to assess safety, tolerability, and immune response. The candidate, from Moderna, uses mRNA technology—the same platform as its COVID-19 vaccine. The move coincides with the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s one of the worst Ebola outbreaks on record: as of early August 2026, 3,802 cases and 1,707 deaths, concentrated mainly in Ituri province in the eastern DRC, with Kisangani among affected areas. Community transmission accounts for roughly 60–70% of new infections, hindering containment. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya warns contact tracing is not performing well. CEPI stresses speed in vaccine development. A parallel Phase 1 trial began in July at the University of Oxford; doses will be produced by Serum Institute of India. Timeline to approval remains uncertain, but the trials represent a significant milestone.

triage.headline_ja: エボラワクチンの実験的候補が臨床試験開始 - カナダで最初のボランティアが接種を受ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪級のエボラ出血熱流行が継続中（症例3,802件、死亡1,707人）で、地域感染が60-70%を占め封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はカナダでのエボラワクチン臨床試験開始が主題だが、サマリーにはコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、キサンガニ含む）での大規模エボラ流行の詳細（症例数、死亡数、地域感染率、接触者追跡の機能不全）が含まれており、これが実際の感染症イベントとして重要。インド（Serum Institute）、カナダ、英国（オックスフォード）はワクチン製造・試験地であり発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija, ki je ušla izpod nadzora: Število okuženih je preseglo štiri tisoč
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An epidemic that has spiraled out of control: The number of infected has surpassed four thousand.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 4,053 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,850 deaths across five provinces; Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally by case count and the fastest-spreading on record. Health authorities warn that the virus began spreading months before the official outbreak declaration on 15 May, suggesting true infection numbers far exceed reported figures. From mid-January to 15 May, investigators identified more than 500 suspected cases, according to Science. Contributing factors include delayed case detection, an overwhelmed epidemiological surveillance system, ongoing armed conflict in the region, and shortages of vaccines and effective therapies for the strain causing this outbreak. Historically, the only larger Ebola epidemic was the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). Public health efforts face numerous field obstacles to prevent a repeat such tragedy.

triage.headline_ja: 制御不能に陥った感染症流行:感染者数が4千人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認済みエボラ症例4,053人・死者1,850人と大規模化しており、史上最速の拡大速度・武力紛争地域での対応困難・ワクチン不足など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行の拡大を主題としており、シエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアは過去の2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Egypt sends second shipment of medical aid to DR Congo to support Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Egyptian Agency of Partnership for Development (EAPD), in coordination with the Health Ministry and the Egyptian Embassy in Kinshasa, has dispatched a second shipment of medicines and medical supplies to the Democratic Republic of Congo to support its Ebola response. The aid, part of Egypt's development cooperation and humanitarian assistance, aims to bolster DR Congo’s healthcare system and strengthen regional health security to curb cross-border spread of Ebola. The mission builds on earlier assistance from the EAPD and underscores Egypt's commitment to capacity-building across Africa and addressing shared health challenges. The initiative aligns with sustainable development goals and highlights ongoing support as of 7 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エジプト、エボラ対応支援のためコンゴ民主共和国へ2回目の医療物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、国際的な医療支援が必要とされている状況を示す記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はエジプトからDRCへの医療支援物資の輸送に関するものであり、新規発生報告ではないが、DRCで継続中のエボラ流行と越境拡大リスクへの対応として国際支援が行われている点が確認できる。エジプトは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: FOCUS全球新聞／美CDC新主任　面對2疫　環孢子蟲病.沙門氏菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FOCUS Global News / New CDC Director Faces Two Outbreaks: Cyclosporiasis and Salmonellosis
article.articleSummary: Erica Schwartz was confirmed by the Senate (51-44) as CDC director, becoming the agency’s first African American female leader. As of August 5, 2026, the United States faces two major foodborne outbreaks: cyclosporiasis and Salmonella. Cyclosporiasis has spread to 15 states, with 6,358 cases, 278 hospitalizations, and 2 deaths; investigations point to Taylor Farms lettuce, and six additional states (Arkansas, Iowa, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina) are affected, suggesting a common Cyclospora source linked to a Taylor Farms facility in central Mexico that has a history of prior outbreaks. Salmonella infections total 345 cases and 36 hospitalizations across 27 states, tied to Mexican peppers distributed by Coast Citrus Distributors from Sinaloa; Chipotle and QDOBA have halted pepper shipments. The USDA has paused inspections of avocados from Michoacán. Background mentions Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda and a 30-year high measles outbreak in the U.S. due to vaccination gaps.

triage.headline_ja: FOCUS世界ニュース／米CDC新長官、2つの疫病に直面—環孢子虫症とサルモネラ症
triage.triage_reason: 主たる事案は米国内の食品由来アウトブレイク（サイクロスポーラ症・サルモネラ症）であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）はいずれも本記事の主題ではない。DRC・ウガンダのエボラ、米国麻疹は背景情報として触れられているのみで、詳細情報がなく評価対象外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国内での食品由来感染症アウトブレイク（サイクロスポーラ症・サルモネラ症）であり、原因食材はメキシコ産だが、米国・メキシコともに対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・ウガンダのエボラ、米国の麻疹は背景情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات "إيبولا" ترتفع إلى 4053 في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise to 4,053 in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths in a rapid outbreak across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Government data show 4,053 confirmed infections, making this the second-largest, and the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. Experts suspect transmission began months before the May 15 declaration, possibly in January, with more than 500 suspected cases between mid-January and May 15. Ongoing containment is hampered by delayed detection, armed conflict, strained surveillance, and shortages of vaccines and therapeutics for the circulating strain. The West Africa 2010s outbreak, with over 28,000 cases across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, remains the largest. Official counts may underrepresent the true scale.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が4,053人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例4,053人・死者1,850人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行であり、紛争地域での対応困難と資材不足も重なるため、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威としてフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 內地新冠陽性率上升趨緩　南方顯著高於北方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China's COVID-19 positivity rate is rising but slowing; the South is significantly higher than the North.
article.articleSummary: Mainland China's COVID-19 positivity rate is rising but the pace has slowed, with overall mid-level circulation. The dominant NB.1.8.1 lineage remains. Sentinel surveillance shows influenza-like illness accounts for 4.5% of emergency department visits nationwide, with southern provinces at 5.7% versus 2.9% in the north. In ILI respiratory samples, the top pathogens are SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and enteroviruses; among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) samples, SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and human parechovirus are most common. The current COVID-19 wave is cyclical and of similar intensity to the previous two years; positivity is highest in the 15–59 age group, and disease remains predominantly mild with effective targeted antivirals. Influenza activity is at a low-level fluctuation, dominated by B/Victoria and A(H3N2); rhinoviruses, enteroviruses, parechovirus, and parainfluenza show fluctuating, lesser activity.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土の新型コロナ陽性率上昇は鈍化、南部が北部より顕著に高い
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の周期的流行で、過去2年と同程度の強度、症状も軽症中心であり、異常性や重症化、国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報がないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 定期的なサーベイランス報告であり、COVID-19・インフルエンザともに例年並みの季節性変動を示す内容。特段の異常シグナルなし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC commend Uganda for containing latest Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC commend Uganda for containing its latest Ebola outbreak. A joint high-level mission to Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Aug. 4–5 noted that Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28, with the last patient discharged on July 16 after testing negative. The agencies praised Uganda's swift response, rapid contact tracing, coordinated national action, trusted community engagement, and cross-border surveillance. They cautioned that ongoing transmission in the DRC keeps neighboring countries at risk and urged sustained preparedness, including laboratory readiness, surveillance, and cross-border coordination. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya emphasized community engagement as essential to breaking transmission chains and bringing the response closer to communities while supporting frontline teams. The statement underscores continued vigilance to prevent spillover into neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDC、最新のエボラ出血熱流行を抑え込んだウガンダを称賛
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのアウトブレイクは終息したが、DRCでの継続的なエボラ伝播が指摘されており、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが懸念されるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの継続的なエボラ伝播が今後の焦点であり、隣国への波及リスクが継続的に監視されるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Behörde prüft mögliche Ebola-Virusmutation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Authorities examine possible Ebola virus mutation.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo authorities, with the Africa CDC and the World Health Organization, are examining a possible mutation of the Ebola virus as infections surge. The outbreak, described as unprecedented in severity, spans five eastern provinces and is under intensified genetic and epidemiological investigation to determine whether a viral mutation is driving transmission or virulence. The Bundibugyo variant is implicated, a form for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Government figures place confirmed Ebola cases above 4,000 with about 1,850 deaths. International partners are assisting with laboratory and field operations to inform public health measures and guide vaccine or therapeutic strategies amid this escalating multi-province crisis in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:当局がエボラウイルスの変異の可能性を調査
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部5州にまたがるエボラ流行で確定4000例超・死亡1850人と極めて深刻かつ「前例のない severity」とされ、ウイルス変異の可能性も調査中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variantとされ承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がないこと、致死率約46%と高いことが特に懸念される。ウイルス変異の有無について遺伝学的・疫学的調査が進行中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τα 4.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Confirmed Ebola cases surpassed 4,000.

Only the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak was larger, with over 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ確定症例が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行が継続し、確定症例が4,000人を超え史上最速の拡大速度を記録。複数州に拡大し武力紛争や検出遅延で封じ込めが困難であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Patvirtintų Ebolos infekcijų skaičius Konge viršijo 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola infections in Congo surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has confirmed more than 4,000 Ebola virus disease cases, marking it the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak has affected five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Experts say the true number of infections is likely higher, with transmission circulating for months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. A Science study published last month estimated that from January through May 15 more than 500 people were infected. Ebola virus disease is deadly and spreads through direct contact and contact with bodily fluids, causing high fever, nausea, and severe internal bleeding. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone remains the largest with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ確定感染者数が4,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,000人超のエボラ感染が確認され、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大の流行とされており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はリトアニア語メディアの報道で、DRCの5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）にまたがる大規模流行を報じている。リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Patvirtintų Ebolos infekcijų skaičius Konge viršijo 4 tūkst. atvejų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola infections in Congo exceeded 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 4,000, with 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths reported by Friday, according to the national health institute cited by Reuters. This is the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak, affecting Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces. Experts warn the true case count may be higher, noting the virus circulated for months before the May 15 official declaration. A Science study published last month traced the outbreak to January or earlier in Ituri, with more than 500 infections from January to May 15. Ebola causes high fever, nausea, and severe internal bleeding and spreads through direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids. The largest Ebola outbreak on record occurred 2014–2016 in West Africa (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染確認数が4千人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例4,053例、死亡1,850人に達し、史上2番目の規模かつ最速拡大のエボラアウトブレイクとされており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo, nuova allerta: "In Congo il virus sta superando la capacità di risposta sanitaria"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo, new alert: "In Congo the virus is exceeding the health system's capacity to respond."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to outpace response. A WHO-Africa CDC field mission (Aug 4–5) found operational gaps, limited resources, contact-tracing challenges, and noted the start of first clinical trials for therapy and vaccine, including visits to the Rwangole Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia. As of Aug 4, DRC had 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, and 776 recoveries across 51 health zones in five provinces; 99 new cases and 52 deaths were reported in the previous 24 hours. Ituri remains the epicenter (~90% of cases); contact tracing stands at ~75% (below the 95% target). North Kivu treatment centers have surpassed capacity (bed occupancy 139%), with 674 hospitalized. Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The mission urged rapid scale-up of case finding, diagnostics, care, beds, labs, safe burials, health-worker protection, and timely funds to frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ、新たな警報：「コンゴでウイルスが保健医療対応能力を超えつつある」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、症例数・死亡者数が多く医療体制の許容量を超え、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例・死亡が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO-Africa CDC合同ミッションが医療対応能力の限界を指摘しており、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Super El Niño pode favorecer doenças transmitidas por animais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super El Niño Could Facilitate Animal-Transmitted Diseases
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, a Super El Niño could drive major climate shifts in Brazil over the coming months, with extreme rainfall, heat, and drought. Environmental changes may alter animal, insect, and rodent behavior, increasing opportunities for zoonotic transmission. Heavy rains create standing water that boosts mosquito breeding and supports ticks and snails, raising the potential spread of dengue, chikungunya, and malaria where vectors exist. Prolonged drought may push rodents toward human settlements, increasing contact with contaminated feces and urine and heightening hantavirus and leptospirosis risks, especially where food storage is poor or debris provides shelter. Domestic dogs and cats can facilitate spillover by moving between wildlife and human environments. The article emphasizes that El Niño does not directly cause disease; risk stems from a combination of ecological and social factors, including deforestation and floodborne contaminants.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーエルニーニョが動物媒介感染症を助長する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では具体的な症例報告ではなく、気候変動による将来的な感染症リスク増加の可能性を論じた予測的・一般的な内容であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症発生事例ではなく、気候変動（エルニーニョ）が将来的にデング熱・チクングニア熱・マラリア・ハンタウイルス・レプトスピラ症のリスクを高める可能性について一般的に論じたもの。実際の症例数や発生状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt kéo dài sau Covid-19, người đàn ông 43 tuổi phát hiện mắc lao màng ngoài tim hiếm gặp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prolonged fever after COVID-19: a 43-year-old man diagnosed with rare tuberculous pericarditis.
article.articleSummary: 43-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City presented with fever after COVID-19, tachycardia to 170 bpm, and dyspnea. Echocardiography showed pericardial effusion with concurrent pleural effusion. Pericardiocentesis and pleural drainage were performed; CT chest/abdomen was nondiagnostic. Pericardial fluid analysis detected Mycobacterium tuberculosis, diagnosing tuberculous pericarditis, a rare extrapulmonary TB form (~1% of TB). The infection can compress the heart, reduce pumping, cause heart failure, and threaten life if untreated. The patient likely experienced latent TB reactivation after COVID-19–related immune decline. He began standard anti-tuberculosis therapy; after about two weeks fever and dyspnea improved markedly. After roughly 20 days, he was afebrile and discharged, continuing TB therapy for at least 6 months. Early detection and full adherence yield favorable prognosis; vaccination with BCG and latent TB screening are advised for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19後の長期発熱、43歳男性に希少な結核性心膜炎が判明
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in the Congo exceed 4,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 4,000 cases for the first time in the current outbreak, described as the largest and fastest-spreading globally. The latest report from the DRC Public Health Institute tallies 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths. Experts believe transmission began months before the 15 May declaration of the outbreak, and the true figure may be higher than official counts, according to Libyan agency WA. The United Nations warns the outbreak could cost Africa about $3.6 billion. The World Health Organization has urged increased support at all levels to combat Ebola as the outbreak accelerates in areas with weak governance and severely limited health infrastructure. WHO spokesperson Tarik Jasarevic says the response remains well behind the surge in cases, calling for more funding, treatment capacity, field investigation teams, and proper burial of victims.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染、4000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大級かつ急速に拡大するエボラ流行が4000症例・1850死亡に達し、WHOが国際支援を要請しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.6%と高く、WHOが資金・治療能力・現地調査チームの不足を指摘。国連はアフリカ経済への影響を約36億ドルと試算しており、国際的関心・支援ニーズが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El ébola deja ya 1.850 muertos y más de 4.000 casos...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC - Ebola has already claimed 1,850 lives and more than 4,000 cases....
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has claimed 1,850 lives and 4,053 confirmed cases since it was declared mid-May, according to the national Public Health Institute. The worst outbreak on record is centered in Ituri Province in northern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with militia attacks driving displacement and severely hindering containment efforts. The World Health Organization warned of extreme gravity and called for an urgent, mass-scale response. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no vaccine is approved, was declared on May 15 and remains active across five provinces: Upper Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, affecting 51 health zones. A treatment center in Mongbwalu, Ituri, illustrates strained medical capacity. The situation demands intensified surveillance, robust public health measures, and sustained support to frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ - エボラ出血熱によりすでに1,850人が死亡、感染確認者は4,000人超
triage.triage_reason: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が5州・51保健地区に拡大し、致死率も高く、WHOが緊急大規模対応を要請しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株にはワクチンが承認されておらず、民兵活動による住民避難が封じ込めを著しく妨げている。感染は北キブ、南キブ、イトゥリ、ウペールウエレ、チョポの5州に及ぶ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les équipes d'intervention poursuivent leur combat en RDC, tandis que l'Ouganda se rapproche de la fin de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Response teams continue their fight in the DRC, as Uganda nears the end of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda declares the end of its Ebola outbreak approach as the last confirmed patient left treatment on July 16, triggering the 42-day waiting period to formally end the outbreak in the country. In neighboring eastern DRC, Ituri province continues to grapple with its 17th Ebola outbreak (May 2026), described by WHO as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, though not the deadliest strain. As of July 27, CDC records 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths. On July 15 in Bunia, Ebola response workers protested unpaid risk allowances, highlighting funding gaps and the risk to outbreak control, with local advocate Robert Uyergiu Mambo stressing that delays paralyze the response. US funding cuts since 2025 and Africa CDC’s call for $1.4 billion (only 13% disbursed by June) are degrading surveillance, community outreach, and logistics, undermining the 2019-era gains in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：DRCでは対応チームが対応を継続、ウガンダは流行終息に近づく
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州で史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が継続し、3,360症例・1,487死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、資金不足が対応能力を脅かしているためフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات إيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية تتجاوز 4 آلاف حالة - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000 - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) now totals 4,053 confirmed infections and 1,850 deaths, with the outbreak spanning five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. As of 2026-08-07, the surge is described as the fastest-spreading yet and the second-largest global outbreak by case count, behind West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (>28,000 cases). Scientists say transmission likely began months before the official 15 May declaration; a Science journal study published last month pinpointed onset in January or earlier in Ituri, citing more than 500 suspected cases from mid-January to 15 May. Response challenges include delayed detection, ongoing armed conflict, strained surveillance systems, and shortages of vaccines and therapeutics for the circulating strain, complicating containment across the five affected regions.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 4,000 as more health zones affected
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 cases with 4,053 confirmed and 1,850 deaths since mid-May, per Health Ministry. Bundibugyo virus spreading across 53 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo; Ituri is the epicenter with 86.9% of cases. Investigations underway to assess whether viral changes drive transmission. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya cautioned figures may be undercounted and urged stronger community-led response, broader contact tracing, and easier access to testing and care. MSF notes expansion but inadequate reach to communities, with new suspected cases daily in new locations outside established transmission chains, signaling the outbreak remains hard to stop. This remains the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak by infections.

triage.notes: 世界第2位の規模のエボラアウトブレイクとされ、Bundibugyoウイルスの変異可能性も調査中。Africa CDCやMSFが対応強化を要請しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola deja ya 1.850 muertos y más de 4.000 casos confirmados en...

article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's worst Ebola outbreak has caused 1,850 deaths and 4,053 confirmed cases since its declaration on 15 May. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain remains active across five provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—with 51 health zones affected. The World Health Organization has warned of extreme gravity, with sustained transmission and a rising toll. Militia attacks in Ituri have displaced populations and severely hindered containment efforts. There is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola, underscoring the urgency to intensify and broaden the response to control the outbreak in affected communities.

article.articleHeadline: Mesmo com queda no país, Acre continua em alerta para síndrome respiratória grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even with a nationwide decline, Acre remains on alert for severe respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Despite a nationwide decrease in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, Acre remains at alert/high-risk levels per Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin covering Week 30 (July 26–Aug 1). Acre is among 14 states with elevated SRAG circulation, alongside Amazonas, Bahia, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima, Santa Catarina, Sergipe. In the capital Rio Branco, SRAG incidence is at alert/high-risk among 15 cities in the past two weeks, with no long-term growth or acceleration in six weeks. Nationally, RSV remains the leading SRAG cause at 54.1% of positives in the past four weeks, followed by rhinovirus 26.1%, influenza B 9.3%, influenza A 7.3%, and SARS-CoV-2 1.8%. Since 2026 began, Brazil has 130,054 SRAG cases, with 69,895 lab-confirmed; positives: RSV 42.1%, rhinovirus 30%, influenza A 18.9%, influenza B 5.1%, SARS-CoV-2 4.1%.

triage.headline_ja: 全国的には減少傾向も、アクレ州は重症呼吸器症候群への警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザによる重症呼吸器症候群（SRAG）のサーベイランス報告であり、全国的には減少傾向にあるが一部州で警戒レベルが継続しているため、経過観察の対象とする。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、ライノウイルス、SARS-CoV-2）によるサーベイランスデータであり、既存の公衆衛生モニタリング体制内で管理されている状況。新規性や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: De nombreux décès et contaminations à Ebola recensés dans les camps de réfugiés, selon le HCR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Numerous deaths and Ebola infections recorded in refugee camps, according to UNHCR.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, five of 69 refugee sites in Ituri province have reported laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, with several deaths, according to UNHCR. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the outbreak, amid overcrowding, water and sanitation shortages, and distrust of health services, all hindering early testing and the implementation of response measures, including safe burials. UNHCR warns misinformation is slowing surveillance and complicating control efforts. Across affected provinces, 3,973 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 1,801 deaths have been recorded, with Ituri alone accounting for about 87% of infections, per UN information based on WHO data. The UN warns of rapid spread among displaced people, who total about 4.4 million in the region (3.8 million internally displaced, ~274,000 refugees/asylum seekers, 290,000 repatriated). In the week reported, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded in RDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：難民キャンプで多数のエボラ死者・感染者、UNHCRが報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプで急速に拡大しており、大量の死者・感染者が確認され、国際的拡大リスクや管理困難性が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: UNHCRおよびWHOデータに基づく報告。避難民・難民の過密状態、衛生状況の悪さ、誤情報の拡散が対応を困難にしていると指摘されている。累計3,973例確認、1,801人死亡、直近1週間で567新規症例・296死亡と急速な拡大を示している。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉失控！民主剛果破4000人感染、1850死　專家憂病毒恐已突變
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control! Democratic Republic of the Congo Surpasses 4,000 Infections, 1,850 Deaths; Experts Fear the Virus May Have Mutated.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak reaching 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, the second-largest on record and the fastest-spreading. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is under study for possible mutation, with WHO and Africa CDC analyzing. Outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces; declared May 15, but transmission likely began months earlier, with over 500 suspected cases by mid-May. Surveillance is severely strained: MSF notes about 90% of hospitalized patients are not on official contact lists, and two-thirds of deaths occur in the community. Authorities shift to door-to-door case finding to interrupt transmission. A suspected importation case aboard a boat to Kinshasa prompted quarantines. Remdesivir compassionate use and broader Ervebo vaccine consideration are being explored; UNICEF reports measles vaccination declines threaten child health.)

triage.headline_ja: エボラ失控！民主コンゴで感染者4000人超、死者1850人 専門家はウイルス変異を懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、死者1850人・感染4053人に達し、ウイルス変異の疑いや監視体制の逼迫、キンシャサへの拡大疑いもあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : les structures sanitaires de Bafwasende renforcent la protection des soignants - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: the health facilities in Bafwasende strengthen the protection of healthcare workers
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness in the Bafwasende health zone, Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 7 August 2026, strengthens protection of healthcare workers. Facilities have received protective gear including gloves and single-use gowns, with staff urged to maintain precautions during the outbreak period. Ten community relay points per health area have been trained to aid detection and rapid alert notification, enhancing community surveillance amid population movements from Ituri, the Ebola epicenter. A formal response plan is being finalized to secure support for bolstering local health facilities. An Ebola Treatment Center site at Bafwasende General Referral Hospital is being prepared; the building, long overgrown, is being weeded and cleaned, with a rehabilitation quote to be issued to solicit funds from authorities and partners. Proximity to Ituri underscores the need for heightened surveillance and rigorous preparation of medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：バフワセンデの医療施設が医療従事者の保護を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、イツリ州（震源地）からの人口移動によりツショピ州キサンガニ・バフワセンデ地域にも波及リスクがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（ツショピ州キサンガニ・バフワセンデ）でのエボラ流行対応強化に関するもの。震源地イツリ州からの人口移動によるリスクが指摘されている。エボラは既知の高致死性疾患であり継続的なモニタリングが必要。
