Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: मानसून में ही क्यों बढ़ते हैं स्वाइन फ्लू के केस, ये नॉर्मल फ्लू से कैसे अलग, डॉक्टर ने बताया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why do swine flu cases increase only during the monsoon season, and how is it different from regular flu, as explained by the doctor?
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, swine flu (H1N1) cases are rising in Delhi and several other Indian states during the monsoon. High humidity (80-90%) allows viral droplets to survive on air and surfaces; cooler temperatures and crowded indoor settings during rain further facilitate transmission from a single cough or sneeze. Swine flu differs from regular influenza: abrupt high fever, severe muscle and joint pains, profound fatigue, and a persistent dry cough, with possible breathing trouble. Most individuals recover in 5-7 days, but risk is higher for children under 5 and adults over 65, and those with diabetes or respiratory disease. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation details, nor infection source or import/export specifics. Public health emphasis is on early medical consultation for at-risk groups during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期になぜスワインフルの症例が増えるのか、通常のインフルエンザとの違いを医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期に季節性で毎年見られるH1N1増加についての一般的な健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク規模のデータがなく、異常性や新規性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性スワインフル(H1N1)の一般的な医療啓発情報であり、症例数・検査確認・感染源等の詳細データはない。インドでは毎年モンスーン期に見られる既知の現象であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasaï-Central : la NSCC dénonce la vente de moustiquaires distribuées gratuitement contre le paludisme - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasaï-Central: NSCC denounces the sale of mosquito nets distributed free of charge to combat malaria - Le Potentiel.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, in Demba, Kasaï-Central, the Nouvelle société civile congolaise (NSCC) denounced the trafficking of insecticide-treated mosquito nets intended for malaria prevention. Coordinated by Marcel Masanka, the NSCC says nets are regularly seen in the streets sold for 1,000 Congolese francs each, while campaigns aimed to distribute them free to targeted households. Malaria remains a leading cause of morbidity in the territory. The NSCC also cites unconfirmed information about possible involvement by health facility officials and calls for investigations. Provincial Health Minister Honoré Mutshipayi Balowe condemned the practice as unacceptable and urged security and health authorities to identify perpetrators and halt the trafficking. The NSCC asks for stronger distribution controls and for residents to report sales, diversion, or misuse, asserting that nets must reach beneficiaries free of charge.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ・サントラル州：NSCCがマラリア対策用無償配布蚊帳の横流し販売を告発
triage.triage_reason: マラリア予防用蚊帳の横流し・不正販売に関する行政・社会問題の記事であり、感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: マラリア自体の流行状況の変化ではなく、蚊帳配布の不正流通に関する社会問題の報道。マラリアは同地域で慢性的な主要疾患とされているが、新規の異常発生を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de sarampo em parque da Universal Studios, nos EUA, acende alerta de autoridades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles case at a Universal Studios park in the United States prompts authorities' warning.
article.articleSummary: Measles case at Universal Studios Hollywood in Los Angeles County prompts a public health warning. A confirmed measles case was at the park on July 26, with exposure between 10:00 and 21:00; visitors should verify vaccination status and monitor for symptoms through August 16. Measles is transmitted airborne and can linger up to two hours after an infected person leaves; symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash. In the United States, measles infections in 2026 exceed 2,300, the highest annual total since 1991. In Brazil, 17 measles cases have been confirmed in 2026 (Rio de Janeiro 1; São Paulo 13; São Bernardo do Campo 2; Guarulhos 1), with 3 resolved and 14 ongoing in three São Paulo-area cities; health authorities urge revaccination and a dose-zero for infants under one. Universal Studios Hollywood reports cooperation with the Public Health Department.

triage.headline_ja: 米国ユニバーサル・スタジオの公園での麻疹症例が当局の警戒を喚起
triage.triage_reason: 米国で2026年の麻疹感染者数が1991年以来最多を記録し、ブラジルでも複数都市で症例が継続確認されており、公衆衛生当局が警告を発するなど社会的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 米国（ロサンゼルス）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルでは2026年に17例（リオデジャネイロ1、サンパウロ13、サンベルナルドドカンポ2、グアルーリョス1）が確認され、14例が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: São Paulo registra 7 novos casos na última semana; veja quem deve se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: São Paulo records 7 new cases in the past week; see who should get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, measles outbreak in São Paulo State, Brazil: São Paulo city confirmed seven new measles cases in the past week, bringing the state's annual total to 23 cases across three cities. One additional case in Rio de Janeiro in March was closed. Of the 23 confirmed in São Paulo state, two are imported and the remainder are related to importation, with the infection source not yet identified. Sixteen patients had no vaccination history or were incompletely vaccinated. In addition to the capital, two cases were reported in São Bernardo do Campo and one in Guarulhos. In response, the Ministry of Health recommended unrestricted revaccination for all residents of the three cities aged 6 months to 59 years with a booster, through September 1.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロ州で先週7件の新規症例、ワクチン接種対象者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で輸入関連の麻疹アウトブレイクが継続しており、感染源未特定でワクチン未接種者が多く、保健省が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど社会的・行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 感染源が特定されていない輸入関連の麻疹症例が複数都市で確認されており、ワクチン未接種者を中心に感染拡大の可能性がある。ブラジル保健省は3都市の住民に対し追加接種を推奨している。

article.articleHeadline: Agencies On High Alert As Rapidly Spreading Ebola Virus Kills More In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Rapidly spreading Ebola Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province has infected 19 internally displaced people and killed 5. About five of Ituri’s 69 displacement camps have reported Ebola cases. Since the outbreak began on May 15, there have been almost 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths, with the latest 24-hour WHO/health authorities reporting 52 deaths and 99 new confirmed cases. Authorities and international partners urge a rapid scale-up of the community-led Ebola response, emphasizing early detection, contact follow-up, improved access to care, frontline-health-worker support, and faster resource delivery. A joint high-level mission to Uganda and DRC—led by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Africa CDC DG Dr Jean Kaseya, and WHO Regional Director for Africa Dr Mohamed Janabi—sought lessons from Uganda’s containment and to address Bunia’s operational challenges and community priorities.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大するエボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国でさらなる死者を出し、各機関が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約4,000症例・1,800人以上の死亡という大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が急速に拡大しており、WHO事務局長らが現地入りするなど国際的関心・支援が既に発生しているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHO高官の視察対象国として言及されているが、感染発生地としての言及はないため verified_locations から除外。国内避難民キャンプでの感染拡大が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: لغز كورونايعود: تساؤلات جديدة حول مصدر الفيروس! - قناة العالم الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The coronavirus mystery returns: New questions about the origin of the virus!
article.articleSummary: Renewed questions about the origin of the coronavirus—whether COVID-19 arose naturally or resulted from a laboratory-related incident—dominate analysis as of August 7, 2026. The White House now endorses the lab-leak hypothesis, portraying it as the origin after years of ambiguity. Critics question why the theory is resurfacing now and why intelligence agencies did not take a definitive position earlier. The report notes that the updated White House page on COVID-19 origins does not present new scientific findings but reiterates conclusions from the 2024 Congressional committee’s final report, which favored a lab-related accident in Wuhan, China as a plausible origin, supported by several arguments. No new laboratory-confirmation data is reported. Details are linked in an accompanying video.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスの謎が再燃：ウイルスの起源をめぐる新たな疑問！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19の起源（自然発生か研究所流出か）をめぐる政治的・歴史的議論の再燃であり、新規の感染事例発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2019年に発生したCOVID-19の起源（武漢の研究所流出説など）についての政治的議論の再燃を扱っており、現在進行中の新規感染症発生を報告するものではないため、地理的発生地としての検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola deja ya 1.850 muertos y más de 4.000 casos confirmados en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has already claimed 1,850 lives and more than 4,000 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 1,850 lives and registered 4,053 confirmed cases since its May 15 declaration, according to the Public Health Institute. It is the worst Ebola outbreak on record in DRC, centered in Ituri province in the north, with spread across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, affecting 51 health zones. Ongoing violence from militias has driven displacement and severely hampered containment efforts. The World Health Organization has warned of extreme gravity, noting sustained transmission and a continual rise in cases and deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an urgently scaled-up, mass response. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species, for which no vaccine is approved, complicating vaccination strategies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数1,850人、確認症例4,000人超に
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で、致死率が高く複数州に拡大、WHOが極めて深刻と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチンがないBundibugyoエボラウイルス種による流行であり、民兵による暴力が対応を著しく妨げている点が管理可能性・国際支援の必要性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS recomienda ensayos con la vacuna Erbevo para intentar frenar el actual brote en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO recommends trials of the Erbevo vaccine to curb the current outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO recommends prioritizing Ervebo, Merck's vaccine for Zaire ebolavirus, in clinical trials to address the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which has surpassed 4,000 infections and 1,850 deaths as of August 7, 2026. The WHO's Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization discussed candidates on July 31 and concluded that animal studies show Ervebo offers a degree of protection. Ervebo is approved for the Zaire ebolavirus variant; the current DRC outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer variant for which no vaccine or specific treatment is licensed. The recommendation signals a cautious exploration of cross-variant protection, with registrational studies and trials to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo, while leveraging existing manufacturing by Merck.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国での現行アウトブレイク抑制のためErvebo(エルベボ)ワクチンの臨床試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者4000人超、死者1850人超に達するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、既存ワクチンが未承認のブンディブギョ型による稀な変異株が原因であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 現行アウトブレイクの病原体はブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスであり、承認済みワクチン(Ervebo)はザイール型対象のため交差防御効果の検証が課題。既に4000人以上感染、1850人以上死亡と大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ইনফ্লুয়েঞ্জা, নিউমোনিয়ায় আর ভুগতে হবে না, বিশ্বে প্রথম 'এমআরএনএ' ফ্লু টিকা অনুমোদন পেল
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza will no longer have to suffer from pneumonia; the world's first mRNA flu vaccine has been approved.
article.articleSummary: World's first mRNA flu vaccine, Emflusiva, approved to combat influenza and pneumonia risk. Developed by Moderna, it uses messenger RNA to elicit a stronger antibody response, building on COVID-19 vaccine tech. The vaccine is initially approved for adults aged 50–64, with requests submitted for those 65 and older. In trials, Emflusiva showed higher protection against multiple influenza strains than conventional flu vaccines. A Delhi-based MC survey reported pneumonia disproportionately affecting children under five and adults over 65, with the elderly bearing the highest mortality; ICU occupancy among elderly with pneumonia and respiratory diseases runs 65–70%, and about 30% of cases are invasive pneumonia. If approved for older age groups, the vaccine could substantially reduce virus-related illnesses in the elderly.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザとその肺炎、もう苦しまなくていい　世界初の『mRNA』インフルエンザワクチンが承認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン承認に関するニュースであり、疾病アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: デリーの調査データは肺炎の一般的な疫学情報であり、特定のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。記事の主題はModernaのmRNAインフルエンザワクチン承認であり、感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Africa CDC says will use Zaire Ebola vaccine in curr
article.articleSummary: Africa's top health agency will roll out the Zaire ebolavirus vaccine to counter the latest outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The Bundibugyo variant, which spreads through contact with bodily fluids and causes haemorrhagic fever, has resulted in over 1,800 deaths out of nearly 4,000 confirmed cases since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in the DRC. The outbreak has spread across five provinces in the eastern and northeastern regions of the country. Scientists are scrambling to find a vaccine for the new Bundibugyo variant, while authorities deploy the Zaire vaccine as part of the response to this ongoing crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：アフリカCDC、現在の流行に対しザイール株エボラワクチンを使用すると発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例約4000、死亡1800超）が5州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対する有効ワクチンが未確立であり、ザイール株用ワクチンの転用対応が行われている点が異常性を高めている。致死率約45%と非常に高く、5州に拡大している点からも国際的拡大リスクを懸念すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de raiva bovina avançam e colocam rebanhos em alerta - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bovine rabies cases advance and put herds on alert - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã - Mato Grosso do Sul and Pedro Juan Caballero - Paraguay.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in herbivores is prompting alerts across southern Brazil. In early 2026, Paraná confirmed 75 cases (69 cattle, 6 horses) across 57 foci, including near Parque Nacional do Iguaçu. Santa Catarina registered 27 bovine cases this year, with circulation from the north to Itajaí Valley; Itapiranga is a recent location. In 2025, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul reported 230 infected animals in 197 foci, over 80% cattle, prompting vaccination mandates in western Paraná. Rio Grande do Sul had 45 active foci by June across ten regions, with alerts in several municipalities. Outside the region, Bezerros, Pernambuco, reported a rabid horse in July, triggering vaccination in six nearby municipalities. Transmission is primarily via Desmodus rotundus; infected animals show neurological signs and usually die within days. Vaccination starts at three months, boosters after 30 days, annual revaccination; isolate symptomatic animals and report bat roosts; control by authorized teams.

triage.headline_ja: 牛の狂犬病症例が拡大し、家畜群に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 動物(家畜)における狂犬病(牛・馬)の発生であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の直接的脅威は報告されていない。既知の風土病的事象で異常性は低く、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 家畜(牛・馬)の狂犬病流行であり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。ワクチン接種義務化など地域レベルでの対応が既に行われている。

article.articleHeadline: New CDC Director Confirmed as Agency Juggles Measles, Cyclospora and a Jalapeño Salmonella Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Erica Schwartz was confirmed CDC director on 2026-08-07, taking the helm during three concurrent outbreaks. Measles now has 2,371 confirmed cases as of July 30, 2026—the year’s highest tally since 1991 and above 2025’s total (2,289); 37 new outbreaks this year and 94% of cases outbreak-associated, with PAHO to review U.S. measles elimination status in November. Cyclosporiasis tied to recalled Taylor Farms de Mexico iceberg lettuce marks the largest U.S. outbreak on record, with more than 10,000 lab-confirmed domestically acquired cases since May 1, and Michigan alone reporting 12,485 cases and two deaths. A jalapeño outbreak linked to Sinaloa, Mexico, distributed by Coast Citrus Distributors accounts for 345 illnesses across 27 states, 36 hospitalizations, no deaths; onset June 19–July 20; 27 clusters at Chipotle and Qdoba, which have halted serving the peppers. Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are under elevated response.

triage.headline_ja: 新CDC局長が承認、機関は麻疹・サイクロスポーラ症・ハラペーニョ由来サルモネラのアウトブレイクに対応中
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は米国内のアウトブレイク（麻疹・サイクロスポーラ症・サルモネラ）であり、対象国であるDRCのエボラについては『高度な対応下にある』との一言のみで具体的な新情報がないため、継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国内の複数アウトブレイク（麻疹、サイクロスポーラ症、サルモネラ）とCDC新局長就任であり、DRC・ウガンダのエボラは既知流行への簡単な言及のみで詳細情報がない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Consultório odontológico é interditado em Belém por risco de infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dental clinic is shut down in Belém due to risk of infection.
article.articleSummary: Belém, Pará, Brazil – A dental clinic in the Icoaraci district has been interdicted on a precautionary basis by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesma) after a sanitary inspection by the Department of Sanitary Surveillance (DEVISA) identified irregularities during licensing. Investigators found deficiencies in biosafety practices, infrastructure conditions, and cleaning, with irregularities in the processing and sterilization of dental instruments. The health authority warned that such failures could raise the risk of infection transmission among patients and staff, including serious viral diseases like hepatitis and HIV. The clinic had been notified earlier to obtain a sanitary license and implement required adaptations, but a subsequent inspection found no corrective actions. The temporary interdiction means the clinic cannot resume care until all irregularities are corrected and regularization with the sanitary surveillance authority is completed. Patients are advised to verify licensure, hygiene, and that sterilized instruments are properly sealed and opened in their presence.

triage.headline_ja: 感染リスクによりベレンの歯科医院が営業停止処分に
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の衛生管理不備による予防的措置であり、実際の感染事例発生の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症患者の発生報告はなく、衛生当局による予防的な行政措置に関する記事。ブラジル国内の一施設に限定された事案であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma 23 casos de sarampo, e amplia vacinação em três cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 23 measles cases and expands vaccination in three cities.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo state reaches 23 confirmed cases, with vaccination expanded to residents of three municipalities: São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. Vaccination targets individuals aged six months to 59 years, and doses are available at all Basic Health Units (UBSs) in these areas. According to the São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP), two cases are imported and the remaining infections are linked to importation, though the exact infection source has not yet been identified. The outbreak has grown within less than a week, prompting authorities to extend vaccination recommendations to nearby urban centers. The announcement emphasizes accessible vaccination and monitoring of vaccination post queues to curb transmission and prevent further measles spread.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹23例を確認し3都市でワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 1週間足らずで23例に増加し、輸入例を含む麻疹アウトブレイクが複数都市に拡大、州保健当局がワクチン接種対象を拡大するなど行政の対応が強化されているため。
triage.notes: 感染源の特定に至っておらず、輸入例に関連した二次感染が疑われる。今後の症例数推移とワクチン接種状況の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Dentista é preso após ser acusado de transmitir HIV propositalmente a várias mulheres em Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dentist arrested after being accused of deliberately transmitting HIV to several women in Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: HIV exposure case in Rondônia, Brazil: A dentist in Porto Velho has been arrested after allegedly deliberately transmitting HIV to several women with whom he had relationships. The Ministério Público de Rondônia filed charges; the clinician knew of his HIV diagnosis for ten years and did not seek treatment to control the virus. The case came to light after three women diagnosed with HIV; a fourth victim has been identified during investigations. Authorities fear more individuals may have been exposed. The dentist is imprisoned and faces charges including rape, danger of contagion of a grave disease, and grievous bodily harm, with potential penalties totaling up to ten years in prison plus fines. Ongoing investigations may reveal additional victims.

triage.headline_ja: 歯科医、複数の女性に故意にHIVを感染させた疑いで逮捕（ロンドニア州）
triage.triage_reason: 個人による故意のHIV感染事件であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や国際的拡大リスクはなく、犯罪事件としての性質が強いため見送り。
triage.notes: 本件は個人の刑事事件（意図的なHIV感染）であり、感染症の集団発生・公衆衛生イベントには該当しない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、事件の性質上シグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 4000 - MigNews - Новости Израиля и Мира на русском языке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, totaling 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths since the mid-May outbreak declaration. It stands as the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally by confirmed cases. The virus has spread to 53 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo Provinces, with Ituri the epicenter, accounting for about 87% of cases. Researchers are probing whether viral changes may have accelerated transmission. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya cautioned that the true scale may exceed official counts and urged stronger community engagement, expanded contact tracing, and improved access to testing and treatment. MSF warns the epidemic shows no signs of slowing, with new suspected cases detected nearly daily in new areas, highlighting the need for proactive measures to outpace spread.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoにおけるエボラ症例数が4,000人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが53の保健地域に拡大し、死亡者数も多く、国際的拡大・対応支援の必要性が高いためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ流行で、世界第2位の規模。感染拡大が続き、ウイルス変異による伝播性増加の可能性も調査中。Africa CDCおよびMSFが警鐘を鳴らしており、国際的な支援強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo volta a circular em São Paulo: um alerta para a vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles back in circulation in São Paulo: a vaccination alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles returns to circulation in the São Paulo Metropolitan Region, Brazil. As of Aug 7, 2026, the State Health Secretariat reports 23 measles cases this year: 20 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. Two cases are imported; the remainder are linked to importation, though the infection source is not yet identified. Sixteen patients lacked vaccination or had incomplete vaccination. In response, the Ministry of Health issued an extraordinary measure: indiscriminate vaccination for people 6 months to 59 years old in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo during the Multivaccination Campaign (Aug 3–Sep 1). Infants 6–11 months receive a zero-dose of the measles–mumps–rubella vaccine; routine doses at 12 and 15 months follow. Coverage gaps persist: 2025 first dose 92.9%, second dose 78.3%. In the United States, 2026 has over 2,300 cases, mostly unvaccinated. Measles is highly contagious via airborne transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで麻疹が再流行:ワクチン接種への警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ都市圏で麻疹の再流行（輸入関連含む23例）が確認され、保健省が緊急ワクチン接種措置を発令するなど異常性と国際的拡大の可能性が認められるため。
triage.notes: 米国の症例数（2300例以上）は参考情報として記載されているが、記事の主題はブラジル・サンパウロ都市圏の麻疹再流行であるため、米国は対象国リストにも含まれず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: CG News: CG में मलेरिया से मौत! बैगा आदिवासी महिला की सिम्स में मौत, 72 गांव में मंडरा रहा खतरा | CG News: Malaria death in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh! A Baiga tribal woman died at CIMS; the threat looms over 72 villages.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CG News: Death due to malaria in CG! A Baiga tribal woman died at CIMS; the threat looms over 72 villages.
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths and rising cases in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh. A 37-year-old Baiga woman, Rekha Baiga of Aropani village in Kota block, died at SIMS during malaria treatment, with the health department confirming malaria as the cause. The district has recorded over 40 malaria cases, including 18 active patients. Kota block comprises 72 villages categorized as malaria-affected, prompting intensified response: mobile medical teams, broad screening, medicine distribution, and a district-wide containment drive with camps in forests and remote villages over the past 10 days. In Cipat area, 17-year-old Dinesh Ode (Bhagat) from Adarali village is suspected to have died of malaria while being transported to SIMS; his family says a medical report confirmed P. falciparum malaria, though SIMS management says he arrived dead. The situation underscores ongoing transmission and the need for rapid public health action in Kota.

triage.headline_ja: CGニュース：CG州でマラリアにより死亡！バイガ族の女性がCIMSで死亡、72村に脅威が迫る
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州コタ地区の限定的地域でマラリア死亡例と40人超の患者が確認されているが、国際的拡大リスクは低く、社会的関心の広がりも不明であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: チャッティースガル州コタ地区の72村がマラリア流行地域とされ、保健当局が移動医療チームや検診・薬剤配布などの封じ込め対策を実施中。地方限定の風土病的流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上のリスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تقييم لقاح إرفيبو لسلالة إيبولا فى تجربة جديدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization evaluates the Ervebo Ebola vaccine for an Ebola strain in a new trial.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-07, the World Health Organization (WHO) reported that its Technical Advisory Group on prioritising candidate vaccines (TAG-CVP) recommended evaluating Merck's Ervebo Ebola vaccine in a new clinical trial against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The recommendation was issued in a WHO statement released today. The TAG-CVP's guidance focuses on assessing Ervebo's suitability for protection against this specific Ebola strain to inform vaccine strategies for outbreak response in the DRC. This decision underscores ongoing efforts by WHO to evaluate vaccines against diverse Ebola strains through targeted trials. It notes only a procedural recommendation by the WHO advisory group, with no trial results disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新たな臨床試験でエボラ株に対するエルベボワクチンを評価
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWHO技術諮問グループによるワクチン臨床試験実施の手続き的推奨に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生や症例報告を伴うものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン試験実施に関するWHOの手続き的発表であり、具体的なアウトブレイクの規模・症例数・拡大状況等の情報は含まれていない。DRCでのBundibugyo株エボラの現状について続報があれば要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Enough leptospirosis medicine available in Mandaue
article.articleSummary: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The City Health Office says leptospirosis prophylaxis and preventive medicines are available at the City Health Office and barangay health centers amid recent rains and flooding. Assistant City Health Officer Dr. Phyllis Bidon says stocks are sufficient to help residents exposed to floodwaters access treatment. She cautions against self-medication; antibiotics for prophylaxis should be taken only after consultation with a health worker, especially for children. Prevention efforts emphasize washing feet after floodwater exposure, monitoring symptoms, and seeking prompt medical care if fever, leg pain or cramps, or eye-related symptoms occur. The city’s surveillance unit has not recorded an increase in leptospirosis cases, though hospitals admit patients from neighboring localities, making attribution to residents difficult. The Health Office continues to provide medical consultations, injury treatment, water/sanitation monitoring, nutrition services, and mental health support in evacuation centers during floods.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市、レプトスピラ症治療薬の在庫十分と発表
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の予防的な医薬品供給状況を伝える内容で、症例増加は確認されておらず、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水期における予防措置と医薬品供給の広報が主旨であり、症例数の増加は報告されていない（サーベイランスユニットは増加を確認していない）。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تقييم لقاح "إرفيبو" لسلالة إيبولا فى تجربة جديدة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Evaluation of the Ervebo vaccine for the Ebola strain in a new trial - Youm7
article.articleSummary: WHO's Technical Advisory Group on CVP recommended evaluating Ervebo in a randomized trial targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola (BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. This follows the May 16 public health emergency declaration over the ongoing DRC outbreak and subsequent vaccine reviews. Earlier, TAG-CVP advised against using Ervebo outside carefully designed research settings. On July 31, members reviewed new data, including animal studies showing Ervebo provides some protection against Ebola and related mortality. They concluded there are no safety concerns with deploying Ervebo in outbreak contexts, including among contacts of cases. Ervebo should be prioritized for inclusion in a randomized trial during the current outbreak, as no BDBV-specific vaccine exists. Efficacy against Ebola infection and transmission remains unproven, and a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine would still be preferred if sufficiently data become available; production must be scaled if effective and accessible.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:エボラ出血熱のブンディブギョ株に対する「エルベボ」ワクチンの新たな試験での評価
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（5月16日に公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み）に関する続報であり、ブンディブギョ株特異的ワクチンが存在しない中でのワクチン試験評価という重要な公衆衛生上の動きのため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みの進行中アウトブレイクに関するワクチン試験の続報。ブンディブギョ株(BDBV)特異的ワクチンが存在しないため、既存のエルベボワクチンのランダム化比較試験実施が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola a fait plus de 1 800 morts en RDC, et l'aide internationale tarde à arriver
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has killed more than 1,800 people in the DRC, and international aid has been slow to arrive.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak has surpassed 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 5, 2026, with UNICEF reporting about 300 child fatalities. Less than three months after the outbreak was declared on May 15, the situation is described as out of control, hindered by insecurity and slow international aid. The UN calls it the most significant Ebola outbreak ever recorded in the DRC. On August 7, authorities and Africa CDC authorized use of the Ervebo vaccine (targeting the Ebola Zaire virus) alongside the antiviral obelde as part of intensified response efforts. Authorities also note a potential mutation of the virus. The article underscores the ongoing, rapidly spreading crisis and the urgent need for robust international support to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、死者1,800人超に達するも国際支援の到着が遅れる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ史上最大規模の流行がDRCで進行中で、死者数が急増し国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウイルスの変異の可能性が言及されており、続報でのゲノム解析結果の確認が必要。ワクチン(Ervebo)と抗ウイルス薬の使用開始も注視点。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情陰霾　民主剛果破4000例確診1850人亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gloom over Ebola outbreak as the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths (total infections 4,053; deaths 1,850). It is the world’s second-largest Ebola outbreak and the fastest-spreading on record. Officials say the virus was circulating months before the May 15 declaration, with a Science study noting more than 500 suspected cases in Ituri Province from January to mid-May. The affected provinces are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Containment challenges include detection delays, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments for the circulating virus strain. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone exceeded 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情陰霾　民主コンゴが確診4000例・死者1850人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000例超・死者1850人という大規模かつ史上最速拡大のエボラ流行が継続しており、封じ込め課題（紛争、ワクチン・治療薬不足）もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの現行エボラ流行が主題。西アフリカ（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）は過去（2014-2016年）の比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストにギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネは含まれていない点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Seven passengers on boat intercepted near Kinshasa test negative for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Seven passengers aboard a river boat intercepted near Kinshasa tested negative for Ebola, easing concerns of in-transit transmission after a 32-year-old man who had traveled on the vessel died in Mongala province late last month amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo. The boat, halted at Maluku about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, prompted temperature checks and clinical screening for all 300 passengers on Thursday; a mobile laboratory was deployed. Only seven were tested because Ebola transmission is not contagious before symptom onset. All seven passengers with symptoms resembling malaria (fever, headaches) were negative, according to Jean-Jacques Muyembe, head of the National Institute for Biomedical Research. The vessel was decontaminated; health authorities expanded screening to all boats arriving in Kinshasa, given the capital's population of more than 17 million, to prevent further spread, as the outbreak has surpassed 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths across five eastern provinces since its May 15 declaration.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ近郊で拿捕された船の乗客7人、エボラ検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で5州にまたがり4000例・1850人以上の死者を出しているエボラ流行が、人口1700万人超の首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクを示す事案であり、国際的関心と対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は検査陰性という個別事案だが、背景にある東部コンゴでの大規模エボラ流行（5州、4000例超、死者1850人超）と首都への拡大懸念から、既存の進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRA継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les militaires sensibilisés à la prévention d'Ebola pour leur protection - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Soldiers educated on Ebola prevention for their own protection - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Soldiers of the Armed Forces in the Ituri operational sector, in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, were trained on Ebola prevention to protect themselves and maintain operational capacity. The sensitization session in Bunia, organized by the CREC risk communication and community engagement pillar, emphasized understanding Ebola virus disease transmission and protective behaviours. Dr. Cagod Inkale, interim president of CREC, stated the objective is to reach all social groups in Ituri and ensure military personnel apply preventive measures to safeguard themselves, the community, and the mission. Core messages included regular handwashing, avoiding physical contact with people of unknown health status, not handling individuals with Ebola symptoms, and supporting dignified, safe burials. The activity forms part of the broader community mobilization strategy for Ebola response in Ituri, progressively targeting all professional categories to strengthen prevention and adherence to public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：兵士たちが自らを守るためエボラ予防について教育を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州でエボラ対応活動（予防啓発）が継続中であることを示す記事だが、新規感染者数や拡大状況など具体的な疫学情報が含まれておらず、既存対応の一環の報道にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの新規発生や感染者数の増加を報じるものではなく、既存の対応活動（軍への予防教育）に関する内容。継続中のアウトブレイク状況を把握するため関連報道の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitaria en Santa Cruz por un caso sospechoso de sarampión: qué síntomas hay que tener en cuenta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in Santa Cruz over a suspected measles case: which symptoms should be monitored.
article.articleSummary: Suspected measles case in Caleta Olivia, Santa Cruz, has prompted a health alert as authorities activate the preventive protocol per national guidelines. The Expanded Immunization Program and Hospital Zonal Epidemiology units urge vaccination with MMR. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, or hearing loss; it spreads via airborne droplets and contaminated surfaces and can remain viable for up to two hours. An infected person can transmit to about 9 of 10 non-vaccinated contacts. Symptoms include high fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, and white Koplik spots inside the cheeks; severe cases may require hospitalization. First MMR dose at 12 months; second dose after the first year; adults born before 1965 are generally protected; health workers should be up-to-date. Travelers should verify vaccination before travel and seek care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルスで麻疹疑い例、公衆衛生アラート発令：注意すべき症状とは
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サンタクルス州での麻疹疑い1例に関する注意喚起記事であり、対象国（フィリピン等）とは無関係。国際的拡大等の懸念も現時点で確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(Calabarzon, Santa Cruz)が含まれるが、記事内容はアルゼンチン・サンタクルス州（Caleta Olivia）での事例であり、フィリピンとは無関係。対象国リストにアルゼンチンは含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri - Haut-Uélé : Jean Bakomito à Bunia pour bâtir une riposte commune contre Ebola et l'insécurité - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri – Haut-Uélé: Jean Bakomito in Bunia to build a joint response to Ebola and insecurity - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri and Haut-Uele provinces are coordinating a joint response to the ongoing Ebola epidemic and regional insecurity. Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu of Haut-Uele, on 7 August 2026, visited Bunia, Ituri’s capital, to strengthen inter-provincial coordination on security and health. The current epidemiologic situation is a centerpiece of talks, with Ebola affecting both provinces, prompting shared surveillance, prevention, and case management efforts. Beyond public health, discussions address security in eastern DRC and harmonizing strategies against armed groups operating in the region, notably the ADF. The initiative signals a move to transcend administrative boundaries and implement a unified approach to armed violence and health emergencies, aligning provincial actions for the needs of the populations.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州・オートウエレ州: ジャン・バコミト氏がブニアを訪問、エボラと治安不安への共同対応構築へ - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中のエボラ出血熱流行が複数州にまたがり、武装勢力による治安悪化が対応を複雑化させているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はDRCで繰り返し発生している既知の疾患だが、武装勢力（ADF）による治安不安が公衆衛生対応を阻害しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限への影響については記事内で言及なし。続報および感染者数・死亡者数等の具体的疫学情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : les opérateurs économiques appelés au respect des mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: Economic operators urged to respect barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo – On 7 August 2026, the Federation of Enterprises of Congo (FEC), Haut-Uele group, urged economic operators to strictly observe barrier measures to curb Ebola. Transport sectors should reduce bus occupancy and limit motorcycle riders to two; hotels must disinfect rooms and equipment for each use; pharmacies and shops should provide handwashing facilities and use disinfectants, especially after handling money. Businesses should install handwashing at entry/exit points of restaurants and bars and suspend large gatherings temporarily. Authorities were urged to strengthen border controls with thermo-flash thermal scanners and other preventive equipment. The FEC leader warned that Ebola has claimed lives in the province and can affect anyone without protection.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：経済関係者に感染防止策の遵守を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCオート・ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱による死者が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は経済団体（FEC）が感染対策の遵守を呼びかける内容であり、感染者数・死亡者数等の詳細な疫学情報は記載されていない。エボラは既に同州で死者を出しているとの記述があり、継続的なアウトブレイクの可能性がある。続報で症例数・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola response turns to Merck vaccine, Gilead drug as Congo outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo expands as Merck & Co.'s Ebola vaccine and a Gilead Sciences antiviral drug are slated for wider use. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention and Congolese officials plan to broaden access to both products across two eastern provinces to blunt the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. The intensified strategy follows months of conventional control measures failing to curb transmission. As of 2026-08-07, almost 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths have been reported since the outbreak was declared 12 weeks ago, underscoring the severity and urgency of the response. The move signals increased reliance on vaccination and antiviral treatment to reduce infections and fatalities in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行悪化、対応はメルク社ワクチンとギリアド社薬剤に転換
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最速のエボラ流行が拡大し、約4000症例・1800人超の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大ペースとされ、Africa CDCとコンゴ政府がワクチン・治療薬の使用拡大を計画中。従来の対策では制御できていない点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : renforcement de la surveillance à Bafwasende après un premier cas local confirmé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Strengthening surveillance in Bafwasende after a locally confirmed first case - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a locally confirmed first case. Surveillance intensified after confirmation; this case is the sixth positive in the area that has been monitored. Contact tracing identifies at least 32 contacts, including medical staff who treated the patient, colleagues, and family members. Some family members initially resisted but are now cooperating, allowing ongoing follow-up. Investigative teams faced early challenges with the patient’s family before outreach improved collaboration. Two alert Ebola cases were recorded on Thursday at the reference General Hospital in Bafwasende, now under investigation by a ten-person field team supported by partners to assist health services in surveillance. The new local transmission case raises the total Ebola cases in Tshopo to eight, of which seven were imported from neighboring Ituri province.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：バフワセンデで初の地域内感染例確認後、監視体制を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国トショピ州で新たな地域内感染によるエボラ症例が確認され、接触者32人が特定されるなど公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある事案であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: トショピ州での感染は隣接イトゥリ州からの輸入例7件に加え地域内感染1件（計8件）で、地域内感染は今回が最初の確認例。10名体制の現地調査チームがパートナー支援を受けて対応中。

article.articleHeadline: В Индонезии поймали обезьяну, которая напала на 18 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Indonesia, a monkey that attacked 18 people was caught.
article.articleSummary: On July 2, 2026, in Tembilahan, Sumatra, Indonesia, a long-tailed macaque (Macaca fascicularis) terrorized the city for three days, attacking at least 18 people, including children and the elderly. Some victims sustained bites or scratches and required stitches; several received rabies vaccines as a precaution. The aggressive macaque was captured three days after the onset of attacks using an iron cage provided by the Fire and Rescue Service and was sent to Pekanbaru for observation by the regional environment and natural resources agency. Local officials warned the threat may involve other macaques and urged vigilance. Following the initial incidents, about 40 schools were temporarily closed, with hundreds of children shifted to remote learning; authorities planned to resume classes on August 10 if the area is deemed safe.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで18人を襲ったサルを捕獲
triage.triage_reason: 単一のマカクによる咬傷事件で狂犬病感染は未確認だが、予防的にワクチン接種が行われ学校閉鎖等の社会的影響があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病確定例は報告されておらず、被害者への予防接種は予防的措置。他のマカクによる追加攻撃の可能性が指摘されており、続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Seven passengers on boat intercepted near Kinshasa test negative for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Seven passengers on a river boat intercepted near Kinshasa tested negative for Ebola after screening following a death of a traveler suspected of the disease. The vessel was stopped in Maluku, about 65 km upstream from Kinshasa, on Wednesday; 300 passengers underwent temperature checks and clinical screening on Thursday, with a mobile laboratory deployed. Only seven were tested because infected individuals are not contagious before symptoms. All tests on the seven passengers who showed symptoms resembling malaria—fever and headaches—were negative. The boat was decontaminated and passengers given food and medical assistance. Screening was expanded to all boats arriving in Kinshasa to prevent spread to the capital's more than 17 million people. The May 15 Ebola outbreak has surpassed 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths across five eastern provinces.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ近郊で拿捕された船の乗客7人、エボラ検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（4000症例超、1850人死亡）が首都キンシャサへ拡大するリスクに関する続報であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日発生、5州で4000症例超・1850死亡）の一環として、首都キンシャサへの拡大防止策（船舶スクリーニング強化）が報じられている。本記事自体は陰性確認だが、背景の疫学状況は極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo sobem para 23 no estado de São Paulo; veja recomendações | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases rise to 23 in the state of São Paulo; see recommendations.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise to 23 in São Paulo state in 2026, with seven new infections in three days. Of the 23 cases, 16 patients lacked vaccination or had incomplete schedules. Confirmed cases are in the capital, São Paulo, plus São Bernardo do Campo and Guarulhos; two cases are imported and others linked to importation, with the infection source not yet identified. In response, SES-SP launched a Multivaccination Campaign through Sept 1 across 645 municipalities, offering indiscriminate measles vaccination for residents aged 6 months to 59 years in the capital, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. People aged 60+ are not targeted due to presumed prior immunity. Vaccination coverage in 2026 is 77.5% for first dose and 65.5% for second, below the 95% national target. The state reports stock: 150,000 doses for the capital and 80,000 for São Bernardo do Campo; all municipalities are stocked.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹症例が23例に増加、推奨事項
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が急増（23例）し、ワクチン接種率も国目標を下回っており、州保健当局が大規模接種キャンペーンを実施するなど拡大リスクと行政の関与が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 感染源未特定の輸入関連症例が含まれ、ワクチン接種率が国目標(95%)を下回る（1回目77.5%、2回目65.5%）ため、今後の拡大に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos de sarampo em São Paulo sobe para 23 | Brasil | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of measles cases in São Paulo rises to 23 | Brazil | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state total 23 as of 7 August 2026: 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo (ABC Paulista), and 1 in Guarulhos (Metropolitan Region). Seven new cases were reported on the publication date. Although infection sources remain officially unknown, authorities note a transmission chain linked to importation of the virus in these locations. In response, vaccination is recommended for all individuals aged 6 months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo city, regardless of vaccination history. The State Health Secretariat launched a Multivaccination Campaign to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15, beginning 3 August. On 28 July, the Ministry expanded measles vaccination to the same age group in the three locations. Investigations are ongoing; infection sources remain unknown.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹症例数が23人に増加 | ブラジル | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で輸入例に起因する麻疹の伝播チェーンが確認され、複数自治体でワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されるなど行政の対応が強化されているため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心（政府対応）も認められる。
triage.notes: 感染源は正式には不明だが、輸入例に関連した伝播チェーンがあるとされる。州保健局と保健省がワクチン接種対象年齢を拡大し、複数回の接種キャンペーンを実施している。

article.articleHeadline: 23 Siswa SD di Sidoarjo Diduga Keracunan Jajanan Frozen Food
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23 Elementary School Students in Sidoarjo Allegedly Poisoned by Frozen Snacks
article.articleSummary: 23 students from SD Islam Ar Rahma (Sukodono, Sidoarjo, East Java) were rushed to RS Assakinah Medika on Friday, Aug 7, 2026, amid a mass suspected food poisoning linked to frozen snacks bought at the school canteen. The 3rd and 4th graders arrived at the emergency department with abdominal pain and weakness; medical staff administered IV fluids and ordered laboratory tests. Affected pupil Nazifa cited odeng and fried snacks purchased during the first break around 10 a.m.; symptoms emerged later around the Zuhr prayer time. Dozens of students reported similar gastroenteritis symptoms, with initial evaluations pointing to a food-related infection. Satreskrim Polresta Sidoarjo is leading the investigation, securing remaining food samples for forensic analysis and taking witness statements. The school will cooperate to identify the exact cause, including reviewing canteen management. By Friday night, several students were still under observation.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョの小学生23人、冷凍スナックによる食中毒疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単一学校における食中毒疑い事例であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、局所的な食品安全事案として処理可能。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いであり感染症イベントとしての性質が薄い。警察が調査中で、原因究明中。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола се шири до осам пута брже него раније, најављена примена постојеће вакцине
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Spreads Up to Eight Times Faster Than Before; Deployment of an Existing Vaccine Announced.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia region) is accelerating under Bundibugyo ebolavirus, spreading six to eight times faster than previous outbreaks. As of 7 August 2026, confirmed cases exceed 4,000 (4,053) with 1,850 deaths (case fatality ~43.9%). About 90% of cases are in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan. The number of health zones with cases has risen from nine in May to 51. The Africa CDC and WHO are pursuing investigations to determine whether viral mutation or other factors drive the unprecedented transmission. A deployment of an existing Zaire ebolavirus vaccine is underway; limited testing suggests reduced mortality among vaccine recipients, with no deaths observed in the vaccinated group, though symptoms can still occur. The outbreak began in late April 2026, prompting urgent public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが従来の最大8倍の速さで拡大、既存ワクチンの投入が発表される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が急拡大し、感染者4,000人超・致死率約44%と重篤で、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダン国境付近）もあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境付近での懸念のみで対象国リストに含まれず、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウイルス変異の可能性についてAfrica CDC・WHOが調査中であり、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило четыре тысячи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC has surpassed four thousand.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported as of 2026-08-07. The outbreak spans five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—and is described by experts as the second-largest globally and the fastest-spreading in history. Government data indicate infections were likely occurring months before the official outbreak declaration on May 15, and more than 500 suspected cases were identified from mid-January to May 15. Contributing factors include delayed detection, an overwhelmed surveillance system, ongoing conflict, and the absence of vaccines and specific therapies for the circulating Ebola strain. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) caused over 28,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ感染者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでエボラ感染者が4000人・死者1850人を超え、5州に拡大する史上最速の流行とされ、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準も該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行（ギニア、リベリア、シエラレオネ）は比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: دراسة لقاح "إرفيبو" ضد سلالة إيبولا الجديدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: A study of the Ervebo vaccine against the new Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the World Health Organization's Technical Advisory Group for Immunization in Emergencies (TAG-CVP) recommended prioritizing the Ervebo vaccine for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial addressing Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Amid an Ebola outbreak in the DRC and a Public Health Emergency of International Concern declared on 16 May, the group reviewed available vaccines and animal-data suggesting Ervebo provides protection against Ebola virus disease. They found no safety concerns for deploying Ervebo in this outbreak context and stressed the absence of vaccines specifically licensed against BDBV, making Ervebo the best available candidate for rapid testing in the ongoing trial. Ervebo remains the only licensed Ebola vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:新型エボラ株に対する「エルベボ」ワクチンの研究
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生しているエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行は既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: PHEICが2026年5月16日に宣言済みであり、既にWHOが正式な国際緊急事態として対応中の進行中アウトブレイクである。ワクチン試験に関するWHO技術諮問の報告が本記事の主題。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah patient discharged from Kozhikode Medical College Hospital
article.articleSummary: 43-year-old Feroke resident with Nipah virus infection was discharged from Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital (MCH) on August 7 after a full recovery. He was admitted to the isolation ICU in critical condition on June 11, with infection confirmed June 10 at the Viral Research and Diagnostic Laboratory at Kozhikode MCH and the ICMR-NIV Pune. Initially treated at a private hospital, he was transferred to MCH for specialized care. The patient required nearly 1.5 months on life support before stabilization. He moved from the isolation ICU to a transit ICU on July 4, then off ventilator support and to a standard room. Scans showed significant neurological improvement; memory was fully restored; fever resolved; he was fully conscious, oriented, and able to walk without assistance. International coordination aided his treatment, including airlifting remdesivir from Bahrain.

triage.headline_ja: コーリコード医科大学病院でニパウイルス患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染は致死率が高く公衆衛生上重篤とみなされ、インドでは稀な事象であるため異常性も認められる。IHR基準が2項目該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の患者（6月に感染確認、8月に退院）の経過報告であり新規発生ではないが、ニパウイルスは高致死率の人獣共通感染症でケララ州では過去にも複数回のアウトブレイクが発生しているため、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が推奨される。バーレーンからのレムデシビル空輸は国際支援の一例であり、発生地域には含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: O avanço do sarampo pode sair do controle? Especialista avalia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could the measles outbreak get out of control? Expert weighs in.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, São Paulo state reports 23 measles cases, concentrated in the capital (20), with 2 in São Bernardo do Campo and 1 in Guarulhos. The SES-SP dispatched 150,000 MMR vaccine doses to São Paulo and 80,000 to São Bernardo do Campo. The seven new cases were under investigation since July and linked to earlier infections, with no confirmed new transmission chain. Experts warn the risk of spread exists beyond current cases, noting increased measles circulation in the Americas could lead to new introductions. Measles’ high contagiousness makes rapid containment dependent on interrupting transmission chains. Herd immunity—achieved through high, evenly distributed vaccination coverage—is essential. Two pillars are emphasized: sustained vaccination uptake and vigilant surveillance to detect suspected cases early. Those fully immunized may receive an additional booster dose, which is considered safe.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の流行は制御不能になるか？専門家が見解を示す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹23例が確認され、感染拡大リスクについて専門家が警鐘を鳴らしており、行政も大規模ワクチン配布で対応するなど社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にカナリア諸島（スペイン）が含まれるが、記事本文はブラジル・サンパウロ州の麻疹流行を主題としており、対象国リストにスペインは含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Αγώνας δρόμου για νέο εμβόλιο κατά του Έμπολα - Ξεκίνησαν οι δοκιμές σε ανθρώπους - Newshub.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A race against time for a new Ebola vaccine - Clinical trials have begun - Newshub.gr
article.articleSummary: New randomized clinical trial begins in Canada for a candidate vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of Ebola virus species. Phase 1 trial enrolling about 80 volunteers to assess safety, tolerability, and immune response. The vaccine, developed by Moderna, uses an mRNA platform—the same as their COVID-19 vaccine. This marks a critical step as the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history; as of early August, 3,802 cases and 1,707 deaths. The outbreak is spreading rapidly, with roughly 90% of cases in Ituri Province (eastern DRC) and confirmed cases in five other provinces including Kisangani. About 60-70% of new infections appear linked to community transmission rather than traced contact chains, prompting concerns about contact tracing effectiveness. CEPI funds and coordinates efforts; Oxford University also launched a Phase 1 trial in July; doses produced by Serum Institute of India. A vaccine for Bundibugyo remains unavailable.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の新規ワクチン開発競争 - ヒト臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、死者1,707人・感染者3,802人に達し、地域社会内感染の拡大が懸念されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ種）とそれに対するワクチン開発（カナダ・英国での臨床試験、インドでの製造）に関するもの。ワクチン開発拠点（カナダ、英国、インド）は発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В России зарегистрировали одну из первых в мире тест-систем вируса Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia registered one of the world's first Bundibugyo virus diagnostic test systems.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Federal Budgetary Institution TsNIII Epidemiology of Rospotrebnadzor has developed PCR diagnostic test systems for Bundibugyo virus, ranking among the earliest globally for detecting this Ebola virus variant. The reagents are officially registered by authorities and deliver high sensitivity and specificity, including at the earliest infection stages when clinical symptoms are non-specific and difficult to differentiate from other febrile illnesses. The test kits were promptly dispatched to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where Russian scientists collaborated with African colleagues to verify their performance in real-world field conditions, confirming accuracy and reliability outside controlled laboratory environments, as reported by the agency.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、世界初のブンディブジョウイルス診断検査システムの一つを登録
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシアによる診断検査キットの開発・登録に関する内容であり、DRC・ウガンダでの実際の感染拡大や新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は診断技術開発・検査キットの現地検証活動に関する内容で、DRC・ウガンダでの具体的な症例やアウトブレイク発生を報じていないため、対象国の実際の感染症イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Xã Hồng Vân: Phun hóa chất, diệt bọ gậy, dập ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hồng Vân Commune: Chemical spraying, eliminating mosquito larvae, to stamp out the dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Hanoi’s Department of Health and Hanoi CDC, with Hong Van Commune authorities, assessed the dengue outbreak in Hong Van, Hanoi. They reviewed outbreak dynamics, governance, surveillance, and response, and conducted field checks. The team ordered continued chemical spraying of adult Aedes mosquitoes in Bạch Liên and Phương Quế to interrupt transmission. On 6 August, Hong Van mobilized environmental sanitation and larval-control efforts in these hamlets. Local health stations, rapid-response teams, police, armed forces, and residents participated. Of 1,811 households (about 98%), 4,546 water containers were inspected, with 952 containing larvae and treated by washing, overturning, water replacement, or removal of waste. Larval density remains high, sustaining dengue transmission risk under variable weather. Residents are urged to maintain weekly hygiene, eliminate standing water, sleep under nets, wear long sleeves, and seek prompt medical care for fever. Families should spend about 10 minutes weekly to remove larval habitats.

triage.headline_ja: ホンヴァン社:化学薬剤散布、幼虫駆除でデング熱流行を封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハノイの一地区における季節性デング熱の局地的アウトブレイク対応であり、幼虫密度が高く感染リスクが継続しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報はなく、通常の風土病対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事はハノイ市保健局・CDCによるルーティンの防除活動報告。重症例数や死亡者数などの詳細情報がなく、国際的な懸念材料は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: موارد تایید شدۀ ابتلا به ایبولا در کانگو از مرز ۴۰۰۰ گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Congo have surpassed the 4,000 mark.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 4,053 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths in a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. About 90% of cases are in Ituri Province, with spread to five other provinces including Kisangani. Ongoing challenges include late diagnosis, armed conflict, limited access to contaminated areas, public distrust, and shortages of vaccines and effective treatments. A related incident saw 300 passengers on a passenger ship screened after the death of a man suspected of Ebola; four symptomatic travelers are awaiting laboratory confirmation. The World Health Organization notes more than 100 health-care workers infected since the outbreak began. Uganda declared the end of its own outbreak in mid-June, but cross-border transmission risk persists. Authorities continue laboratory testing and contact tracing amid security and logistical hurdles to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確定症例が4,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（確定4,053例、死亡1,850例）で、複数州への拡大、医療従事者感染、渡航者スクリーニングなど国際的拡大リスクが顕著であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは自国のアウトブレイク終息を宣言済みだが越境リスクに言及されているため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova nada u borbi protiv ebole; Kod vakcinisanih nije zabeležen nijedan smrtni slučaj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New hope in the fight against Ebola; Not a single death has been recorded among the vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with vaccination using the Zaire ebolavirus vaccine now deployed in response. Africa CDC director Žan Kaseja stated limited data show no deaths among vaccinated individuals, though some symptoms persist; vaccine reduced mortality but did not fully suppress illness. WHO and Africa CDC plan further studies to assess potential viral mutation or other changes, as the outbreak is reportedly spreading six to eight times faster than prior events. Confirmed cases exceed 4,000 (4,053) with 1,850 deaths ( CFR 43.9%), and roughly 90% of cases are in Ituri province near Uganda and South Sudan, notably Bunia. Health zones with cases rose from 9 in May to 51. The outbreak began in late April; the 2014–2016 crisis in DRC had about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの闘いに新たな希望；ワクチン接種者からは死亡例なし
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で症例4,053例・死亡1,850例（CFR43.9%）に達し、過去のアウトブレイクより6〜8倍速い拡大、ワクチンの効果不完全やウイルス変異の可能性も指摘されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンは国境近接地域として言及されているが、記事上で症例発生は確認されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、通常使用されるZaireエボラウイルスワクチンの効果が限定的である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Nasib Dua Warga Padang Batung HSS Kalsel yang Digigit Anjing Rabies, Mendadak Korban Dicakar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fate of two Padang Batung residents in HSS, South Kalimantan, bitten by a rabid dog, suddenly became victims of being scratched.
article.articleSummary: Two Padang Batung residents in Hulu Sungai Selatan, South Kalimantan, bitten by a dog suspected of rabies remain under medical care at RSUD Brigjend Hasan Basry Kandangan as of 7 August 2026. One victim is an elderly resident from Pandulangan; both are receiving treatment per standard post-bite SOP. The attacking stray dog, previously roaming the area, was shot and its head sent to Balai Veteriner Banjarbaru for testing, with rabies confirmed on 6 August 2026. There have been three reported dog-attack incidents in the subdistrict (Pahampangan, Batu Bini, Pandulangan). Lab-confirmed rabies were found for bites in Pahampangan and Pandulangan; Batu Bini remains unconfirmed due to the missing dog. Authorities are coordinating with residents to heighten vigilance and reporting of suspected rabid dogs.

triage.headline_ja: 南カリマンタン、フルスンガイスラタン県パダンバトゥンの狂犬病犬に噛まれた住民2人の顛末、突然引っかかれる被害も
triage.triage_reason: 南カリマンタンの一地域における狂犬病感染犬による咬傷事例で、検査により狂犬病が確認されているが、既知の風土病であり国際的な拡大リスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 同一亜地区（Padang Batung）で複数件の犬咬傷事例が発生し、うち2件で狂犬病が検査確認されている。地方当局が野良犬への警戒強化を住民と連携して実施中。人-人感染のリスクはなく、局所的な動物由来感染症事例として管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Тест-система Роспотребнадзора на вирус Бундибуджио официально зарегистрирована
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor's test system for Bundibugyo virus has been officially registered.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor has officially registered a PCR diagnostic test system for Bundibugyo virus, a Ebola virus species. Developed by researchers at the agency's Institute of Epidemiology in response to an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the kit was produced in just four days. The reagent set reportedly offers high sensitivity and specificity even at early infection when clinical symptoms are nonspecific and may resemble malaria or other Central African diseases. The system is intended to enable early laboratory confirmation, rapid public health response, patient isolation, and timely supportive care for hemorrhagic fevers caused by Ebola viruses. The reagents were immediately sent to the DRC, Republic of Congo, and Uganda, with independent African colleagues validating its effectiveness in outbreak settings and in comparative testing against foreign systems.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（Rospotrebnadzor）がブンディブギョウイルスの検査システムを正式登録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクに関する内容であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの検査キット開発・登録に関する報道だが、背景にコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルスによるアウトブレイクがある。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ロシア自体は感染発生国ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 中盖结核病防治合作项目山东省启动会在青举行
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shandong Province Kick-off Meeting for the Sino-Guinea Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Cooperation Project Held in Qingdao
article.articleSummary: On August 7, in Jimo District, Qingdao, Shandong Province, the Sino-Guinea Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Cooperation Project launched its Shandong phase. The initiative aims to strengthen close-contact screening and comprehensive hospital patient detection research in low-incidence TB areas, as part of the China–Guinea TB collaboration between the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention and the Gates Foundation. Since its 2009 start, the program has advanced TB diagnostic tool validation and patient-management models. China’s TB situation is improving but remains challenging, with regional disparities and gaps in prevention. The Shandong launch supports the national TB-control plan and the 2025–2030 Shandong TB Plan, targeting an incidence below 18 per 100,000 by 2030. The project emphasizes contact tracing, preventive therapy, proactive patient discovery, and knowledge synthesis to inform policy and create a replicable, scalable model for nationwide use and international collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・ギニア結核予防対策協力プロジェクト 山東省キックオフ会議が青島で開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核対策協力プロジェクトの開始式典に関する行政的な報道であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核予防対策の国際協力プロジェクト開始に関する定例報道であり、ギニアは資金・技術協力の対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はChina（山東省）。
