article.articleHeadline: Testes de vacinas aceleram corrida da ciência contra o ebola na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine trials accelerate the science race against Ebola in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) prompts urgent vaccine trials as of 2026-08-07, with nearly 3,973 confirmed cases and at least 1,801 deaths. Global labs and the World Health Organization have launched field clinical trials to test Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to evaluate cross-protection for frontline workers while new vaccines are developed. Three additional candidates advance to human testing: an mRNA-based vaccine (Phase 1) using RNA messenger technology; Chadox Bdbv, a viral-vector vaccine developed in the United Kingdom by Oxford University; and the RVSV platform from Hilleman Laboratories. Authorities caution that final regulatory approval and large-scale distribution will take time. In the interim, community engagement and active contact tracing are emphasized as immediate, effective tools to save lives, strengthen laboratories, and protect healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン試験がDRコンゴにおけるエボラとの闘いを加速
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクで多数の症例・死亡者が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 英国（オックスフォード大学）はワクチン開発拠点として言及されているのみで、感染発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。致死率は約45%と高く、WHOと国際機関によるワクチン治験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго зарегистрировали более 4000 случаев заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 4,000 cases of Ebola infection have been registered.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 cases, with 4,053 confirmed and 1,850 deaths reported by the National Institute of Public Health of DRC. The World Health Organization declared a new outbreak in mid-May. Officials warn the real case burden may exceed official tallies. This outbreak is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic that included Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone with over 28,000 cases. The current outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since the virus was identified there in 1976. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting DRC, said the outbreak is spreading faster than response capacity and urged expanded, multi-partner actions to scale up the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が4000人を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000例超・死亡1850人という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行であり、WHOが対応能力を上回る拡大速度と警告している。IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援要請がある重大シグナル。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo; 16 não se vacinaram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo Confirms 23 Measles Cases; 16 Did Not Get Vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state confirms 23 measles cases; 16 patients had no vaccination history or incomplete immunization. Of the total, two cases are imported, with others linked to them; cases are distributed: 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 20 in São Paulo city. Authorities urge residents of São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo aged 6 months to 59 years to vaccinate against measles, regardless of prior vaccination, unless contraindicated. In other municipalities, vaccination actions should be intensified with active case finding and catch-up doses per the National Vaccination Calendar. Measles is highly contagious, spreading via cough, sneeze, or speech and can transmit before symptoms appear. A single case can generate 16–18 infections if unvaccinated. High vaccination coverage (ideally >=95%) and vigilant surveillance are essential; complications include encephalitis, pneumonia, and immunologic amnesia.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹23例確認、うち16人はワクチン未接種
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の伝播性の高さと未接種者の多さから流行しやすさの懸念はあるが、重症例・死亡報告はなく国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候もないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 地元当局がワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化しており、現時点では国内対応で管理可能とみられる。輸入症例が起点となっており、今後の拡大有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola échappe au contrôle - OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola outbreak is out of control - WHO.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths reported as of August 4, 2026. The number of cases rose by 299 and deaths by 180 in four days, according to the Congolese Ministry of Health. The epidemic now spans 51 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri province the epicenter. Security instability and massive population displacement hinder access for response teams. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and has surpassed the scale of the 2018–2020 RDC outbreak. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo, unlike Ebola Zaire. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking in Kinshasa, called for urgent and massive reinforcement of response operations under the government’s leadership, along with stronger frontline protection and enhanced surveillance and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行がWHOの制御を超えて拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、致死率の高いエボラの大規模流行かつWHO事務局長が緊急対応を要請しており、社会的・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行で、ワクチンや標的治療薬が未承認。2018-2020年の流行規模を上回り、治安不安・住民避難が対応を阻害している。WHO事務局長が直接現地入りし緊急増強を要請するなど極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança no estado de São Paulo com sete novos casos confirmados; saiba cidades afetadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles advances in São Paulo state with seven new confirmed cases; find out which cities are affected.
article.articleSummary: Measles advances in São Paulo state with seven new confirmed cases, bringing total to 23 infections, 16 of which lacked vaccination or had incomplete immunization. Data from SBIm and the SES confirm two imported cases; others are linked to importation, though the infection source remains unidentified. As of Aug 4, 2026, 16 cases occurred in São Paulo city, São Bernardo do Campo, and Guarulhos; the seven new cases are all in the capital. To curb transmission, the São Paulo Health Secretariat launched a vaccination reinforcement for people 6 months–59 years, starting Aug 3 and running through Sep 1 for multivaccination; in the other 642 municipalities, the campaign focuses on updating vaccination records for children and adolescents up to 15. Symptoms include fever >38.5°C and rash, plus dry cough, conjunctivitis, or malaise; measles is highly airborne, with transmission up to two hours in enclosed spaces. Isolation and vaccination updates are advised.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹が拡大、新たに7人の感染確認 影響を受けた都市は
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が23例に増加し、未接種者が多数を占め感染源不明の症例もあることから、地域拡大とワクチン接種強化キャンペーンなど行政の関心が確認されるため。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルドドカンポ、グアルーリョス）での麻疹アウトブレイク。輸入例と未接種者の多さが拡大要因とされ、州保健局がワクチン接種強化キャンペーンを実施中。死亡例や重症例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: OMS propone probar en RDC una vacuna ya existente contra otra cepa del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes testing in the DRC an already existing vaccine against another Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the World Health Organization recommends testing Ervebo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant fueling the current outbreak, due to the absence of a specific vaccine for Bundibugyo. Ervebo, developed against the Zaire ebolavirus, is the only Ebola vaccine licensed and is prioritized for a randomized clinical trial within the outbreak context. Preliminary animal data suggest Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, with no major safety concerns observed. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option but is not yet available. The DRC declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak on 15 May, beginning in Ituri province in the northeast and spreading to the northeast and east. Reported figures include 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths; the 2018–2020 outbreak was the deadliest, with about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で別のエボラ株に対する既存ワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）は確定4,053例・死亡1,850例と規模が大きく、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を提案するなど公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行はイトゥリ州で始まり北東部・東部に拡大中。ブンディブギョ株に特化したワクチンが存在しないため、既存のErvebo（ザイール株向け）の試験提案がなされている。死亡者数・症例数が大きく、地域拡大や国境を越えた伝播のリスクにも注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: നിപ വൈറസ്; അതീവഗുരുതരാവസ്ഥയിലായിരുന്ന 43കാരൻ ആരോഗ്യവാനായി ആശുപത്രിവിട്ടു | നിപ വൈറസ്; അതീവഗുരുതരാവസ്ഥയിലായിരുന്ന 43കാരൻ ആരോഗ്യവാനായി ആശുപത്രിവിട്ടു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah virus; a 43-year-old man in critical condition has recovered and been discharged in good health | Nipah virus; a 43-year-old man in critical condition has recovered and been discharged in good health
article.articleSummary: Kerala Nipah virus infection in a 43-year-old man from Farook who was critically ill but recovered and discharged on August 7, 2026. He first sought treatment on June 1 at a private Farook hospital, was discharged, then relapsed with fatigue, speech difficulties and disorientation and re-admitted June 7–8 at Aster MIMS Hospital, Kozhikode. Ventilation started June 9 as MRI revealed brain involvement; Nipah confirmation followed after a sample sent to a Pune laboratory. He was moved to Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital, ICU isolation on June 11 under a medical board. Two monoclonal antibody doses were given (June 12 and 14); remdesivir, ribavirin and antibiotics were administered. Ventilation persisted for about 1.5 months with multidisciplinary care, including platelet and PRBC transfusions. After three weeks, Nipah tests on secretions, blood and urine were negative. He was moved from ICU to a room on July 31 and discharged on August 7, 2026, with health department praise for staff.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス；重篤だった43歳男性が回復し退院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死率が高く人-人感染の可能性もある疾患であり、ケララ州での確定症例（重症化・長期入院）が報告されているため、フルリスク評価による継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のケララ州ニパウイルス感染者（43歳男性）が長期入院・集中治療を経て回復・退院したことを報告するフォローアップ記事。新規発生や地域拡大の証拠はないが、ニパウイルスは高致死率・人-人感染リスクを有するため継続監視の対象とする。Puneは検体検査のための地名であり発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: В России зарегистрировали тест-систему на вирус Бундибуджио. Детали разработки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia registered a diagnostic test system for Bundibugyo virus. Development details.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor officially registered a PCR diagnostic system for Bundibugyo virus, developed in four days after reports of intensified Ebola-like outbreaks in Africa. Scientists from the Federal Budgetary Institution Central Research Institute of Epidemiology of Rospotrebnadzor produced one of the world's first Bundibugyo virus PCR tests. The reagent kit is now registered, and the tests were promptly sent to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, where Russian and African colleagues confirmed their effectiveness in real outbreak conditions and in head-to-head comparisons with other countries' systems. The development was praised for ease of use and accuracy. Over 7,500 tests have been dispatched to African countries. Beyond Uganda, Congo, and DRC, requests came from Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, and North Korea for the Russian system.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアがブンディブギョウイルスの診断検査システムを登録。開発の詳細
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ様（ブンディブギョウウイルス）アウトブレイク激化を受けた診断キット開発・供給に関する記事であり、DRCでの実際の流行状況と国際的な検査キット需要拡大が示唆されているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア製診断キットの登録・供給が主題だが、アフリカ（特にDRC）における実際のブンディブギョウ（エボラ属）ウイルスのアウトブレイク激化を前提としている。コンゴ共和国・ウガンダ・北朝鮮・トルクメニスタン・タジキスタンは対象国リスト外のため除外。詳細な症例数・死亡率等の情報は記事中に無く、フルRRAでの追加確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал тест-систему на вирус Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor registered a test system for Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: Russian test system for Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola variant, has been officially registered by Rospotrebnadzor’s Central Research Institute of Epidemiology. The PCR reagent kit shows high sensitivity even at early infection stages. Tests were dispatched to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the Republic of Congo, and Uganda, where local specialists confirmed effectiveness in real-world conditions. As of 3 August at 14:01, Ebola cases in the DRC reached 3,748. The Russian development has been praised for ease of use and accuracy by regional experts. Russia also plans to send specialists to Uganda to assist in the outbreak response. This registration follows the ongoing Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus in Central Africa, with international diagnostic collaboration noted."}

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ変異株）用検査システムを登録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクにより症例数3,748例に達しており、深刻な公衆衛生イベントとして国際的な診断支援協力も行われているため、フルRRAの対象とすべきである。
triage.notes: 記事本文はロシアの検査キット登録が主題だが、DRCにおける進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの症例数（3,748例）が言及されており、既存アウトブレイクの継続・拡大状況を示す重要情報を含む。ウガンダ・コンゴ共和国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。ロシアも対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : des relais communautaires reprennent la sensibilisation contre Ebola après un dialogue social - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Community relay networks resume Ebola awareness campaigns after a social dialogue - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola virus disease remains active in North Kivu, DR Congo, with the 17th outbreak (Bundibugyo variant) progressing amid insecurity. In Beni’s Budji district, community relay networks have resumed awareness activities after a social dialogue to end threats from small resistance groups; relays operate within their home cells where they are known. Katwa health zone is the province’s main hotspot, followed by Butembo and Beni, as response teams bolster surveillance and care. Some areas show pockets of resistance hindering eradication and corresponding with rising suspected cases in the community. Community-based epidemiological surveillance is emphasized to detect risks quickly, supporting formal health systems with early alerts and targeted interventions; no laboratory confirmation or exact case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:社会対話後、地域連携ネットワークがエボラ啓発活動を再開 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）に関する報告であり、治安不安や住民の抵抗により症例数が増加傾向にあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の第17次エボラアウトブレイク（コンゴ民主共和国・北キブ州）の地域対応活動（コミュニティ動員再開）に関する続報。検査確定症例数や具体的な感染者数は報告されていないが、疑い症例の増加と治安不安による対応の難航が指摘されており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В России зарегистрирован тест на вирус лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A test for the Ebola virus has been registered in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor registered a PCR diagnostic test system for Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Developed by the Federal Budgetary Institution Central Research Institute of Epidemiology, the reagents were officially registered after four days of work to strengthen biobanking safety. The kit offers high sensitivity and specificity even at early infection when symptoms are non-specific and can be mistaken for malaria and other Central African diseases. The new Russian tests are already dispatched to the DRC, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, with over 7,500 tests distributed to African partners; effectiveness confirmed in real-world use with African colleagues. Beyond Africa, requests for the Russian system have arrived from Turkmenistan, Tajikistan, and North Korea. Context: as of 22 July 2026, Ebola deaths in the DRC approached 1,000.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでエボラウイルス検査が登録された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの診断検査キット登録というやや異例の技術ニュースであり、DRCでの深刻なアウトブレイク背景があるが、イベント自体は検査キット開発・登録で新規症例発生ではない。対象国内での実際の感染症イベントに関する情報が限定的。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはDRC、北朝鮮、トルクメニスタン、タジキスタン、ロシア、ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はロシアでの診断キット登録である。実際の感染症イベントはDRCとウガンダで発生しており、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本記事は検査キット開発のニュースであり、新規感染症イベントの報告ではないが、背景にあるDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（死亡約1000人）の深刻性と国際的な関心の高さからWATCH段階とした。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : des femmes appelées à jouer le premier rôle dans l'éradication d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Women urged to play a leading role in eradicating Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, women from the CECA-20 community in Butsili were urged to take a leading role in eradicating Ebola during a risk-communication session. The participants were briefed on Ebola’s history, origins, transmission-reducing measures, safe burial practices, and clinical signs; emphasis was placed on women adopting self-protective behavior as routine. The organizers highlighted community-wide action as essential to end the outbreak, and the women pledged to intensify community education. The risk-communication unit lamented ongoing resistance by some youths, which has hindered responders; in Ngongolio, two outreach workers' phones were stolen. Reinforcements of outreach workers are regularly deployed to areas with resistance to enable responders to operate.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラ根絶に女性が主導的役割を果たすよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ流行地域における住民啓発活動の報道であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの具体的疫学情報がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコミュニティ啓発活動（リスクコミュニケーション）についての報告であり、新規感染者数や致死率など具体的な疫学データは含まれていない。若者の抵抗や対応員への妨害行為（携帯電話盗難）が報告されており、対応活動継続中であることを示唆する。既存のエボラ流行状況の一環として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: চিকুনগুনিয়া বাড়ছে কেরলে, আক্রান্ত শতাধিক, ভয় বেশি শিশুদেরই! কোন কোন লক্ষণ দেখে সতর্ক হবেন?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya cases rising in Kerala, over a hundred affected, fear higher among children! What symptoms should you watch out for?
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases have surpassed 100 in Kerala, India, with many hospitalised as monsoon-driven Aedes mosquito activity rises. The disease, transmitted by Aedes, is causing heightened concern alongside dengue and malaria; it primarily affects children aged 3–7 who exhibit high fever, severe muscle and joint pains, and sometimes seizures, with rash appearing in some cases. Early testing can be negative in the first week, making lab confirmation essential. IgM and RT-PCR assays diagnose chikungunya, complemented by a TC-DC hemoglobin test to assess anemia. Management focuses on hydration—ORS, coconut water, and fruit juices. Preventive measures include covering skin with cotton clothing and keeping young children under mosquito nets. Co-infection with dengue can occur, increasing risk and complicating diagnosis, underscoring the need for vigilant differential testing in Kerala. The region also contends with dengue and Japanese encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でチクングニア熱が増加、感染者100人超、子供への懸念大——注意すべき症状とは
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケララ州でのチクングニア熱流行はモンスーン期に例年見られる蚊媒介感染症の季節的増加であり、IHR基準の該当は乏しいが、小児の重症化や登録熱・日本脳炎との合併感染リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モンスーン期に伴う蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア、デング熱、日本脳炎）の季節的増加であり、地域の医療機関で対応可能な範囲と見られる。小児の重症例や合併感染の報告があるため続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Un hombre se enfrenta al brote de ébola más veloz de la historia sin recibir salario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man faces the fastest Ebola outbreak in history without pay.
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with over 4,000 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccines or approved treatments. About 90% of current cases are concentrated in the affected area. Health workers, including 29-year-old infection control officer Wiza Bondele at an Ebola treatment center, have worked since May without pay, facing a promised 510 USD monthly that remains unsettled. Payroll is under review, with strikes disrupting care. Payments are being shifted to mobile money, but only a few workers have received funds. The conflict environment, attacks on health teams, and misinformation hinder response as workers persist despite financial hardship.

triage.headline_ja: ある男性が給料をもらわずに史上最速のエボラ流行と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で4,000人超の症例・1,800人超の死亡を伴うエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の急速な拡大があり、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、医療従事者への未払いやストライキ、紛争による対応阻害も重なっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生イベントと判断。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ株での大規模流行であり、致死率も高く、医療従事者の未払い・ストライキ・紛争による対応阻害が response capacity を著しく低下させている点で国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu : 30 décès et plus de 400 cas de choléra enregistrés, deux nouvelles zones de santé touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu: 30 deaths and more than 400 cholera cases recorded, two new health zones affected.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Kwilu province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains active across Mokala and Ipamu health zones as of 7 August 2026, with 419 cases and 30 deaths since the start of June. Bandundu and Kikongo zones report no new cases; Bandundu records 212 cases and 14 deaths with over 198 recoveries, while Kikongo has 166 cases and 8 deaths with more than 100 recoveries. Mokala and Ipamu remain affected, with main transmission linked to untreated water from the Kasai River. Chlorination is underway in Piopio and Panu (Mokala) and Kinkole (Ipamu). The response is supported by central and provincial authorities, providing water-treatment inputs, personal protective equipment for healthcare workers, and disinfection materials for infected sites.

triage.headline_ja: クイル州：コレラで30人死亡、400人以上の症例確認、新たに2つの保健地域で感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国クイル州で継続中のコレラ流行が新たな保健地域に拡大し、累計419症例・30死亡と重症度が高く、水系感染の継続的曝露リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるNew Zealand（Waikato, Piopio等）は誤った地理情報付与であり、記事本文の主題はDRCクイル州のコレラ流行のみ。Piopioは記事内でMokala保健地域内の地名として言及されており、DRC国内の地名と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavirus in DR Kongo verbreitet sich schneller als je zuvor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebolavirus in DR Congo is spreading faster than ever before.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than ever, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths reported by the national health institute as of 7 August 2026. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no approved therapy or vaccine, and authorities warn that the severity is unprecedented. Africa CDC and the World Health Organization are examining whether a mutation could be driving transmission and severity. Despite new laboratories and treatment centers, limited vaccines, reduced aid, delayed detection, strained surveillance, and ongoing conflict hinder containment. An unresolved death involved a passenger who died after leaving Pimu in Mongala Province from Ebola-like illness, triggering quarantine and testing of nearly 200 travelers. WHO cautions that regional spread is possible amid conflict, displacement, and cross-border movement. This is the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record; the largest occurred in West Africa (2014–2016) with over 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスがかつてないほど急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（感染4,053例、死亡1,850例）が急速に拡大しており、変異の可能性や国境を越えた拡散リスクも指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はAngola（対象国リスト外）にも言及しているが、主たる発生地はDRCであるため同国のみをverified_locationsに含めた。ウイルスはBundibugyo variantで承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、変異による感染力・重症度の変化が調査中。

article.articleHeadline: OMS propõe testar na RDC uma vacina já existente contra outra cepa do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes testing in the DRC an existing vaccine against another Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO recommends testing Ervebo, the Ebola vaccine licensed against the Zaire ebolavirus, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address a Bundibugyo variant outbreak that began in Ituri province and has spread to the northeast and east. As of 2026-08-07, 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases have resulted in 1,850 deaths. No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo is available yet. Preliminary animal data suggest Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, and no major safety issues have been observed. Experts urge a randomized clinical trial of Ervebo within the current outbreak context, while Bundibugyo-specific vaccines remain the preferred option if available. The DRC’s Ebola outbreak is its seventeenth, following the deadliest episode in 2018–2020 with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ別系統に対する既存ワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョ株によるDRCでのアウトブレイクで4,053例確認・1,850人死亡という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約45.6%と高く、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）のブンディブギョ株への有効性が未確立であるため、ワクチン開発・臨床試験を含む国際支援が必要な状況。DRCにとって17回目のエボラ流行であり、2018-2020年の大規模流行に次ぐ規模となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo e convoca população de três cidades para vacinação urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 23 measles cases and calls on residents of three cities to receive urgent vaccination.
article.articleSummary: 23 measles cases confirmed in São Paulo state as of 2026-08-07, with 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos; origin traced to two imported cases that seeded secondary transmission in the Metropolitan Region. Authorities launched an urgent vaccination drive in the three cities for residents aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of prior doses, unless contraindicated. Other municipalities are advised to intensify active outreach for overdue doses per the National Vaccination Schedule. Measles is highly contagious and can linger in the air after an infected person leaves a room via speech, cough, or sneeze. Symptoms include fever and a red rash; complications can include pneumonia, encephalitis, and immune amnesia. A single case can transmit to up to 18 unvaccinated people; the goal is 95% vaccination coverage. Source: Agência Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹23例を確認し3都市住民に緊急ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 輸入例を発端とした二次感染の拡大が確認され、当局が3都市で緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど行政的関心が高く、麻疹の高い感染力から流行しやすさ基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 23例中20例が州都サンパウロ市に集中。輸入例からの二次感染で、当局は6ヶ月～59歳の住民を対象に緊急接種を実施中。死亡・重症例の報告は本文中に確認できず。

Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: China Reports Four More H9N2 Infections as U.S. Bird Flu Risk Stays Low for the General Public
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the World Health Organization reported four additional human infections with avian influenza A(H9N2) in China during July 24–30: a 72-year-old woman in Jiangxi, a 12-year-old boy in Jiangsu, a 3-year-old girl in Gansu, and a 58-year-old woman in Yunnan. One case had direct live-poultry exposure; three were linked to live-poultry stalls or wet markets. Two hospitalized patients with chronic respiratory conditions were discharged; the other two had mild illness and recovered. U.S. public risk remains low, while workers with prolonged animal contact face greater risk and are advised to use protective equipment. Since 2015, 164 Western Pacific Region H9N2 cases with two deaths; 2026 may meet or exceed last year’s total. In six months, 20 known global infections (12 in China; 1 each in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Italy). H5N1 is high-pathogenic, with 12 external infections and three deaths; no sustained human transmission. Precautions include PPE for at‑risk workers and household measures: avoid sick/dead wild birds; cook poultry and eggs; avoid raw milk.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でH9N2感染がさらに4例確認、米国での鳥インフルエンザリスクは一般には低いまま
triage.triage_reason: 中国でのH9N2散発例は既知のパターンで重症度も低く持続的ヒト-ヒト感染はないが、家禽との接触による曝露が継続している可能性がありWPRO基準を一部満たすため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H9N2は例年報告される散発的な鳥由来ヒト感染で、今回も生きた家禽市場との接触が主な感染経路。重症例はなく回復。H5N1についても言及があるが米国等ではリスク低評価。香港・台湾・イタリアの症例も報告されているが対象国リスト外（香港は中国に含める運用だが本記事の主題は中国本土の4例）。

article.articleHeadline: Τι αναφέρει ο ΠΟΥ για τα υποψήφια εμβόλια για την αντιμετώπιση της νόσου Έμπολα σε Κονγκό και Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What the WHO says about candidate vaccines for the control of Ebola in the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda drives accelerated vaccine assessment. Africa CDC, in collaboration with the World Health Organization, is examining candidate vaccines for rapid deployment to curb the epidemic. At the third Technical Advisory Group for Priority Pathogen Vaccines (TAG-CVP) meeting on 31 July 2026 (following May 2026 sessions), the panel reviewed data on cross-protection against BDBV provided by the licensed Ebola vaccine Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV), drawing from published, preprint, and unpublished studies, including new non-human primate and civet challenge data and pseudovirus neutralization findings, within established safety, efficacy, and availability criteria. The updated consensus states that, in the absence of a BDBV-specific vaccine ready for evaluation, Ervebo should be prioritized for inclusion in a Phase 3 trial during the current outbreak, without prior Phase 2 data, while keeping open later inclusion of a BDBV-specific candidate. The aim is to accelerate approval of Ervebo if a BDBV-specific vaccine does not advance.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱対策候補ワクチンについて発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス（BDBV）のアウトブレイクが発生し、WHO/Africa CDCが緊急ワクチン評価を行っており、複数国にまたがる深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラ出血熱（BDBV株）はDRCとウガンダの国境地域で発生しており、既存のErvebo（rVSV-ZEBOV）ワクチンの第3相試験への迅速組み込みが検討されている。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Menkes Ungkap Temuan Bakteri E. Coli di Kasus Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Minister Reveals Escherichia coli Finding in MBG Poisoning Case
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli (E. coli) contamination linked to the Free Nutritious Meals program (MBG) in Jayapura, Papua, and Semarang, Central Java, has prompted a review. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin announced laboratory confirmation of E. coli in several MBG food samples. Dadan Hindayana, head of the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional, BGN), cited serious SOP violations, noting meals cooked up to 10 hours before distribution. Authorities tightened MBG oversight and warned of potential legal action if evidence of intent or sabotage emerges. The program is under comprehensive evaluation to achieve a zero-accident target. No counts of illnesses, hospitalizations, or fatalities are provided in the report. The case underscores food-safety risks within public nutrition initiatives.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相、無償栄養食事プログラム(MBG)の食中毒事件で大腸菌検出を発表
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食プログラムでの大腸菌汚染が確認されたが、患者数・入院・死亡者数などの規模を示す情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPapua New Guineaが含まれるが、記事の主題はインドネシア国内（パプア州ジャヤプラおよび中部ジャワ州スマラン）の給食プログラムでの汚染事案であり、PNGは無関係と判断し除外した。患者数等の具体的被害規模が不明のためWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي بإدراج لقاح إرفيبو في تجربة سريرية لمواجهة تفشي فيروس بونديبوجيو بالكونغو الديمقراطية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization recommends including the Ervebo vaccine in a clinical trial to combat Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, the World Health Organization's Technical Advisory Group on Immunization recommended prioritizing Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola Zaire vaccine, for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial as part of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. While animal studies suggest cross-protection by Ervebo, efficacy against Bundibugyo virus has not been proven. The group says vaccinating contacts of confirmed cases with Ervebo does not raise safety concerns. A long-term option remains developing a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine. The guidance emphasizes leveraging an existing vaccine in the outbreak response while evaluating actual protection against Bundibugyo through trials.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国におけるブンディブギョウイルス流行対策として臨床試験にエルベボワクチンの組み込みを推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）の流行が継続中であり、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を推奨するなど国際的な対応が進行しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）流行に対するWHOのワクチン臨床試験推奨に関するもので、既存の流行対応の一環。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS recomienda priorizar el estudio de la vacuna contra el ébola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends prioritizing the study of the Ebola vaccine....
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Mongbwalu) prompted WHO's Technical Advisory Group on prioritization of vaccines (TAG-CVP) to recommend Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine against Zaire ebolavirus, be included in a phase 3 randomized trial to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo. Since the May 16, 2026 public health emergency of international concern declaration for Bundibugyo Ebola virus in DRC, vaccine and treatment options have been evaluated. Earlier guidance cautioned against use outside research to study efficacy against Bundibugyo. In their July 31, third meeting, animal studies suggested some cross-protection against Bundibugyo and safety was acceptable when vaccinating contacts. The experts propose prioritizing Ervebo in a phase 3 trial without a prior phase 2, acknowledging that a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine would be preferable, though data are unavailable. If efficacy data are sufficient, scale production and access for affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行に対するワクチン研究の優先順位付けを推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)が既に宣言されており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC宣言済みの継続事案であり、WHO TAG-CVPによるワクチン(Ervebo)の第3相試験実施推奨に関する続報。ザイールエボラウイルス用ワクチンのBundibugyoエボラウイルスへの交差防御効果が焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Обезьяна ранила 18 человек и закрыла 40 школ на Суматре
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A monkey injured 18 people and closed 40 schools in Sumatra.
article.articleSummary: A wild macaque in Tembilahkan, Sumatra, injured at least 18 people, prompting the closure of 40 schools and forcing hundreds of students into remote learning. The attacks may involve multiple animals. After a three-day search, investigators captured the primate in an iron cage trap provided by the fire-rescue service and transported it to Pekanbaru for observation. Specialists from the Regional Agency for Natural Resources Conservation will monitor the macaque and determine possible causes for the unusual aggression. Victims ranged from children to the elderly; several required stitches, and some received rabies vaccinations. Local authorities urged continued caution until the city is deemed safe. Classes are scheduled to resume on 10 August if no additional attacks occur.

triage.headline_ja: スマトラでサルが18人を負傷させ、40校が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・スマトラで野生マカクによる複数人への咬傷事件が発生し学校閉鎖に至ったが、狂犬病の確定診断や病原体拡散の情報はなく、公衆衛生上の重大性は現時点で不明確。
triage.notes: 咬傷被害者の一部は狂犬病ワクチンを接種しているが、マカクの狂犬病感染有無は確認中であり、続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo e amplia vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Confirms 23 Measles Cases and Expands Vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in São Paulo state: 23 confirmed cases; 16 unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Cases: 20 in the capital (São Paulo city), 1 in Guarulhos, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo. Two cases imported; rest linked to those. The Health Secretariat calls residents aged 6 months to 59 years in these cities to receive measles vaccination, regardless of prior vaccination status, unless contraindicated; visit a Primary Health Care unit. Indiscriminate vaccination was adopted in these municipalities due to outbreak risk per the State Epidemiological Surveillance Center Prof. Alexandre Vranjac. In other municipalities, vaccination actions should be intensified: verify vaccination status, conduct active case finding, update overdue doses per the National Vaccination Schedule. Renato Kfouri of the Brazilian Immunization Society notes measles is highly contagious; transmission can occur before symptoms; one case can generate 16-18 infections among the unvaccinated. Emphasizes high coverage and surveillance; potential severe complications include encephalitis, pneumonia, immune amnesia.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹23例確認、ワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除国であるブラジルのサンパウロ州でアウトブレイクが発生し、未接種者への感染拡大リスクが高く、当局が緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施しているため、フルリスク評価が推奨される。
triage.notes: 感染例のうち16人が未接種または不完全接種で、感染力の強さと免疫記憶喪失などの合併症リスクが指摘されている。州保健局は複数自治体で無差別ワクチン接種を導入。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал тест-систему для выявления вируса Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor registered a test system for detecting Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor registered a PCR-based test system for Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo virus), developed in response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The reagent kit is described as highly sensitive and specific, capable of detecting the virus at early stages when symptoms resemble malaria and other African diseases. Diagnostic kits have been sent to the DRC, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, with Russian scientists and local colleagues confirming their effectiveness at outbreak sites. To date, more than 7,500 tests have been provided to African countries. Last month, a batch of these diagnostics was supplied to Guinea. The DRC Ebola outbreak death toll has surpassed 960. The effort strengthens global epidemiological safety and Russia’s biopreparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監督庁がブンディブギオウイルス検出用テストシステムを登録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギオ株）の診断キット開発・配布に関する情報であり、アフリカでの流行対応に関連しているが、記事の主題はロシアの技術開発であり、新規の感染症イベント情報ではない。情報が限定的で、実際の流行状況の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアの診断キット開発であり、既存のエボラ流行への対応支援に関するもの。発生地域としてRepublic of Guinea（対象国外）、Russian Federation（対象国外）も挙げられているが、verified_locationsには対象国のDRCのみを含める。ウガンダでの流行も言及されているが、ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 4000 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, now exceeding 4,000 confirmed infections: 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths. This is the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history. The virus is believed to have circulated for months before official confirmation on May 15, with a July Science study suggesting onset in January or earlier and more than 500 cases from mid‑January to May 15. CDC Africa and the World Health Organization are launching a mutation investigation to determine whether the virus has changed and how that might affect control efforts. Contributing factors include delayed detection, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing conflict, and shortages of vaccines and treatments for this strain. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone surpassed 28,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ感染者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000人超・死亡1850人という大規模かつ史上2番目に速いエボラ流行であり、変異調査も開始されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ・アンゴラ・リベリア・ギニアが含まれるが、記事本文はこれらを2014-2016年流行との比較として言及しているのみで、現行の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: पटना में डेंगू ने पकड़ी रफ्तार! सात दिन में 19 नए मरीज, 89 तक पहुंचा आंकड़ा - patna dengue cases surge 19 new infections in 7 days
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Has Picked Up Pace in Patna! 19 New Cases in Seven Days, Tally Climbs to 89.
article.articleSummary: Patna, Bihar reports 89 dengue cases since January, with 19 new infections in the first seven days of August (July total: 26). The Civil Surgeon has instructed government hospitals, urban primary health centers and the municipal corporation to remain vigilant, ensure dedicated dengue wards at PMCH, NMCH, and IGIMS, and maintain beds and platelet stocks. Health teams are micro-mapping affected wards and conducting door-to-door surveys; hotspots may be declared with intensified fogging and larviciding. Spraying has been hindered by an eight-day municipal worker strike. Residents should seek testing at government or recognized hospitals for fever, avoiding self-medication. Key dengue symptoms include high fever, severe head/eye pain, muscle/joint pain, red rash, nausea, weakness, with potential bleeding in severe cases. Preventive steps: eliminate standing water, regularly clean water containers and containers like coolers and tires, wear full-sleeve clothing, and use mosquito repellents.

triage.headline_ja: パトナでデング熱が拡大！7日間で19人の新規感染、累計89人に到達
triage.triage_reason: インド・パトナ市における季節性のデング熱症例増加であり、地域当局が対応中だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、フルRRAへの移行基準には達しない。
triage.notes: 毎年季節的に発生するデング熱の地域流行であり、地元衛生当局が病棟確保・防除活動を実施中。自治体職員のストライキにより防除作業に遅延が生じている点は留意事項。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo caused by Bundibugyo Ebola strain shows 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality rate 46%). WHO vaccine experts endorsed a full-scale randomized trial of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo in the ongoing outbreak. Ervebo has proven safe and efficacious against the Zaire strain, with early animal data suggesting cross-protection: three of four vaccinated non-human primates survived Bundibugyo versus one of four controls; a research-grade ferret study reported 100% protection in vaccinated animals, with all controls dying within 10 days. Experts noted no safety concerns using Ervebo in vaccination of contacts, given regulatory licensure and extensive use in Africa. They cautioned expectations: efficacy against symptomatic disease and transmission may be limited, but protection against fatal outcome is plausible. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option; two candidates in early human trials, a third in development.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRコンゴのエボラ流行でエルベボワクチンの臨床試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が既に4,053例・死亡1,850例（致死率46%）と深刻であり、IHR基準の複数該当とWHOの国際的関与が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: エボラのブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、致死率46%と高い。WHOがワクチン（エルベボ）の交差防御効果を検証する臨床試験を推奨している段階であり、既存の公衆衛生対応の一環として国際的注目度が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Helfer kämpfen gegen Seuche und Misstrauen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aid workers fight against epidemic and mistrust.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak has reached 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths, the largest such crisis in the country’s history. Mistrust of health measures, coupled with armed conflict and destroyed infrastructure, hampers response; Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reports only about 59% of contacts are being traced in Ituri province. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects. To regain control, WHO and Africa CDC urge communities to lead surveillance, involving trusted local leaders, religious authorities, and women and youth groups; improved safe burials and transport are prioritized. Vulnerable logistics are strained by reduced funding, border controls, and administrative hurdles. Three treatment centers in Ituri are testing experimental therapies; an oral Obeldesivir is being studied for post-exposure prophylaxis. The WHO also advises prioritizing Ervebo in Phase 3 Congo trials, with Bundibugyo-specific vaccines still under development; a UK trial began in July.

triage.headline_ja: 支援者たちが疫病と不信感に立ち向かう
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が過去最大規模（3,973例、死亡1,801人）に達しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 英国は臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 'Deeply concerning': WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom warns conflict and hunger are slowing the fight against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remain hard to control as the conflict zone hampers containment, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In an exclusive interview with O GLOBO in Rio (2026-08-07), he warns that war and hunger slow the global response. Tedros emphasizes advancing financial reform and finishing the annex to the Pandemic Agreement (PABS), which would enable rapid pathogen information sharing and fair access to medicines and vaccines; the annex is needed for ratification of the broader agreement. He notes the United States’ withdrawal from WHO but expects its return. For Brazil, he highlights three roles: showcasing the SUS health system as a model, Fiocruz’s local vaccine production to address equity, and helping conclude the pandemic framework while Brazil chairs negotiations on the agreement. He also references his prior collaboration with Fiocruz during his tenure as Health Minister.

triage.headline_ja: 「深く懸念される」：WHO事務局長テドロス・アダノムが、紛争と飢餓がエボラ対策の足かせになっていると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における既知のエボラ流行に関するWHO事務局長のコメント記事であり、新規の感染拡大や症例数増加など具体的な疫学情報は示されていないが、紛争による対応の遅れが懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・リオでのWHO事務局長インタビューであり、ブラジルは発生国ではなく取材地・政策議論の文脈で言及されているのみのため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي بتجربة لقاح "إرفيبو" لمواجهة فيروس بونديبوجيو بالكونغو | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends testing the Ervebo vaccine to combat Bundibugyo virus in Congo | Sabq
article.articleSummary: WHO's Technical Advisory Group on Immunization (TAG) recommended prioritizing the Ervebo vaccine, licensed against Ebola Zaire (Zaire ebolavirus), for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial as part of the field response to the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Animal studies suggest cross-protection between Ebola Zaire and Bundibugyo viruses, but efficacy against Bundibugyo requires confirmation through human trials. The WHO notes that vaccinating contacts of cases with Ervebo does not raise current safety concerns. A vaccine specifically targeting Bundibugyo remains the preferred long-term option, highlighting the need for ongoing development. This guidance aims to bolster outbreak control in the DRC while awaiting Bundibugyo-specific vaccine solutions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのブンディブギョウイルス対策としてエルベボワクチンの試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクに対しWHOがワクチン臨床試験を推奨しており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中であるためフルRRA相当のシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOのTAGがEbola Zaire用ワクチン(Ervebo)をBundibugyo株アウトブレイクの臨床試験に組み込むことを推奨。ヒトでの有効性は未確認であり、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC calls for village-level response to contain Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC's ongoing Ebola outbreak is to be tackled via a village-centered community response, per Africa CDC. At Kinshasa crisis meeting in the capital, chaired by President Felix Tshisekedi and with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and international partners, Africa CDC said the response should occur at village level, not provincial or district levels. Priority actions include free healthcare, stabilizing essential health workforce, developing an integrated health and humanitarian plan, and accelerating digital transformation of the response. The plan also aims to safeguard the planned reopening of schools next month, while accelerating Ebola vaccines and therapeutics development and intensifying cross-border cooperation. Implementation begins immediately.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行抑制へ村落レベルの対応を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱流行に対し、大統領・WHO事務局長を含む危機対応会議が開催されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・支援が高い事案であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はDRCで継続中の流行であり、Africa CDC・WHO・大統領を含む高レベル対応会議が開催されている。渡航・貿易制限への言及は記事中になく不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола: эксперты ВОЗ рекомендовали начать испытания вакцины "Эрвебо" в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO experts recommended starting trials of the Ervebo vaccine in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO expert advisory group recommended prioritizing Ervebo, the only registered Ebola vaccine, in a randomized clinical trial during the ongoing Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Ervebo currently targets the Zaire ebolavirus strain, but experts explored its use against Bundibugyo virus following a May 16 Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration. The group had previously advised against Ervebo outside carefully planned protocols to assess efficacy against Bundibugyo. In their latest assessment, animal studies suggested partial cross-protection and reduced mortality. The panel found vaccination of contacts with Ervebo to be safe in this outbreak and urged its prioritization in trials lacking a strain-specific vaccine. However, efficacy against disease and transmission is not yet proven; a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains preferred, with plans to scale production and ensure access once data become available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO専門家がコンゴ民主共和国でのワクチン「Ervebo」の試験開始を推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱はすでにPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既に2026年5月16日にPHEICが宣言されているブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の続報。既存の登録ワクチンErveboは対象株（ザイール株）と異なり、交差防御効果の検証段階にあるため、フルリスク評価での継続的モニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavírus: o que é, sintomas e como prevenir a doença transmitida por roedores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: what it is, symptoms, and how to prevent the rodent-borne disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, hantavirus infection—caused by Orthohantavirus—is a rare but potentially severe rodent-borne disease in Brazil and the Americas. The predominant concern is hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS), which can begin with fever and myalgias, digestive symptoms, and dry cough, and may rapidly progress to shortness of breath, hypotension, and acute respiratory failure. Human exposure mainly occurs through inhalation of airborne particles from urine, feces, or saliva of infected wild rodents; less common routes include contact with mucous membranes, skin abrasions, or bites. Early recognition hinges on assessing exposure history, especially in rural settings, barns, crops, long-neglected houses, or other rodent-present environments. The message underscores that although rare, HCPS requires vigilance and timely diagnosis to manage severe respiratory compromise.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：それは何か、症状、そしてげっ歯類が媒介する疾患の予防方法
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ハンタウイルス感染症に関する一般的な健康啓発・説明記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の症例・発生状況を報告するものではなく、ハンタウイルス感染症（HCPS）に関する一般的な医学解説記事である。具体的な症例数、発生地域、時期などの疫学的情報が含まれておらず、実際のアウトブレイクイベントとしては扱えない。

article.articleHeadline: IOM Multi-Country Ebola Bundibugyo Outbreak Response Update - sitrep #12
article.articleSummary: As of 29 July, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported 3,532 confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BVD) cases and 1,556 deaths, the largest and fastest-growing BVD outbreak in the country. Transmission is rising in eastern DRC amid insecurity and displacement, with spread into the provinces of Tshopo and Haut-Uélé creating cross-border risks to South Sudan and the Central African Republic (CAR). IOM notes 12.2 million health screenings at 223 points of entry/control across affected and at-risk countries, and more than 10.7 million people reached via risk communication and community engagement. In the reporting period, IOM supported 1.4 million health screenings in DRC following geographic expansion. Uganda declared the end of its BVD outbreak on 28 July 2026, though preparedness continues. Kinshasa surveillance is expanding after a vessel alert involving ~200 passengers and a probable Ebola case.

triage.headline_ja: IOM複数国エボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク対応アップデート - 状況報告書 第12号
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大・最速拡大のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが発生し、致死率約44%、周辺国への越境リスクも指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、ウガンダにも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCではキンシャサでの船舶関連の疑い例による監視強化も報告されており、国内拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Убивающий людей в Африке штамм вируса Эбола может мутировать
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus strain killing people in Africa could mutate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, could mutate, according to Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya. The DRC’s Public Health Institute reports over 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths, with the outbreak officially registered May 15 but likely beginning in January. It is the second-largest on record, with cases eightfold and deaths sixfold higher than the 2014-2018 West Africa crisis at this stage. More than two-thirds of deaths occurred in communities, signaling high undetected transmission. The epidemic centers on Ituri province and has spread to neighboring regions; Uganda has 20 cases. Contact tracing remains weak (about 10 contacts per patient vs 40 expected). Africa CDC is shifting to active case finding; remdesivir is being deployed and Ervebo vaccination is under consideration, with early data suggesting milder disease in vaccinated individuals. UNICEF notes vaccination disruptions in Mongbvalu, measles first-dose coverage down 69%.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで人々を死に至らしめているエボラウイルス株が変異する可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）が4000例超・死者1800人超と2014-2018年の西アフリカ危機を上回る規模で拡大し、ウガンダにも波及、変異の可能性も指摘されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。麻疹ワクチン接種率低下（Mongbvalu地域で69%減）も同時に報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ấn Độ phát triển vaccine nội địa phòng dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India develops a domestic vaccine against African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: India unveils its first domestically developed live attenuated vaccine against African swine fever (ASF), announced August 4, 2026, during ICAR’s anniversary. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal on the MA-104 cell line, it uses a genotype II ASFV strain with targeted deletions and has undergone laboratory and field evaluations by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD). It is recommended for healthy pigs aged 8 weeks and older, given as a 1 ml intramuscular dose with a booster after 14 days. ASF is a transboundary, high-mortality disease with mortality up to nearly 100%; India previously had no commercially approved vaccine. Since first detected in 2020, outbreaks in Assam (2020–2021) caused about 276 crore rupees in losses, while Mizoram by 2025 affected over 11,382 farming households with about 982 crore rupees losses. The vaccine could reduce mortality, curb economic losses, and enable large-scale, affordable production for domestic and global supply.

triage.headline_ja: インドが、アフリカ豚コレラのための国内ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは動物の疾患であり、人間の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的。ただし、インドでの流行歴と新規ワクチン開発は獣医学的に重要であり、情報の完全性を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事象は動物疾患（ASF）であり、IHR(2005)の人間公衆衛生基準には該当しない。WPROスクリーニング基準では、ASFが東南アジア・南アジアで流行しやすい疾患であり、インドでの2020年初検出後、アッサム州・ミゾラム州での継続的な流行実績（経済損失982億ルピー以上）があることから複数基準に該当する。ただし、これはワクチン開発の重要な進展を示す記事であり、人間の感染症の危機を示唆するものではないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Ebola virus could be mutating after thousands of cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant is surging, with over 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths as of August 5, 2026. Declared mid-May and possibly looming since January, hotspots are in northwestern DRC near the Uganda border, including Ituri where most deaths occur outside clinics. Africa CDC warns of a possible mutation and plans door-to-door active case searches as traditional contact tracing remains weak (about 10 contacts per patient vs ~40 expected). There is no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine yet, though a different Ebola vaccine could potentially reduce deaths. Uganda reports 20 linked cases and two confirmed deaths; France recently confirmed its first imported Ebola case from a doctor returning from the DRC. The UK has had no cases in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性エボラウイルス、数千人の感染者を出し変異の可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が4000例超・死者1800人超に達し、ウガンダへの越境伝播やフランスへの輸入例も確認されており、変異の懸念や接触者追跡の不備など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランス・英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未整備・変異懸念・接触者追跡不足など流行拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS propone probar en RDC una vacuna ya existente contra otra cepa del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO proposes testing in the DRC an existing Ebola vaccine against another Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO proposes testing Ervebo, the Ebola vaccine approved against the Zaire ebolavirus, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to address the Bundibugyo variant driving the current outbreak. Ervebo has not been developed specifically for Bundibugyo; preliminary animal data suggest some protection and no major safety concerns. Although a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option, experts advise prioritizing Ervebo for a randomized clinical trial within the ongoing outbreak. The DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, starting in Ituri province (northeast) and spreading to the northeast and east. Authorities report 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths. The most deadly outbreak (2018–2020) caused nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 cases, but a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is not yet available.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国で、別のエボラ株に対して既存ワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）は既に4,053症例・1,850死亡と深刻な公衆衛生被害を出しており、WHOが新規ワクチン試験を提案するなど国際的関心・対応が必要な状況であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言された第17次エボラ流行はブンディブギョ株が原因で、致死率が高い（約45%）。既存のZaireエボラウイルス用ワクチン（Ervebo）の適用可能性についてWHOが臨床試験を提案している段階であり、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Caritas berichtet von Ebola-Ausbreitung in Zentralafrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caritas reports Ebola spread in Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Caritas International reports that the Ebola outbreak in the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the worst and deadliest in the country's history, with five additional provinces now affected and potential for further expansion. The WHO previously reported 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths; containment now hinges on community understanding and rapid infection-control measures. Caritas notes that fighting Ebola relies on community education, medical care in supported health centers, and provision of protective equipment—over 70,000 euros already allocated to Ebola relief. The virus is spreading as fast as ever; there is no vaccine for the current variant, so interrupting transmission chains and isolating patients are key. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, with mortality ranging from 25 to 90 percent depending on the variant. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder control and raise regional risk; Uganda has declared its outbreak ended.

triage.headline_ja: カリタス、中央アフリカでのエボラ拡大を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行が拡大中で、5州に感染が広がり、ワクチンがない変異株であることから国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事中でアウトブレイク終息と述べられているため、現時点での発生国としては除外した。DRCの流行は史上最悪規模とされ、紛争・人口移動により地域リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: CCZ de Araçatuba qualifica equipes de saúde e reforça estratégias para prevenção da leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araçatuba CCZ trains health teams and reinforces strategies for leishmaniasis prevention.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba’s Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) conducted a technical training on August 7, 2026, to strengthen leishmaniasis surveillance, prevention and control under the Week of Prevention and Control of Visceral Leishmaniasis. Led by veterinarian Andresa Xavier, the session updated the Manual of Leishmaniasis and aligned canine and human management with the latest Ministry of Health and State Health Secretariat guidelines for visceral leishmaniasis. Key topics covered diagnostic workflows for dogs, including biospecimen collection, rapid diagnostic test (DPP), confirmatory ELISA, result interpretation, and handling inconclusive cases. Emphasis on canine case management, responsible ownership, entomological surveillance and environmental control of the sand fly vector. Field practices: sanitary notification forms, domiciliary visit reports, active search for suspects, and early human case identification. From January–July 2026, two human cases (one fatal); 177 dogs tested positive, vs 286 canine cases in the same period last year.

triage.headline_ja: アラサトゥーバのCCZ、リーシュマニア症予防のため保健チームを訓練・戦略を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州アラサトゥーバでの内臓リーシュマニア症の予防研修活動に関する記事だが、人的症例数（2例、うち1例死亡）は前年より減少傾向で、既存の対策プログラムの一環であり緊急性は低い。ただし人獣共通感染症としての継続監視は必要。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による通常の予防・監視強化活動の報告であり、症例数も前年比で減少している。新規の異常な流行を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS recomienda ensayos con la vacuna Ervebo para intentar frenar el actual brote en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Recommends Ervebo Vaccine Trials to Curb the Current Outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO's technical vaccine advisory group recommends prioritizing Ervebo in human trials to address the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), which has over 4,000 confirmed cases and about 1,850 deaths. The guidance follows July 31 meetings evaluating candidates, with animal studies showing Ervebo provides protection: up to 75% survival in primates and 100% in ferrets, with treated animals having milder disease and lower viral loads. Ervebo is approved for Zaire ebolavirus, but the current outbreak in the DRC is due to Bundibugyo, a rarer variant with no authorized vaccine or specific treatment. Antibody responses against Bundibugyo are weaker than against Zaire, though potentially neutralizing. The advisory group found no safety risks in randomized trials involving contacts of cases. Declared an international emergency on May 16, the outbreak is the second-largest by infections and the largest in the DRC, surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic (2,299 deaths, 3,481 cases).

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国の現行アウトブレイク抑制のためErvebo(エルベボ)ワクチン試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例4,000人超・死者約1,850人に達する大規模エボラ流行が国際的緊急事態として宣言されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは2026年5月16日にWHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として宣言されており、2018-2020年の流行を上回るDRC史上最大規模。原因株はBundibugyoで、既承認ワクチン(Ervebo)はZaire株用のため有効性が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Surpass 4,000 in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 cases, with 4,053 confirmed and 1,850 deaths, according to INSP data Aug. 5; 793 recovered and 694 in isolation or hospital. Contact tracing has reached 77.7%. The epidemic spans 53 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri as epicenter (86.9% of cases) and new detections in Gombari (Haut-Uélé) and Bafwasende (Tshopo). Transmission remains via contact with bodily fluids; airborne spread is not implicated. Delays in detection and ongoing conflict hinder containment. On Aug. 6, authorities screened more than 300 riverboat passengers after a man who disembarked upstream died in Mongala; a boat from Tshopo halted about 40 miles from Kinshasa; a death in Pimu is under investigation. A mobile lab screened four symptomatic passengers; investigations continue. WHO chief Tedros urged faster scaling of response and greater international support; last month the outbreak was the world’s second largest.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が4,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州53保健区に拡大し、死者1,850人・致死率高く、紛争による対応阻害と国際支援要請があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が国際支援拡大を要請しており、河川船舶乗客のスクリーニングなど国境を越えた拡散リスクの監視も行われている。致死率は約45.6%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Broj oboljelih od ebole u DR Kongu premašio 4.000, zaraza se proširila na nova zdravstvena područja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 4,000, and the outbreak has spread to new health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths since the epidemic was declared in mid-May. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, has spread to 53 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo, with Ituri accounting for 86.9% of cases. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak globally by infections. Authorities say the true burden may be higher than reported. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya urged stronger community engagement, faster contact tracing, and easier access to testing and treatment to stop transmission. MSF warns the response is expanding but remains too slow to reach local communities, with new suspected cases reported almost daily in locations outside established chains. Investigations are underway into possible changes in the virus driving spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ感染者数が4,000人を超え、新たな保健地帯へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例4,053人・死亡1,850人に達し、53保健地帯に拡大する大規模なエボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な支援要請も出ている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoウイルスによる第2位規模のエボラアウトブレイク。感染拡大が継続中で、ウイルス変異の可能性も調査中。MSFは対応が現地コミュニティへの到達に追いついていないと警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : la sensibilisation communautaire, facteur d'interruption de la chaîne de transmission (Un député national) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: community sensitization, a factor in interrupting the transmission chain (A national MP) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, demands strengthened community sensitization and regular payment of incentives to field responders to interrupt transmission chains, according to national MP Me Nene Kashinde (Aru constituency). In Bunia on 7 August 2026, he urged tighter outbreak management and timely remuneration of frontline workers, noting unpaid staff reduce performance and jeopardize control efforts. He called for intensified prevention campaigns reaching remote villages and proposed that the Ministry of Communication support community radio stations to broadcast prevention messages in hard-to-access areas. Local media, he argued, counter rumors, bolster trust between communities and response teams, and improve adherence to sanitary measures. He also welcomed cross-border cooperation with Uganda for surveillance and coordination, reaffirming Ituri MPs’ commitment to community sensitization in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ:地域社会への啓発が感染連鎖を断つ要因(国会議員談) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でのエボラ流行への対応強化を求める国会議員の発言に関する記事であり、既存の流行状況の継続対応に関する内容で新規の異常事態や重大な悪化を示す情報はないが、エボラという疾患の性質上、継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの新規発生や症例数など具体的な疫学データを含まず、対応策(啓発活動・報酬支払い・国境を越えた協力)に関する政治家の発言が中心。ウガンダとの国境協力への言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。既存流行への対応継続に関する内容であり、フルRRAに進むほどの新規性・緊急性の情報は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah survivor discharged after over 2 months of treatment in Kerala
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old Nipah virus patient from Farook, Kerala, was discharged August 7, 2026 from Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode after more than two months of treatment, including about six weeks on a ventilator. He first presented June 1 with fever, sore throat and body pain, was readmitted June 7 with fatigue, disorientation and slurred speech, and deteriorated June 9 requiring ventilation. Nipah infection was confirmed by samples sent to the National Institute of Virology, Pune, before admission to GMC Kozhikode on June 11. Multidisciplinary care (cardiology, neurology, pulmonology, gastroenterology) supported recovery; low platelets and hemoglobin necessitated transfusions. Repeated tests of throat/nasal swabs, blood and urine became negative for Nipah about three weeks later. He moved out of isolation ICU on July 4, shifted to a general room July 31, and was discharged August 7. Kerala reported no Nipah-related deaths during the latest outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でニパウイルス感染から回復した患者、2カ月以上の治療を経て退院
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いニパウイルス感染症の症例報告であり、Kerala州で継続しているアウトブレイクの一部として公衆衛生上の重要性が高く、社会的関心も見込まれるためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 本記事はKerala州における既知のニパウイルスアウトブレイクの回復例に関する続報であり、新規感染拡大や国際的リスクの明確な記載はないが、致死率の高い病原体であるため継続監視が妥当。Maharashtra州やPalestineは記事本文で言及されておらず、発生地域として不適切と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: В России зарегистрировали тест на Эболу - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Ebola test has been registered in Russia - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor registered a PCR diagnostic test kit for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the Ebola virus species. Developed by the Federal Budgetary Institution Central Research Institute of Epidemiology, the kit reportedly delivers high sensitivity and specificity even at early infection stages when symptoms are nonspecific and hard to distinguish from malaria and other Central African diseases. The reagent set was created within four days after epidemiological concerns in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, and tests have been sent to the DRC, Uganda, and the Republic of Congo, with local African colleagues confirming effectiveness in real-world conditions. Ebola is highly contagious with high mortality; first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC near the Ebola River. The 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak involved over 28,000 cases and about 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでエボラウイルス検査キットが登録される - Вести.ru
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシアによるエボラ検査キットの登録であり、DRC・ウガンダでの『疫学的懸念』への言及はあるが具体的な新規発生の詳細（症例数・地域・時期）が不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの検査キット開発・登録が主題であり、DRC・ウガンダでの具体的なエボラ発生状況（症例数、発生時期など）は明記されていない。既知の背景情報として言及されている可能性が高く、新規シグナルとしての確度は低い。スーダン・アンゴラ・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ดีอาร์คองโก "กักตัว" ผู้โดยสารบนเรือเกือบ 200 คน-ยอดเซ่นอีโบลาทะลุ 1,850 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo quarantines nearly 200 passengers aboard a boat as Ebola death toll surpasses 1,850.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of August 7, 2026, DR Congo reports 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and at least 1,850 deaths. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province in eastern Congo, continues to spread rapidly, with 60–70% of new patients not linked to known contacts, indicating sustained community transmission. A passenger death with Ebola-like symptoms prompted authorities to quarantine nearly 200 passengers aboard a boat intercepted near Kinshasa; results are pending to confirm infection. A linked case previously disembarked at Pimu in Mongala Province before dying. The government has not disclosed a current infection status in Kinshasa. Healthcare workers in Ituri protested over unpaid wages, reducing facility operations and complicating care for critically ill patients. No specific infection source identified in the article.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴ、ボート乗船の乗客約200人を隔離 ― エボラ死者数1,850人突破
triage.triage_reason: エボラ致死率の高い大規模流行（4,053例・死者1,850人）が続き、市中感染拡大や首都キンシャサ近郊への波及疑いがあり、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 医療従事者の賃金未払いによるストライキが対応能力を低下させており、キンシャサ近郊での感染拡大疑いは結果待ちの状態。続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie in der DR Kongo: WHO dringt auf Impfstofftests
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo: WHO presses for vaccine trials.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths across five eastern provinces since the outbreak was officially declared on May 17. WHO vaccine experts urge clinical trials of Ervebo, a vaccine already approved for another Ebola variant, arguing it shows efficacy against Bundibugyo despite not being variant-specific. Animal studies (monkeys) showed three of four vaccinated survived exposure to Bundibugyo versus one of four controls; a yet-unpublished rat study indicated all vaccinated survived while all controls died within ten days. Given Ervebo's prior widespread use and safety, trial phases could skip interim steps and move to Phase 3, enrolling primarily contacts of known cases. While vaccination may not prevent infection or symptoms entirely, it could reduce fatal outcomes. Ongoing efforts continue to develop a variant-specific vaccine for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行:WHOがワクチン試験を推進
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで大規模流行(感染4,053人、死亡1,850人)しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、WHOの関与が確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.6%と高く、Bundibugyo変異株に対するワクチン(Ervebo)の臨床試験をWHOが推進している状況。5州にまたがる大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: 發燒咳嗽的人越來越多 大陸新冠疫情形勢嚴峻(圖)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More and more people with fever and cough; the COVID-19 situation in Mainland China is severe (photo).
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is surging across Mainland China as of late July 2026, with fever and cough widespread in Guangdong, Hubei, Jiangsu, Shandong and other provinces. Guangzhou reports crowded fever clinics; some deaths are alleged, with claims that death information is being blocked. Chinese CDC sentinel data (week 30) show SARS-CoV-2 positivity at 20.3% among influenza-like illness samples and 9.5% among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection samples, highest among monitored pathogens, indicating an increasing share of COVID-19 in respiratory illnesses rather than a population-wide rate. Residents and healthcare workers in Wuhan, Zhengzhou, Nanjing, and Linyi describe rising cases and prolonged illnesses. Previously released June data indicate 79,000 local confirmed infections nationwide, 130 severe cases, and 1 death, amid ongoing questions about data transparency and hospital testing practices. Overall, the article depicts an upward trend and substantial public health challenges from the resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱・咳の患者が急増、中国本土の新型コロナウイルス感染症の状況は深刻（写真）
triage.triage_reason: 中国複数省でCOVID-19が急増し、発熱外来の混雑や死亡情報隠蔽疑惑など公衆衛生上の懸念が指摘されており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・重症度・持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は海外メディア（secretchina）による報道で、死亡情報の隠蔽疑惑など政治的センシティブな内容を含むため、公式統計との整合性確認が必要。CDC監視データでは陽性率上昇が示されているが、人口全体の罹患率ではない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo : deux patients guéris sortent du centre de traitement Ebola de Katwa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: two recovered patients leave the Ebola treatment center in Katwa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola survivors, including a nurse and an infant, were discharged Friday from the Katwa Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. They arrived the prior Thursday and spoke of healing, urging colleagues to protect themselves and promptly refer suspected Ebola cases to the center, dispelling rumors that the CTU is a morgue. Since the outbreak began, Katwa’s center has discharged 45 patients, all reporting solid care. The facility remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with 200 laboratory-confirmed cases as of the August 6 epidemiological bulletin; the Butembo health zone has 92 confirmed cases. Early medical care and isolation improve survival and halt transmission; individuals with fever, fatigue, vomiting, or diarrhea should seek care at a specialized center.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ：カトゥワのエボラ治療センターから治癒した患者2名が退院 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（確定症例200例）に関する続報であり、重篤な感染症の継続的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）に関する経過報告。ブテンボ保健区で92例の確定症例、全体で200例確定。患者退院は良いニュースだが、流行自体は継続中でありモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola în RDC: OMS solicită organizarea unui studiu clinic cu vaccinul Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO calls for a clinical trial of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts WHO to push for a randomized Phase 3 trial of Ervebo—the only licensed Ebola vaccine—due to the Bundibugyo variant driving the current outbreak; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Ervebo, developed against Zaire ebolavirus, showed some protective signals in animals against Bundibugyo and no major safety concerns. The outbreak, declared May 15 after weeks of delay, began in Ituri province in the northeast and has since spread to northern/eastern provinces, notably Nord-Kivu, amid fragile state capacity and weak health infrastructure. Laboratory-confirmed cases reach 4,053 with 1,850 deaths reported by authorities. The article notes the 2018–2020 RDC outbreak as the most severe (≈3,500 cases, ≈2,300 deaths). No details are provided on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHOがErvebo（エルベボ）ワクチンの臨床試験実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが拡大し、確定症例4,053例・死亡1,850例と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、ワクチン・治療法未確立という異常性・国際的懸念も高いため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、WHOがErvebo（元来ザイール株用）の臨床試験を要請している点が特筆される。感染拡大の国際的リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: piden ampliar urgentemente las medidas para contener la transmisión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Urgent call to expand measures to contain transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to outpace response in several areas. As of 4 August 2026, 3,973 confirmed cases and 1,801 deaths with 776 recoveries have been reported across 51 health zones in five provinces. In the last 24 hours, 99 new cases and 52 deaths were recorded. Ituri province accounts for about 90% of cases, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu among the hardest-hit health zones. Contact tracing stands at 75%, below the 95% target needed to rapidly identify transmission chains. 674 people are under care; North Kivu treatment centers are operating at 139% occupancy. A joint WHO-Africa CDC high-level mission (4–5 August) urged rapid expansion of operations, community engagement, and safe access for responders. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths and declared the outbreak over on 28 July 2026. Sustain surveillance and cross-border coordination; no travel restrictions advised.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：感染拡大阻止のための対策拡充を緊急要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、致死率が高く、複数州・保健区に及び、対応能力（治療センター占有率139%、接触追跡率75%）を超えている状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されたが、2026年7月28日にアウトブレイク終息が宣言されている。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。主たる発生地はDRC東部（イツリ州、北キブ州）。

article.articleHeadline: 发烧咳嗽的人越来越多 大陆新冠疫情形势严峻(图)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More and more people with fever and cough; Mainland China's COVID-19 epidemic is severe (Photo)
article.articleSummary: Mainland China faces a severe resurgence of COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) in July–August 2026. Guangdong, Hubei, Jiangsu and Shandong report widespread fever and cough, with Guangzhou’s fever clinics overwhelmed and reports of deaths that some locals allege are being underreported. National sentinel surveillance (week 30, released 2026-07-30) shows COVID-19 positivity at 20.3% among influenza-like illness samples and 9.5% among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection samples, the highest among monitored pathogens; these figures are sentinel indicators, not population-wide rates. Hu Biejie, chief of the Infectious Diseases Department at Zhongshan Hospital (Fudan University), notes an ongoing rise, with emergency department visits and in-patient COVID-19 cases increasing. On 2026-07-29, a Wuhan physician warned via social media about July’s rising cases. Residents in Guangzhou, Zhengzhou, Linyi, Nanjing and Wuhan report widespread symptoms. June nationwide: 79,000 locally confirmed cases, 130 severe cases, 1 death; testing reportedly uneven, with some hospitals not testing for COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱・咳の患者が増加、中国本土の新型コロナ流行は深刻な状況(写真)
triage.triage_reason: 中国複数省でCOVID-19が再拡大し、発熱外来が逼迫、死亡過小報告の指摘もあり、WPRO基準（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的関心も高いため、フルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
