triage.notes: COVID-19は既に世界的に流行している疾患であり、今回の事象は季節的な再拡大とみられるが、複数省での症状拡大・医療逼迫・死亡過小報告の懸念があるため、続報の確認が必要。公式統計（6月：確定79,000例、重症130例、死亡1例）と現場報告の間に乖離がある点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah survivor discharged from Kozhikode Medical College after nearly 2 months of treatment
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection in a 43-year-old man from Feroke, Kozhikode, Kerala, was confirmed on June 10, 2026, after samples were sent to VRDL Kozhikode and ICMR Pune following suspicion at a private hospital. He was admitted to the isolation ICU of Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, on June 11 in critical condition. A special medical board led by the principal and superintendent oversaw his care, with input from multidisciplinary experts, and Remdesivir was arranged by Health Minister K Muraleedharan, obtained from Bahrain. He required ventilator support for about 1.5 months, was moved to transit ICU on July 4, and later weaned off. By August 7, 2026, he was fully conscious, able to walk without assistance, fever had subsided, memory returned to normal, and brain imaging showed improvement. He was discharged after nearly two months of treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コーズィコード医科大学病院で約2か月間の治療を経て、ニパウイルス感染からの生還者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは致死率が高く公衆衛生上重篤な感染症であり、ケララ州で確定例が発生・ICU管理を要したことから、フォローアップ記事ではあるがヒト-ヒト感染リスクや重症度の観点からRRAへの引き上げが妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のニパウイルス感染確定例（2026年6月10日確定）の患者が回復・退院したという続報であり、新規発生や地域拡大の情報はない。ただしニパウイルス自体の重篤性とケララ州での再発性を考慮しPICKUPと判断。プネ（ICMR検査機関）とバーレーン（薬剤調達先）は発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تدعو لبدء تجربة سريرية للقاح ضد إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for starting a clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization vaccine experts recommended a large-scale randomized trial of the Ervebo Ebola vaccine to determine whether it offers cross-protection against the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ervebo is approved and proven safe and effective against the Zaire strain; early data, including animal studies, suggest some protection against Bundibugyo. The DRC outbreak has 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths, and the virus is spreading faster than response capacity. The WHO Technical Advisory Group on Vaccines prioritized including Ervebo in a randomized trial amid the outbreak. They reviewed studies showing three of four vaccinated primates survived Bundibugyo vs one of four controls; and an unpublished mongoose study indicating full protection by a version of Ervebo, with controls dying within ten days. No safety concerns were found for vaccinating contacts, but expectations must be managed for protection against disease and transmission; Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains preferred.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラワクチンの臨床試験開始を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが拡大中で、確認症例4,053件・死亡1,850件と規模が大きく、既存ワクチンの交差防御効果が不明なため、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準複数該当のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラのブンディブギョ株はザイール株用ワクチン(Ervebo)の交差防御効果が不明であり、WHOが大規模無作為化試験を推奨。感染拡大が対応能力を上回っているとの報告あり、国際的懸念が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: OMS propone probar en RDC una vacuna ya existente contra otra cepa del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes testing in the DRC an existing Ebola vaccine against another strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO recommends testing Ervebo, the only approved Ebola vaccine, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo against the Bundibugyo variant driving the current outbreak. Ervebo was developed against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, which differs from Bundibugyo; early animal data suggest some cross-protection and no major safety concerns observed. With no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine available, experts advise prioritizing Ervebo for a randomized clinical trial within the outbreak context while a variant-specific vaccine remains the preferred option. The DRC declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15, starting in Ituri province (northeast) and spreading to the northeast and east. As of the report, 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths have been recorded; the 2018–2020 outbreak remains the deadliest in the country, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で別系統のエボラウイルスに対する既存ワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が発生し、確定症例4,053例・死亡1,850例と過去最大級の規模に達しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 現行流行はブンディブギョ型で、既存ワクチンErvebo（ザイール型対応）の交差防御性が未確立。WHOはランダム化臨床試験実施を推奨しており、国際的な支援・介入が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo; 16 não se vacinaram - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo Confirms 23 Measles Cases; 16 Were Not Vaccinated - Click Guarulhos.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the State of São Paulo total 23 confirmed cases as of 2026-08-07, with 2 imported and the remaining linked to those imports. Distribution: 20 cases in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Sixteen patients had no vaccination history or incomplete schedules. A targeted mass vaccination is underway in Guarulhos, the capital, and São Bernardo do Campo for residents aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, unless contraindicated, and within the interval rules for live vaccines. In other municipalities, vaccination actions should be intensified with status checks, active case finding, and updating overdue doses per the National Vaccination Calendar. A Multivaccination Campaign began August 3 to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15. Pregnant women should not receive MMR; lactating women may; those with severe immunodeficiency or severe vaccine allergies should avoid it. FAQ: www.guarulhos.sp.gov.br/perguntas-frequentes-sobre-o-sarampo.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹23例を確認。うち16人が未接種 - Click Guarulhos
triage.triage_reason: 輸入例に起因する麻疹の地域内伝播が確認され、未接種者が多いことから流行しやすさと持続的曝露のリスクがあり、行政による大規模ワクチン接種対応が実施されているため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認証を取得した国であり、輸入例による地域内伝播の再発は公衆衛生上注視すべき事象。現時点で重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、州・市レベルで対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Τσαντ: 13 νεκροί και 239 κρούσματα από χολέρα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad: 13 dead and 239 cholera cases.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports 13 cholera deaths and 239 cases since the outbreak was officially identified on 24 July, with a case-fatality rate of 5.4%. Most infections are in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the northern part of Chad and in the capital N'Djamena, where 11 deaths occurred in August. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated against cholera to date; the first death was recorded on 13 June. The outbreak in Chad unfolds as several African nations—Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Nigeria—also report cholera cases in recent months. Ongoing transmission highlights the need for continued vaccination, surveillance, and public health measures to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: チャド：コレラで13人死亡、239人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドで継続的なコレラ流行が発生しており、死亡者・症例数が増加し複数のアフリカ諸国でも報告されているため、地域的拡大のリスクと重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドでの流行だが、対象国リストに含まれるDRCも「近年コレラ症例を報告している」と明記されているためverified_locationsに含めた。CARおよびナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Peor brote de ébola en la República del Congo ya deja 1.850 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Worst Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo has already left 1,850 dead.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 Aug 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing the worst Ebola outbreak on record, with 1,850 deaths and 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases since the mid-May declaration. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain drives transmission, for which no vaccine has yet been approved. The outbreak is centered in northern Ituri and spans five provinces—Alto Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—with 51 health zones affected. The World Health Organization warns that transmission is sustained and case and death counts continue to rise, calling for urgent and massive intensification of the response. Militant attacks in Ituri have fueled displacement and greatly hindered containment efforts. No details on imported or exported cases are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪のエボラ流行、死者1,850人に
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行が5州51保健地区に拡大し死者1,850人・確定例4,053人に達し、ワクチン未承認株による持続的なヒト-ヒト感染とWHOの緊急対応要請があり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事見出しは誤って「Republic of the Congo」と記載しているが、本文および発生地域データからコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の流行であることが確認できる。武装勢力の攻撃により対応が妨げられている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 中国多种病毒齐发 新冠阳性率连续数周居首
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Sees Simultaneous Outbreaks of Multiple Viruses; COVID-19 Positivity Rate Tops for Several Consecutive Weeks.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity in mainland China reached 22.3% in the 31st epidemiological week (July 27–Aug 2, 2026), leading sentinel hospital respiratory samples. Influenza and enterovirus followed at 13.3% and 4.1% respectively. Among hospitalized severe acute respiratory infection samples, COVID-19 positivity was 8.2%, influenza 5.8%, and human parainfluenza virus 5.5% (up 1.3 points). The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains dominant; southern provinces show higher positivity than northern, with ages 15–59 affected most. The report indicates possible underreporting and social-media testimonials of prolonged illness and severe symptoms. Some netizens blame booster vaccination or three-dose schedules for adverse outcomes. In Nanjing, a 17-year-old female student from Anhui was diagnosed with COVID-19 after loss of smell and severe cough, yet pediatric and antiviral access barriers limited treatment to a small self-paid cough remedy. An expert suggests official data may be an iceberg without transparent denominators.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で複数のウイルスが同時流行、新型コロナウイルスの陽性率が数週間連続で首位に
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19陽性率が数週連続で最高値を記録し、複数の呼吸器ウイルスが同時流行しているとの報告があり、SNS上での関心も高まっているため、続報確認とフルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事は中国本土（安徽省、江蘇省南京市を含む）における季節性呼吸器ウイルス（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス）のサーベイランスデータに基づく。データの透明性欠如や過小報告の懸念、SNS上での重症例・後遺症に関する投稿が指摘されているが、公式統計としては深刻な公衆衛生上の危機を示す明確な証拠は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Third meeting of the WHO Technical Advisory Group on candidate vaccine prioritization (TAG-CVP) for Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak response: meeting report, 31 July 2026
article.articleSummary: Third meeting of the WHO Technical Advisory Group on Candidate Vaccine Prioritization (TAG-CVP) held on 31 July 2026 addresses vaccine prioritization for the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. With no BDBV-specific vaccine ready for evaluation, the group reviews cross-protection data from the licensed Ebola vaccine Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) based on published, pre-print, and unpublished studies, including non-human primate and ferret challenge data and pseudovirus neutralization results. TAG-CVP reaffirmed criteria for vaccine safety, potential efficacy, and outbreak availability. The updated consensus recommends prioritizing Ervebo for inclusion in a Phase 3 research study in the current BVD outbreak without a preceding Phase 2, while keeping the option to add a BDBV-specific candidate later if one becomes available. Current date reference: 7 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス病アウトブレイク対応のためのWHO候補ワクチン優先順位付け技術諮問グループ(TAG-CVP)第3回会合報告（2026年7月31日開催）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生中のエボラ属（ブンディブギョウウイルス）による重篤なアウトブレイクであり、WHOがワクチン優先順位付けのための国際専門家会合を開催するなど国際的関心・対応が進行中であるため、フルリスク評価の対象とすべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO TAG-CVP会合報告であり、既知のブンディブギョウウイルス病(BVD)アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に対するワクチン戦略の技術文書。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。既存アウトブレイクの継続的対応状況として、フルRRAでの詳細確認（症例数・死亡率・地理的拡大状況等）が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde reforça vacinação de crianças e adolescentes contra sarampo, pneumonias e outras doenças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Reinforces Vaccination of Children and Adolescents Against Measles, Pneumonias, and Other Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Ministry of Health launches the 2026 Multivaccination Campaign to update immunization cards for children and adolescents under 15 and boost nationwide vaccine coverage. The drive runs through September 1, with a national Day D on August 22, offering 20 vaccines from the National Vaccination Schedule. It aims to prevent measles, pneumonias, meningitis, and other immunopreventable diseases, strengthening herd protection through selective vaccination. About 1.5 million doses are distributed to states; total deployments exceed 177 million in 2026, with nearly 180 million doses allocated. The campaign adds the Pneumococcal 20-valent vaccine for children under 5. Dengue vaccination for ages 10–14 and COVID-19 vaccination for children are included per indications. Measles vaccination is intensified in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, offering the MMR vaccine to 6 months–59 years to block outbreaks. Over 7.2 million MMR doses have been distributed in 2026, ~2.9 million administered; São Paulo region allocated 3.2 million doses. To date, more than 94.8 million doses have been administered.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、麻疹・肺炎その他の疾患に対する子供・青少年へのワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル政府による定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 麻疹対策として一部地域（サンパウロ等）でMMRワクチン接種強化との記載はあるが、具体的な感染者数・アウトブレイク規模の記載はなく、政府の予防接種プログラムの広報記事という性格が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor hospitalised after battling dengue husband Milind Chandwani reveals she continued shooting despite 104-105 degree fever
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Avika Gor has been hospitalised after a dengue diagnosis. Her husband Milind Chandwani posted that she was extremely weak and running a fever of 104–105°F, yet she continued shooting and completed an important shoot before her health deteriorated. She is currently recovering under medical supervision. The piece notes the irony that her new song Bukhar was released while she battled fever. Friends recount she travelled to Delhi for a shoot, a doctor was called, and she survived on ORS while barely able to eat, yet still showed up on set. Milind and close friends praise her dedication and resilience, highlighting a high-profile example of perseverance in the face of dengue and ongoing treatment, with fans sending prayers for a speedy recovery.

triage.headline_ja: アヴィカ・ゴール、デング熱と闘った末に入院 夫ミリンド・チャンドワニが104〜105度の高熱にもかかわらず撮影を続けたことを明かす
triage.triage_reason: 個人（著名人）のデング熱罹患に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常事態を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 個人の健康状態に関する芸能記事であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 'Bijna alle bedden voor mogelijk besmette patiënten in de stad liggen al vol'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Almost all beds for potentially infected patients in the city are already full.
article.articleSummary: In Beni, Democratic Republic of Congo, beds for potentially infected patients are nearly full as Ebola activity rises in the surrounding health regions; last week seven people tested positive in Beni. Construction of the Ebola center is hampered by heavy storms that turn the site into a mud pit, threatening the opening timeline. Médecins Sans Frontières supports the center with medications and materials for both Ebola care and regular health services, while International Medical Corps also assists; nonetheless more people are dying from malaria and obstetric complications than from Ebola. A makeshift team—doctor Marius, Ahmed the pharmacist, and six day workers from Beni—has built the center’s pharmacy amid the chaos, with daily queues at the gate for work. The site is advancing a planned ambulance entrance and latrines, and twenty women still attend prenatal care clients, underscoring ongoing healthcare needs alongside the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: 市内の感染疑い患者用ベッドはほぼ満床
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ベニでエボラ陽性者が増加しベッドが逼迫しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常事態）に2つ該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: MSFやInternational Medical Corpsなど国際支援団体が活動しており、エボラ対応施設の建設が悪天候で遅延している状況。マラリアや産科合併症による死亡もエボラより多いと言及されており、複合的な公衆衛生危機の側面がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds our response capacity
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceeds response capacity, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak has reached about 4,053 confirmed cases and over 1,850 deaths, making it the second largest and fastest-spreading globally. Caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO and Africa CDC call for rapid scaling up of all response efforts, sustained resources, and stronger international support; emphasis on safe access for response teams and protection of civilians and health workers. Solidarity extended to the government, affected communities, and frontline health workers. Urgency to mobilize support to end the outbreak and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、対応能力を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行(4,053症例、1,850人以上死亡)がWHOにより対応能力を超えると発表され、国際的拡大リスク・重症度・管理可能性の観点から複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、致死率が高く、WHO・Africa CDCが国際支援の緊急動員を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'OMS réitère l'appel à renforcer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO reiterates call to strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting the Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 5 August 2026 urged strengthening the Ebola virus disease response as the country faces its 17th outbreak in the east. He called for adapting the response to the epidemic’s evolution, stronger government-led coordination, and concerted action by all partners to halt transmission. Emphasis was placed on community engagement, building trust, and respecting local practices—particularly safe and dignified burials—to reach affected populations. The plan includes protecting health workers and community relay agents with PPE and timely payment, and aligning Ebola response with other humanitarian actions. By 5 August, the outbreak had 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths across five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Upper Uele, with Ituri experiencing disruptions from staff strikes.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：WHOがエボラ対応強化を改めて呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、確定4,053例・死亡1,850例という大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、WHO事務局長が現地訪問して対応強化を要請するなど社会的・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクだが、規模拡大とWHOトップの現地訪問により対応強化が改めて要請されている。地域はイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、チョポ、オートウエレの5州にまたがる。国境を越えた拡大やスタッフストライキによる対応の停滞状況については続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: O sarampo pode voltar a circular no Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can measles circulate again in Brazil?
article.articleSummary: Measles reintroduction risk in Brazil remains elevated as of 2026-08-07. Brazil reported 3 measles cases in 2026 with 468 suspected, despite the WHO declaring elimination in 2024—a status revoked in 2019 after a 21,700-case outbreak. The Ministry of Health warns of an imminent reintroduction, aided by rising measles activity across the Americas. In 2025, the United States, Canada, and Mexico accounted for about 67% of regional infections, creating travel-related risk for spectators during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Vaccination remains the main defense: 2025 coverage was 92.66% for the first dose and 78.02% for the second (measles-containing) dose. Travelers should get the MMR vaccine at least 15 days before travel; children as young as 6 months may be vaccinated prior to travel to endemic areas. The standard schedule is MMR at 12 months with a 15-month booster; adults 29 and younger may have two doses, 30–59 typically one if unsure; prior infection confers lifelong protection.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹はブラジルで再び流行する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはWHOの排除認定を取り消された後、再流行リスクが高まっており、2026年FIFAワールドカップに伴う渡航者経由での輸入例増加が懸念されるため、国際的拡大リスクと異常性の両基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は主にブラジルにおける麻疹再流行リスクに関する保健省の警告を扱っており、米国・カナダ・メキシコ・スペイン等は感染源国としての言及に留まるため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Iloilo province on dengue alert
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Iloilo Province, Philippines, has breached the alert threshold with 1,595 cases as of Aug. 1, including 196 new infections in the past week. The Iloilo Provincial Health Office says the alert threshold was breached by mid-July and warns that continued rise could hit the epidemic threshold. Calinog leads with 145 cases, followed by Cabatuan (130) and Estancia (100). In the latest week, Estancia reported 22 new cases, Ajuy 17, Calinog 16, Cabatuan 12, and Dumangas 12. There have been six dengue-related deaths: Estancia 2, Ajuy 1, Carles 1, San Dionisio 1, and Dingle 1. Dengue clustering covers 56 barangay across 24 towns, with Estancia six villages accounting for 40 cases; Ajuy five villages, 20 cases; Dumangas three villages, 16 cases. Officials blame breeding sites from poorly managed solid waste and urge residents to clean their surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: イロイロ州、デング熱警戒
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・イロイロ州でデング熱症例が警戒閾値を超過し死亡例も発生、拡大が続いており地元保健当局が警戒を発令しているため。
triage.notes: フィリピンでは毎年季節性のデング熱流行が報告されており、本件も地方レベルの警戒であるため異常性は低いが、症例数増加・死亡例・地域拡大が続いている点から経過を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng, chống viêm não do vi-rút ở trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive prevention and control of viral encephalitis in young children.
article.articleSummary: Viral encephalitis cases among children in Lao Cai Province, Vietnam have surged since early July, with over 10 pediatric admissions to the Lao Cai Province Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital’s Intensive Care Unit. Notable cases include M.A.N., just over 2 years old from Bac Ha Commune, admitted July 19 after two days of high fever and diarrhea; initially diagnosed with meningitis-encephalitis at Bac Ha District Medical Center before transfer for intensive care. A second patient, T.T.D., 10, was admitted July 22 after five days of fever, severe frontal headache, and vomiting; antibiotics were ineffective, and viral encephalitis was suspected and treated aggressively. Symptoms span high fever, headache, nausea/vomiting, altered consciousness, and seizures; presentations can mimic other infections. Viral encephalitis most often affects 2–10-year-olds; this year onset is in July, later than usual (April). Prevention emphasizes vaccination (Japanese encephalitis and meningococcal) per MOH, plus mosquito control, environmental hygiene, safe food, good nutrition, and prompt medical care to reduce mortality and long-term neurodevelopmental sequelae.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のウイルス性脳炎の予防・対策に積極的に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ラオカイ省で小児のウイルス性脳炎（日本脳炎含む）症例が例年より早期・多発しており、重症化例（ICU入院、意識障害・痙攣）も見られるため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高まりからフルRRAへの移行が適当と判断した。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎は蚊媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染は通常見られないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、季節性の変化（例年4月発症が今年は7月）や重症例の増加が注目点。続報でのウイルス種特定・地域拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Keracunan Massal di Sidoarjo, 23 Siswa SD Sakit Perut Usai Jajan Odeng di Sekolah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mass poisoning in Sidoarjo, 23 elementary school students sick with stomach pains after snacking on odeng at school.
article.articleSummary: Mass foodborne illness in Sidoarjo, East Java, Indonesia: 23 third- and fourth-grade students at SDI Ar Rahma Sukodono were hospitalized with abdominal pain and weakness after snacking on odeng (fish cake skewers) and fried items at the school canteen around 10:00 a.m. Symptoms escalated by midday, with many classmates experiencing similar abdominal pain and malaise. Emergency care included IV fluids and blood tests; initial assessment points to a gastrointestinal infection related to consumed food. The incident is being investigated by Satreskrim Polresta Sidoarjo, with remaining snacks seized for forensic laboratory testing. The school is cooperating and plans a review of canteen operations and food supply chains. Some students remain under observation, and lab results to confirm the cause are pending as of publication on 2026-08-07.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョで集団食中毒、学校でオデンを間食後に小学生23人が腹痛を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 単一校での食中毒事案であり、感染症の国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す要素がなく、既存基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 食品由来の集団食中毒（食品衛生事案）であり、感染症のヒト-ヒト伝播や国際的な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。原因究明は現地警察・保健当局の調査に委ねられている。

article.articleHeadline: Тест-систему Роспотребнадзора для выявления Эболы официально зарегистрировали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor's test system for detecting Ebola has been officially registered.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor's PCR diagnostic tests for Bundibugyo ebolavirus have been officially registered. The reagent kit offers high sensitivity and enables early detection when Ebola-like symptoms resemble malaria. Developed within four days after learning of an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the tests were immediately deployed to Africa, with more than 7,500 units distributed. African partners and Russian scientists evaluated the assays, comparing them with systems from other countries, and local experts praised usability and accuracy. The report notes Russia previously offered modified Ebola vaccines to African partners. As of 2026-08-07, these diagnostics aim to strengthen outbreak response and early case identification in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監督庁のエボラ検査システムが正式に登録された
triage.triage_reason: エボラ診断キットの技術開発・登録というニュースであり、疾病自体の発生報告ではない。ただしDRCにおけるエボラ発生への対応という背景があり、地域検証対象外（ロシア）での報道のため、続報で実際の流行状況の詳細を要確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはロシアのエボラ診断キット開発と登録についての報道。サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生への対応と明記しているため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。ただし、記事の主体はロシアの診断技術開発であり、DRCでの実際の患者発生数・疫学情報などは記載されていない。継続的に実際の流行状況を把握する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Medical officers trained on Ebola, zoonoses in Dimapur
article.articleSummary: Medical Officers in Dimapur district participated in a capacity-building training on Ebola Virus Disease and zoonoses held at the CMO's Conference Hall on August 7, 2026. The Ebola segment, led by Dr. Ito T. Yeptho, covered epidemiology, transmission modes, clinical features, infection prevention and control, case definitions and reporting protocols, stressing early detection, safe specimen collection, and coordination with district surveillance for rapid response. Dr. K. Pewezo Khalo outlined protocols for collecting, transporting, testing, and submitting samples from suspected Ebola cases through the District Hospital laboratory network. The zoonoses session, led by Dr. Molungtsungba of IDSP, highlighted animal-to-human transmission routes and the One Health approach, with topics including rabies, anthrax, leptospirosis, and other locally relevant diseases, and the need for intersectoral coordination among health, animal husbandry, and community stakeholders. The training aimed to refresh guidelines under IDSP and strengthen diagnostic suspicion and reporting.

triage.headline_ja: ディマプルでエボラおよび人獣共通感染症に関する医療従事者研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、医療従事者向けの能力構築研修に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の疾患発生を報告するものではなく、インド・ナガランド州ディマプルで実施された医療従事者向け研修（エボラ・人獣共通感染症）の内容紹介であるため、トリアージ対象外とする。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал тест-систему на вирус Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor registered a test system for Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Russia's Rospotrebnadzor registered a PCR diagnostic test system for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The development strengthens biosafety capabilities and technological independence. In response to an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, Russian scientists were among the first to produce PCR tests for this variant, completing the work in four days. The tests were shipped to the DRC, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda, where local specialists confirmed their effectiveness in outbreak settings and in comparative evaluations against other countries’ systems. More than 7,500 tests have been dispatched to African nations; shipments also went to Turkmenistan, with requests from Tajikistan and North Korea. Russia previously created an Ebola diagnostic test and strengthened border control.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ブンディブジオウイルスの検査システムを登録
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブジオ型）の流行が DRC とウガンダで発生しており、IHR 基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」「国際的に拡大するリスク」に該当。WPRO スクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」で複数該当し、国際的な診断支援が展開されている点で社会的・政治的関心も高い。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (not in target list but confirmed outbreak location)

triage.notes: 記事の主題はエボラウイルス（ブンディブジオ型）の流行が DRC とウガンダで発生していることに対する、ロシアの診断検査システム開発である。Bluedot API の発生地域フィールドには複数国が含まれているが、実際の流行発生地は DRC とウガンダ。検査キットの配送先（トルクメニスタン、タジキスタン、北朝鮮など）は流行地ではなく、対応国である。対象国リスト中、DRC のみが verified_locations に含まれる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、サマリーで明確に流行地として記載されており、補足として記入している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Le virus Ebola s'infiltre dans les camps de déplacés, l'ONU redoute un désastre sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola virus infiltrates displaced persons camps; the UN fears a health disaster.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed Ebola cases have appeared in displacement camps in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of August 7, 2026, per the United Nations. The virus is present among thousands of families housed in makeshift shelters, raising fears of rapid spread amid severe overcrowding and limited access to basic health care. The development complicates the response, demanding expanded epidemiological surveillance and intensified risk communication to quickly identify suspected cases and cut transmission chains. While food distribution and humanitarian aid continue in the camps, strict infection prevention measures are required. The UN warns that current efforts may be inadequate without urgent international funding and support, calling for immediate resource mobilization to stock health centers and protect responders, and unhindered access for medical teams to reach all affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスが避難民キャンプに侵入、国連は保健上の大惨事を懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患が過密な避難民キャンプで確認され、国連が国際支援の緊急動員を求めており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 避難民キャンプでの過密状態と医療アクセスの制限により、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。国連が国際的な資金・支援の緊急動員を要請している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Combating fear with faith: How caritas is fighting DRC's fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is confronting the largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. As of 7 August 2026, the United Nations reports 3,973 confirmed cases and more than 1,800 deaths. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. Widespread fear, economic devastation, and the trauma of ongoing armed conflict compound the crisis, while the humanitarian response is further hindered by suspensions in international aid. The report highlights the scale and speed of transmission in the region, underscoring the urgent need for public health measures and community support. No specifics on laboratory confirmation timelines, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are provided. The situation reflects a fragile health landscape in eastern DRC, where medical outreach and faith-based relief efforts intersect amid ongoing conflict and funding gaps.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖に信仰で立ち向かう：カリタスがコンゴ民主共和国最速拡大のエボラ流行にどう取り組んでいるか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大かつ最速拡大のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行で、確定症例3,973人、死者1,800人超と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、武力紛争や国際支援停止で管理困難な状況にあるため。
triage.notes: 国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事内に明示的記載なし。武力紛争と国際援助停止により対応が著しく困難化している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO vaccine experts recommended a full-scale Phase III randomized ring trial of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, in the Democratic Republic of Congo to test cross-protection against the Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak. Confirmed cases exceed 4,000 (4,053) with 1,850 deaths; about 87% of cases are in Ituri and 11% in North Kivu. The trial would vaccinate contacts around known cases. Animal data show three of four vaccinated non-human primates survived Bundibugyo versus one of four controls; unpublished ferret studies indicate 100% protection with the vaccine. Efficacy against symptomatic disease and transmission may be limited, but protection against fatal outcome is possible. Gavi maintains a stockpile of 500,000 Ervebo doses; roughly 55,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu have been vaccinated in prior campaigns, with some doses already in DRC. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行でErvebo(エルベボ)ワクチン治験実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例4,053例・死亡1,850例に達する大規模エボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、WHOが新型ワクチン治験を推奨するなど国際的関与が高い深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で既存ワクチンの交差防御効果を検証する第III相治験がWHOにより推奨されている。Ituri州（87%）・北キブ州（11%）に症例集中。致死率約45.6%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية يتجاوز قدرتنا على الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo overwhelms our ability to respond.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning that the epidemic is outpacing response capacity. In a Friday post on X, he urged intensified global efforts, greater resources, and stronger international support alongside the Africa CDC and affected communities. As of 7 August 2026, the current wave declared on 15 May 2026 has about 4,053 confirmed infections and over 1,850 deaths, marking it the second-largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak globally. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The appeal emphasizes safe access for response teams, protection of civilians and health workers, and sustained commitments to end the outbreak and save lives, highlighting the urgent need for increased funding and international solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、我々の対応能力を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が対応能力を超える大規模流行と警告しており、致死率・感染規模ともに深刻でIHR基準の複数該当及び高い社会的関心が確認される。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、確定感染者約4,053人、死者1,850人超と報告されており、史上2番目に大規模かつ最速拡大の流行とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 7 tháng tuổi điều trị viêm não Nhật Bản sau cơn co giật kéo dài
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-month-old girl treated for Japanese encephalitis after a prolonged seizure.
article.articleSummary: Seven-month-old girl in Ninh Bình, Vietnam, was treated for Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) after a prolonged seizure. She presented with high fever and a generalized seizure lasting about 20 minutes, continuing on arrival to Bach Mai Pediatric Center, Ninh Bình. The team stabilized her and performed a diagnostic lumbar puncture with family consent; CSF showed central nervous system inflammation and MRI revealed brain parenchymal lesions compatible with encephalitis. Subsequent tests confirmed JEV infection. Managed in intensive care, she received seizure control, cerebral edema management, continuous neuro monitoring, fluid/electrolyte adjustment, and nutritional support. After 24 days, she was afebrile, seizure-free, alert, feeding well, and vitals stable, then discharged with follow-up to monitor potential neurological sequelae. The report highlights the importance of evaluating fever with prolonged or recurrent seizures as possible encephalitis or meningitis, with lumbar puncture guiding diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 生後7ヶ月の女児、長時間のけいれん後に日本脳炎の治療を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 個別の日本脳炎症例報告であり、ワクチン予防可能な既知の風土病的疾患のため異常性は低いが、小児の重症例として継続監視の対象とする。
triage.notes: 単一の小児症例報告であり、日本脳炎はベトナムで既知の風土病。集団発生や異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зарегистрировал тест-систему для выявления лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor registered a test system to detect Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor registered a PCR-based test system to detect Bundibugyo ebolavirus, an Ebola virus species. Developed by the Central Research Institute of Epidemiology amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, Russian scientists say they were among the first to create a PCR diagnostic for this variant. The reagent kit enables early detection, even when symptoms mimic malaria or other Central African diseases. After registration, deliveries began to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of the Congo, and Uganda. Effectiveness was confirmed in outbreak settings and via comparative testing with foreign analogues. In total, more than 7,500 Russian tests have been supplied to African countries, with local professionals praising the test’s accuracy and ease of use.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、エボラ熱検査システムを登録
triage.triage_reason: エボラおよびマラリア関連の記事であり、DRCとウガンダでの発生が言及されているが、記事の主題はロシア製診断試薬キットの登録・供給であり、新規のアウトブレイク警告ではない。IHR基準は限定的に該当するが、情報が診断ツール供給に偏重しており、感染症流行の現況・拡大リスクに関する詳細が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事のBluedot APIによる地域判定にはロシア連邦が含まれているが、サマリーではロシアは診断キット開発国であり、感染症イベント発生地ではない。ウガンダは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。続報でエボラおよびマラリアの流行状況に関する詳細情報があれば、フルRRA実施の検討が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Alerte Ebola à Kinshasa : les autorités sanitaires renforcent la surveillance à Maluku et appellent la population au calme | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola alert in Kinshasa: health authorities strengthen surveillance in Maluku and call on the population to stay calm | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Kinshasa as authorities strengthen surveillance in Maluku after a boat from Équateur arrived. Four passengers with fever were identified during dockside screening; samples were collected and sent to the laboratory, with results pending and no confirmed Ebola cases yet. The vessel originated from Équateur, not Kisangani in Tshopo, and no epidemiological link to Kisangani has been established. A multi-agency response, including INSP, the General Secretariat for Public Health and Hygiene, PNHF, with OIM support, has deployed screening at Maluku for three days, recording passengers, checking temperatures, conducting clinical exams, and decontaminating the boat. All passengers are under government care during surveillance, receiving meals and basic facilities. This is part of the national Ebola preparedness and response plan, aiming to detect suspected cases early and prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース｜キンシャサでエボラ警戒：保健当局がマルクでの監視を強化、住民に冷静な対応を呼びかけ｜mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国の首都圏（マルク/キンシャサ）で発熱症状のある疑い例が検出され検査中であるため、確定前でも早期のリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発熱症例4名は検査結果待ちで、エボラ確定例は未報告。船はキサンガニ（チョポ州）ではなくエクアトゥール州から来航し、疫学的関連は未確立。Bluedotの発生地域に含まれる『Ecuador（南米）』はフランス語の『Équateur』州名との混同による誤付与とみられ除外した。政府による複数機関連携の対応（INSP、公衆衛生総局、PNHF、IOM支援）が既に展開されており、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情告急 WHO建議展開Ervebo疫苗試驗 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak in critical condition; WHO recommends launching Ervebo vaccine trials - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak remains dire, with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths reported. WHO vaccine experts on Friday urged large-scale human clinical trials of the Ervebo vaccine—the only approved Ebola vaccine—to assess its effectiveness against the local, rarer Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, which is spreading in the region. The proposed design is a ring vaccination trial, vaccinating contacts around confirmed cases. Although Ervebo was developed for the Zaire ebolavirus, animal data suggest it may confer protection against Bundibugyo as well. The Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunisation (Gavi) reports a stockpile of 500,000 doses of Ervebo that could be deployed for the trial. Experts caution that safety is established, but the vaccine's impact on preventing symptoms and transmission may be limited; nonetheless, it could lower mortality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ疫病が深刻化 WHOがErveboワクチン治験の実施を勧告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例4,053件・死亡1,850人という大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラ流行が継続しており、稀なBundibugyo株への対応としてWHOがワクチン治験を勧告するなど国際的関与が既に生じているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 稀なBundibugyoエボラウイルス株が拡大しており、既承認のErveboワクチン（Zaire株用）の有効性検証のためリング接種試験が提案されている。GaviはErvebo50万回分の備蓄を報告。

article.articleHeadline: ಹಂದಿಗಳ ಸಾವಿಗೆ 'ಆಫ್ರಿಕನ್ ಸ್ವೈನ್ ಫೀವರ್' ವೈರಸ್ ಕಾರಣ; ಆತಂಕ ಬೇಡ, ಜಾಗೃತೆ ಇರಲಿ: ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗಳ ಸಲಹೆ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pig deaths caused by African Swine Fever virus; no need to panic, stay alert: officials advise.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) has been confirmed as the cause of deaths among wild pigs in forested areas of Kundapur taluk and among farm pigs at Sainapur near Bainduru, with carcasses sent to labs in Mangaluru and Bengaluru for confirmation. Officials say ASF does not affect humans or other animals and there is no vaccine or treatment; once symptoms appear in a pig, death is likely. A disease-control plan imposes a 1 km infected zone around the outbreak and a 10 km surveillance belt, with humane euthanasia and safe disposal of carcasses and government compensation for culled animals. Previous ASF events in Dakshina Kannada and Udupi districts (Kinnigoli, Moodabidri, Kapu) are cited as context. Three months are targeted to restore disease-free zones, with coordinated action by Animal Husbandry, Health, Forest, and Panchayat departments, and urgent reporting of dead or sick pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の死因はアフリカ豚熱ウイルス、パニックは不要だが警戒を：当局が助言
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ASF）でヒトへの感染性はなく公衆衛生への直接影響はないが、養豚業への経済的影響と地域拡大の可能性があるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、公衆衛生上のリスクは低い。養豚産業への経済影響と過去の同地域での発生歴から、地域当局が対策を実施中。人的健康被害はなく、動物衛生当局による管理下にある。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор официально зарегистрировал тест-систему на вирус Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor officially registered a test system for Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor formally registered a PCR diagnostic kit for Bundibugyo virus, developed by the Central Research Institute of Epidemiology. The test system was created in four days in response to an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The reagent kit enables PCR detection with high sensitivity even at early disease stages. Russian tests have been shipped to DRC and Uganda, where local colleagues validated their effectiveness. Rospotrebnadzor noted positive assessments from foreign specialists for ease of use and accuracy. Context: Reuters reported about 90% of Ebola cases concentrated in Ituri Province, especially Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Nyakunde, with ongoing transmission. WHO representative Anne Ansia stated the outbreak remains unsettled and hospital capacity is strained.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ブンディブジョウウイルス検査システムを正式登録
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで継続中のブンディブジョウ型エボラアウトブレイクに関する情報であり、症例集中・病院逼迫・国際的な検査支援などIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの検査キット開発が主題だが、背景としてDRC(イトゥリ州、ブニア、モングバルウ、ニャクンデ)でのブンディブジョウ型エボラアウトブレイクが継続中であり、WHOも状況不安定と表明。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma 7 novos casos de sarampo e total sobe para 23 - 07/08/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP confirms 7 new measles cases and the total rises to 23 - 07/08/2026.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state total 23, with seven new in the capital last week. Two cases are imported; the rest are linked to importation, source not identified. Sixteen patients have no vaccination history or incomplete schedules. The outbreak affects São Paulo city, São Bernardo do Campo (ABC), and Guarulhos, prompting vaccination for everyone aged 6 months to 59 years in these cities, even if previously immunized. A zero-dose for 6–11 months is advised; it does not replace routine doses. The state sent 150,000 MMR doses to São Paulo and 80,000 to São Bernardo do Campo; all municipalities are supplied. Routine schedule remains two doses: MMR at 12 months and MMR+varicella at 15 months; healthcare workers must have two doses. Measles is airborne; symptoms include fever, rash, conjunctivitis, runny nose, and cough; no specific treatment; complications include pneumonia, otitis, encephalitis, and death. Vaccination is free at UBS across 645 SP municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹の新規症例7件を確認、累計23件に - 2026年8月7日
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれず、また規模も限定的で公衆衛生上の深刻な国際的懸念には至っていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。州レベルで積極的なワクチン接種対応が行われており、行政は既に管理体制にある。

article.articleHeadline: 93,155 dengue cases reported this year
article.articleSummary: Dengue in the Philippines: As of Jan. 4–Aug. 1, 2026, the Department of Health reports 93,155 dengue cases and 386 deaths, down 46% from the same period in 2025 (174,077 cases; 699 deaths). Central Luzon has the most cases (16,057), followed by the National Capital Region (10,611) and Calabarzon (10,320); Davao region (7,537) and Zamboanga Peninsula (6,124) are also high. From July 5 to Aug. 1, several areas breached epidemic threshold, signaling active, widespread outbreaks: Mandaluyong, Lapu-Lapu, Zamboanga; Abra, Agusan del Sur, Albay, Aurora, Camarines Norte, Davao Oriental, La Union, Sulu, Tawi-Tawi, Zamboanga Sibugay. Cebu City and Mandaue City, plus Davao de Oro, breached the alert threshold. Epidemic vs alert thresholds indicate escalating risk and urgent action. DOH urges preventive actions: taob/flip, taktak/shake, tuyo/dry up, takip/cover containers to stop mosquito breeding. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus.

triage.headline_ja: 今年のデング熱症例、93,155件に達す
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで例年発生する季節性デング熱の定期報告で前年より減少しているが、複数地域で流行閾値を超過しており動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事はDOHの定期統計報告。前年同期比で症例・死亡数は減少しているが、複数地域（Mandaluyong、Lapu-Lapu、Zamboanga等）で流行閾値を超過しており、局地的な拡大リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 4천명 넘어...수도까지 번질라 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 4,000... Emergency as it spreads to the capital.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 cases, with mounting concern as transmission nears Kinshasa. As of Aug 5, 2026, cumulative confirmed infections reach 4,053 and deaths 1,850 (case fatality 45.7%). Active cases include 694 isolated or hospitalized patients and 793 recoveries. The epidemic concentrates in five northeastern provinces, including Ituri as the origin, with fears of river-transport spreading to the capital. A ship traveling from Mongala toward Kinshasa halted near Maluku after a 1,700 km journey; 300 passengers were screened and 7 symptomatic individuals tested negative. Kinshasa has tightened surveillance on incoming vessels. Frontline health workers face wage arrears and disrupted control efforts. Africa CDC plans to deploy the Zaire ebolavirus vaccine to Ituri and North Kivu, noting partial protection against Bundibugyo ebolavirus; Remdesivir is being considered amid access and security challenges that complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ感染確認者が4000人超え…首都への拡大に非常事態
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4,000人超、致死率45.7%）が首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念を伴い、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 致死率45.7%と非常に高く、首都キンシャサへの拡大リスク、医療従事者の賃金未払いによる対応体制の脆弱性、Africa CDCによるワクチン展開計画など、フルリスク評価が必要な複数の懸念要素が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Siswa SD di Sidoarjo Dilarikan ke Rumah Sakit usai Diduga Keracunan Jajanan Kantin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of elementary school students in Sidoarjo rushed to the hospital after suspected poisoning from cafeteria snacks.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of elementary students in Sidoarjo, East Java, were rushed to the hospital on Friday evening (7 Aug 2026) after suspected mass poisoning from cafeteria snacks. Twenty-three pupils from SDI Ar Rahma Sukodono were treated at the Emergency Department of RS Assakinah Medika with digestive symptoms after eating frozen snack foods sold in the school canteen. Patients showed weakness and severe abdominal pain; many required IV fluids and were undergoing further evaluation in treatment and laboratory rooms. Dr. Ilham Muhammad Kevin said initial assessments indicated a digestive tract infection linked to the foods. One student, Nazifa, reported symptoms began shortly after consuming odeng and fried snacks from the canteen. Police from Polresta Sidoarjo are investigating, securing leftover food for forensic laboratory testing; school representatives pledged full cooperation to review the canteen operation.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョの小学生数十人、学校売店の菓子で食中毒疑いにより病院搬送
triage.triage_reason: 単一校での食中毒（食品由来）事案であり、感染症のヒト-ヒト伝播や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。原因不明の感染症としてのシグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 食品による集団食中毒の疑いであり、警察が食品残渣を検査中。感染症アウトブレイクではなく食品安全事案として扱うのが適切。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola llega a los campamentos de refugiados en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola reaches refugee camps in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola reaches refugee camps in the northeast Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with cases in at least five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Alto Uele, and Tshopo—affecting about 4.4 million internally displaced people. As of 2026-08-07, Congolese authorities report 4,072 cases and 1,853 deaths. UNHCR notes cases in at least five of 69 camps in Ituri. The Bundibugyo strain, with a 30–50% case fatality rate, has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda recently confirmed 20 Ebola cases, 15 imported from DRC, with 2 deaths; Uganda declared Ebola-free on 2026-07-28. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids. Currently, 694 patients are in isolation/hospitalized and 793 have recovered. WHO urges intensified case detection, daily contact tracing, expanded testing and referral, increased treatment capacity and safe burials, and protection and support for frontline health workers amid insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプに到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（4,072症例、1,853死亡、致死率30-50%）が発生し、難民キャンプにも拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例はDRCからの輸入例であり、ウガンダは2026-07-28にエボラ終息宣言済みのため主要発生地域には含めない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations からも除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Bunia reste l'épicentre de l'épidémie avec 950 cas confirmés et 289 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Bunia remains the epicenter of the outbreak with 950 confirmed cases and 289 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia health zone leading at 950 confirmed cases and 289 deaths. Other major foci: Rwampara (692), Mongbwalu (558), and Nizi (431) confirmed cases. In the latest period, Bunia reported 25 new cases, followed by Nizi (21) and Rwampara (18); Lita (9), Fataki (5), Mongbwalu (5), and Mangala (2) also reported infections. In the last 24 hours, Ituri documented 85 new confirmed cases and 47 deaths (35 community deaths, 12 in Ebola treatment centers). Cumulatively, Ituri has 3,460 cases and 1,464 deaths (case fatality rate 42.3%), accounting for 87.1% of national cases and 81.3% of national deaths. Six health zones—Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Lita, Nyankunde—concentrate the majority of cases and deaths, underscoring ongoing transmission and the need for intensified surveillance and care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ブニアがエボラ流行の震源地であり続ける、確定症例950例、死者289人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で大規模なエボラ流行が継続中で、致死率42.3%と非常に高く、複数の保健地区で新規症例・死亡が拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda, Romania, Australiaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRCイツリ州の状況のみを主題としているため除外した。エボラ流行は既知でWHO等への報告対象と考えられ、継続的なフルRRAでのモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: La Alianza Gavi celebra la propuesta de la OMS para estudiar la vacuna 'Ervebo' contra el brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Gavi Alliance welcomes the WHO's proposal to study the Ervebo vaccine against the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, is recommended by the WHO Technical Advisory Group to be included in a Phase 3 trial to study its use against Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The WHO notes extensive safety and immunogenicity data from Ervebo’s use against Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks, enabling a Phase 3 start without a prior Phase 2. Doses from the global Ebola vaccine stockpile, managed by Gavi and the Interagency Coordinating Group (ICG), are expected to support the trials. The study would complement efforts to develop a vaccine specific to Bundibugyo. Gavi has allocated $40 million from its Emergency Response Fund to accelerate access to Bundibugyo-specific candidates for research and prequalification by WHO and others. This outbreak is currently the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and could become the largest ever, occurring in hard-to-control areas.

triage.headline_ja: Gaviアライアンス、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に対するワクチン「Ervebo」研究のWHO提案を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模とされるエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行であり、WHO・Gaviが国際的な緊急対応・資金投入を行っている重大事案のため。
triage.notes: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模、史上最大化の可能性があるとされるブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行に対し、WHOがErveboワクチンの第3相試験実施を提案し、Gaviが緊急対応基金から4000万ドルを拠出している内容。制圧困難な地域での発生である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : Caritas mise sur l'aide alimentaire pour protéger les familles en quarantaine et préserver leur dignité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Caritas relies on food aid to protect families in quarantine and preserve their dignity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri: Caritas distributes food aid to quarantined families to preserve dignity during the response. In Bunia health zone and in Rwampara, 152 households in isolation receive 21 days of food supplies, delivered door-to-door to avoid stigma and reduce transmission risk by limiting market visits. The six-month program, titled Emergency Community Intervention against Ebola in Ituri: prevention, awareness and basic support to the most affected families, is funded by Caritas Germany via Trócaire and local partners. Beyond medical care, the initiative aims to build trust, combat discrimination, and sustain vulnerable households while reinforcing public health measures. A recovered patient testifies to receiving assistance during illness, underscoring the program’s impact. The effort highlights early care, hygiene, and prompt hospital treatment as key components of the outbreak response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ:カリタスが隔離家族の尊厳を守るため食糧支援に注力
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上常時重大な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、DRCイツリ州で継続する対応活動（隔離世帯152世帯）が報告されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイツリ州（Bunia、Rwampara）でのエボラ対応における食糧支援活動に焦点を当てている。ルワンダのキガリ州も発生地域に含まれているが、記事本文ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として言及されており、対象国リストにルワンダは含まれないため除外。既知のイツリ・エボラ流行の継続報道であり、新規性は低いが公衆衛生上の重大性からPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Un mono siembra el terror en Indonesia: decenas de escuelas cierran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A monkey sows terror in Indonesia: Dozens of schools close.
article.articleSummary: An aggressive long-tailed macaque captured in Indonesia after allegedly attacking at least 18 people, including children and the elderly. Attacks produced bites and scratches that required stitches and rabies vaccines for victims. In response, 40 schools were closed and hundreds of students studied online for three days. The monkey was sent to observation to determine the cause of its aggression, while authorities maintain surveillance for other monkeys that might pose similar risks to the community. The incident highlights potential rabies exposure in the area, with preventive vaccination among affected individuals noted in the report. No additional details on laboratory confirmation or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: サルがインドネシアで恐怖を広める：数十校が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 凶暴なサルによる咬傷事件で学校閉鎖等の社会的インパクトはあるが、狂犬病感染の検査確認情報がなく、単発の野生動物事故の域を出ないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の検査確認や感染源の特定情報はなく、予防的ワクチン接種のみが報告されている。学校閉鎖など社会的関心は高いが、感染症としての深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは断定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Elevan a mil 800 la cifra de muertos por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll rises to 1,800.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 1,801 deaths and 3,973 confirmed cases as of August 4, 2026, since the outbreak was declared on May 15 in the eastern country. The case fatality rate is 45.3%. Of the affected, 674 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 776 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 75.3%. Five provinces are affected: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Although there has been no new geographic extension in the 24 hours prior to the bulletin, the epidemic remains in a stage of sustained transmission with high levels of virus circulation, per the Congolese Ministry of Communication.

triage.headline_ja: エボラによる死者数が1800人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、致死率45.3%、複数州にまたがる持続的伝播があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 5州(イトゥリが震源地、北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、ツォポ)にわたる持続的伝播があり、致死率45.3%と高い。国際的拡大リスクは近隣国への波及可能性として評価。

article.articleHeadline: WHO experts urge trial of Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: WHO experts recommend a full-scale randomized clinical trial of Ervebo to assess protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Ervebo, licensed for the Zaire strain, shows early non-human primate evidence—three of four vaccinated animals survived exposure versus one of four controls; a ferret study with a research-grade vaccine showed complete protection, while all unvaccinated ferrets died within 10 days. No safety concerns were raised for testing among contacts of EBOV patients; hundreds of thousands have received Ervebo in Africa. Effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains uncertain; protection against symptomatic infection and transmission could be limited, though vaccine may reduce death risk. As of WHO figures, 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths (case fatality ~46%). The outbreak is the DR Congo's 17th since 1976, with transmission via infected bodily fluids and severe haemorrhagic fever. Two Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines are in early human trials, a third in development.

triage.headline_ja: WHO専門家、コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスに対するエボラワクチンの臨床試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）は確定症例4,053例、死亡1,850例（致死率約46%）に達しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既承認ワクチン（Ervebo、ザイール株対象）のブンディブギョ株への有効性は不確実であり、非ヒト霊長類・フェレット試験の予備データに基づき大規模ランダム化比較試験が推奨されている。1976年以来DRCで17回目の流行であり、体液を介した感染で重症出血熱を呈する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak prompts WHO to pursue a full-scale randomized ring trial of the Ervebo vaccine to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo. As of 7 August 2026, 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths have been reported, with 87% in Ituri and 11% in North Kivu. TAG-CVP recommended Ervebo be prioritized for inclusion in a trial vaccinating contacts around known cases. Animal data show Ervebo conferred survival in non-human primates (3/4 vaccinated vs 1/4 controls); ferrets showed 100% protection with the study-grade vaccine. No safety concerns were raised for the ring trial given its licensing and prior use. Gavi maintains a stockpile of 500,000 doses, with about 55,000 frontline workers in Ituri/North Kivu vaccinated previously. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; control relies on vaccination and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCのエボラ流行に対しエルベボワクチンの試験実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,053例・死亡1,850例に達する大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続しており、WHOがワクチン試験を主導するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心が認められるため。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.6%と高く、Gaviのワクチン備蓄やWHOのTAG-CVP勧告など国際的対応が進行中。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Los expertos temen que el virus del brote de ébola en Congo esté mutando ante un "nivel de gravedad sin precedentes"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts fear that the virus behind the Ebola outbreak in Congo is mutating in the face of an unprecedented level of severity.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached about 4,000 confirmed cases (3,973) and 1,801 deaths as of August 4, 2026, concentrated in Ituri Province and spreading to North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo, with 20 cases in neighboring Uganda. Authorities fear possible viral mutation amid unprecedented severity and will shift from gradual measures to door-to-door active case finding. In Bunia, MSF reports 90% of admitted patients are not on known contact lists; tracing yields roughly 10 contacts per case instead of the ~40 expected, signaling widespread undetected transmission. The response emphasizes village-centered work, community engagement, digital tools, and support for internally displaced camps; remdesivir may be used compassionately, and Ervebo vaccine testing for Bundibugyo is under consideration. A suspected death on a boat to Kinshasa triggered quarantines; UNICEF warns essential health services are disrupted, with measles first-dose coverage in Mongbwalu down 69%.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、コンゴのエボラ流行ウイルスが「前例のない重篤度」を前に変異している可能性を懸念
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が約4,000症例・1,801死亡に達し、ウガンダへの越境例や広範な未検出感染が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。麻疹ワクチン接種率低下も併せて報告されているが主たる懸念はエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: DoH&FW clarifies on free Hepatitis services
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B and C screening, viral load testing, and treatment are provided free of charge across Nagaland’s government facilities. The Nagaland Department of Health & Family Welfare (DoH&FW) clarified this following a NNagaDAO representation tied to World Hepatitis Day 2026. Free screening is available at District Hospitals, most Community Health Centres, some Primary Health Centres, and some Health and Wellness Centres. Free Viral Load Testing for both Hep B and C is offered at District Hospitals, while free treatment is provided at District Hospitals designated as Treatment Centres. Districts are authorized to offer free baseline investigations for Hep B/C positive patients, including Liver Function Test, Renal Function Test, Complete Blood Count, Ultrasound Abdomen, Fibroscan, and Prothrombin Time. For information on NVHCP services, the public should contact the nearest government health facility.

triage.headline_ja: 保健家族福祉局、無料B型肝炎サービスについて説明
triage.triage_reason: 無料の肝炎検査・治療サービスの提供体制に関する行政広報であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 世界肝炎デーに関連した通常の保健医療サービス案内であり、感染症イベントとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une thèse recommande la surveillance environnementale pour prévenir la maladie de schistosomiase - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a thesis recommends environmental surveillance to prevent schistosomiasis - ACP.
article.articleSummary: DRC focuses on schistosomiasis prevention; Kinshasa ACP reports a thesis recommending environmental and animal surveillance to curb transmission, especially around Kimpese. Dr. Germain Kapour warns of hybrids forming between animal- and human-infecting Schistosoma, underscoring a One Health approach that links environmental and animal monitoring. Schistosomiasis is a neglected tropical parasite transmitted via water containing small snails; human symptoms include hematuria and abdominal pain, with infertility cited as a potential complication in women. The study details molecular and phylogenetic identification of snails and mapping of high-risk areas to guide vector control. WHO recommends four pillars: annual treatment in affected areas, access to potable water, hygiene education, and mollusc-control; open-air toilets can contaminate rainwater that becomes drinking water. Institutions include INOHA, with acknowledgment of Professors Muyembe and Bompangue.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:住血吸虫症予防のため環境サーベイランスを推奨する学位論文 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究・学位論文に関する報道であり、急性の集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急対応を示す情報ではないため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 住血吸虫症は既知のNTD（顧みられない熱帯病）であり、本記事は研究論文の紹介記事。急性のアウトブレイクや異常な症例増加の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavariant in Congo maakt al 1.850 doden: WHO wil vaccin Ervebo versneld testen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola variant in Congo has already claimed 1,850 lives: WHO wants to accelerate testing of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: WHO notes that a Bundibugyo-variant Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in about 4,000 confirmed and probable cases and 1,850 deaths as of August 7, 2026. Ervebo, a vaccine developed against the Zaire ebolavirus strain, remains the only Ebola vaccine approved for use. New preliminary data indicate that Ervebo confers some protection in animals against Bundibugyo and shows no major safety concerns in those studies. Although experts still prefer a vaccine tailored to Bundibugyo, WHO and partners advocate moving Ervebo into a large Phase 3 trial as quickly as possible, leveraging existing safety data. If feasible, such a trial could run immediately in high-risk areas, potentially accelerating protection options while development of a variant-specific vaccine continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ変異株、死者すでに1,850人：WHOはエルベボワクチンの迅速な試験を求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行（約4,000症例、死亡1,850人）が継続しており、致死率が高く国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が大きいためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラ流行の続報。ワクチン開発・臨床試験の進展に関する情報であり、WHOによる国際対応が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO experts recommend testing licensed Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo virus in Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO experts recommend prioritizing the licensed Ebola vaccine Ervebo for evaluation in a randomized clinical trial during the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Preliminary animal studies suggest Ervebo may offer some cross-protection against death from Bundibugyo virus, though the vaccine is licensed for Zaire ebolavirus. The advisory group found no safety concerns with a trial vaccinating contacts of cases within the Bundibugyo outbreak, but effectiveness against Bundibugyo disease and transmission needs demonstration. A Bundibugyo-specific vaccine would remain the preferred option, though no candidate data are yet available. The DR Congo outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, and the group met on July 31 for the third time to review new data. Earlier guidance had cautioned against using Ervebo outside carefully designed research settings until performance against Bundibugyo is assessed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO専門家、コンゴでのブンディブギョウイルスに対し認可済みエボラワクチンの試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のブンディブギョウ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定されており、WHOがワクチン試験を検討するなど国際的関心・介入が高い深刻な事案であるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは通常のザイールエボラウイルスではなく稀なブンディブギョウウイルスによるもので、既存の認可ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性が未確認である点が特筆される。5月16日にPHEICが宣言されており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasaï Oriental : 54 cas de tuberculose signalés à la prison centrale de Mbujimayi - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasai-Oriental: 54 tuberculosis cases reported at Mbuji-Mayi Central Prison - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Mbujimayi Central Prison in Kasai-Oriental Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reported 54 tuberculosis cases, with 52 among inmates and none among staff. Director Marguerite Mbelu cited crowded conditions and close proximity, complicating isolation and prolonging TB screening. The facility has TB drugs but malaria medicines are in very short supply, and other medicines are unavailable. It awaits replenishment from Cadmeko (Centre d'achat et de distribution des médicaments du Kasaï Oriental) and the Diulu health zone, following advocacy by the provincial Health Minister and the Justice Minister. Central government subsidy has been scarce, with only one disbursement at 70% since the start of the year, leaving debts and prompting appeals for assistance to meet prisoners' needs. No other diseases or outbreaks are detailed.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ・オリエンタル州:ムブジマイ中央刑務所で結核54例を報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内という限定的環境での結核集団発生であり過密状態がリスク要因だが、国際的拡大の兆候はなく情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 刑務所内での集団感染であり過密状態・医薬品不足が問題。結核は既知の風土病でIHR基準には該当しないが、資源不足への外部支援要請がある点でWPRO基準の一部に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : plus de 60 % de létalité due à l'épidémie d'Ebola à Nia-Nia - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: more than 60% case fatality rate due to the Ebola outbreak in Nia-Nia - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo. As of August 7, 2026, 119 confirmed cases, 72 deaths and 24 recoveries reported, yielding a case fatality rate above 60%. The high lethality is linked to difficulties performing post-mortem sampling in PK51, with security constraints hampering response activities. About 90% of post-mortem samples tested in the area are positive, indicating intense community transmission. Response efforts remain limited due to major security constraints. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, chief medical officer of the health zone, stressed the urgency of accelerating a full resumption of health interventions in PK51 to reduce mortality and interrupt the transmission chain. The report highlights ongoing Ebola transmission and the critical gaps in outbreak response caused by security and access challenges in PK51.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:ニアニアでのエボラ流行による致死率60%超 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例119例・死亡72例（致死率60%超）が報告され、コミュニティ内感染が強く疑われる状況で、治安上の制約により対応が阻害されているためIHR基準の複数該当かつ社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: PK51地域における治安上の制約が検体採取・対応活動を著しく妨げており、地域社会内での感染拡大（陽性率約90%）が示唆される。国際的な支援・介入の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: What Fresh Hell Is This? AI Used to Design 16 Brand New Viruses
article.articleSummary: Stanford researchers used artificial intelligence to design 16 novel viruses intended to infect bacteria, marking the first instance of AI-designed whole viral genomes. From 302 AI designs selected for synthesis, 16 were viable in the lab and capable of killing Escherichia coli. While framed as a potential breakthrough for treating disease, the work triggers urgent safety and security concerns about AI-generated pathogens. The article also links these advances to debates around lab-based coronavirus research, citing Wuhan Institute of Virology and EcoHealth Alliance, and the DEFUSE proposal led by Peter Daszak, with references to furin cleavage sites at the spike S1/S2 junction and chimeric SARS-related viruses; it notes a 2018 DARPA grant for similar work and mentions Ralph Baric. The report highlights potential ethical and biosafety risks tied to dual-use research.

triage.headline_ja: 何という悪夢だ？AIが16種の新型ウイルスを設計
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、AIによるバクテリオファージ設計研究とバイオセキュリティ論争に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の実発生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は大腸菌に感染するAI設計ウイルス(バクテリオファージ)に関する研究報道であり、ヒト感染症のアウトブレイクではない。武漢研究所やCOVID起源論争への言及があるが、これは実際の発生地域ではなく研究背景の言及に過ぎないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP esclarece dúvidas sobre vacinação emergencial após confirmação de 23 casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government clarifies questions about emergency vaccination after confirmation of 23 measles cases.
article.articleSummary: Measles emergency vaccination for residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo after 23 confirmed cases and higher transmission risk. Residents should go to the nearest Basic Health Unit (UBS) to receive the MMR vaccine, regardless of prior vaccination. The Center for Epidemiological Surveillance aims to curb spread as most cases lacked full vaccination. To ensure supply, 150,000 MMR doses were distributed to the capital and 80,000 to São Bernardo do Campo. In other state areas without outbreaks, authorities maintain active case finding and routine calendar doses, not indiscriminate vaccination. Contraindications: pregnancy; severe immunodeficiency; history of severe allergic reactions to vaccine components. Breastfeeding women may be vaccinated. Those who received live vaccines in last 30 days (e.g., yellow fever, varicella) should wait the advised interval. This coincides with the Multivaccination Campaign updating records for children and adolescents up to 15 years.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、麻疹23例確認後の緊急ワクチン接種に関する疑問に回答
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ市など複数都市で麻疹23例が確認され、州政府が異例の緊急ワクチン接種（生後6ヶ月〜59歳対象）を実施しており、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 対象地域はサンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サン・ベルナルド・ド・カンポの3都市に限定。ワクチン未接種者が多いことが感染拡大の主因とされ、州は15万回分＋8万回分のMMRワクチンを緊急配布。重症度・死亡例に関する情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP reforça segurança da vacina contra o sarampo após confirmação de 16 casos no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government reaffirms the safety of the measles vaccine after confirmation of 16 cases in the state.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo state, Brazil, total 16 confirmed infections, triggering intensified vaccination messaging. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat reiterates that the measles–mumps–rubella (triple viral) vaccine is safe and effective; vaccination coverage is 87.8% for the first dose and 73.8% for the second dose, both below the 95% target. The vaccine is free at Basic Health Units and uses attenuated viruses. To curb transmission, residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo should participate in the Multivaccination campaign through September 1. In other municipalities, follow the National Calendar: two doses up to 29 years old and one dose for 30–59. The vaccine is contraindicated for pregnant individuals and infants under six months; achieving high coverage is essential to protect vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、州内で麻疹16例確認後にワクチンの安全性を再強調
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹16例が確認され、ワクチン接種率が目標(95%)を下回っており感染拡大の可能性がある。州保健当局が公式に対応・広報しており社会的・行政的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 低いワクチン接種率(1回目87.8%、2回目73.8%)が継続的な感染リスクを示唆。重症例・死亡等の情報はなく、現時点では州レベルでの対応で管理可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Guia esclarece dúvidas sobre sarampo e orienta prevenção em Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guide clears up questions about measles and provides prevention guidance in Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in São Paulo state prompt Campinas to release a Q&A guide. Campinas had no cases since 2021, but the state reported 23 confirmed cases in 2026, with outbreaks in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. A multivaccination campaign began on August 3, and Campinas is engaging schools and hospitals. In 2025 the city reached 98.30% first-dose and 92.41% second-dose coverage for the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella). Measles is highly contagious and spreads via respiratory secretions; the virus can linger in the air for up to two hours. Transmission occurs from six days before to four days after rash onset, potentially infecting up to 18 people. Incubation: 7–21 days; symptoms include fever, red rash, runny nose, cough, and conjunctivitis. Guidance covers vaccination, isolation, and when to seek care; high-risk groups include children under 5, pregnant women, and immunosuppressed. Travelers should verify vaccination and monitor contacts for 30 days.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹に関する疑問を解消するガイド、カンピーナスで予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で麻疹確認例23件と地域的増加が見られるが、カンピーナス市自体は2021年以降症例なく、深刻度・国際的拡大の証拠は限定的。ワクチン接種キャンペーンなど対応は進んでおり、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: 米国・カナダ・メキシコでのアウトブレイクも言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Chad registra 13 muertos por cólera desde el inicio del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chad reports 13 deaths from cholera since the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Chad reports 13 cholera deaths since officials declared the outbreak in late July, with about 239–240 confirmed cases nationwide and a case-fatality rate of 5.4%. Most infections are in the Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and in the capital, N'Djamena. In August, N'Djamena accounted for 11 of the 13 deaths, signaling accelerated transmission in densely populated areas. Health authorities attribute persistence to limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation. About 50,800 people have been vaccinated against cholera since the outbreak was announced on July 24 as part of a campaign to curb transmission and protect vulnerable groups. The first cholera death in this outbreak occurred on June 13, more than a month before official confirmation. Outbreaks have been reported in the Central African Republic, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria amid water and sanitation challenges. Cholera is a bacterium transmitted via contaminated water or food; timely diagnosis and care are critical.

triage.headline_ja: チャド、コレラ流行開始以来13人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: 主たる報道はチャドのコレラ流行（対象国外）だが、DRCでも同様の流行が報告されているとされる。DRCに関する具体的な症例数・死亡者数等の情報がなく、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチャドのコレラ流行（対象国外）。DRCについては『流行が報告されている』との簡潔な言及のみで、症例数・死亡数等の詳細情報は記載されていないため、DRCに関する続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus conhecido por causar bronquiolite em bebês também preocupa quem tem mais de 60 anos - Correio Regional São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus known to cause bronchiolitis in babies is also a concern for people over 60 - Correio Regional São Paulo
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) poses a significant risk to seniors in Brazil, particularly in the São Paulo region; While commonly linked to bronchiolitis in infants, RSV can cause pneumonia, respiratory failure, and hospitalization in people aged 60 and older, especially with cardiovascular or pulmonary disease, diabetes, kidney disease, or immunosuppression. Transmission via talking, coughing, sneezing, hand contact, and contaminated surfaces enables rapid spread within families and communal settings. Early RSV-like symptoms—runny nose, cough, low fever, malaise—may mask more serious lung involvement in the elderly. Prevention relies on multiple strategies; vaccines exist for influenza, pneumococcus, and RSV. Brazilian Immunization Society recommends RSV vaccination for adults 60-69 with risk factors, and for 70+ regardless of comorbidities, as a single-dose, year-round option. Vaccination remains advisable as RSV circulation can extend beyond winter, including tropical regions like Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 乳児の細気管支炎を引き起こすことで知られるウイルスは、60歳以上の人々にとっても懸念材料
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVに関する一般的な健康啓発・予防接種推奨の記事であり、異常な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はRSVの高齢者へのリスクと予防接種推奨に関する啓発コンテンツであり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠流感叠加流行，专家厘清用药边界_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and influenza co-epidemic: experts clarify the boundaries of medication use.
article.articleSummary: Beijing, late July 2026, sees rising SARS-CoV-2 positivity alongside influenza activity as residents seek care for fever, sore throat and cough. Week 31 surveillance (Jul 27–Aug 2, 2026) reports COVID-19 at 22.3% positivity among influenza-like illness samples, influenza at 13.3%, and COVID-19 accounting for 8.2% of hospitalized severe acute respiratory infections. The dominant NB.1.8.1 lineage is circulating; no major variant or public-health risk detected, and COVID-19 is not strongly seasonal, though case numbers fluctuate. Clinicians warn that COVID-19 and influenza have overlapping symptoms and do not share antiviral efficacy (oseltamivir ineffective for COVID-19; antibiotics ineffective). Six domestically approved oral COVID-19 antivirals exist, but require hospital prescriptions. For high-risk patients, treatment within 72 hours improves outcomes; for mild cases, symptom relief with guidance (paracetamol, Lianhua Qingwen) is advised. Emphasis on timely testing and guideline-concordant therapy to limit complications.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナとインフルエンザの同時流行、専門家が薬剤使用の境界を明確化
triage.triage_reason: 北京における新型コロナ・インフルエンザの通常の季節的共流行に関する医療従事者向け治療ガイダンス記事であり、新規変異株や重症化率の急増、公衆衛生上のリスクは報告されていない。
