triage.notes: 記事は主に臨床医向けの薬剤使用ガイダンスであり、監視データ（第31週）ではCOVID-19陽性率22.3%、インフルエンザ13.3%、重症急性呼吸器感染症の8.2%を占めるが、『主要な変異株や公衆衛生リスクは検出されていない』と明記されており、通常の季節性呼吸器感染症の枠内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma sete novos casos de sarampo que somam 23; três cidades aumentam a vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms seven new measles cases, bringing the total to 23; three cities ramp up vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in São Paulo State, Brazil, with 23 cases reported as of 7 August 2026: 20 in the capital city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. Health authorities attribute transmission to importation, though the infection source remains unknown. In response, the São Paulo state health department and the Ministry of Health expanded vaccination efforts: vaccination recommended for residents aged 6 months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo, regardless of prior vaccination status; a Multivaccination Campaign to update vaccination cards for children and adolescents under 15 began on 3 August; a dose zero is advised for children 6-11 months in areas with transmission. The measles vaccine (MMR) is free via SUS for 12 months to 59 years; nationwide distribution of 7.2 million doses in 2026, with about 2.9 million administered. Emphasize maintaining updated vaccination records to prevent reintroduction.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹7例の新規感染確認、累計23例に；3都市がワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明の麻疹アウトブレイクがブラジル・サンパウロ州で拡大しており、複数都市でワクチン接種強化が実施されるなど行政の関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の輸入例に起因するとされ、州保健当局とブラジル保健省が複数都市でワクチンキャンペーンを実施中。重症度や死亡例に関する情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS appelle à organiser un essai clinique avec l'ancien vaccin Ervebo pour lutter contre le nouveau variant d'Ebola qui sévit en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for conducting a clinical trial with the older Ervebo vaccine to counter the new Ebola variant that is raging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths as of May 15, the largest outbreak in the country's history. The circulating Bundibugyo variant has no specific vaccine; WHO proposes evaluating Merck’s Ervebo vaccine (Zaïre strain) in a DRC Phase 3 clinical trial, based on favorable safety data and animal evidence of cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Trial logistics and eligibility are under discussion, with DRC the only country where Bundibugyo is circulating. A global stock of about 500,000 Ervebo doses, maintained with Gavi support, could back the studies, and some doses are kept in the DRC due to recurrent outbreaks. In parallel, variant-specific vaccines are in development (Moderna in Canada; rVSV Bundibugyo by Hilleman Laboratories; an Oxford vaccine), with a first volunteer dose administered in late July. Ebola spread via contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で猛威を振るう新型エボラ変異株対策として、旧型ワクチン「エルベボ」を用いた臨床試験の実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国において過去最大規模のエボラ流行（4,053症例、1,850死亡）が継続しており、既存ワクチンが効かない新変異株（ブンディブギョ株）の出現とWHOによる緊急対応（臨床試験提案）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: Canadaは新型ワクチン（Moderna）の開発拠点として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ブンディブギョ変異株は現時点でDRCのみで確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'DRC's largest Ebola outbreak on record: Active conflict and armed groups hamper the response'
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with its largest Ebola outbreak on record, with transmission spreading undetected for months before identification. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, complicating diagnosis and case confirmation given symptoms overlap with other illnesses. Officials note delayed diagnosis and difficulty distinguishing Bundibugyo from other common diseases, exacerbated by the outbreak’s scale. Operational challenges are amplified by the presence of active conflict and armed groups, which hinder response efforts and access for health teams. The commentary features Sharon Gaffney and Heather Kerr, Congo Country Director for the International Rescue Committee, underscoring the need for secure access and robust laboratory confirmation to curb transmission. No specific case counts are provided in the article. Keywords: Ebola, Bundibugyo, DRC, outbreak, conflict, public health response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行:紛争と武装集団が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が発生しており、紛争により対応が阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数を示していないが、Bundibugyo株による過去最大規模の流行であり、紛争地域での対応困難が強調されている。国際的な支援団体（IRC）が関与しており、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي باختبار لقاح ايرفيبو ضد فيروس بونديبوجيو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization recommends testing the Ervebo vaccine against Bundibugyo virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, WHO experts advised prioritizing evaluation of the licensed Ervebo vaccine (rVSV-ZEBOV) in a randomized clinical trial during the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Preliminary data from animal studies suggest cross-protection by Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus and a reduction in deaths, but efficacy against Bundibugyo and suppression of human transmission remain unproven. Ervebo is currently the only licensed Ebola vaccine against Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo virus; the Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option, though data for candidates are not yet available. The WHO's advisory groups formed after the May 16 international public health emergency declaration for the Congo outbreak, with the third meeting on 31 July reviewing latest data. Previously, it recommended against using Ervebo outside tightly controlled research settings until its performance against Bundibugyo is demonstrated.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、ブンディブギョウイルスに対するエルベボワクチンの試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョウウイルス(エボラ関連)アウトブレイクに関し、WHOが5月16日に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既にWHOがPHEIC相当の国際緊急事態を宣言済みのアウトブレイクであり、ワクチン戦略に関する続報。フルリスク評価対象として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Guarapari emite alerta de saúde para aumento de casos de catapora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarapari issues a health alert for rising varicella (chickenpox) cases.
article.articleSummary: Guarapari, Brazil reports a health alert for rising varicella (chickenpox) cases as of August 6, 2026, with an uptick in confirmed cases and additional notifications under investigation. Authorities urge individuals with suspected or confirmed infection to stay away from work or school until all skin lesions fully heal to prevent transmission. Key symptoms include fever above 38.5°C, headache, malaise, red spots that evolve into vesicles and crusts, and intense itching. Although typically milder in children, varicella can be more severe in pregnant women, adults, and those with low immunity. The municipality notes ongoing monitoring and investigations. Vaccination is free and available at health units for those eligible under the National Vaccination Schedule, reinforcing prevention alongside case management and public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: グアラパリ市、水痘（水疱瘡）症例増加で健康警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症で、地方自治体レベルの通常の公衆衛生対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・グアラパリ市（対象国リストに含まれない）での局地的な水痘症例増加に関する自治体の健康警報であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil...）のうちBrazilは対象国リストに含まれるが、地域限定の軽度な感染症であるため国際的懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Spatiotemporal heterogeneity and the shifting epicenter of pulmonary tuberculosis notifications in thailand over a 10-year period: Evidence from national surveillance data
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) in Thailand shows marked spatiotemporal heterogeneity from 2014–2023, despite a national decline in incidence. Global Moran's I found no significant nationwide clustering, but Local Indicators of Spatial Association revealed evolving local hotspots. Space-time scan statistics detected seven clusters; the most likely cluster shifted from the Eastern industrial region (2014–2019; RR=3.64; LLRatio=1,463.28) to the Lower Northeastern border region (2020–2023; including Ubon Ratchathani, Si Sa Ket, Amnat Charoen, Yasothon, Roi Et; RR=3.22; LLRatio=3,145.62; P<0.001). Notification completeness affected interpretation: 154 of 770 province-years (20%) had zero notified cases, concentrated 2014–2016. The Eastern cluster had annual notifications, while many Lower Northeastern and Prachuap Khiri Khan province-years were zero in 2014–2016. The shift likely reflects reporting changes, not transmission; highlights the need to assess reporting completeness before space-time analyses and supports geographically targeted improvements in TB surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおける肺結核届出数の空間時間的異質性と震源地の変遷:10年間の全国サーベイランスデータからの知見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去10年間の学術的な疫学研究であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。全国的な結核届出数は減少傾向にあり、報告体制の変化を反映した分析にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイの結核サーベイランスに関する学術研究論文であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため、地理的言及はあるがEBSシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Confira qual bairro recebe serviços de combate à Dengue nesta sexta-feira em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Check which neighborhood will receive dengue control services this Friday in Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: On Friday, Campo Grande’s vector-control program by Sesau will spray only Bairro Nova Lima in the afternoon (16:00–22:00) to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The UBV Ultra Low Volume fumigation targets adult mosquitoes, especially females. Residents are urged to open doors and windows to maximize effectiveness. Operations by the CCEV (Coordenadoria de Controle de Endemias Vetoriais) may be delayed or canceled in case of rain, wind, or fog, which impair application. Although intended to reduce disease transmission, the insecticide can affect non-target species, requiring careful deployment. The article does not provide case or death counts, and focuses on ongoing weekly control activities in Campo Grande, with notification of the single-neighborhood schedule for the week.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデ、今週金曜日にデング熱対策サービスを実施する地区を確認
triage.triage_reason: 定例のベクター対策活動に関する告知記事であり、症例数や死亡数、異常な増加等の情報がなく、公衆衛生上の懸念を示す内容は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой в Конго превысило 4000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases, with 1,850 deaths reported. The outbreak is now recorded in five provinces. Scientists say the flare began as early as January. Containment has proved extremely difficult: the virus was detected too late, epidemiological surveillance systems are overwhelmed, and ongoing armed conflict complicates response efforts. The article notes that there are no effective vaccines or treatments for this Ebola strain, further hindering control measures. Symptom details are not specified in the report. As of August 7, 2026, the situation underscores a high-fatality, multi-region outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染確認例が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC内5州に拡大し、4000例超・死者1850人の高致死率アウトブレイクとなっており、有効なワクチン・治療法もなく国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 武力紛争が対応を複雑化させており、監視体制も機能不全との報告あり。ワクチン・治療薬が効かない株である点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Faridabad News: बरसात में जलजनित रोग फैलने का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Faridabad News: Risk of waterborne diseases spreading during the monsoon.
article.articleSummary: Faridabad, India, faces increasing risk of dengue, malaria, viral fever, conjunctivitis, and food poisoning as monsoon rains and waterlogging persist. Four days of continuous rain have created standing water, boosting mosquito breeding and driving rising OPD visits in government and private hospitals. Patients report high fever, body pains, cold symptoms, eye redness, vomiting, diarrhea, and GI troubles. Dr. Ram Chandra Soni, Chair of Gastroenterology at Acord Hospital, notes stagnant water promotes vector-borne and waterborne infections. Health officials urge residents to prevent water accumulation, wear full-sleeve clothing, use mosquito repellents, and drink only clean boiled or filtered water; avoid foods sold in the open and eat fresh items. Doctors advise seeking care for fever beyond three days, severe eye infection, or persistent vomiting/diarrhea with declining platelets. Fogging and anti-larval spraying are underway.

triage.headline_ja: ファリダバードニュース：モンスーンによる水系感染症拡大の危険性
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア等の増加に関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における季節性の媒介動物・水系感染症増加についての地域ニュースであり、地方自治体レベルでの対応（防疫・啓発）が行われている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola. OMS pede ensaio clínica da vacina Ervebo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. WHO calls for a clinical trial of the Ervebo vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is battling the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus, triggering the largest outbreak in the country's history with over 4,000 cases since it was officially recognized on May 15. There have been 1,850 confirmed deaths. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; the outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. No vaccine specific to Bundibugyo exists; WHO urges prioritizing Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, designed against the Zaire strain, for a randomized trial within the ongoing outbreak to evaluate cross-protection and safety. Animal studies show Ervebo offers some protection against Bundibugyo with no major safety concerns. Additional candidates include Moderna's Bundibugyo-targeting vaccine, rVSV Bundibugyo from Hilleman Labs, and an Oxford vaccine; early July saw the first volunteer dose. Trials are also under way for treatments such as remdesivir, MBP134 monoclonal antibody, and obeldesivir.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱。WHOがエルベボ・ワクチンの臨床試験を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中で、4000例超・死者1850人と重篤度が高く、既存ワクチンの効果が不明なため国際的対応が必要な状況であり、IHR基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模の17回目のDRCエボラ流行で、致死率約46%（1850/4000）。既存ワクチンEervebo（ザイール株用）のブンディブギョ株への交差防御効果が未確認であり、WHOが臨床試験を要請している段階。

article.articleHeadline: NMC to deploy 1,112 ASHA workers for door-to-door dengue survey | Nagpur News
article.articleSummary: A Nagpur Municipal Corporation plan to deploy 1,112 ASHA workers for a citywide door-to-door mosquito larval survey aims to strengthen surveillance against dengue, chikungunya and other vector-borne illnesses during the monsoon. The ₹33.36 lakh proposal funds two months of Rs 1,500 monthly honoraria per worker. Each worker will survey about 500 households per month (roughly 50–75 houses daily) to identify breeding sites and disseminate prevention messages, with daily oversight by health supervisors and inspectors. The plan cites expanding city limits, staff shortages, and rising public complaints as drivers for intensified surveillance. Nagpur has previously relied on ASHA workers for larval surveillance during monsoons, with community outreach helping early detection and elimination of stagnant water. If approved, the survey would begin immediately to curb transmission in the peak monsoon period; the Standing Committee will deliberate on Aug 11.

triage.headline_ja: NMCがデング熱の戸別調査のためASHAワーカー1,112人を配置へ|ナグプールニュース
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性デング・チクングニア対策としての行政的サーベイランス強化策であり、異常な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期における通常の予防的媒介動物対策の記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な増加についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Украина, Газа, Эбола, цены на продовольствие
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Main News of the Day | Friday: Ukraine, Gaza, Ebola, Food Prices
article.articleSummary: Ervebo vaccine is prioritized for clinical trials in the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); Ervebo is the only registered Ebola vaccine, with demonstrated protection against Zaire ebolavirus, while efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus circulating in the DRC remains to be proven. Separately, UN agencies report continued humanitarian activity amid conflict in Ukraine, with attacks on civilians causing casualties and injuries; Save the Children’s Sumy office was damaged, and two staff were wounded in Kherson, though aid delivery persists. In Gaza, July aid volumes rose 33% versus June, but imports remain restricted for certain cargo, including engine oil and spare parts, and building materials; the number of destroyed buildings in Gaza has increased by 9% since the ceasefire. Global food prices rose in July per FAO, driven by heat, energy costs, and Black Sea export disruptions, with wheat up 5.8%.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜金曜日：ウクライナ、ガザ、エボラ、食料価格
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）流行に対するワクチン臨床試験開始が報じられており、公衆衛生上重大かつ管理体制の支援が必要な事案であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はウクライナ・ガザ情勢等を含む国連ニュースの日次まとめであり、エボラに関する情報はDRCでの既存流行に対するErveboワクチン試験の優先実施に限定される。新規の異常事象というより既知流行の継続報告だが、Bundibugyo株への有効性未確認という点で懸念材料あり。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织技术委员会同意在刚果（金）对传统埃博拉疫苗实施临床试验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Technical Committee Approves Clinical Trials of a Traditional Ebola Vaccine in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompted WHO on May 16 to declare a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) and convene a technical advisory group to review candidate vaccines and therapies. The only licensed Ebola vaccine, Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) targeting Zaire ebolavirus, should not be used outside research settings. At the July 31 meeting, the group reviewed animal data showing cross-protection of Ervebo against Bundibugyo virus, especially in preventing death, and judged that vaccinating exposed contacts posed no safety concerns during the Bundibugyo outbreak. With ongoing transmission and no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine, the group recommended prioritizing Ervebo for randomized clinical trials. However, a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option; if efficacy data are sufficient, mass production and access must be scaled up.

triage.headline_ja: WHO技術諮問委員会、コンゴ民主共和国での従来型エボラワクチンの臨床試験実施に合意
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ出血熱流行を受けPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事案は既にWHOによりPHEICが宣言されている進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウ種）流行であり、既存のRRA（リスク評価）が存在する可能性が高い。ワクチン開発・臨床試験の進捗に関する続報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Des experts de l'OMS recommandent de tester le vaccin homologué contre Ebola face au virus de Bundibugyo en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO experts recommend testing the licensed Ebola vaccine against Bundibugyo virus in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO experts recommended prioritizing evaluation of the licensed Ebola vaccine Ervebo in a randomized trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus is ongoing. Preclinical animal studies suggest Ervebo may offer some cross-protection against Bundibugyo-related deaths, though efficacy against infection and transmission remains unproven. Ervebo is the only licensed Ebola vaccine but is approved for Ebola caused by Zaire ebolavirus, not Bundibugyo virus. The WHO Technical Advisory Group on Vaccine Prioritization found no safety concerns for potential use of Ervebo during a Bundibugyo outbreak in a trial vaccinating contacts of infected individuals; however, a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine would remain preferred once available. The outbreak prompted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16; the group met on July 31 to review new data, and previously recommended against using Ervebo outside carefully designed research until performance against Bundibugyo was evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: WHO専門家、コンゴ民主共和国のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対し承認済みエボラワクチンの試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されているブンディブギョ型エボラの流行であり、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的・国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本件は2026年5月16日にWHOによりPHEICが宣言された既存のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に関する続報であり、ワクチン戦略検討の一環。既にフルRRA対象として扱われている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma 23 casos de sarampo e reforça vacinação contra doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 23 measles cases and reinforces vaccination against the disease.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases reach 23 in the State of São Paulo, Brazil, with 16 patients unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Of total cases, two are imported; the remaining linked to these introductions are distributed: 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 20 in the city of São Paulo. In response, health authorities have launched expanded vaccination targeting residents aged 6 months to 59 years in the three cities, regardless of past vaccination status if there are no contraindications. Vaccination is to be conducted at Basic Health Units (UBS). The expanded strategy is to curb spread per the São Paulo Epidemiological Surveillance Center Prof. Alexandre Vranjac. In other municipalities, actions emphasize vaccination status checks, active case finding, and catch-up dosing aligned with the National Immunization Schedule.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹23例を確認しワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 未接種者を中心に麻疹の地域内伝播が継続しており、当局がワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施するなど公衆衛生対応が活発化しているため、WPRO基準を満たしフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 感染源は輸入例2件からの拡大で、未接種・不完全接種者が多数を占める。ブラジルは過去に麻疹排除認定を受けており、再興流行の兆候として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow News: मदर मिल्क में मिले HIV, सिफिलिस या बैक्टीरिया, KGMU में डबल स्क्रीनिंग के बाद ही मिलती एंट्री
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lucknow News: HIV, syphilis or bacteria found in breast milk; entry to KGMU only after double screening.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Lucknow's King George's Medical University Mother Milk Bank applies multi-layer screening to every donated breast milk before reaching newborns. Donor mothers are screened for HIV-1/2, hepatitis B and C, and syphilis, as well as active tuberculosis, severe infections, fever, sepsis, and high-risk histories or recent transfusions. Even after pasteurization, each milk batch undergoes microbiological testing; if any pathogenic bacteria or infections are detected, the batch is discarded. This double screening is required before any milk is given to neonates, especially preterm, low-birth-weight, or critically ill infants in NICUs, to prevent sepsis, pneumonia, and enteric infections. Detected organisms may include Bacillus cereus, Staphylococcus aureus, Klebsiella, E. coli, Enterobacter, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Acinetobacter, Enterococcus, coagulase-negative Staphylococcus, Candida, and rare Listeria or Salmonella. The protocol emphasizes safety and adherence to international standards to ensure infection-free, nutritious milk.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウニュース: 母乳バンクでHIV、梅毒、細菌を検出——KGMUではダブルスクリーニング後のみ入庫許可
triage.triage_reason: 母乳バンクにおける通常のスクリーニング体制を紹介する記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は病院の母乳バンクにおける標準的な感染症スクリーニングプロトコルの説明であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため対象国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial in DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO vaccine experts urged a randomized trial of Ervebo to test cross-protection against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The outbreak includes 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths. It would be a ring vaccination trial around cases. Ervebo is licensed and effective against the Zaire strain; early animal data hint protection against Bundibugyo, with three of four vaccinated primates surviving and ferrets showing 100% protection. No safety concerns exist for vaccinating contacts, but efficacy against symptomatic disease and transmission in a Phase III trial may be modest, though protection against death is possible. About 87% of cases are in Ituri and 11% in North Kivu. Gavi maintains a 500,000-dose Ervebo stockpile; roughly 55,000 frontline workers in Ituri and North Kivu have been vaccinated previously. Two Bundibugyo vaccines are in early trials, with a third in development; the outbreak could be the largest in DRC history.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行でErvebo(エルベボ)ワクチンの試験を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行が発生し、4,053症例・1,850死亡と深刻な公衆衛生被害があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行はDRC史上最大規模になる可能性があり、WHOがErveboワクチンの交差防御試験（リングワクチン接種）を提言。既存承認株（Zaire株）とは異なる株のため有効性は未確立で、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Jean-Pierre Bemba ordonne le contrôle sanitaire des bateaux avant leur accostage à Maluku - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Jean-Pierre Bemba orders sanitary checks on boats before they dock at Maluku - LePotentiel.
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, Congo's Vice-Prime Minister for Transport, Jean-Pierre Bemba, ordered boats to stop before docking at Maluku port in Kinshasa to allow health teams to screen all passengers as part of strengthened Ebola surveillance. The measure follows a vessel that arrived at Maluku on 5 August after sailing from Kisangani (Tshopo) with more than 200 passengers; it was escorted by naval forces, and a mobile sanitary setup with tents, medical staff, and isolation capacity was deployed with WHO support. The alert centers on a 32-year-old traveler who fell ill in Mongala and died on 25 July with Ebola-compatible symptoms, though no sample was collected before burial, so the death is not confirmed. Authorities are tracing the itinerary and contacts; counts vary (~200–300). At Maluku, temperature checks, clinical exams, sampling, isolation, and ship disinfection were performed. These precautions aim to prevent spread to Kinshasa, 65 km away by river, amid the largest DRC Ebola outbreak since 2018–2020; as of 30 July 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola has 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Why Nova Scotia was chosen to test new Ebola vaccine
article.articleSummary: Moderna's Ebola vaccine targeting Bundibugyo virus begins first-in-human Phase 1 trials at two Nova Scotia sites (Truro and Halifax) and Toronto, enrolling 80 volunteers across Truro, Halifax, and Toronto. The first participant received the vaccine in Truro on Monday. The study primarily assesses safety (injection-site pain, fevers, fatigue) and immunogenicity (antibody response), with intensive monitoring in the first week and ongoing follow-up for a year to detect long-term effects. Recruitment methods include social media, a dedicated website, and a database of past trial volunteers; participants typically receive $50–$100. The outbreak context involves the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has reported about 1,700 deaths and 3,800 infections. If successful, subsequent phases will occur in East Africa near the outbreak zone.

triage.headline_ja: ノバスコシア州が新型エボラワクチンの試験地に選ばれた理由
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はカナダで実施されるエボラワクチンの第1相臨床試験に関する報道であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではない。DRCのアウトブレイクは既知の背景情報として言及されているに過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカナダ（ノバスコシア州・トロント）でのワクチン臨床試験であり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCのエボラ流行への言及は既存の周知情報であり、本記事における新規シグナルとはみなさない。

article.articleHeadline: Propone la OMS probar vacuna existente contra cepa del ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Proposes Testing an Existing Ebola Vaccine Against an Ebola Strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization recommended a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test Ervebo against the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola virus disease amid the current outbreak. Preliminary animal studies suggest Ervebo could offer some protection against this strain, with no major safety concerns detected to date. While developing a vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo remains the best option, Ervebo is viewed as the most viable immediate tool to respond to the health emergency. The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15, but authorities acknowledge the virus circulated weeks earlier in Ituri province, with spread to other parts of the northeast and east. To date, 4,053 cases have been confirmed and 1,850 people have died, making it one of the most severe outbreaks in the country. Trial results will indicate whether the vaccine can help contain spread while research continues toward a strain-specific immunization.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ株に対する既存ワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,053症例・1,850死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 致死率約45.6%と極めて高く、Bundibugyo株に特化したワクチン開発が課題。WHOがErvebo（既存Ebolaワクチン）の臨床試験を提案しており、国際的な対応・支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: Childhood deaths rise; hopes raised over new vaccine
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, eastern DRC, has killed more than 300 children since mid-May; UNICEF notes children account for about a quarter of confirmed cases and roughly one-third of deaths. Pregnant women are at higher risk as health services falter, with maternal deaths nearly doubling; about six women die weekly from childbirth complications and Ebola infection during pregnancy is linked to near-universal fetal loss. Ituri, a conflict-torn province, hosts nearly one million displaced people, with women and children comprising ~80% of the displaced. About 13,000 community health workers have reached over 2.4 million people with prevention/early-detection messages and conducted more than 500,000 household visits. WHO advised evaluating Ervebo in a randomised trial for Bundibugyo virus disease, noting potential cross-protection; Ervebo is licensed for Ebola Zaire, though a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine is preferred. PHEIC declared 16 May; advisory meetings continued through 31 July.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：子どもの死者数増加、新ワクチンへの期待高まる
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが宣言されているエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクで、子ども・妊産婦の死亡が多数報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月16日にPHEICが宣言されたブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク。紛争地帯であるイトゥリ州で医療アクセスが困難な状況にあり、国際的な支援が継続的に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: International experts discuss emerging infectious disease threats at SRMIST
article.articleSummary: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre (SRMIST) hosted the second international conference on Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases at SRMIST, attracting more than 400 delegates, including about 200 students, researchers, and early-career investigators, with roughly 30 national and international speakers. Over two days, sessions addressed pandemic preparedness, HIV pathogenesis, and the broader challenges of emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases. The event underscored the role of interdisciplinary research and durable international partnerships in strengthening global disease preparedness. Key speakers included S.P. Thyagarajan, former Vice-Chancellor of the University of Madras, who urged an integrated approach to combat emerging infections, and Rafick Sekaly, Vice-Chair of Translational Medicine at Emory University, who stressed nurturing the next generation of researchers. SRMIST Dean Sunil Narayan and Dean R. Jayanthi also spoke, highlighting scientific engagement and ongoing efforts at the institution.

triage.headline_ja: SRMISTで新興感染症の脅威について国際専門家が議論
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、学術会議の開催報告であるため、いずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術会議（国際会議）の開催報告であり、実際の感染症発生事例を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fortaleza reduz em 61% número de bairros em risco para dengue, aponta novo levantamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortaleza reduces the number of dengue-risk neighborhoods by 61%, according to a new survey.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza recorded a 61% reduction in Aedes aegypti–infestation risk neighborhoods in the third LIRAa 2026 survey, dropping from 41 to 16 out of 121 neighborhoods. The number of areas deemed satisfactory rose from 18 to 36. The results, released by the Municipal Health Secretariat, reflect improved vector control during the rainy season’s peak and subsequent lower rainfall. LIRAa identifies mosquito presence and breeding sites to target interventions, guiding actions such as home visits, vector monitoring, larviciding and insecticide campaigns, and case blockades for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya arboviruses. Additional measures include tire collection, cleaning campaigns, health education, and installation/monitoring of Larvicide Dissemination Stations (EDL). Fortaleza also conducts cross-city operations (Operação Fronteira) and METROFOR vector-control activities in transport hubs. Community participation remains essential to eliminate standing water and allow access for inspectors across all neighborhoods.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザ、デング熱リスク地区を61%削減、新調査で判明
triage.triage_reason: デング熱等の媒介蚊対策が改善しているという肯定的な内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱リスク地区の減少という改善傾向を報告する内容であり、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の危機を示すものではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、リスク低減の報道であるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: New AI-generated viruses spark biosafety fears
article.articleSummary: Stanford researchers trained an AI model, Evo, to recognize DNA patterns and design viruses never seen in nature that could infect bacterial cells, demonstrating viability in lab experiments. Evo was restricted from data on human-, animal-, plant-, or fungus-infecting viruses to mitigate misuse. Published in Science, the work intensifies biosafety concerns that AI could lower the barrier to dangerous gain-of-function research, prompting calls for strict oversight or bans on such work as a potential next lab-generated pandemic looms, per Rutgers biologist Richard Ebright. Johns Hopkins’ Moritz Hanke and Thomas Inglesby warn governance is lagging behind rapid advances. Proponents like Samuel King of Stanford view phage therapy and alternative solutions to rising antibiotic resistance as potential benefits. The debate references the COVID-19 pandemic and Wuhan, China, to illustrate global biosafety risks and the need for guardrails.

triage.headline_ja: AIが生成した新種ウイルス、バイオセーフティへの懸念を呼ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、AIによるウイルス設計技術とバイオセーフティ政策論議に関する記事であり、具体的な公衆衛生上の発生事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はAIによるバイオセキュリティ研究・ガバナンスに関する論説であり、COVID-19やWuhanは事例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の感染症発生ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah patient recovers, discharged from hospital | Kochi News
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus infection in a 43-year-old Feroke resident treated at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital was discharged after recovery. Infection was confirmed on June 10; he was admitted to the isolation ICU in critical condition on June 11. A special medical board from multiple departments oversaw his treatment. Health authorities obtained remdesivir via intervention by the health minister, sourced from Bahrain. He remained on ventilator support for about one and a half months, then was moved from the isolation ICU to the transit ICU on July 4. Once he began breathing on his own, he was taken off the ventilator and shifted to a regular room. Fever subsided, memory returned to normal, and brain abnormalities seen on scans showed significant improvement. He was discharged on Friday.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス感染患者が回復、退院 | コーチ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高リスク病原体だが、本記事は6月に感染確認済みの単一症例が回復・退院したとの続報であり、新規感染拡大や集団発生の兆候は記載されていない。ケララ州は既知の発生地域であるため、今後の新規症例の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ケララ州コジコード地区は過去にも複数回ニパウイルスのアウトブレイクが発生している既知の流行地域。本記事は単一患者（6月10日感染確認、約1.5ヶ月の人工呼吸器管理を経て回復）の転帰報告であり、新規クラスターの発生は言及されていない。バーレーンはレムデシビルの調達元として言及されているのみで発生地ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les autorités contrôlent les passagers d'un bateau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: authorities screen passengers on a boat.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is being investigated in the Democratic Republic of Congo after authorities intercepted the Yingfeng 2 near Kinshasa. A 32-year-old man aboard reportedly died on July 25 with Ebola-like symptoms and had not been tested. To prevent spread to Kinshasa (population >17 million), health teams are conducting temperature checks and clinical screening on all passengers. A mobile laboratory has been deployed about 65 kilometers upstream from Kinshasa, and samples have been taken from four passengers with fever; results were due on Aug 7, 2026. The vessel, with a 200-seat capacity, appears to have carried more than 300 people, expanding screening challenges. Passengers arrived on Aug 5; authorities continue to determine where the deceased contracted the virus and whether there is any epidemiological link to Kisangani, where imported Ebola cases have occurred. The goal is to ensure no case enters Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:当局が船の乗客を検査
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い死亡例が発生し、大都市キンシャサへの拡大リスクがあるため、公衆衛生上の重大性と国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 300人以上が乗船した船での未確認死亡例があり、検査結果待ち。キサンガニとの疫学的関連性も調査中で、続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde SP orienta vacinação contra o sarampo e esclarece dúvidas sobre a campanha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Health Department guides measles vaccination and clarifies questions about the campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts mass MMR vaccination in São Paulo state, Brazil, with 23 confirmed cases as of 7 August 2026. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat directs mass MMR vaccination for residents aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo city, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo to curb transmission. In other municipalities, teams should review records and update overdue doses. Pregnant women should not receive the MMR vaccine; individuals with severe immunodeficiency or a history of serious allergic reactions to vaccine components should avoid vaccination. Lactating women may be vaccinated. Already immunized individuals may receive the MMR dose if no contraindication and the interval after other live vaccines is respected. Two of the 23 cases were imported; the rest are linked to local transmission. Stocks are sufficient, with 150,000 doses to São Paulo city and 80,000 to São Bernardo do Campo; Multivacinação continues for under 15s.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局、麻疹ワクチン接種を推奨しキャンペーンに関する疑問に回答
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹の地域内伝播が確認され（23例中大半が国内感染）、大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルRRAでの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 23例中21例が地域内感染とされ、麻疹排除国であったブラジルでの再流行の可能性が示唆される。ワクチン在庫は十分とされ、現時点で外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RedeTV! ES: Guarapari emite alerta após aumento de casos de catapora e reforça cuidados para evitar transmissão - 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RedeTV! ES: Guarapari issues alert after rise in chickenpox cases and reinforces precautions to prevent transmission - 2026.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak in Guarapari, Espírito Santo, Brazil, prompts municipal health alert as of Aug 6, 2026, with rising confirmed cases and notifications under investigation. The Health Secretariat's coordinator notes ongoing case investigations and urges individuals with suspected or confirmed infection to abstain from work or school until their skin lesions have completely healed to prevent transmission. Patients should seek care if fever exceeds 38.5°C, headaches, malaise, red lesions that progress to vesicles and crusts, and intense itching. While commonly pediatric, varicella can be more severe in pregnant women, adults, and immunocompromised persons. The Guarapari City Hall emphasizes that varicella vaccination is free and available at local health units for those eligible under the National Vaccination Calendar.

triage.headline_ja: RedeTV! ES：グアラパリ市、水疱瘡症例増加を受けて警報を発令し、感染防止対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症であり、ワクチンも存在し地域の公衆衛生対応も通常の範囲内であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とする。地域の健康局が通常の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種呼びかけ、感染者への就業・登校自粛要請）を行っているのみで、国際的懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak: WHO Recommends Ervebo Vaccine Trial Amid Crisis
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, with more than 4,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths, prompts WHO to approve Ervebo in a Phase III trial to assess protection against the Bundibugyo strain. Ervebo is the only licensed Ebola vaccine and has shown strong protection against the Zaire strain. WHO vaccine advisory group notes animal studies indicating potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo, and finds no major safety concerns for a trial, given extensive prior use in Africa. However, officials caution that vaccination may not fully prevent infection or transmission, but could reduce severe illness and fatalities. A vaccine specifically developed for Bundibugyo remains the preferred solution, with several candidates in early testing. Expanding research and vaccination strategies are deemed crucial to slow the outbreak's spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ流行:WHOがEbovoワクチンの試験実施を推奨、危機的状況下で
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4,000例超、死者1,800人超）が継続しており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWHOの緊急対応（ワクチン臨床試験承認）から国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン効果は未確定であり、続報でのフェーズIII試験結果の推移を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Covid cases turn moderately severe, H1N1 triggers more ICU admissions amid flu vaccine complacency
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 infections in Pune are increasingly moderate-to-moderately severe, with ICU admissions, ventilator support and ARDS reported. H1N1 influenza has emerged as the more serious respiratory threat this monsoon, driving ICU admissions and severe cases. Maharashtra state data show 427 confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases and four deaths through July 31. Experts link the surge to favorable weather for viral transmission and waning annual flu vaccination after the Covid era. Some H1N1 patients progress from upper to lower respiratory infections and pneumonia; ventilator support has been needed and there have been one or two deaths, with many patients unvaccinated. Covid-19 is described as endemic, with population immunity falling and broader testing likely to reveal more cases. Risk is higher for elderly individuals and those with comorbidities such as diabetes or obesity.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ感染が中等度から中等度重症化、ワクチン接種への慢心の中でH1N1がICU入院を増加させている
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1流行とCOVID-19の地域的増加であり、重症例やICU入院はあるものの、インド・マハーラーシュトラ州における例年のモンスーン期の流行パターンの範囲内とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はプネー市・マハーラーシュトラ州における季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）とCOVID-19の増加を報じるローカルニュース。ワクチン接種率低下と季節要因（モンスーン）が要因とされ、国家レベル・国際的な異常事態としての報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: EU Authorizes Mpox Vaccine for Toddlers, Closing Deadly Gap for DRC Children
article.articleSummary: European Commission approves Bavarian Nordic's IMVANEX mpox/smallpox vaccine for children aged 2–11, the first major regulatory clearance of a non-replicating mpox vaccine for this age group, addressing a fatal gap in DRC where children under 15 represent about 60% of mpox cases and roughly 80% of deaths (UNICEF, 2024). The decision, adopted Aug 7, 2026, follows EMA/CHMP positive opinion (June 22–25, 2026) and extends EU authorization to ages two and up; the vaccine is marketed as IMVANEX in the EU and JYNNEOS in the US. A Phase 2 trial in the DRC and Uganda (NCT06549530) enrolled 227 children 2–11 and 224 adults; two doses 4 weeks apart; two weeks after dose 2, pediatric responses were non-inferior and 2.5× higher than adults, with safety similar to adults. MVA-BN cannot replicate in human cells, a key safety feature. In Sept–Oct 2024, 265,000 doses arrived in the DRC, but campaigns mainly targeted adults due to authorization gaps.

triage.headline_ja: EUがトイストマー年齢(乳幼児)向けのMpoxワクチンを承認、DRCの子どもにおける致死的なギャップを埋める
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるmpoxの小児死亡率の高さ（死亡の約80%が15歳未満）が改めて強調されており、ワクチン接種ギャップという公衆衛生上の課題が継続していることから、既存の深刻な流行状況とその対応（ワクチン供給・承認）に関する重要な進展としてフルRRAでの経過確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はEUによるワクチン承認（規制上のニュース）が主題であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないが、DRCにおける既存のmpox流行の深刻さ（小児死亡率）とワクチンアクセスの課題を示す重要な背景情報として位置づけられる。米国・ウガンダは規制承認国・臨床試験実施国として言及されているのみで、発生地域として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: A l'issue d'une visite en RDC, le chef de l'OMS appelle à intensifier la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following a visit to the DRC, the WHO chief calls for intensifying the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is outpacing response efforts. Following a joint mission in Uganda (Kampala) and DRC, WHO and Africa CDC urge immediate scale-up, centering communities. About 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths have been reported across 51 health zones in five provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter (roughly 90% of infections); Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu are among the hardest hit. Contact tracing is around 75%, far from the 95% target; North Kivu treatment centers operate at 139% capacity. Priorities include earlier detection, 95% daily contact follow-up, closer access to testing and treatment, stronger labs, ambulances, and safe, dignified burials; protect health workers with PPE and pay. Ervebo is being considered in a randomized trial against Bundibugyo; efficacy against this strain remains unproven, while a strain-specific vaccine is awaited. Kinshasa meetings with President Tshisekedi aim to accelerate coordination and funding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国訪問後、WHO事務局長がエボラ対応の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例約4,000人、死者1,800人超の大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が拡大中で、WHO・Africa CDCが対応強化を要請しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文では合同ミッション訪問先として言及されているのみで、症例発生の主題はDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : début des essais d'un vaccin en Nouvelle-Écosse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Vaccine trials begin in Nova Scotia.
article.articleSummary: Moderna launches a Phase 1 Ebola vaccine trial in Canada for Bundibugjo ebolavirus. Health Canada authorized the study this week, enrolling about 80 healthy adults at three sites: Halifax and Truro, Nova Scotia, and Toronto, Ontario. The trial assesses safety and immunogenicity, monitoring adverse effects (fatigue, fever, injection-site pain) and antibody responses. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola; the Democratic Republic of Congo reports a rapidly expanding outbreak with more than 1,700 deaths and about 3,800 infections since mid-May. Vaccinations begin next week, with an initial small group dosed and monitored for about a week before others join. Recruitment is via social media and the center’s site, with modest compensation ($50–$100). The effort runs through 2027, with the next development phase expected in East Africa contingent on results and approvals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ノバスコシア州でワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: 記事本体はカナダでのワクチン治験だが、コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる急速に拡大するアウトブレイク（死者1,700人超、感染者約3,800人）が発生しており、ワクチンが存在しない深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはカナダ（ワクチン治験実施国）が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。実際のアウトブレイクはDRCで発生しており、Bundibugyoエボラに対するワクチンが存在しない点、致死率・感染規模が非常に大きい点から重大事案と判断。モザンビークも発生地域に挙がっているが記事本文中で言及がなく確認不能のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 傳播速度史上最快！民主剛果爆第二大疫情，確診破4千奪1850命 | 中央社 | ESG遠見
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest spread in history! The Democratic Republic of the Congo's second-largest outbreak, with over 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 4,000 confirmed cases with about 1,850 deaths as of August 7, 2026, per the DRC public health institute. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 fatalities reported. A Science journal study suggests the virus was circulating in Ituri as early as January, with over 500 suspected cases by May 15. The spread is described as the fastest on record, impeded by reporting delays, overwhelmed surveillance, ongoing military conflict, and the absence of vaccines or treatments for this strain. By comparison, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak exceeded 28,000 cases, but this current event ranks as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速の感染拡大！コンゴ民主共和国で第二の大規模流行、確定症例4000人超・死者1850人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州で4,000人超の感染・1,850人の死亡と大規模化し、史上最速の拡大速度、有効なワクチン・治療法の欠如、軍事紛争による対応困難など公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事では当該株に対するワクチン・治療法が存在しないと明記されており、軍事紛争下でのサーベイランス崩壊も拡大要因とされている。Angolaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文で言及がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola cases surpass 4 000 as more than 300 children die: UN
article.articleSummary: As of Friday, 7 August 2026, Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo surpassed 4,000 with 1,850 deaths. In Ituri province, children and women bear a disproportionate burden: UNICEF reports more than 330 children have died since the outbreak began, with children accounting for about a quarter of confirmed cases but nearly a third of deaths. Maternal deaths have nearly doubled, averaging about six childbirth-related deaths per week. Fear has driven health-service disruption, with use of services in the hardest-hit areas down by more than 40%. UNICEF and partners have deployed 13,000 community workers, reaching over 2.4 million people. The World Health Organization advised a clinical trial in Congo of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者数が4000人を超え、子ども300人以上が死亡：国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCイトゥリ州で大規模流行（症例4000人超、死者1850人）し、医療サービス崩壊や国際支援（WHO・UNICEF）が動員されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行の継続報道。死者数・症例数の増加、医療体制崩壊、WHOによる臨床試験実施の動きなど、継続的な監視とフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma mais 7 casos de sarampo e total sobe para 23; veja onde estão os registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP confirms seven more measles cases and total rises to 23; see where the cases are registered.
article.articleSummary: Seven additional measles cases were confirmed in São Paulo State, raising the 2026 total to 23. New cases: 20 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, and 1 in Guarulhos. The Health Secretariat urges measles vaccination for everyone aged 6 months to 59 years in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, regardless of prior vaccination history, aligning with a Health Ministry expansion after identifying a transmission chain linked to importation; infection sources remain unknown. A Multivaccination Campaign began July 3 to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15, aiming to boost coverage and curb transmission. The measles vaccine is free via SUS and part of the National Vaccination Schedule for 12 months to 59 years; a 6–11 month dose zero is advised during outbreaks. In 2026, over 7.2 million triple-viral doses distributed; ~2.9 million administered; 2025 coverage was 92.9% first dose and 78.3% second.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹7例確認、累計23例に；発生地域を確認
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明の麻疹伝播チェーンがサンパウロ州で継続しており、当局が予防接種拡大対応を行っているが、重症例・国際的拡大の明確な情報はなく、続報の注視が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の輸入関連伝播チェーンが継続しており、州政府はワクチン接種キャンペーンを拡大中。重症度・国際的拡大に関する情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Licensed Ebola vaccine could be used in Congo outbreak, WHO advisors say
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 4,000+ Ebola cases and 1,852 deaths (CDC), the second-largest outbreak on record, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Insecurity and response barriers hinder contact tracing, with Africa CDC noting about 80% of new infections arise from unknown sources; the outbreak reached 1,000 cases in 40 days, far faster than the 2018 episode. WHO advisory group recommended testing Merck's Ervebo—licensed against Orthoebolavirus zairense—in a phase 3 trial in DRC, citing lab data suggesting cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Separately, the Oxford Vaccine Group started a phase 1 trial of ChAdOx1 BDBV targeting Bundibugyo, first healthy volunteer dosed; Moderna began a phase 1 trial of mRNA-1469, with Health Canada authorization. WHO DG Tedros, meeting officials in Kinshasa, urged rapid, scaled-up response led by communities, as new cases continue to rise with ongoing, severe transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO専門家、コンゴのエボラ流行に既承認ワクチンの使用を提言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で、死者1,852人・症例4,000人超、感染拡大速度が過去を上回っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、既承認ワクチン（Ervebo）の交差防御性を検証する第3相試験や複数の新規ワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV、mRNA-1469）の第1相試験が進行中。治安悪化による接触者追跡困難、新規感染の約8割が感染源不明という点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola supera 4.000 casos confirmados en República Democrática del Congo - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 4,053 confirmed cases as of August 5, up from 3,000 two weeks earlier, with a case fatality rate of 45.7%. From May 15 to August 5, 694 patients remain isolated or hospitalized, 793 have recovered, and contact tracing stands at 77.7%. Affected provinces are Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele in the east, and Tshopo in the center-north. On July 31, the seventeenth outbreak in the DRC became the second-most-contagious in the country’s history, after the 2018–2020 crisis (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Globally, only the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak had more. The World Health Organization notes rapid growth; the virus is Bundibugyo, with a 30–50% fatality range and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、確定症例が4,000例を超える - テレスール
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（確定症例4,053例、致死率45.7%）が急速に拡大しており、IHR基準（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく主題国ではないため除外。北キブ州は対象国リストにないがDRC国内のため国単位でDRCとして計上。

article.articleHeadline: Russia comes out with test kit for diagnosing Bundibugyo virus -- sanitary watchdog
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus PCR diagnostic kit developed by Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor offers high-sensitivity, high-specificity detection for the Ebola-related Bundibugyo virus, including in early infection when symptoms are nonspecific and may mimic malaria. The kit, with officially registered reagents, was evaluated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, and also deployed to the Republic of the Congo. Validation involved outbreak epicenters and comparative trials against other countries’ test systems, with strong on-the-ground performance. By 2026-08-07, more than 7,500 tests had been delivered to African countries, enhancing regional diagnostic capacity and biosurveillance amid the ongoing Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The effort highlights international collaboration to strengthen biosecurity and diagnostic independence. Keywords: outbreak, diagnostic kit, PCR, Bundibugyo virus, DRC, Uganda, Republic of the Congo, biosurveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、ブンディブギョウイルス診断用検査キットを開発――衛生当局
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）およびウガンダで進行中とされるブンディブギョウウイルス（エボラ関連）の流行に言及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事本文は主にロシア製診断キットの開発・配布に関する内容だが、DRCおよびウガンダで進行中のブンディブギョウウイルス（エボラ）流行の存在を裏付けている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。続報でDRCにおける症例数・死亡数等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue mobiliza 90 agentes em quatro bairros de Limeira neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control drive mobilizes 90 agents in four Limeira neighborhoods this Saturday
article.articleSummary: Dengue control campaign in Limeira, Brazil mobilizes 90 agents to inspect homes and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites this Saturday, 8 August, from 7:30 to 12:00 in four neighborhoods: Jardim Residencial Alto do Flamboyant; Parque Residencial Santa Eulália; Jardim Residencial Vitória; and Jardim Residencial Santina Paroli. Health workers will search for containers and other water-collecting sites to curb mosquito proliferation and will educate residents. Entry permission is requested; personnel will wear uniforms and ID badges. Residents are urged to permit entry and to inspect yards and lots, removing objects that can collect water. Eliminating standing water in pots, containers, gutters, tires, and other items is a key preventive measure against dengue transmission. The mutirão is part of the municipality’s preventive actions to reduce breeding sites and raise dengue awareness in Limeira.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラの4地区で今週土曜日にデング熱対策のため90人の担当者が動員される
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防・蚊駆除活動の告知であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の一地方都市（リメイラ、サンパウロ州）での定例的な蚊駆除・啓発活動を報じるものであり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Seven passengers on boat intercepted near Kinshasa test negative for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Seven passengers on a boat intercepted near Kinshasa tested negative for Ebola. About 300 passengers underwent temperature checks and clinical screening, with a mobile laboratory deployed at the site. Only seven were tested for Ebola because infected individuals are not contagious before symptoms appear, according to Jean-Jacques Muyembe, head of Congo's National Institute for Biomedical Research. All seven tests were negative; the boat was decontaminated and passengers received food and medical assistance. Health officials expanded screening to all boats arriving in Kinshasa to prevent spread to the capital, which has over 17 million residents. The Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 has surpassed 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths across five eastern provinces in Congo, based on latest government data.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ近郊で拿捕された船の乗客7人、エボラ検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000例超・死者1,850人超に拡大しているエボラ流行が、人口1,700万人の首都キンシャサへの拡大リスクとして船舶検疫を強化している状況であり、公衆衛生への影響及び国際拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は陰性結果の報告だが、既に4,000例超・死者1,850人超に達している東部5州のエボラ流行が首都キンシャサへ波及するリスクへの対応強化を示すものであり、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの重要な進展として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Appel de l'OMS et des CDC Afrique en faveur d'un engagement international accru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola — WHO and Africa CDC call for increased international engagement.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts a joint call by the WHO and Africa CDC for intensified international engagement to secure safe access for response teams and protect civilians and health workers. As of 7 August 2026, DRC reports about 4,000 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 1,800 deaths across 51 health zones in five provinces since the outbreak began. Ituri remains the epicentre, accounting for roughly 90% of infections, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu among the hardest-hit zones. Treatment centers are under mounting pressure, with Nord-Kivu occupancy at 139%, straining capacity and staff. Contact tracing stands at 75% versus an operational target of 95%, hindering rapid interruption of transmission. The call follows a WHO-Africa CDC mission to Uganda and the DRC; Tedros stresses urgent international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱—WHOとアフリカCDCが国際的関与の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約4,000人の確定患者、1,800人超の死者を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、国際的拡大リスクと重大な公衆衛生への影響が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOとアフリカCDCが国際支援を要請しており、ウガンダ・ルワンダへの越境リスクも懸念されるが、記事の主題はDRC国内の流行であるためverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。治療センターの占有率139%、接触者追跡率75%（目標95%）など、対応能力の逼迫が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos de sarampo em SP provoca corrida por vacinação e gera filas em ao menos 100 postos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in measles cases in São Paulo triggers a rush to get vaccinated and leads to queues at least 100 vaccination posts.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases rise in São Paulo state, Brazil, triggering a mass vaccination drive. As of 7 August 2026, São Paulo city accounts for 20 of 23 state cases, with 2 in São Bernardo do Campo and 1 in Guarulhos. A booster dose is recommended for all people 6 months to 59 years; 153 vaccination posts reported long queues, and the Secretariat of Health distributed 150,000 doses to the capital and 80,000 to São Bernardo do Campo. Authorities urge vaccination in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo regardless of prior vaccination status. A multivaccination campaign for under-15s began on 3 August. On Tuesday, the 28th, the Ministry expanded the recommendation to 6–59 years in the three cities due to a transmission chain linked to virus importation; infection source remains unknown. Vaccination is free via SUS; dose zero for 6–11 months when circulating. In 2026, 7.2M doses distributed, 2.9M administered; 2025 national D1 92.9%, D2 78.3%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例増加、ワクチン接種殺到により少なくとも100か所の接種所で行列発生
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認証国であったブラジルにおいて輸入株による伝播連鎖が確認され、複数都市でワクチン接種対象年齢が拡大されるなど公衆衛生上の対応が強化されており、社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（サンパウロ市、サンベルナルドドカンポ、グアルリョス）で輸入株による麻疹伝播連鎖が発生。ワクチン接種対象を6ヶ月〜59歳に拡大し大規模接種キャンペーンを実施中。重症度・死亡例の情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Worst-hit Sitapur now sees malaria cases fall
article.articleSummary: Sitapur emerged as UP's worst malaria-hit district in 2025 with 3,643 cases (about 25% of the state's 14,593) and one malaria death. Hardoi 1,481; Shahjahanpur 1,179; Pilibhit 707; Lucknow ranked fifth with 676 cases (573 indigenous, 103 imported), with imported cases over 15% of Lucknow's burden. IDSP UP Joint Director Dr Vikasendu Agarwal attributes high caseload to rural mosquito breeding, waterlogging and delayed detection; two Sitapur blocks were severely affected in 2025, but intensified surveillance and vector-control have contained the outbreak this year, with around 400 cases in 2026. Lucknow improved to 192 cases till August 2026 vs 396 in the same period 2025, and has seen no malaria deaths in three years. District malaria officer Dr Ritu Srivastava notes surveillance in labour colonies, construction sites and waterlogged areas, plus anti-larval drives. Experts urge sustained vigilance to prevent a resurgence as monsoon persists.

triage.headline_ja: 最も被害の大きかったシタープルでマラリア症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: 地域的な季節性マラリア流行の経年比較記事であり、症例数は前年より減少傾向にあり、対策も既に機能しているため、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州の風土病であり、記事は監視・対策の成果を報告する内容。症例は前年比で減少しており新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: US tightens travel rules for people returning from Ebola-hit regions
article.articleSummary: US tightens travel rules for travelers returning from Ebola-hit regions Uganda, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of 2026-08-07. Temporary restrictions apply to certain passengers who recently visited these Ebola-affected countries to reduce transmission risk. The measures are part of ongoing U.S. public health protocols for travelers arriving from areas affected by Ebola. The Reuters report provides no case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmations, or infection source details. No further outbreak specifics are given. This action underscores heightened border vigilance to prevent imported Ebola cases and protect domestic public health.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行地域からの帰国者に対する渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 米国がウガンダ・南スーダン・DRCのエボラ流行地域からの渡航者に対し規制を強化しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航規制強化についてであり、ウガンダ・南スーダンでの発生状況の詳細（症例数、症状、検査確認等）は本記事に含まれない。対象国リストにDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。ウガンダ・南スーダンでの流行実態については別途情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Health worker fights Ebola outbreak while awaiting paycheck
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, Congo's eastern Ituri province is the epicenter of the ongoing Ebola outbreak, described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. At an Ebola treatment hospital in Ituri, 29-year-old health worker Wiza Bondele goes to work daily to slow transmission, disinfecting contaminated areas, checking visitors' temperatures, and enforcing handwashing protocols, actions that put him at high risk of infection. The report notes frontline workers facing severe risk and financial strain, with Bondele working while awaiting paycheck. The piece highlights the human cost of the outbreak and the crucial role of hospital staff in outbreak containment, even as resources and payment issues persist.

triage.headline_ja: 医療従事者、給与未払いのままエボラ出血熱の流行と闘う
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・イトゥリ州で「史上最速の拡大」とされるエボラ流行が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は現地医療従事者の待遇問題を中心に報じているが、背景として『史上最速拡大』とされるエボラ流行の深刻さが強調されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: OMS pide priorizar uso de la vacuna Ervebo ante brote de Ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urges prioritization of the use of the Ervebo vaccine amid Ebola outbreak in the DRC
article.articleSummary: On 7 August 2026, WHO urged prioritizing the Ervebo vaccine in human clinical trials to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has more than 4,000 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths. A WHO technical advisory group found preclinical data indicate Ervebo provides some protection against the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain responsible for the outbreak. In primates, survival reached up to 75%; in ferrets, 100%. Vaccinated animals exhibited lower viral loads and less severe disease. Ervebo is approved only for Zaire ebolavirus, while Bundibugyo is less common and has no commercial vaccine or specific therapy. Antibody responses against Bundibugyo are weaker than against Zaire, though neutralizing activity remains. The plan proposes randomized vaccination of direct contacts in affected areas. The committee’s guidance follows WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern, and signals readiness to start clinical trials without compromising safety.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行に対しErveboワクチンの優先使用を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4,000例超・死亡1,850人規模のエボラ流行がPHEIC宣言済みであり、WHOがワクチン優先使用を呼びかけるなど国際的関心・対応が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 既にWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）。フルRRA対象として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS recomenda testar vacina contra ebola durante surto na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends testing an Ebola vaccine during an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the World Health Organization recommends testing the Ervebo Ebola vaccine in an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Bundibugyo variant drives transmission and for which no licensed vaccine exists. Ervebo was developed against a different Ebola strain (Zaire ebolavirus), but preliminary animal data suggest it may offer some protection and show no major safety concerns. The WHO notes that developing a strain-specific vaccine remains the ideal solution, yet in the current context Ervebo is the best available candidate for clinical evaluation. Congolese authorities report 4,053 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths since the outbreak began. This represents a targeted clinical trial approach rather than a blanket deployment, pending further efficacy and safety data.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行下でワクチンの試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続し、確定症例4,053例・死亡1,850例に達しており、WHOが未承認ワクチンの臨床試験を推奨するなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で致死率が高く（約45.6%）、既存承認ワクチン（Ervebo）は別株用であるためWHOが試験的使用を推奨。国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: न माउथपीस बदल रहे न कैलिब्रेशन, चेकिंग के नाम पर बांट रहे इंफेक्शन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: Neither mouthpieces nor calibration are being changed; in the name of checking, infections are being spread.
article.articleSummary: Agra, India reports gaps in infection control during the Drink-and-Drive campaign using breath analyzers at dusk at key intersections (God Temple cinema area, Delhi Gate, MG Road). Although officials claim mouthpieces are changed after every test, inspections show reuse of mouthpieces, risking spread of bacteria and viruses. About 50 upgraded breath analyzers were recently supplied; disposable mouthpieces arrived, but several locations still reuse older pieces. On an average day, over 100 drivers test positive for alcohol; penalties under the Motor Vehicles Act apply for levels above the limit. Some officers wipe or clean mouthpieces and reuse them; health experts say disposable mouthpieces must be single-use. Rules require a separate mouthpiece per person, proper device preparation, mandatory change after each use, and periodic calibration. False positives can occur due to mouthwash, medicines, or food, prompting re-testing. Diseases of concern include influenza, TB, and COVID. Dr. Vinay Goel and Sonam Kumar comment on enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: アグラニュース：マウスピースも交換せず校正もせず、飲酒検査の名目で感染を拡散
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、飲酒検問時の器具衛生管理の不備を指摘する一般的な公衆衛生記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準への該当は認められない。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、飲酒検問における器具（マウスピース）の再利用による感染リスクを指摘する地域ニュース記事。特定の疾患発生や症例数の急増は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: US tightens travel rules for people returning from Ebola-hit regions
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, the United States tightened travel rules for people who recently visited Ebola-affected regions, focusing on Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). US citizens and US nationals who have been in Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days before US arrival must route air travel through designated US airports for public health entry screening, even if they only transited through the country. Travelers who have been in the DRC within 21 days before departure will not be allowed to board commercial flights to the United States and must stay outside the US until 21 days have elapsed since leaving DRC. Those who visited Ebola-affected provinces in the DRC may face additional local requirements before departure. If Ebola is suspected, patients are transferred to a hospital for medical evaluation, isolation, and care, per CDC guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ発生地域からの帰国者に対する渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国(DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン)での発生を受け、米国が渡航制限措置を実施しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航規制強化に関するものだが、根本原因はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Guarapari emite alerta de aumento de casos de catapora; veja sintomas e prevenção - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarapari issues an alert about a rise in chickenpox (varicella) cases; see symptoms and prevention - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: Guarapari, Brazil, issued an alert about a rise in chickenpox (varicella) cases, with vaccination emphasized as prevention. The Municipal Health Secretariat notes the disease is highly contagious and can affect all ages, but is more severe in pregnant people, adults, and those with weakened immunity. Common symptoms include high fever, body aches, malaise, and skin lesions that are red, painful, or pus-filled, often with loss of appetite. Varicella transmits via airborne particles and droplets from talking, coughing, or sneezing, as well as direct contact with lesion fluid and shared objects. Transmission typically occurs one to two days before lesions appear and continues until all blisters crust over. The alert reflects ongoing monitoring by Guarapari’s health authorities and underscores vaccination to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: グアラパリ市、水痘（水疱瘡）症例増加に関する警告を発令；症状と予防法について - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な既知の感染症で、地方自治体レベルの通常の公衆衛生広報にとどまり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 水痘はワクチンで予防可能な既知の疾患であり、ブラジルの一地方都市の保健当局が住民向けに注意喚起した内容。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本イベントの性質上シグナルとしての重要性は低いためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Guarapari registra aumento de casos de catapora e faz alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guarapari records a rise in chickenpox cases and issues a warning
article.articleSummary: Guarapari reports rising chickenpox (Varicella) cases; municipal health surveillance confirms cases with others under investigation and ongoing monitoring to curb transmission. Infected individuals with suspected or confirmed varicella should remain away from school and work until all lesions have crusted. Varicella-zóster is highly contagious, spreading via airborne particles and direct contact with vesicle fluid or contaminated objects. Common symptoms include fever, headache, malaise, red rash that evolves into vesicles and crusts, with intense itching; contagious before lesions appear and until crusts form. Vaccination is the main prevention, freely available through the SUS; residents should keep their vaccination cards up to date. Additional measures to reduce transmission include frequent handwashing, avoiding contact with the sick, and not sharing personal items. Those with symptoms are urged to seek a health unit for evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: グアラパリ市、水痘症例の増加を確認し注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 水痘（水疱瘡）はワクチンで予防可能な一般的な小児感染症であり、単一自治体での症例増加は国際的公衆衛生上の脅威に該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルの通常疾患であり、感染力はあるがワクチンで予防可能、重症例や死亡の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: veja os cuidados e quem deve se vacinar após alta de casos em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: See the Precautions and Who Should Be Vaccinated After a Surge in Cases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles in São Paulo State reaches 23 confirmed cases in 2026; Campinas reports no confirmed cases since 2021 but maintains preventive measures. In 2025 Campinas achieved 98.3% first-dose and 92.4% second-dose coverage of the MMR vaccine. Public health actions include multivaccination campaigns and guidance to schools and hospitals. Measles is highly contagious, spread by respiratory secretions, with transmission possible before rash. Symptoms: fever, red rash, runny nose, cough, and conjunctivitis; incubation 7–21 days. Vaccination (MMR): first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; ages 5–29 two doses; ages 30–59 one dose; health workers two doses. Higher-risk groups for severe disease include children under 5, pregnant people, immunosuppressed, and vitamin A deficiency. No specific treatment; suspected cases should seek care, and during transmission, isolate to protect vulnerable groups; Campinas facilities are prepared.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：サンパウロ州での症例急増を受けた注意事項とワクチン接種対象者について
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は感染力が強く注意を要するが、サンパウロ州の23例は局所的でブラジル国内の予防接種体制も整っており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州における麻疹症例増加を受けた予防接種呼びかけの一般向け公衆衛生情報であり、国際的な緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Após 5 dias trancado, pitbull que atacou tutor no Mondubim é retirado para exames de raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After five days locked up, the pit bull that attacked its owner in Mondubim is taken for rabies tests.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-related observations in Fortaleza, Brazil: A pit bull that attacked its owner in Mondubim was moved on August 6 for veterinary observation and rabies testing, coordinated by the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ) under the Municipal Health Secretariat. The dog will remain under observation for about ten days, after which it is expected to be returned to its guardians, subject to public authorities' authorization. The owner remains hospitalized from injuries sustained in the weekend attack. The dog had reportedly been left alone for five days inside the residence without water or food. Leishmaniasis testing returned negative. SPA-CE indicated two guardians prepared to assume responsible custody, pending official assessment. The attack occurred on Saturday, August 1, at Travessa Jaboticaba, Mondubim; police and neighbors contained the animal and provided initial care to the victim.

triage.headline_ja: 5日間監禁後、モンドゥビンで飼い主を襲ったピットブルが狂犬病検査のため搬送される
triage.triage_reason: 個別の犬による飼い主への咬傷事故であり、公衆衛生上の広範な脅威や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない単発事例。
triage.notes: 個別の動物咬傷事故に関する地域ニュース記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Eggs, El Niño and Ebola: Week in Review
article.articleSummary: Rare Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo drives the fastest-growing epidemic on record. The Congo strain likely spills over from fruit bats and spreads through bodily fluids; people remain contagious after death, making burial practices a key driver and stressing healthcare systems. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this strain; early supportive care—managing blood pressure and dehydration—can improve survival. In Virginia, health authorities report the state's first locally acquired dengue case, a mosquito-borne illness in which roughly one in four infected people become sick. Separately, El Niño is projected to cost more than $600 billion globally, fueling heat waves, food shortages and crop failures, infrastructure damage, and higher air-conditioning use; energy prices may spike, with cooling measures adopted in parts of Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 卵、エルニーニョ、そしてエボラ：週間レビュー
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録上最速の増加を示す稀なエボラ流行が発生しており、治療法・ワクチンが存在しない致死的疾患であるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国バージニア州のデング熱国内感染例は対象国外のため除外。記事は複数トピックの週間レビューで、エボラに関する記述が主要な公衆衛生シグナルとなる。承認された治療法・ワクチンがないコンゴ株のエボラ流行で、記録上最速の拡大速度とされる点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Estudantes de Barretos transformam aprendizado em ação contra as arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barretos students turn learning into action against arboviral diseases.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, Brazil — A collaboration between USP's Ribeirão Preto’s Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences (FCFRP) and Leodete Silverio Jói Municipal School turned science learning into community action on arboviruses. After a June campus visit where the group toured research labs and participated in Aedes aegypti control activities led by researcher Danillo Espósito, students developed a project showcased at the Municipal Elementary Schools' Science Fair (Aug 4–6). The students highlighted mosquito-control strategies, including the concept of genetically modified mosquitoes nicknamed 'hero mosquitoes.' Back at school, the knowledge spread to the community during the fair, with the stand presenting dengue, Zika, and chikungunya prevention and the role of science in public health. Espósito delivered a supplementary lecture on the topic.

triage.headline_ja: バレトスの学生たち、学びを蚊媒介性感染症対策の行動へと転換
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学校での啓発活動・科学フェアに関する教育的内容であり、実際の感染症流行や症例報告を伝えるものではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の予防に関する学生の教育プロジェクトを紹介するものであり、実際の症例発生や流行状況についての報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള പ്രതിസന്ധി രൂക്ഷമെന്ന് യൂണിസെഫ്: 743 കുട്ടികൾക്ക് രോഗബാധ, 330 പേർ മരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF says the Ebola crisis in Congo is severe: 743 children infected, 330 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens: UNICEF reports 743 children infected and 330 dead as of August 2, 2026 (announced August 6). Transmission fears and limited health-service access are driving care avoidance, says UNICEF representative John Agbor. From April–June 2026, essential health services declined about 42% in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nisi, and Rwampar. UNICEF tags this as the country’s largest and fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak. In response, the Ministry of Health, WHO, and partners have deployed roughly 13,000 community health workers and conducted awareness campaigns reaching over 2.4 million people to curb transmission and restore trust in health services. To scale life-saving interventions and strengthen basic treatment facilities, $113.45 million is needed, but about $89.9 million remains unfunded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ危機が深刻化とユニセフ:743人の子供が感染、330人死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大かつ最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生しており、多数の死者と資金不足が報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 国際機関(UNICEF, WHO)が関与し、資金不足($89.9M)も報告されており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。渡航・貿易制限の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات متزايدة من الكوليرا في تشاد تجاوزت 13 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cholera deaths in Chad have surpassed 13 cases.
