article.articleSummary: Chad reports a rising cholera outbreak with 239 cases and 13 deaths as of the last Monday since the July 24 start. Most infections are in the capital N'Djamena and the Hadjer-Lamé region in the north; 11 of the fatalities occurred in August, with the first death on June 13, signaling silent spread before official confirmation. About 50,800 people have received the preventive cholera vaccine since the declaration. Cholera spreads through contaminated food and water and is highly treatable with rehydration and antibiotics, though death can occur within hours without timely care. Authorities tie ongoing transmission to limited access to safe drinking water and weak sanitation. The Chad outbreak sits within a broader regional pattern, with outbreaks in the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo, and Nigeria, underscoring Africa-wide public health challenges. In high-income countries with modern wastewater treatment, cholera has largely been eliminated, highlighting infrastructure gaps in Chad.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラによる死者数が増加、13人を超える
triage.triage_reason: チャドでのコレラ流行は重症度・流行の可能性が高いが、対象国リストに含まれる国での確定的な発生は確認できず、周辺国（DRC等）への拡大は「地域的な傾向」として言及されているのみで具体的データがないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRC等が含まれるが、記事の主題はチャドでの流行であり、DRC・CAR・ナイジェリアは「地域的な広がりのパターン」として言及されているのみで具体的な発生詳細がないため、対象国として確認できず verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Exame confirma febre maculosa em médico-veterinário que morreu em São Fidélis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test confirms Rocky Mountain spotted fever in a veterinarian who died in São Fidélis.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, São Fidélis, Rio de Janeiro, confirmed Rocky Mountain spotted fever in a veterinarian and entrepreneur who died last week. The final test for the deceased, Gabriel Serra, was positive; five other patients tested negative, and one person remains hospitalized. The disease is a severe tick-borne infection caused by Rickettsia rickettsii, transmitted mainly by the star tick, and is not contagious person-to-person. Key symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle pains, and skin rashes. Following confirmation, the municipality will continue integrated interventions led by the Municipal Health, Environmental Development, Agricultural Development, and Civil Defense departments, per health surveillance protocols. Authorities isolated the property entrance where the tick bite likely occurred. A team from the Rio de Janeiro State Health Secretariat also visited to monitor the response.

triage.headline_ja: サンフィデリスで死亡した獣医師にロッキー山紅斑熱（紅斑熱群リケッチア症）を確認
triage.triage_reason: 重症死亡例が確認されたが、ダニ媒介性で人-人感染せず、既知の風土病として地域保健当局が対応中であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州サンフィデリスでの単発死亡例。ダニ媒介性リケッチア症で人-人感染なし。地方自治体レベルで対応中、州保健局も監視に関与。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低いが、今後の症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Machine learning turns routine water quality data into early warnings for pathogen health risks
article.articleSummary: 95 surface water samples were collected from two drinking water sources in a major Eastern Chinese city (May 2024–Dec 2025) to predict pathogen risks from routine water quality indicators. Six pathogens were monitored alongside three fecal indicators: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Salmonella spp., Shigella spp., adenovirus, norovirus, enterovirus, and fecal coliforms, E. coli, Enterococcus faecalis. Conventional indicators showed weak correlation with viral pathogens. Six ML models were tested; Random Forest and Decision Tree performed best, with all optimized models achieving R² > 0.75; DT for P. aeruginosa exceeded 0.90. Independent Jan–Feb 2026 data supported temporal validity. Predicted pathogen concentrations fed QMRA to estimate DALYs; most risks stayed below 1e-6 DALYs per person-year, but Salmonella spp., Shigella spp., and enterovirus exceeded under unfavorable exposure. Disinfection efficiency emerged as the dominant risk driver. SHAP highlighted turbidity as a strong predictor for fecal indicators (41.6–62.1% importance); other predictors varied by pathogen. Validation across watersheds and real-time integration are needed.

triage.headline_ja: 機械学習が日常的な水質データを病原体健康リスクの早期警告に変換する
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、水質モニタリングにおける機械学習モデルの研究成果を報告する学術記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や実際の症例報告は含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、水質指標から病原体リスクを予測する機械学習モデルの研究報告であるため、トリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo screens hundreds of boat passengers after suspected Ebola death
article.articleSummary: Congolese health authorities screened more than 300 passengers traveling on a river boat near Kinshasa on August 6 after the death of a man suspected of having Ebola, as the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 cases. The screenings along the Congo River aim to identify contacts and prevent further transmission from a suspected case amid high mobility along Kinshasa's river corridor. As of 2026-08-07, the total case count exceeds 4,000, underscoring sustained transmission risk in the region. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and it does not mention any imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ疑い死亡後に川船の乗客数百人をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が4000症例を超え、キンシャサ近郊の河川交通における新たな疑い死亡例でスクリーニングが実施されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う継続中のアウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: 記事は検査確定や感染源についての詳細を欠くが、DRCにおけるエボラ流行が4000症例を超えており継続的なヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高い。キンシャサの河川交通における高い人流が拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 4,000 in DRC as WHO urges Ervebo vaccine trial
article.articleSummary: DRC has reported 4,053 Bundibugyo Ebola cases and 1,850 deaths since the outbreak was declared in mid-May, spanning 53 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for about 87% of cases; North Kivu about 11%. Authorities warn the outbreak is the fastest-spreading on record and may exceed official counts. The WHO recommends a full-scale human trial of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to assess cross-protection against Bundibugyo, for which no specific vaccine exists. Animal data show 3/4 survival in non-human primates treated with Ervebo against Bundibugyo, and a ferret study suggested 100% protection with a research-grade vaccine. TAG-CVP cautions efficacy against disease and transmission may be limited, though protection against fatal outcomes is possible. Gavi maintains a stockpile of 500,000 Ervebo doses, with some already in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ症例が4,000人を突破、WHOがEbrevoワクチン試験を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラが4,053症例・1,850死亡と急拡大し、史上最速の流行と警告されており、WHOがワクチン試験を推奨するなど国際的対応が進行中のため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 感染流行は5つの州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）53保健地域に及び、特にIturiが87%を占める。既存承認ワクチンEbrevoの交差防御効果を検証する大規模臨床試験がWHOにより推奨されており、Gavi備蓄50万回分の一部がDRCに配備済み。

article.articleHeadline: OMS propone probar una vacuna ya existente contra ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes testing an existing Ebola vaccine in Congo.
article.articleSummary: The WHO on 2026-08-07 proposed testing Ervebo, the only Ebola vaccine approved, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid a Bundibugyo-variant outbreak. Ervebo targets the Zaire strain and, while not variant-specific, animal data suggest some protection against Bundibugyo with no major safety issues observed. Experts still prefer a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine but recommend prioritizing Ervebo for a randomized clinical trial in the outbreak setting. The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15, beginning in Ituri province (northeast) and spreading to the northeast and east. To date, 4,053 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths are reported; 708 recoveries, 227 suspected cases under investigation, and about 17,000 contacts followed with over 80% daily check-ins. The 2018–2020 outbreak remains the deadliest in the country, with roughly 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. The WHO urges expanded funding and response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでの既存エボラワクチンの試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の大規模アウトブレイクで4,053例確認・1,850人死亡と重篤かつ拡大中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOがワクチン試験(Ervebo)の実施を提案するほど深刻な状況であり、致死率も高い(約45%)。継続的な感染拡大と国際支援要請が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola takes severe toll on women, children in eastern DRC: UN
article.articleSummary: Ebola takes a severe toll on women and children in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the United Nations, in a report published 7 August 2026. The brief indicates disproportionate harm to women and children amid ongoing transmission, but the article provides no specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or explicit infection sources. Geography cited: eastern DRC; no further outbreak metrics or treatment information are given. The piece’s visible content also includes unrelated material about a Namibian road project, which does not pertain to Ebola coverage. The article thus communicates concern over humanitarian impact from Ebola in eastern DRC without quantitative data or clinical specifics, leaving key outbreak details, disease symptoms, and infection chains unreported within the available text.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRC東部の女性と子どもに深刻な被害:国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重篤・異常な疾患であり、DRC東部での継続的な感染拡大と人道的影響が国連により報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナミビアの道路建設に関する記述はエボラとは無関係であり、発生地域から除外した。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・感染経路等の定量データは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Desterro de Entre Rios promove mobilização sobre descarte correto de lixo e prevenção da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Desterro de Entre Rios Promotes Mobilization for Proper Waste Disposal and Dengue Prevention
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, dengue prevention mobilization was conducted in Pereirinhas district of Desterro de Entre Rios by the Health Surveillance sector to educate residents about proper waste disposal and dengue control. The outreach targeted an area with higher irregular waste dumping, delivering guidance on reducing Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Residents were advised to eliminate containers that collect standing water, keep water storage reservoirs tightly closed, and dispose of materials correctly. The initiative reinforces that cleanliness of public spaces and homes is a shared responsibility to prevent diseases and protect the community. The City Hall and Health Surveillance sector continue educational and preventive actions to build a healthier, safer city.

triage.headline_ja: エントレ・リオス地区デステーロ、ゴミの適正廃棄とデング熱予防に関する啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、実際の症例増加や異常な流行を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の一地区における通常の予防啓発活動を報じるものであり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bolsões de sarampo não respeitam ideologia, diz infectologista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles pockets do not respect ideology, says infectious-disease specialist.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in São Paulo state, Brazil, comprise 23 confirmed cases as of August 7, 2026. The article warns that vaccination coverage is below ideal, creating space for the virus to circulate. Two doses of measles vaccine are required for full protection. Infectious-disease specialist Luana Araújo notes that pockets of unvaccinated individuals, not aligned with any ideology, reveal difficulties in understanding health information and communicating public-health messages. The report underscores the importance of improving vaccination uptake to curb transmission. No further details on lab confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are provided. Overall, the situation illustrates ongoing measles transmission risk in São Paulo due to suboptimal vaccine coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の集団発生はイデオロギーに関係しない、と感染症専門医が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹確定23例の発生が報告されているが、感染源や重症度、拡大状況の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹はワクチン接種率低下により流行しやすい疾患であり、23例確認済みという情報から国内での継続的な感染拡大リスクがある。ただし国際的拡大や渡航制限等の情報はなく、現時点でフルRRAへの移行は時期尚早と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo may be mutating as cases rise
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province with Bunia as a hotspot. As of August 5, 2026, over 4,000 cases and more than 1,800 deaths have been reported (CDC/Africa CDC). Declared mid-May, the outbreak may have lain dormant since January. Officials warn possible mutation and plan studies to assess this, amid weak contact tracing (roughly 10 contacts per patient instead of ~40) and a shift to door-to-door active case searches. No vaccine specifically for Bundibugyo exists, though data suggest a different Ebola vaccine could reduce deaths. Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths linked to the outbreak; France reports its first confirmed Ebola case in June from a doctor returning from the DRC, while the UK continues without cases in this outbreak. Ebola transmission occurs from wild animals to humans and human-to-human after symptom onset, via direct contact.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、症例増加とともに変異の可能性も
triage.triage_reason: 4000例超・1800人超の死亡という大規模アウトブレイクで、ウガンダへの拡大やフランスでの輸入症例も確認されており、変異の可能性も指摘されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20例・2死亡）、フランス（輸入症例1例）への拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。接触者追跡が不十分（本来40人のところ約10人）であることや、変異の可能性に関する研究計画があることから、さらなる拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus eboly sa v Kongu rýchlo šíri. Experti žiadajú klinické testy jedinej schválenej vakcíny
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading rapidly in Congo. Experts are calling for clinical trials of the only approved vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to surge, with 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths reported. WHO experts advocate testing Ervebo, the sole licensed Ebola vaccine, in humans to determine whether it provides protection against the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the DRC. Ervebo is proven safe and effective against the more common Zaire strain, and early data—primarily animal studies—suggest partial protection against Bundibugyo. The WHO Technical Advisory Group on Vaccines for Priority Pathogens recommended prioritizing Ervebo for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial related to the Bundibugyo outbreak. A primate study showed three of four vaccinated subjects survived, versus one of four controls; an unpublished ferret study indicated 100% protection in vaccinated animals, with all controls dying within ten days. The virus is spreading faster than current containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが急速に拡大。専門家は唯一承認されたワクチンの臨床試験を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(Bundibugyo株)の症例・死者数が多数（4,053例、1,850死亡）で急速に拡大しており、既存ワクチンの有効性が未確立という異常性・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する既存ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性は動物実験段階で、ヒトでの臨床試験が求められている点が重要な情報。感染拡大が封じ込め対策を上回っている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : neuf cas confirmés dont cinq décès enregistrés à ce jour dans la Tshopo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: nine confirmed cases, of which five deaths have been recorded to date in Tshopo Province - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Nine confirmed Ebola cases in Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of August 7, 2026, with five deaths (case fatality 56%). At the Ebola Treatment Center, three deaths have occurred; two patients have recovered and are set for discharge. A total of 127 contacts are identified and being followed 100%. Public health action on the ground remains challenging. At the Cité de Refuge church in Kisangani, the sixth case (a man) arrived and vomited there; contact tracing at this site is ongoing, awaiting clearance from the church leader in Kinshasa (ten days). A military captain from Bunia refuses evacuation to the CTE and remains at Bangboka International Airport, seeking travel to Kinshasa. Baego (PK 147 on RN4 in Bafwasende) lacks public health activities; follow-up of the contacts of the territory’s chief—the first positive case in Tshopo since the outbreak. A joint response team returned August 3 from Bafwasende, conducting awareness activities about Ebola’s seriousness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ツォポ州でこれまでに9例の感染確定、うち5例が死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ツォポ州でエボラ出血熱の確定例が9例（致死率56%）発生し、接触者127名の追跡や患者の移動拒否など公衆衛生対応が困難な状況にあり、国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 軍人が治療施設への搬送を拒否しキンシャサへの移動を望んでいる点、教会での接触者追跡が保留中である点など、感染拡大・対応困難のリスクが顕著。エボラという疾患特性上、WHO通知相当の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تشدد قواعد السفر.. قيود جديدة على القادمين من مناطق متضررة بإيبولا - صحيفة الوئام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: America tightens travel rules... New restrictions on arrivals from Ebola-affected regions - Al-Wiam Newspaper
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, the United States has imposed temporary travel restrictions linked to Ebola concerns, targeting arrivals from Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). CDC guidance issued on Friday requires US citizens and other travelers who visited Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days before arrival to enter the US via designated airports for public health screening, including transit travelers who passed through these countries. Stricter measures apply to travelers who visited the DRC within 21 days prior to departure: they will be barred from boarding commercial flights to the US and must remain outside the United States until 21 days have elapsed since leaving DRC. Local authorities may impose additional pre-departure requirements. If Ebola infection is suspected, travelers will be transported to a hospital for testing, isolation, and care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、渡航規則を強化…エボラ被害地域からの入国者に新たな制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行を受け米国がDRC等からの渡航制限を発表しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでのエボラ流行に対する米国の渡航制限措置を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, zika e chikungunya saiba como prevenir, identificar os sintomas e quando procurar atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, Zika and chikungunya: learn how to prevent, identify the symptoms, and when to seek care.
article.articleSummary: Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, registers the most critical arbovirus transmission scenario among Northeast capitals, with climate favoring Aedes aegypti. The city is under red alert for arboviruses, while dengue is under orange alert indicating increased and sustained transmission. This Bahia Notícias guide explains transmission and prevention for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Symptoms typically appear 4–10 days after the bite and include high fever, severe headache, eye pain, muscle and joint pains, red rash, nausea/vomiting, and fatigue. Chikungunya often causes more intense and longer-lasting joint pain; Zika tends to present milder symptoms such as itching and rash. Prevention centers on eliminating standing water to reduce breeding sites in plant pots, tires, bottles, and other containers. Early medical care is advised if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱：予防法、症状の見分け方、受診のタイミング
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州における季節性のデング熱等アルボウイルス感染症に関する一般的な予防啓発・症状解説記事であり、新規性・異常性のある感染症イベントの報告ではない。
triage.notes: サルバドル市がアルボウイルスに対し『レッドアラート』、デング熱に『オレンジアラート』を発令中との記述があるが、記事本体は毎年恒例の季節性流行に対する一般向け予防教育コンテンツであり、突発的な異常事態の報告ではない。El Salvadorは記事本文中で言及がなく、地域名の混同（Bahiaとの類似）とみられるため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تشدد قواعد السفر للعائدين من مناطق متضررة من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: America tightens travel rules for returnees from areas affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prompts tighter U.S. travel controls. As of August 7, 2026, the CDC directs that travelers who visited Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days before U.S. entry undergo public health screening at designated U.S. airports, including transit travelers. Citizens and residents who visited the Democratic Republic of the Congo within 21 days prior to departure are barred from boarding commercial flights to the United States and must remain outside the country for 21 days after leaving DRC. Local authorities in the DRC may impose additional departure requirements for those from Ebola-affected areas. Suspected cases will be transported to hospital for laboratory testing, isolation, and care. The measures respond to Ebola outbreaks linked to Uganda, South Sudan, and the DRC (Ituri region).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ影響地域からの帰国者に対する渡航規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行を受けて米国が渡航制限・空港スクリーニングを実施しており、IHR基準の複数（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダンにも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCのイトゥリ州が流行地域として明示されている。米国によるDRC発の商業便搭乗禁止・21日間の隔離要件など強い渡航制限措置が取られている点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Equipes de Saúde realizam vacinação casa a casa contra o sarampo neste sábado; confira as regiões - Click Guarulhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health teams carry out door-to-door measles vaccination this Saturday; check the regions - Click Guarulhos
article.articleSummary: Guarulhos, São Paulo, Brazil—During the Multivaccination Campaign launched August 3, the city has administered over 22,000 doses of the measles-containing triple viral vaccine (MMR) to residents aged 6 months to 59 years, as it expands measles vaccination to rapidly boost protection and interrupt transmission in Guarulhos, São Paulo, and São Bernardo do Campo. On Saturday, August 8, from 8:30 to 17:00, health teams will conduct house-to-house vaccination in predefined areas served by UBS Marcos Freire, Jacy, Cumbica, Mário Macca, and Jandaia, focusing on priority localities. Campaign runs through September 1; afterward, routine vaccination remains: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months, two doses for 12 months–29 years without documentation, and one dose for adults 30–59 years not previously vaccinated. During the campaign, a 30-day minimum interval from the last SCR dose applies. Infants 6–11 months who received dose zero are included; they will follow the standard schedule.

triage.headline_ja: 保健チームが今週土曜日に麻疹予防の戸別訪問接種を実施；対象地域を確認
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の地域内伝播を阻止するための大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されていることから流行の可能性が示唆されるが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度に関する情報がなく、フルリスク評価に進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の予防接種キャンペーン（ワクチン接種）に関する内容であり、実際の症例報告や感染拡大の規模についての具体的なデータは含まれていない。「伝播を阻止する」との記述から地域での麻疹発生が背景にあると推測されるが、詳細不明のため続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Jetzt wächst die Sorge vor Mutation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Growing concern over mutation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers mutation scrutiny by Africa CDC and WHO. Health workers in protective suits treat an Ebola patient at the Rwampara Treatment Center in the DRC. Officials warn the Bundibugyo-ebola outbreak is unprecedentedly severe. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya says investigations are underway to determine whether a virus mutation has occurred and how to respond. The outbreak now approaches 4,000 cases, with more than 3,900 confirmed cases reported the previous day; over twelve weeks the numbers are more than eight times those seen during the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic, and deaths are more than six times higher in that period. Authorities say capacities—new laboratories and treatment centers—are being expanded, but stopping transmission at the community level remains critical to any impact.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：変異への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が約4000症例に達し、2014年西アフリカ流行を大幅に上回る規模で、変異の可能性についてAfrica CDCとWHOが調査中であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文ではDRCのみが感染発生国として言及されているため除外。ウイルス変異の有無は調査中で未確定。

article.articleHeadline: ONU confirma presencia de ébola en campamentos de desplazados en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Confirms Presence of Ebola in Displaced Persons Camps in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is confirmed in internally displaced persons camps in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), according to the United Nations as of 7 August 2026. Extreme crowding and limited access to basic healthcare in the camps elevate transmission risk, creating favorable conditions for rapid spread. The UN warns the outbreak represents a severe health and humanitarian challenge, complicating response efforts that now require intensified epidemiological surveillance and swift identification of suspected cases to break transmission chains. While ongoing aid distribution and food assistance must continue, these must be coupled with strict preventive measures, and the international community must increase support for the intensified response. Experts regard it as the worst Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date, with 1,850 deaths reported from 15 May to 5 August, and over 4,000 confirmed cases across 53 health zones in five provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国の避難民キャンプでエボラ出血熱の存在を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に加え、DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行として社会的・国際的関心が非常に高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 1,850人の死亡（5月15日〜8月5日）、5州53保健区で4,000人超の確定例。DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行と位置づけられており、避難民キャンプでの過密状態と医療アクセス制限が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայի դեպքերի թիվը գերազանցել է 4000-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo has exceeded 4,000
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 4,000 cases, with 4,053 infections and 1,850 deaths. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. A Science study published last month suggests the outbreak began in January or earlier, with more than 500 suspected cases identified from January through May 15. Delayed detection, ongoing conflict, and a lack of vaccines and treatments have allowed rapid spread. By comparison, the largest Ebola outbreak on record remains West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic, with over 28,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. The report notes the current event is among the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreaks in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が4000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ感染者4,053人・死者1,850人、5州に拡大し過去最速レベルの流行との報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 西アフリカの3国（リベリア、ギニア、シエラレオネ）は2014-2016年流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現行イベントの発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。致死率約45.6%と高く、紛争地域での対応困難やワクチン・治療薬不足が拡大要因として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS propone probar en RDC vacuna ya existente contra otra cepa del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes testing in the DRC an existing vaccine against another strain of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization experts propose testing Ervebo, the Ebola vaccine approved against the Zaire ebolavirus, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to confront a Bundibugyo-strain outbreak. Bundibugyo is the variant driving the current epidemic in the DRC, which has recorded about 4,053 confirmed cases and 1,850 deaths. There is no vaccine specific for Bundibugyo yet. Preliminary animal studies suggest Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, with no major safety concerns observed. Although a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains the preferred option, experts recommend prioritizing Ervebo for a randomized clinical trial within the ongoing outbreak context. The DRC declared its seventeenth Ebola outbreak on May 15, starting in Ituri province (northeast) and spreading to the northeast and east of the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で別系統のエボラ株に対し既存ワクチンの試験実施を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、確定症例約4,053件・死亡1,850人）は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を及ぼしており、WHOによる新規ワクチン試験の提案は国際的関心の高さを示す。
triage.notes: 本イベントはDRCの第17次エボラ流行（2026年5月15日宣言、イトゥリ州発生）に関する続報であり、既に高い死亡率（CFR約45.6%）を伴う進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。ブンディブギョ株専用ワクチンが存在しないため、既存のZaire株用ワクチン（Ervebo）の臨床試験実施が提案されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo rompe récord: brote supera los 4 mil casos y enciende las alarmas sanitarias | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo Breaks Record: Outbreak Surpasses 4,000 Cases and Triggers Public Health Alarms
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 4,053 confirmed cases since the outbreak began on 15 May. The case-fatality ratio stands at 45.7%, with 694 patients isolated or hospitalized and 793 recovered. Surveillance continues with 77.7% of identified contacts followed and over 1,000 alerts investigated in the last 24 hours. The eastern regions are hardest hit: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, and Haut-Uele, with cases also in Tshopo. The World Health Organization notes this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in DRC history, involving the Bundibugyo strain, which typically carries a 30–50% mortality. Transmission occurs by direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal hemorrhaging. Regional spread risk remains high in Sub-Saharan Africa, but low elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が記録更新：発生件数4,000例超え、公衆衛生上の警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが4,000例を超え、致死率45.7%と深刻。IHR基準の複数該当およびWHOによる公式言及があり、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOが史上最速拡大と評価しているエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株で致死率30-50%相当。地域拡大リスクはサブサハラアフリカ域内で高いとされる一方、それ以外の地域では低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Experiencia de Brasil con el dengue se aplicará en 'La Ciudad Bonita'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil's experience with dengue fever will be applied in 'La Ciudad Bonita'.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Fiocruz and the Universidad de Santander (UDES) shared Brazil's dengue strategy with Bucaramanga's metropolitan area, La Ciudad Bonita. The approach combines vaccination with clinical research and surveillance to reduce hospitalizations and strengthen dengue response. Researchers Rafaella Fortini Grenfell, Queiroz, and Priscilla Fernanda da Silva Martins noted two vaccines for ages 10–59 with about 80% efficacy, with ongoing evaluation of results. Fortini, an advisor to WHO, Brazil's Health Ministry, and ANVISA, stressed continuous assessment of outcomes. Given Colombia and Brazil circulate all four dengue serotypes, integrated vaccination, vector control, and elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are essential. Fiocruz conducts phase IV studies to assess safety, immunogenicity, real-world effectiveness, and determine boosters and predominant serotypes. The exchange strengthens scientific cooperation and may incorporate international evidence into Santander's dengue strategies.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱対策経験が「美しい街」（ブカラマンガ）に適用される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の急激な発生や公衆衛生危機ではなく、ブラジルとコロンビアの研究機関間の技術協力・知見共有に関する記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビア（ブカラマンガ）でのデング熱対策戦略にブラジルの経験を活用するという学術・保健協力の内容であり、ブラジルでの発生イベントではない。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 猫体内寄生虫危害与防控安全指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Safety Guidelines for Hazards of Internal Parasites in Cats and Their Prevention and Control.
article.articleSummary: China-based feline internal-parasite control emphasizes exposure-risk assessment and the cat’s health status before selecting a compliant oral dewormer. For ordinary healthy cats needing coverage of nine internal parasites and heartworm larvae, Pu’an Te Pu Le Miao (milbemycin oxime + praziquantel) oral tablets provide dual nematode and cestode protection plus heartworm larva prevention. Third-party data show active ingredients within 90–110% of labeled amounts and bioequivalence to standard milbemycin oxime–praziquantel products. The formulation targets roundworms and hookworms, several cestodes (including Dipylidium caninum), and heartworm larvae, but does not address external parasites or protozoa, requiring additional products for fleas, mites, Giardia, Coccidia, or Tritrichomonas. High-risk cats—6 weeks or younger, under 0.5 kg, pregnant/lactating, ill, or with liver/kidney disease or prior dewormer reactions—must be veterinarian-evaluated before use. Dosing is weight-based; routine intestinal protection is every 3 months, with annual fecal parasite testing recommended.

triage.headline_ja: 猫の体内寄生虫の害と予防・管理に関する安全ガイド
triage.triage_reason: 猫用駆虫薬製品の使用ガイドであり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物用医薬品（猫の駆虫薬）の製品紹介・使用ガイドであり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة تفرض قيوداً مؤقتة على سفر القادمين من مناطق متأثرة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States imposes temporary travel restrictions on travelers from Ebola-affected areas.
article.articleSummary: The United States has imposed temporary travel restrictions on travelers from Ebola-affected areas—Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—to curb Ebola virus transmission. Under new CDC guidelines, U.S. citizens and residents who visited Uganda or South Sudan within the 21 days before their U.S. arrival must travel through designated U.S. airports to undergo health screenings upon entry, including travelers transiting through those countries. Visitors who have been in the DRC within the 21 days prior to travel are prohibited from boarding commercial flights to the United States and must remain outside U.S. territory until 21 days have elapsed since departing the DRC. People who visited Ebola-affected regions may face additional travel measures imposed by local authorities before departure. If Ebola suspicion arises, affected travelers will be transported to a hospital for testing, isolation, and appropriate medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ感染地域からの渡航者に対し一時的な渡航制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: 米国CDCがDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンからの渡航者に対し渡航制限措置を導入するなど、エボラ流行の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国によるエボラ関連渡航制限措置に焦点を当てており、発生国としてDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。米国自体は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Senatsausschuss klagt Fauci wegen Missachtung des Kongresses an - Zahlreiche Infektionsausbrüche in den USA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Senate Committee Files Charges Against Fauci for Contempt of Congress - Numerous Infection Outbreaks in the United States
article.articleSummary: Senate committee votes to refer Anthony Fauci for contempt of Congress over alleged noncompliance, with Rand Paul to forward the matter to the DOJ, framed as criminalizing scientific guidance rather than pursuing COVID-19 origins. Cyclosporiasis outbreaks span 47 states, totaling 10,468 lab-confirmed cases from May 1 to Aug 3, plus 12,255 cases awaiting confirmation, and two deaths in Michigan as of Aug 4. Measles cases in the United States have reached their highest level since 1991, challenging the eradication status declared in 2000. An Mpox-related incident involved inactivated samples transported from the Republic of Congo to Detroit, prompting investigations. The article places these outbreaks in the context of a broader political campaign against infection-disease researchers, amid ongoing public health concerns in the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 上院委員会、ファウチ氏を議会侮辱罪で告発 - 米国内で相次ぐ感染症アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: 記事は米国内の政治的動向（ファウチ氏の議会侮辱罪告発）と米国内でのサイクロスポーラ症・麻疹・Mpox関連事案を扱っており、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事本文では『コンゴ共和国』からデトロイトへの不活化Mpoxサンプル輸送に関する言及のみであり、DRC国内での疾患発生を示すものではないため除外した。米国（対象国リスト外）の国内事案が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera outbreak kills 13, infects 240 in Chad since official declaration
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Chad has killed 13 and infected about 239 people since the epidemic was officially declared on July 24. As of Monday, 239 cases and 13 deaths were recorded nationwide, CFR 5.4%. Most cases concentrated in Hadjer-Lamis region in the north and in the capital N'Djamena, which saw 11 deaths in August, signaling rapid urban spread. Limited access to safe drinking water and sanitation drive transmission despite modern facilities elsewhere. A vaccination campaign has reached about 50,800 people since July 24 to curb spread and protect vulnerable groups. The earliest deaths linked to the outbreak occurred on June 13, prior to official declaration. Cholera is transmitted via contaminated water or food and is easily treatable with early diagnosis. Context: neighboring outbreaks in Africa include Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of Congo and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: チャドでコレラ流行、公式発表以降13人死亡・240人感染
triage.triage_reason: チャドでのコレラ流行に関する記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC等）はいずれも発生地としての主題ではなく、近隣国として文脈的に言及されているのみのため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: DRC、中央アフリカ共和国、ナイジェリアは近隣国での流行事例として文脈的に言及されているのみで、記事の主題である発生国はチャド（対象国リスト外）。そのためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉失控！民主剛果破4000人感染、1850死　專家憂病毒恐已突變 - 國際新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control! The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 4,000 infections and 1,850 deaths; experts fear the virus may have mutated - International News - PChome Online News
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak exceeds 4,000 cases and 1,850 deaths, the second-largest and fastest-spreading on record. Cumulative: 4,053 cases; 1,850 deaths. Five provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain raises mutation concerns; WHO and Africa CDC are analyzing. Initial spread likely in Ituri as early as January; outbreak formally declared May 15, with over 500 suspected cases identified since January. Surveillance is overwhelmed: MSF Bunia reports about 90% of patients not on contact-tracing lists; two-thirds of deaths occur in the community. Public health response shifted to house-to-house searches. A suspected imported case: a boat passenger traveling to Kinshasa died; passengers quarantined and tested. Limited treatment options; compassionate use of Remdesivir considered; Ervebo vaccine being evaluated for broader use. UNICEF reports a 69% drop in first-dose measles vaccination in Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ制御不能！コンゴ民主共和国で感染者4000人、死者1850人を突破　専門家はウイルス変異を懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が4,000例・1,850死亡を超え史上第2位の規模となり、ウイルス変異懸念、監視体制の破綻、輸入疑い例の発生など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱が主題であり、麻疹（Measles）に関する言及はキンシャサ行きボート乗客の輸入疑い例やMongbwaluでの麻疹ワクチン接種率低下の付随情報に留まる。ウイルス変異の可能性についてWHO・Africa CDCが分析中との情報あり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Screening campaign prioritising high-risk areas in Ludhiana: District TB officer - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: TB Mukt Bharat campaign in Ludhiana district targets high-risk urban and rural localities to enable early detection and improved treatment access. The latest phase, launched in May 2026, conducts extensive screening to find hidden patients. In urban areas, 10,383 people were screened with 9,285 X-rays performed and 110 positive results. In rural areas, 113,504 people were screened and 45,591 X-rays done, yielding 26 positives. Villages visited include Thakarwal, Sarabha, Narangwal, Bhaini Waringa and Gujjarwal. Urban screening now covers factory workers; prisoner screening begins Saturday. Treatment has been initiated for positives with follow-ups per protocol. Officials attribute higher urban TB reporting to density, crowded housing and rapid migration to slums; rural areas show fewer cases due to lower mixing and open spaces. Symptoms should prompt a visit to the nearest government hospital.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ市で高リスク地域を優先したスクリーニングキャンペーン実施：地区結核担当官
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラム(TB Mukt Bharat)の通常のスクリーニング活動報告であり、異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は定例的な検診活動の進捗報告。政府による通常のプログラム実施であり緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un bateau parti de la Tshopo isolé à 65 km de Kinshasa, un cas suspect à l'étude
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a boat that departed from Tshopo, isolated 65 km from Kinshasa, a suspected case under investigation.
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case on a boat that departed from Tshopo on the Congo River, near Kinshasa, is under investigation after a passenger died in Pimu, Mongala, with fever and diarrhea. About 200 passengers remain on board; a mobile laboratory has been set up on the riverbank and naval forces monitor the vessel. Lab results have not confirmed Ebola; officials warn other diseases with similar symptoms exist and stress there has been only one death on the boat. Kinshasa remains spared for now. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is in its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo and first declared in Ituri. It has spread to Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, and Sud-Kivu (51 of 140 health zones), with 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths (CFR 45.3%), 776 recoveries, and 674 in isolation; Ituri remains the epicenter around Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：チョポ州を出発した船がキンシャサから65km地点で隔離、疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: 既に3,973例確認・CFR45.3%の大規模な第17次エボラアウトブレイクが進行中であり、首都キンシャサ近郊で新たな疑い例（乗客死亡）が発生していることから、首都圏への拡大リスクが高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 検査結果ではまだエボラは確認されておらず、疑い例1名（死亡）の段階。ただし既存の大規模流行下でキンシャサに近い地点（65km）での事例であり、首都への拡大可能性という点で重大性が高い。続報でラボ確定結果を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Wild Boars in Brazil Are Spreading Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria, Scientists Warn
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-07, researchers screened 100 rectal swabs from European wild boars on two Goiás State farms for Salmonella and Escherichia coli, assessing antibiotic resistance and virulence genes. Salmonella was rare (1/100) and, though resistant to several antibiotics, lacked virulence and resistance markers, suggesting low immediate risk. E. coli was widespread: 56 isolates, with 55 (98.2%) multidrug resistant, notably to sulfonamides, tetracycline, amoxicillin, ampicillin, and doxycycline; nearly all remained susceptible to ceftriaxone. tsh appeared in ~30% of E. coli isolates; papC and iss were less common, with some strains carrying multiple virulence genes. The environment and One Health framework are emphasized: resistance genes persist in soil and water and can move between bacteria; wild boar mobility and farm interfaces may spread resistance. Researchers caution that samples (2014–2017) came from only two farms and antibiotic-use data were not independently verified; captive boars should enter health surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのイノシシが抗生物質耐性菌を拡散させていると科学者が警告
triage.triage_reason: 野生イノシシにおける多剤耐性大腸菌の検出という学術的知見であり、ヒトへの感染事例や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威は報告されていないが、One Healthの観点から薬剤耐性拡大リスクは注視すべき。
triage.notes: 本研究は2014-2017年に採取されたサンプルに基づくものであり、現時点でのヒト感染や急性アウトブレイクの報告はない。抗生物質耐性菌の環境拡散という長期的リスクとして続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Responders in DRC hunt Ebola door to door as cases surpass 4,000 - The World from PRX
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,000 reported cases, with the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention urging a shift to door-to-door disease tracking to locate cases and bolster contact tracing. The report features The World's Marco Werman speaking with Dr. Mesfin Teklu Tessema, head of the International Rescue Committee health unit, and with Trish Newport, emergency program manager for Doctors Without Borders, based in Bunia, the frontline city in the response. The interviews emphasize frontline challenges and the need for intensified surveillance as responders work to curb transmission across affected regions. The report underscores urgent public health measures to halt spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者4,000人超で対応者が戸別調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例数が4,000人を超え、拡大防止のための戸別追跡が必要とされるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクのある事態でありIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDC、IRC、国境なき医師団など複数の国際機関が対応にあたっており、既に大規模な国際支援が展開中の継続的アウトブレイク事案。

article.articleHeadline: ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ ബാധിതരുടെ എണ്ണം കുത്തനെ ഉയരുന്നു, ഇൻഷുറൻസ് അനുവദിക്കുന്നില്ലെന്ന് പരാതി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of influenza patients is rising rapidly, with complaints that insurance is not being approved.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 August 2026, Kerala, including Kochi, reports a sharp rise in influenza cases, with confirmed H1N1 infections. Insurance denials complicate care as New India Assurance policies reportedly refuse coverage for inpatient treatment, alleging hospitals bill for medical and ancillary charges beyond policy terms. Hospitals defend billing practices, while patients face mounting out-of-pocket costs. In one case, Bushir tested positive for H1N1 and, with two accompanying children, was admitted for eight and six days respectively, including two days in isolation; upon discharge, the insurer rejected the daughter’s entire bill. In another case, Meera, 65, and her five-year-old daughter, also diagnosed with H1N1, faced denial of Meera’s Rs 31,000 bill, with insurers citing insufficient documentation though hospital notes suggested inpatient care was unnecessary. The episode highlights an ongoing outbreak and financial hardship for affected families.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者数が急増、保険適用拒否への苦情が浮上
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でH1N1インフルエンザ症例が増加しているが、重症度や国際的拡大の情報がなく、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内とみられるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は保険金支払い拒否問題であり、インフルエンザ(H1N1)自体の重症度・死亡率等の情報は限定的。季節性流行の可能性が高く、続報を注視する。
