article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviária é confirmada em ave silvestre no Parque Ibirapuera em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in a wild bird at Ibirapuera Park in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: On August 7, 2026, the São Paulo state government confirmed a case of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in a wild bird found at Ibirapuera Park, in southern São Paulo. The species, Dendrocygna viduata (white-faced whistling duck), tested positive after lab confirmation following sampling by the Defesa Agropecuária. Authorities emphasize this is an isolated event in free-ranging wildlife and does not affect Brazil's or São Paulo's sanitary status with the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). There is no impact on the poultry production chain, and consumption of poultry and eggs remains safe. A 10-km safety radius shows no commercial poultry facilities nearby. Ongoing epidemiological surveillance will monitor for clinical signs in other birds, and health teams are monitoring people who had contact with the infected bird. Coordination between PESA and animal protection agencies ensures continuous monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロのイビラプエラ公園で野鳥に鳥インフルエンザ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥1羽における孤立的なHPAI検出事例であり、家禽産業や公衆衛生への影響はないと当局が明言している。人への感染や地域拡大の兆候もなく、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 野生の渡り鳥（Dendrocygna viduata）での単発のHPAI陽性事例。半径10km以内に商業養鶏施設なし、OIE衛生ステータスにも影響なしと当局が公表。接触者の健康観察は実施されているが、現時点でヒトへの感染報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية توصي باختبار لقاح "إيرفيبو" ضد فيروس "إيبولا" بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends testing the ERVEBO Ebola vaccine against the Ebola virus in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, WHO’s Technical Advisory Group recommended prioritizing ERVEBO (recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) for inclusion in a randomized clinical trial in the response to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. ERVEBO is the only licensed vaccine against Ebola Zaire virus; preliminary animal data suggest cross-protection, but efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains unproven. The advisory notes that vaccinating contacts of cases with ERVEBO does not raise safety concerns. A vaccine specifically targeting Bundibugyo ebolavirus remains the preferred long-term option. The strategy aims to evaluate potential cross-protection while continuing outbreak control in the DRC, with ongoing development of a Bundibugyo-focused vaccine as the optimal solution long term.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラウイルスに対するERVEBOワクチンの試験実施を推奨
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行に対し、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を推奨しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心の高い事案であるため。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス種に対する既存ワクチン（ERVEBO、ザイール株対象）の交差防御効果は未確認であり、専用ワクチン開発が長期的に望ましいとされている。アウトブレイクの規模・感染者数等の詳細情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue ở Hà Tĩnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak appears in Hà Tĩnh
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak confirmed in Tan Duc village, Ky Hoa commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with 5 NS1 antigen–positive cases and no deaths as of August 7. Index patient: female (born 1959) onset August 1 presenting fever, fatigue, headache, and joint/muscle pain; tested positive on August 4 at Ky Anh General Hospital; four additional cases identified by August 7. Investigations indicate abundant mosquito vectors and multiple larval habitats, with poor sanitation, waste, and standing water amid densely populated households, raising transmission risk. Ha Tinh Provincial CDC, in cooperation with Ky Hoa People’s Committee, deployed urgent measures: epidemiologic investigation, vector surveillance, environmental cleaning, larval source reduction, and targeted indoor/outdoor insecticide spraying around surrounding households; area zoning and containment; intensified surveillance and timely case management/referral. The province supplied 12 liters of insecticide, assigned 24/7 staff, and instituted daily outbreak reporting. All cases currently non-fatal.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省でデング熱の集団感染が発生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省で5例の小規模なデング熱クラスターが確認され死亡例はなく、地方当局が迅速に対応しているが、媒介蚊が多く環境要因により感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節性に発生する疾患であり、本件は5例・死亡なしの小規模事案。地方CDCが独自に対応可能な規模であり、国際的な懸念は低いが、環境要因（蚊の繁殖地、衛生状態）により拡大リスクがあるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Congo: Childhood deaths rise; hopes raised over new vaccine - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo’s Ituri province, begun mid-May, has led to >300 child deaths; children account for ~25% of confirmed cases but ~1/3 of deaths. Pregnant women face elevated risk amid overstretched health services, with health-care use down >40% and maternal deaths ~6 per week; fetal loss is common with infection during pregnancy. Ituri, where nearly one million people are displaced, sees women and children (~80%) disproportionately affected. Humanitarian efforts include 13,000 community workers reaching >2.4 million with prevention/early-detection information and >500,000 household visits. On vaccination, WHO’s Technical Advisory Group recommended evaluating a single licensed vaccine, Ervebo (Ebola Zaire), in a randomized trial for Bundibugyo virus disease, noting preliminary animal data suggesting cross-protection and no major safety concerns for contacts, though a Bundibugyo-specific vaccine remains preferred; the Bundibugyo outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：子どもの死者数が増加、新ワクチンへの期待高まる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行が国際的懸念のある公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は5月16日にブンディブギョウイルス病がPHEICと宣言されたことに言及。イトゥリ州での子ども・妊産婦への影響が甚大であり、ワクチン評価（Ervebo/エボラザイール株）の臨床試験がWHO技術諮問グループにより勧告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Machine learning transforms routine water quality data into early pathogen
article.articleSummary: Eastern China drinking-water sources were studied with a machine-learning framework that pairs environmental measurements with QMRA to forecast pathogen concentrations before lab results. From 95 surface-water samples collected May 2024–Dec 2025, six pathogens were measured: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Salmonella spp., Shigella spp., adenovirus, norovirus and enterovirus, along with fecal indicator bacteria. Bacterial indicators correlated weakly with viruses, underscoring limits of relying on indicators alone. Six ML methods were tested; random forests and decision trees performed best, with all models achieving R² > 0.75; the decision tree predicted P. aeruginosa with R² > 0.90. Independent validation from Jan–Feb 2026 showed retained predictive ability. When linked to QMRA, most estimated health risks stayed below WHO’s 1e-6 DALYs per person per year, though Salmonella, Shigella and enterovirus exceeded the benchmark under unfavorable exposure. Disinfection efficiency was the most influential factor; SHAP identified turbidity as a strong predictor for fecal indicators.

triage.headline_ja: 機械学習が日常的な水質データを病原体の早期健康警告に変換
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、水質モニタリングにおける機械学習手法の研究論文の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国東部の飲料水源を対象とした水質モニタリング手法（機械学習・QMRA）に関する学術研究の紹介であり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告を伴うものではない。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra 23 casos de sarampo e reforça campanha de vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records 23 measles cases and steps up its vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, São Paulo state has reported 23 measles cases, prompting a state-wide multivaccination campaign. With rising demand, health posts have seen increased movement as residents seek vaccination. Authorities are sending additional doses to cover a shortage of the measles vaccine. The Health Secretariat recommends that all residents aged 6 months through 59 years in São Paulo city and the metropolitan municipalities of Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo receive the measles vaccine, even if previously immunized. The initiative aims to contain transmission and protect populations amid an ongoing outbreak in the region. The article does not specify symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or the infection source, focusing instead on vaccination logistics and outreach.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹23症例を記録、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生でワクチンキャンペーンが実施されているが、重症度や感染源、国際的拡大の情報が不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹はワクチン予防可能疾患で本来稀であるため異常事象とみなせるが、症例数23件は限定的規模。ワクチン不足への言及があり管理体制に懸念の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 1.259 ca sốt xuất huyết, Hà Nội siết chặt kiểm tra phòng dịch trên toàn thành phố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,259 dengue cases, Hanoi tightens disease-prevention inspections across the city.
article.articleSummary: 1,259 dengue cases were reported in Hanoi as of August 5, spanning 115 of 126 communes/wards, indicating a peak period and potential spread without decisive control. The Hanoi Department of Health formed 46 inspection teams to monitor 91 communes/wards for surveillance, outbreak response, vector control, risk communication, and preparedness. On August 7, inspection team No. 42 visited Gia Lâm and Phù Đổng. Gia Lâm has six cases year-to-date; vector-control units include 276 rapid-response squads and 36 surveillance teams, conducting household inspections, removing water containers, and organizing two environmental-cleanup campaigns plus four training courses. Phù Đổng reports seven cases across seven hamlets as of August 6, with 552 rapid-response units, 71 surveillance teams, and a 30-person spraying team. In central wards Cửa Nam and Hoàn Kiếm, extensive checks and vector-control actions occurred; Hoàn Kiếm records three cases and one outbreak. Authorities urge intensified surveillance, community participation, environmental sanitation, and targeted spraying to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱1,259例、ハノイ市全域で防疫検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでの季節性デング熱流行で症例数は多いが、重症度や異常性の明確な記載はなく、地元当局が通常の防疫対応を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは確認されない。
triage.notes: ハノイ市内115/126コミューンで発生、季節性デング熱の流行とみられる。当局は検査班・迅速対応班を組織し対応中。重症例・死亡例の報告はなく、国内での通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断。続報での重症度・拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 30% dos casos de sarampo têm complicação e podem acabar até em morte, alerta médico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30% of measles cases have complications and may even lead to death, doctor warns.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, measles outbreaks have been reported in São Paulo state, Brazil, with 23 cases confirmed in under a week in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo. Health authorities advise vaccination for all people aged 6 months to 59 years, excluding pregnant individuals and the immunosuppressed. The measles vaccine is about 97% effective; reaching 95% population vaccination yields herd immunity and halts transmission. Two vaccine doses are required to be considered immunized. Measles is highly contagious and particularly dangerous for unvaccinated groups, including Indigenous communities and infants under 6 months. About 30% of cases develop complications such as pneumonia or encephalitis, which can be severe or fatal. The doctor emphasizes vaccination to prevent severe outcomes and notes that high herd immunity reduces concerns about imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例の30%に合併症、死に至ることも医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が短期間に23件確認され、合併症リスクが指摘されているが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生危機を示す情報は不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主にワクチン接種の重要性を訴える医師の警告であり、感染規模・重症度・地理的拡大に関する詳細情報が不足している。続報での症例数推移やアウトブレイクの拡大状況を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Coahuila refuerza estrategia contra el gusano barrenador; mantiene 36 casos activos.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coahuila reinforces its strategy against the wood-boring worm; maintains 36 active cases.
article.articleSummary: Coahuila reports 36 active screwworm myiasis cases, concentrated in the Southeast (Saltillo, General Cepeda, Arteaga, Ramos Arizpe) with some in Centro and Norte. Eleven joint field brigades of federal and state agencies survey ranch lands to inspect animals, treat wounds with cicatrizants, and administer antiparasitics (ivermectin or doramectin) for about 30–60 days. About 25% of cases involve companion or backyard animals, including ranch dogs and urban pets. When wounds are found, animals are isolated and reported for sampling to confirm screwworm larvae versus other myiasis; larvae are removed and deeper wounds treated. Sterile-fly dispersal continues across regions including Centro, Norte, Don Martín dam, Progreso, Juárez, Carbonífera, Muzquiz, and border towns Zaragoza, Acuña, Piedras Negras, Guerrero, Hidalgo. A Chiapas plant will raise weekly sterile-fly production from ~20 million to 100–120 million by 2028. No animal deaths; recovery in 1–2 weeks with timely care.

triage.headline_ja: コアウイラ州、ラセンウジバエ症対策を強化 ― 活動中の症例36件を維持
triage.triage_reason: メキシコ（対象国外）における家畜・ペット中心の寄生虫症（ラセンウジバエ症）で、ヒトーヒト感染や重篤な公衆衛生影響は報告されておらず、既に自国対応が進行中のため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコ（コアウイラ州、チアパス州など）における家畜・ペットのラセンウジバエ症（screwworm myiasis）対策に関する内容で、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。ブラジルが地域情報に含まれるが、記事本文では言及なし（主題ではない）ため除外。動物疾患であり、ヒトへの直接的健康リスクは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: UN / DRC EBOLA UPDATE
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC continues with total cases exceeding 4,000 and 1,850 deaths. WHO's Technical Advisory Group on Vaccine Research recommends a DRC clinical trial for Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to accelerate the response. UNICEF reports more than 300 child deaths; children account for about a quarter of confirmed cases but nearly one-third of deaths. Health-service use has fallen by over 40% in hard-hit areas due to fear of infection, severely disrupting essential care. In Ituri, maternal deaths from childbirth complications have nearly doubled, and Ebola infection during pregnancy is linked to almost universal fetal loss. UNICEF and partners have deployed 13,000 community workers and conducted over 500,000 household visits, reaching more than 2.4 million people with prevention and early-detection information. OCHA emphasizes restoring community confidence as a key element of the response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連/コンゴ民主共和国 エボラ出血熱最新情報
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で症例4,000人超、死者1,850人に達する大規模なエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ituriはDRC国内の州であり、国としてはDRCのみが該当。WHO・UNICEF・OCHAが対応に関与しており、国際支援の継続が必要な大規模アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: Bahaya Olahraga saat Kurang Fit, Bisa Memperparah Infeksi Sistemik : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangers of Exercising When Not Fit Can Worsen Systemic Infections.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia – August 7, 2026. Exercising while sick or not fully fit can raise the body's workload and slow recovery from infections, according to Dr. Tirta Mandira Hudhi, a physician and health influencer. In an Instagram video, he explains that when ill the immune system is already working hard and the body needs extra energy to recover. Pushing through illness, particularly with systemic infections, may prolong healing and increase the risk of complications affecting other organs. He cites heavier illnesses such as dengue fever, typhoid fever, diarrhea, and poisoning, noting that energy demands rise during systemic infections. The guidance emphasizes avoiding intense physical activity when the body is fighting infection to prevent extended illness or deterioration, a message targeted at the general public in Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: 体調不良時の運動の危険性、全身感染症を悪化させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではなく、医師による一般的な健康アドバイス記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・腸チフスは病名として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生・流行状況の報告ではないため、対象国の実際の感染症イベントとはみなさない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Ebola outbreak tops 4,000 confirmed cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) totals 4,053 confirmed cases across 53 health zones in five provinces as of August 5, 2026, with Ituri province the epicenter (86.9% of cases). Two zones are newly affected: Gombari (Haut-Uélé) and Bafwasende (Tshopo). Deaths reach 1,850 (case fatality rate 45.7%), with 793 recoveries and 694 patients in isolation or hospitalized. Contact tracing covers 77.7% of contacts, supported by 1,158 alerts investigated in 24 hours. The outbreak began May 15 and is the second largest Ebola outbreak on record, behind 2014-2016 West Africa and ahead of 2018-2020 Kivu. MSF warns of alarming, persistent spread and urges accelerated, better-supported response with community-led surveillance; only 59% of Ituri’s contacts have been traced and 90% of ETC admissions were not previously monitored contacts. Response priorities include surveillance, treatment centers, community engagement, and the free hotline 151 for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが確定症例4,000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例4,053例、致死率45.7%と非常に深刻で、史上2番目の規模のエボラアウトブレイクとして国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があり、IHR基準の複数該当が明確。
triage.notes: MSFが接触者追跡率の低さ（イトゥリ州で59%）とコミュニティ主導サーベイランスの不足を警告しており、感染拡大継続のリスクが高い。史上2番目に大きいエボラアウトブレイクであり、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Resistensi Malaria Mengintai, Efektivitas Obat Nyaris Batas Kritis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria resistance looms, drug efficacy nearly at a critical threshold.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Indonesia shows early signs of resistance to piperaquine, though artemisinin and its derivatives remain effective according to researchers. BRIN reports that some parasites can survive therapy, complicating distinctions between reinfection and treatment failure. Genetic markers pfpm2 and pfmdr1 are used to monitor resistance patterns, with initial data indicating most parasites remain theoretically sensitive to piperaquine, yet field isolates exhibit survival post-therapy. The finding suggests resistance mechanisms are more complex than anticipated and calls for deeper genetic studies. BRIN is also pursuing new molecular targets for next-generation antimalarials, notably the apicoplast, a parasite-specific organelle vital to metabolism. Researchers warn that Plasmodium will continue to evolve genetically, underscoring ongoing research to preserve current therapies and accelerate discovery of new drugs to support Indonesia's malaria elimination target by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア耐性の懸念、薬剤有効性が危機的閾値に近づく
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでマラリア薬剤耐性の初期兆候が報告されているが、現時点では研究段階であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や国際的拡大の証拠はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は薬剤耐性研究に関する報告であり、現時点で症例急増や重症化の報告はない。BRINによる継続的なモニタリングと新薬開発の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 【新聞大家談】福奇不敢說！中國「清一色」變異毒株來勢洶洶！ | 病毒 | 福奇日記 | 新冠溯源
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News Roundtable: Fauci Won't Say It! China's 'Uniform' Variant Strains Are Surging! | Virus | Fauci Diary | COVID-19 Origins
article.articleSummary: As of August 7, 2026, Chinese CDC data show a rapid rise in COVID-19 positivity, jumping from 9.6% to 20.3% within three weeks, with southern hospitals reporting a notable uptick in admissions. Officials say the circulating variant NB.1.8.1 now accounts for about 98% of strains, described as an extraordinary dominance in the current outbreak. Environmental factors such as extreme climate, flooding and high humidity are proposed as catalysts for transmission and evolution. The report connects climate, viral evolution, and biosafety risks, while noting high-profile topics about Fauci and other bioscience controversies in the broader discourse. The roundtable edition features Dr. Lin Xiaoxu, a former U.S. Army virologist, to dissect this cross-cutting situation and its implications for COVID-19 origins and global health security.

triage.headline_ja: 【新聞大家談】ファウチは言えない！中国「一色」変異株が猛威を振るう！｜ウイルス｜ファウチ日記｜新型コロナ起源
triage.triage_reason: 中国でCOVID-19陽性率が急上昇し変異株NB.1.8.1が98%を占めるとの報道だが、情報源が政治色の強いメディアであり、重症度や公式データの裏付けが不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 情報源NTDTVは政治色の強いメディアであり、中国CDCの一次データとしての信頼性検証が必要。重症度・死亡者数などの詳細情報がなく、続報の確認が求められる。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Patient Recovers After 45 Days on Ventilator, Discharged in Kerala
article.articleSummary: A 43-year-old Nipah patient from Farook in Kerala was discharged from Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, after about two months of treatment, having spent nearly 1.5 months on a ventilator. He walked out without assistance and had regained normal cognitive functions, including memory. Kerala Health Minister K Muraleedharan attributed the recovery to the coordinated efforts of the entire health department, from cleaning staff to clinicians, and said every worker could take pride in saving the patient’s life. He also noted that Kerala reported no Nipah-related deaths during the latest outbreak. The discharge comes as Kerala continues Nipah surveillance and hospital preparedness during the latest outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ナイパウイルス感染患者、45日間の人工呼吸器管理後に回復、ケララ州で退院
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でのニパウイルス感染症例（重症・人工呼吸器管理）に関する続報であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州でのニパウイルス感染症患者の回復・退院を報じるもの。発生地域に含まれるPalestineは記事内容と無関係であり除外。ケララ州では継続的なサーベイランスと病院の即応体制が維持されている旨言及あり、アウトブレイクが依然進行中である可能性に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Hombre lucha, sin paga, para frenar ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man fights without pay to stop Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of August 7, 2026, centered in Ituri province's Bunia area, has more than 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. It is the second-largest on record, behind West Africa's 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,000 infections and more than 11,000 deaths); the 2018–2020 outbreak caused at least 2,200 deaths. Frontline health workers, including Wiza Bondele, operate amid conflict and precarious pay, often unpaid: a promised $510 monthly wage has not been disbursed. Payroll verifications and name misalignments have delayed payments; some workers have received partial amounts via mobile money. Strikes and protests have interrupted care. Despite hardships, Bondele and colleagues continue working daily to disinfect, screen, and enforce handwashing as the outbreak spreads.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行阻止に無給で奮闘する男性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で4,000人超の確定症例、1,800人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療従事者の未払い問題によるスト等で対応能力にも懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアを中心とした流行を扱っており、Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外。史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行であり、医療従事者への未払い問題が対応能力に影響している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại Congo vượt 4000 Ca, WHO đề xuất thử nghiệm vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 4,000 cases; WHO proposes a vaccine trial.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 4,053 cases and 1,850 deaths due to Bundibugyo since mid-May, spanning 53 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for about 87% of cases, North Kivu about 11%. This is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record; official counts may understate reality. Only the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger. Response challenges include armed conflict, delayed detection, and limited therapies and vaccines, with transmission mainly via contact with bodily fluids. On August 7, WHO recommended initiating comprehensive human trials of Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, to assess possible cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Animal data show protection in non-human primates and ferrets against Bundibugyo. TAG-CVP cautions that Bundibugyo-specific vaccines remain the priority; avoid hasty actions without solid evidence. Two Bundibugyo-targeted candidates are in early trials; a third is fast-tracked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が4000例を突破、WHOがワクチン試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ(Bundibugyo型)流行が4000例・1850人死亡に達し、WHOがワクチン臨床試験を提案するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているため。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 專家稱香港受「三疫夾擊」　籲市民不要掉以輕心 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts say Hong Kong is under a "triple-epidemic onslaught," urging the public not to let their guard down - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong)
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong faces a triple-epidemic of COVID-19, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), according to Dr. Kwan Yat-wah, President of the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and Honorary Clinical Associate Professor at HKU’s Pediatrics and Adolescent Medicine. A 7-year-old boy died from influenza A presenting with shock and encephalopathy; the case is described as unfortunate and not indicative of vaccine failure, noting that antibodies may wane over time and individual immune factors or potential antigenic drift should be considered. Despite summer holidays, group activities can sustain transmission, with flu activity not yet peaked. Citizens are urged to maintain protections—mask-wearing and diligent hand hygiene, especially during travel—and to monitor for severe symptoms. The article emphasizes continuing vaccination confidence while evaluating the need for boosters or updated strains.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、香港は「三重の疫病(COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSV)による包囲」にあると指摘、市民に警戒を呼びかけ - 香港文匯報
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの季節性同時流行という状況で、小児の重症死亡例も報告されているが、これは例年見られるパターンの範囲内であり、症例数や拡大傾向など詳細情報が不足しているため、まずは続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港はChina(1814991)に統合して計上。COVID-19・インフルエンザA・RSVの季節性同時流行に関する専門家コメント記事で、7歳児のインフルエンザA関連死亡例が報告されているが、ワクチン失敗ではなく個別要因の可能性が示唆されており、突発的・異常なアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。症例数や地域的拡大の詳細データが不足しているため、フルRRAへの移行は時期尚早と判断。

article.articleHeadline: जम्मू में मच्छरों से मुक्ति के लिए मेगा अभियान शुरू सभी 75 वार्डों में होगी फॉगिंग - launches mega fogging drive against mosquitoborne diseases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mega campaign launched to eliminate mosquitoes in Jammu; fogging to be carried out in all 75 wards.
article.articleSummary: Jammu City Municipal Corporation launched a city-wide vector-control campaign to combat dengue, malaria, and chikungunya. From August 7 to November 10, 2026, all 75 wards will undergo two daily shifts: morning anti-larvae spraying in flood-prone and drainage areas to curb larval development, and evening thermal fogging after 4 PM to eliminate adult mosquitoes. The effort, directed by Commissioner Dr. Devansh Yadav and Health Officer Dr. Shahid Husain, is coordinated with the health department and uses ward-wise rosters to cover all areas, starting with Ward 66 (Upper Muthi) and Ward 67 (Lower Muthi). Citizens are urged to cooperate and keep homes closed during fogging, especially elderly, children, and those with respiratory conditions. Emphasis on eliminating mosquito breeding sites; stagnant water remains the prime breeding ground. After Phase 1, additional fogging may be carried out if needed; public participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムーで蚊媒介感染症対策の大規模防除キャンペーン開始、全75区でフォギング実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な蚊媒介感染症予防キャンペーンの報道であり、具体的な症例急増や異常発生を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な予防的防除活動の告知であり、デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの実際の症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn dịch Ebola lan rộng, Mỹ thông báo sẽ cấp thêm 242 triệu USD để ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To prevent the Ebola outbreak from spreading, the United States announced it would provide an additional $242 million to respond.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to escalate as Africa CDC implements vaccination with the Ebola Zaire vaccine and expands remdesivir use. Congo reports more than 4,000 cases and about 1,850 deaths, with funding shortfalls, limited treatment capacity, security instability, and incomplete contact tracing hindering control. In Uganda, authorities report a recent Ebola outbreak with roughly a 10% case-fatality rate, crediting remdesivir with improved outcomes; Uganda declared the outbreak over in mid-July after the last patient discharge. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting the DRC, warned the outbreak has outpaced response capacity and urged decisive international action. The United States announced an additional $242 million for the eastern DRC response, raising total direct aid to $512 million to fund six months of emergency operations. African health officials urged continued global support to contain what is described as the region’s most serious outbreak in years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の拡大防止へ、米国が追加で2億4200万ドルの支援を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000人以上の症例・約1,850人の死亡が報告され、WHO事務局長が対応能力を超えたと警告するなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な社会的関心・支援も高まっているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は7月中旬に終息宣言済みのため対象国リストに含まれるウガンダはverified_locationsから除外（ウガンダはID非対象）。主たる進行中の流行はDRC東部。米国のUSは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 105 Confirmed Cases Of Chikungunya Reported In Kerala; What You Need To Know About Symptoms And Prevention
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India reports 105 confirmed and 62 probable chikungunya cases as of August 4, 2026, with most in Thiruvananthapuram. Monsoon conditions favor Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, elevating transmission risk. Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted by daytime-biting mosquitoes; infection is rarely fatal but causes sudden high fever and severe joint pain that can persist for weeks to months, along with headache and fatigue. Diagnosis relies on symptoms, travel history, and blood tests; there is no specific antiviral treatment, and care is supportive. Complications may include persistent joint swelling, neurological issues, myocarditis, and eye problems; older adults and those with chronic illnesses are at higher risk. Prevention focuses on eliminating stagnant water, covering storage containers, using repellents, installing screens or nets, and maintaining clean surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でチクングニア熱の確定症例105件を報告；症状と予防について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州でのチクングニア熱は季節性（モンスーン期）の媒介蚊由来疾患であり、致死率は低く国際的拡大リスクも低いが、感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱はインドで既に流行地域があり、モンスーン期に季節的増加が見られる。今回の報告は地方保健当局の通常監視範囲内と考えられるが、媒介蚊の増加による感染拡大の可能性があるため継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا ترفع التأهب ضد إيبولا.. إجراءات استثنائية للمسافرين من إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States raises its Ebola alert: extraordinary measures for travelers from Africa.
article.articleSummary: The United States raises its Ebola alert with extraordinary travel restrictions for travelers returning from Africa. Based on CDC guidelines issued Friday, U.S.-bound travelers who visited Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days before arrival will be routed to specific U.S. airports for public health entry screening, including those who only transited through these countries. For travelers who visited the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) within 21 days before travel to the United States, they will not be allowed to board commercial flights to the U.S. and must remain outside the United States until 21 days have elapsed since leaving the DRC. Some travelers to Ebola-affected areas in the DRC may face additional local travel requirements before departure. If Ebola is suspected, the traveler will be transported to a hospital for testing, isolation, and care.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ警戒レベルを引き上げ:アフリカからの渡航者に対する異例の措置
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生を受け、米国が異例の渡航制限措置（商業便搭乗禁止・入国後21日間の待機等）を発表しており、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を受けた米国の渡航制限措置が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国自体も対象国リストにないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra 23 casos de sarampo, sendo 16 pessoas não vacinadas. - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records 23 measles cases, with 16 unvaccinated people. - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in the State of São Paulo, Brazil, with 23 confirmed cases, 16 of which involve unvaccinated individuals, highlighting vaccine hesitancy (about 69%). Cases are concentrated in the City of São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, suggesting rapid spread in areas with lower immunization coverage. Measles is highly contagious and transmits via respiratory droplets; infection can cause pneumonia and encephalitis, potentially fatal. Health authorities will intensify vaccination campaigns to reach non-vaccinated populations and reinforce immunization in at-risk zones, with emphasis on children and pregnant women. Public health education is emphasized to counter misinformation and improve access to reliable vaccination information. Next steps include monitoring cases, expanding vaccination outreach, and providing psychosocial support to hesitant parents to safeguard community health.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹23例確認、うち16人が未接種 - Fala Canedo
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン未接種率が高い（約69%）状況下でサンパウロ州の複数都市に麻疹感染が拡大しており、感染力の強さと保健当局の対応強化から社会的関心もあるため、フルリスク評価に進める。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州（サンパウロ市、グアルーリョス、サンベルナルド・ド・カンポ）における麻疹アウトブレイクを報告。未接種率の高さとワクチン忌避が拡大要因とされ、保健当局はワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化予定。

article.articleHeadline: 已接種疫苗7歲男童染甲流不治　專家指屬個別事件
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccinated 7-year-old boy dies from influenza A; experts say it's an isolated case.
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old boy, fully vaccinated against influenza, died from influenza A with shock and encephalopathy after ICU treatment at Queen Mary Hospital, Hong Kong. He passed away on August 4, 2026, the year’s first pediatric flu death. Dr. Kwan Yat-Wah, President of the Asia Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and Honorary Clinical Associate Professor at HKU, described the case as unlucky and isolated, urging public confidence in vaccination. He noted that some individuals mount exaggerated immune responses leading to rapid deterioration; vaccine antibodies wane after about six months and outcomes depend on underlying conditions and potential viral mutations. Hong Kong faces triple threats: COVID-19, influenza, and RSV. By end-July, the Centre for Health Protection recorded 12 children with severe influenza complications. Although summer holidays reduce school contact, gatherings persist. Those vaccinated last year may skip revaccination until the new program starts.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種済みの7歳男児がA型インフルエンザで死亡　専門家は個別事例と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 重症化・死亡を伴う小児インフルエンザ症例であり、香港でのCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSVの「三重の脅威」下での発生として保健当局・メディアの関心が高いため、経過を精査する必要がある。
triage.notes: 専門家は本件を『個別・不運な事例』と評価しており、大規模な異常発生を示す根拠はない。ただし香港では7月末時点で12例の重症小児インフルエンザが報告されており、季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSV）の動向として引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba já registra 5,8 mil casos de arboviroses e 11 mortes por dengue em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba already records 5.8 thousand arboviral disease cases and 11 dengue deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paraíba, Brazil, reports 5,818 probable arboviral disease cases in 2026 as of August 1 (30th Epidemiological Week), including 5,670 dengue, 145 chikungunya, and 3 Zika. There have been 11 dengue deaths across Alagoa Nova, Bayeux, Campina Grande, Guarabira, João Pessoa, Monteiro, São Bento (four deaths), and Sumé. In response, the SES-PB launched the Arboviruses Situation Room to monitor epidemiology and strengthen prevention, vector control, and care in partnership with 223 municipalities. Secretary Ari Reis says the initiative enables faster responses as patterns of Aedes aegypti-transmitted diseases evolve. The Arboviruses unit, led by Carla Jaciara, will oversee case notifications, investigations, lab and clinical workflows, and data analysis to guide decisions. Public participation is urged: eliminate standing-water containers, keep water tanks closed, clean gutters and drains, discard tires, and allow entry of vector-control agents. Suspected cases with fever, body and joint pains, rashes, retro-orbital pain or intense malaise should seek care.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年に着蜘節足媒介性疾患5,818例、デング熱による死亡11例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パライバ州における例年のデング熱等アルボウイルス感染症の流行報告であり、州政府が独自に監視体制（Situation Room）を強化して対応しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、突発的異常性も明示されていない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱は同州で季節性・地方病的に発生しており、2026年の症例数・死亡者数は報告されているが、前年同期比較や急激な増加を示す情報はなく、現時点では経過観察が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Novo surto de ebola e violência armada sobrecarregam igrejas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak and armed violence overwhelm churches.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu bearing the brunt as a new transmission wave emerges. A mission physician, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola while treating patients at a local hospital. The rapid spread strains Christian communities, which continue to provide spiritual support and humanitarian aid amid high transmission risk and ongoing armed conflict. Local partners report more than 150 congregations trained to respond to Ebola; delays in seeking care and burial practices are contributing to transmission. The DRC faces a major humanitarian crisis, with armed violence, internal displacement, food insecurity, and recurring infectious disease outbreaks. Islamic State–linked ADF militants attack villages, churches, and Christian leaders in the east. Portas Abertas ranks the DRC 29th on the 2026 World Watch List. Dozens of Christians killed, hundreds abducted, over 30,000 displaced recently.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱の流行と武力紛争が教会を圧迫
triage.triage_reason: DRCイースト地域でエボラ出血熱の新たな流行波が拡大し、医療従事者への感染や紛争による対応困難も報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心が高い事案と判断される。
triage.notes: エボラはDRCで反復的に発生している既知の疾患であるため『異常/予想外』はNoとしたが、武力紛争下での拡大・医療者感染・埋葬慣習による感染継続はリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Avika Gor Hospitalised With Dengue, Shot Through Fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue patient in Mumbai: Actress Avika Gor has been hospitalised after testing positive for dengue. Her husband Milind Chandwani posted that she had a sustained fever of 103–104°F for five days and was admitted last night. Despite the illness, Gor continued working, completing a two‑day project in one day and then travelling to Delhi for an ad shoot to prevent producer losses, after tests confirmed she hadn’t contracted another virus. He praised her work ethic and said she prioritized others’ time and money over her health. Gor later shared hospital‑bed updates, flashing a victory sign and noting her platelet counts as she received treatment with an IV drip. Her new song Bukhaar released the same day, and Milind urged fans to keep her in their prayers. Gor rose to fame in Balika Vadhu and later acted in Telugu and Hindi projects.

triage.headline_ja: 女優アヴィカ・ゴル、デング熱で入院 発熱に見舞われる
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人のデング熱罹患に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: インドはデング熱の常在国であり、本記事は個人の闘病を報じる芸能記事であって公衆衛生イベントとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma mais 7 novos casos de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms 7 more new measles cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-07, São Paulo state has reported seven new measles cases, bringing the total to 23 (20 in the capital São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos). Health authorities urge vaccination for everyone aged 6 months to 59 years in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo, regardless of prior immunization. A National Multivaccination Campaign against Poliomyelitis and Measles began July 3 to update vaccination records for children and adolescents under 15. On July 28, the Ministry of Health expanded measles vaccination recommendations to the same age group in the three cities due to a transmission chain linked to virus importation, with investigations ongoing and the infection source currently unknown. Measles vaccine is free via SUS; dose zero is recommended for 6–11 month olds in areas with transmission. In 2026, 7.2 million MMR doses distributed; about 2.9 million administered. 2025 national coverage: 92.9% D1, 78.3% D2.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、麻疹の新規感染者を7人確認、計23人に
triage.triage_reason: 感染源不明の麻疹伝播チェーンが継続しており、保健省が対象地域でワクチン接種推奨を拡大するなど行政の関心が高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の輸入株による伝播チェーンが継続中。国全体でのポリオ・麻疹合同ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、行政の対応は活発だが外部支援の必要性は記述なし。

article.articleHeadline: 1.259 ca sốt xuất huyết, Hà Nội tăng cường kiểm tra phòng dịch trên toàn thành phố
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,259 dengue fever cases, Hanoi steps up disease-prevention inspections citywide.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Hanoi, Vietnam, rose to 1,259 cases as of Aug 5, 2026, across 115 of 126 communes/wards, signaling peak-season transmission. Hanoi’s Department of Health has formed 46 inspection teams to scrutinize 91 communes/wards with recent cases over the past two weeks, focusing on epidemiological surveillance, outbreak response, vector control, risk communication, and local readiness. On Aug 7, teams visited Gia Lam (6 cases this year) and Phu Dong (7 cases across seven villages). Gia Lam maintains 276 vector-control squads and 36 surveillance teams, conducting two environmental cleanups and trainings, with spraying readiness. Phu Dong organized 552 rapid-response members, 71 surveillance teams, and a 30-person spraying unit. In central wards Cu Nam and Hoan Kiem, Cu Nam reported extensive household checks (over 14,100), removal of 1,118 larval containers, release of ~5,000 larvivorous fish, and school spraying. Hoan Kiem documented 3 cases and 1 outbreak, with 901 staff/volunteers, 16,600 households checked, 1,266 larval containers addressed, and broad public-info efforts. Authorities call for continued surveillance and community-led environmental sanitation to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱1,259例、ハノイ市全域で防疫検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: ハノイでのデング熱季節性流行であり、当局が組織的に対応しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、通常の季節性感染症対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ハノイ市当局が独自に大規模な対応（検査班46チーム編成等）を行っており、国内対応能力は十分と見られる。デング熱は同地域の季節性流行であり、重症度や死亡者数に関する情報は記載がない。

article.articleHeadline: 七歲男童中甲流死亡　關日華：屬個別事件　盼勿礙市民對疫苗信心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven-year-old boy dies from H1N1 influenza; Kwan Ri-hua says it is an isolated incident and hopes it will not undermine public confidence in vaccines.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-08, Hong Kong reports a seven-year-old boy who died from influenza A (H1N1) with shock and encephalopathy; the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases president Dr. Kwan Ri-hua states the death is unfortunate and emphasizes not to downplay influenza, as some individuals' immune response can trigger rapid deterioration. The child had previously received a flu vaccine; Kwan says the incident is isolated and notes waning antibodies over time, urging analysis of congenital factors and possible viral mutations. He warns Hong Kong is facing a 'triple attack' of COVID-19, influenza, and RSV, with flu season ongoing. He adds that pediatric influenza-related severe cases requiring hospitalization are higher this year than last, and advises parents to vaccinate children before summer break ends.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳男児がA型インフルエンザ（H1N1）で死亡　關日華医師「個別事案であり、市民のワクチンへの信頼を損なわないよう望む」
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児のインフルエンザ重症死亡例が報告されたが、専門家は個別事案と説明。ただし今年は小児の重症入院例が昨年より増加しているとの言及があり、季節性インフルエンザの重症化傾向として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は香港での事例であり、対象国リストのChina(1814991)に含める。個別事例として専門家が説明しているが、今年の小児重症インフルエンザ入院例増加という広がりを持つ情報が含まれるため、続報の有無を注視するWATCH判定とした。
